title: ASPIRE: Asynchronous Batched Self-Speculative Decoding for Long-Context LLM Inference
summary: Long-context LLM inference is bottlenecked by attention, whose repeated KV-cache reads make decoding memory-bound. Self-speculative decoding alleviates this by drafting tokens with sparse attention and verifying them with full attention, but existing batched methods remain synchronized: all requests in a batch share a single draft-verify schedule, even though the optimal draft length varies widely across requests and changes dynamically within each request. We propose ASPIRE, a non-synchronized batched self-speculative decoding framework built on three components. First, a unified mixed forward allows drafting and verifying requests to coexist in the same batched forward pass, removing the need for global draft-verify phases. Second, a lightweight online speculation scheduler uses per-request acceptance-rate estimates and a batch-aware cost model to let each request independently choose when to verify. Third, an intra-draft refresh layer performs full attention at a single designated layer during drafting, updating the sparse context at every draft step to reduce staleness during drafting. Across three models and five reasoning and long-context benchmarks, ASPIRE achieves $1.70$-$4.58\times$ speedup in decoding throughput over autoregressive baselines and improves average speedup by approximately $27\%$ over the strongest prior self-speculative baselines.

AI.tldr: ASPIRE提出非同步批量自推测解码框架，通过统一混合前向、在线推测调度器和草稿内刷新层，让每个请求独立决定验证时机，在三个模型五个基准上实现1.70–4.58倍吞吐加速，较最强基线平均提升约27%。
AI.motivation: 长上下文LLM推理受注意力瓶颈限制，KV-cache重复读取使解码受内存带宽约束。自推测解码用稀疏注意力草稿、全注意力验证来缓解，但现有批量方法高度同步：批内所有请求共享同一草稿-验证调度，而最优草稿长度在请求间差异大且随请求动态变化，导致效率次优。
AI.method: ASPIRE由三部分组成：(1) 统一混合前向，使草稿与验证请求共存于同一次批量前向中，消除全局草稿-验证阶段划分；(2) 轻量在线推测调度器，基于每请求接受率估计与批感知代价模型，让各请求独立选择验证时机；(3) 草稿内刷新层，在草稿阶段于指定单层执行全注意力，每步更新稀疏上下文以降低草稿陈旧度。
AI.result: 在三个模型、五个推理与长上下文基准上，ASPIRE相较自回归基线实现1.70–4.58倍解码吞吐加速，平均加速比相较最强先前自推测基线提升约27%。
AI.conclusion: 打破批量同步约束、按请求自适应调度草稿与验证，并结合层内刷新缓解上下文陈旧，是提升长上下文自推测解码吞吐的有效途径。

title: EDCT-Bench: Uncovering Faithfulness Gaps in VLMs via Explanation-Driven Counterfactual Testing
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can produce Natural Language Explanations (NLEs) that sound plausible yet remain inconsistent with the visual evidence they cite. We present Explanation-Driven Counterfactual Testing (EDCT), an intervention-based protocol that extracts visual concepts cited in a model's explanation, applies verified minimal edits to them, and tests whether the resulting answer and explanation remain consistent with the edited image. Using this protocol, we create EDCT-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark spanning three complementary domains: knowledge-intensive visual question answering (OK-VQA), safety-critical driving (DriveLM), and 3D spatial reasoning (3DSRBench). Across the evaluated VLMs, EDCT reveals substantial faithfulness gaps, with models frequently producing responses inconsistent with verified visual changes. Finally, our fine-tuning study suggests that EDCT-generated counterfactuals provide high-impact training signals.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Explanation-Driven Counterfactual Testing（EDCT）协议，通过提取解释中引用的视觉概念并施加经核实的最小编辑，检验模型答案与解释在新图像下是否保持一致，并构建了跨三个领域的EDCT-Bench基准，揭示VLM存在显著忠实性缺口，且其生成的反事实样本可作为高价值训练信号。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）生成的自然语言解释（NLEs）虽听起来合理，却常与其所引用的视觉证据不一致，即解释忠实性不足；现有评测缺乏对解释所引用视觉概念的干预式验证手段，难以量化这种不一致性。
AI.method: 提出Explanation-Driven Counterfactual Testing（EDCT）：一种基于干预的协议，先从模型解释中提取被引用的视觉概念，对这些概念施加经过验证的最小编辑，再检测编辑后图像的模型答案与解释是否仍保持一致；并基于该协议构建EDCT-Bench基准，覆盖知识密集型VQA（OK-VQA）、安全关键驾驶（DriveLM）与3D空间推理（3DSRBench）三个互补领域；另开展微调研究评估所生成反事实样本的训练价值。
AI.result: 在所评估的VLM上，EDCT揭示出显著的忠实性缺口（faithfulness gaps），模型频繁给出与已验证视觉变化不一致的响应；微调研究表明EDCT生成的反事实样本能提供高影响力的训练信号。
AI.conclusion: EDCT为VLM解释忠实性提供了基于反事实干预的可验证评测范式，EDCT-Bench为多领域系统评估提供了基准，同时其反事实样本兼具诊断与训练增强的双重价值。

title: On-Device Commercial Intent Retrieval Under Size, Latency, and Privacy Constraints: A 3 MiB Retrieval System with Typed Egress Boundaries
comment: 36 pages, 40 tables, 1 figure. Evidence bundle (measurement ledgers and verification gates, no datasets): https://github.com/hyojunguy/ondevice-intent-evidence
summary: We study commercial intent inference that runs entirely on the user's device, under three constraints frozen before the work began: the downloaded payload under 3 MiB, Tier-0 inference under 20 ms at p95, and no raw text, content embedding, or stable identifier leaving the device. Under them we build a retrieval path over a 6,020-leaf commercial taxonomy: a static embedding table distilled from a Korean sentence transformer, quantized to 4 bits, no inference runtime. Our main result is where that constraint costs accuracy. On real Korean commerce text labelled by others (22,900 AI-Hub shopping reviews), mid-category top-5 on real product names is 75.0% against an 18.4% permutation baseline, but splits on one observable: a query containing some leaf name as a substring scores 83.5%, one containing none 45.2%. A generic 196.6x larger teacher seemed to localize the gap (+20.1 pp without an anchor, +0.1 with). That null was two effects cancelling: the same teacher fine-tuned on the student's own contrastive pairs reaches 0.8586 and beats the pure-encoder student by +10.6 pp with an anchor and +20.9 pp without. The cost is not uniform, but it is not free anywhere; where the anchor is absent, task adaptation buys the teacher nothing, so what the constrained encoder lacks there is capacity. The expensive regime is detectable on-device from the ranker's own score margin: declining the least confident fifth lifts the rest to 0.8296. A second axis we first reported, a manufacturer model code, does not survive source-category fixed effects (-4.0 pp, p=0.51); the anchor does (+13.0 pp). Payload is 2,942,652 bytes, all three library links measured. Tier-0 p95 is 4.431 and 3.670 ms on two iPhones (A14, A16) and 5.080 ms on a budget Android tablet (Snapdragon 695), all slower than three server CPUs on the same code. Taxonomy supervision is mostly synthetic Korean utterances.

AI.tldr: 该工作研究完全在设备端运行的商业意图推断，在预置三项约束（下载体积<3 MiB、Tier-0 p95延迟<20 ms、不上传原始文本/内容嵌入/稳定标识符）下构建了面向6,020叶节点商业分类体系的检索路径：使用从韩语句编码器蒸馏并量化为4 bit的静态嵌入表，无推理运行时。核心发现是约束带来的精度损失高度依赖可观测特征——查询中是否含叶节点名称子串，导致准确率从83.5%骤降至45.2%。
AI.motivation: 在隐私与资源受限的端侧场景（如手机、平板）中进行商业意图推断，需满足严格的体积、延迟与隐私约束。作者希望明确在这些约束下精度损失发生在何处、能否用更小的模型弥补，以及失败可否在设备端被检测并进行选择性拒答。
AI.method: 构建6,020叶商业分类上的静态嵌入表检索路径：从韩语句子Transformer蒸馏、4 bit量化、无推理运行时。在22,900条AI-Hub韩国购物评论（他人标注）上评估中类top-5。对比一个体积大196.6倍的通用教师模型，并将教师微调于学生自身的对比对。用工K者模型代码作为附加特征，用评分边际进行置信度检测与拒答。测量体积与三个硬件上的Tier-0 p95延迟。
AI.result: 中类top-5为75.0%，基线18.4%；查询含叶节点名称子串时83.5%，不含时45.2%。通用大教师几乎无增益（有锚+0.1 pp，无锚+20.1 pp），但对齐到学生对比对后可达0.8586，较纯编码器学生提升：有锚+10.6 pp、无锚+20.9 pp。制造商模型代码效应不稳健（-4.0 pp，p=0.51），锚可保留（+13.0 pp）。拒答最低置信的五分之一后剩余集合达0.8296。体积2,942,652字节；Tier-0 p95为A14 4.431 ms、A16 3.670 ms、Snapdragon 695 5.080 ms。
AI.conclusion: 约束下的精度损失并非均匀分布，而是集中在缺少叶节点锚点的查询上；该区域缺乏的是模型容量而非任务适配。设备端可依据排序器自身评分边际检测高成本情形并选择性拒答。制造商模型代码经固定效应控制后不成立，锚点特征成立。监督信号主要来自合成的韩语话语。

title: TACTICS: Taxonomy-Aware Intelligent Corpus Sampling for Machine Translation
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026 (The Eleventh Conference in Machine Translation 2026 - WMT2026)
summary: Large-scale machine-translation (MT) systems are typically evaluated on random samples from a corpus whose distributional composition is an artifact of how it was assembled. Such a sample inherits the phenomena the collection happens to contain rather than the full space a system must handle, spanning rule-governed conventions (terminology, punctuation, currency formatting) and context-dependent phenomena (tone, honorifics, document-level coherence), and thus provides no coverage guarantee for assessing robustness. We propose TACTICS (Taxonomy-Aware Coverage-opTimized Intelligent Corpus Sampling), which recasts coverage as an explicit objective. TACTICS induces a hierarchical taxonomy from a locale style guide, classifies segments against it, and selects a fixed-budget subset jointly optimizing coverage of rare categories, document-level coherence, and distributional fidelity to the full corpus. Applied to MT evaluation across four translation directions, TACTICS improves coverage of rare categories over lexical and embedding-based selection. By targeting the phenomena that separate systems, TACTICS makes a fixed evaluation budget go further, recovering the true system ranking from far fewer segments than random sampling wherever a real quality gap exists and never signaling a difference where none exists.

AI.tldr: 提出TACTICS方法，将机器翻译评测的语料采样重构为显式的覆盖率优化问题，通过从本地化风格指南归纳层级分类体系并分类语料片段，在固定预算下联合优化稀有类别覆盖、篇章级连贯性和分布保真度，从而在更少样本下恢复真实的系统排序。
AI.motivation: 大规模机器翻译系统通常在语料库的随机样本上评测，而该语料库的分布构成是语料组装方式的产物（人为痕迹）。随机样本只能继承语料恰好包含的现象，而非系统必须处理的完整空间——既包括规则驱动的约定（术语、标点、货币格式），也包括上下文依赖的现象（语气、敬语、篇章级连贯性），因此无法为鲁棒性评估提供覆盖率保证。
AI.method: TACTICS（Taxonomy-Aware Coverage-opTimized Intelligent Corpus Sampling）将覆盖率作为显式优化目标：1）从本地化风格指南中归纳出层级分类体系（hierarchical taxonomy）；2）将语料片段对照该分类体系进行分类；3）在固定预算下选择一个子集，联合优化稀有类别覆盖率、篇章级连贯性以及与完整语料的分布保真度。
AI.result: 在四个翻译方向的机器翻译评测中，TACTICS在稀有类别覆盖率上优于基于词汇和基于嵌入的选择方法。通过瞄准区分系统性能的现象，TACTICS使固定评测预算发挥更大作用：在存在真实质量差距的情况下，用远少于随机采样的片段即可恢复真实系统排序；在不存在差距时也从不错误地指示差异（无误报）。
AI.conclusion: 将覆盖作为显式优化目标的采样策略（TACTICS）能显著提升机器翻译评测的预算效率与鲁棒性，兼顾稀有现象覆盖、篇章级连贯和分布保真，从而更可靠地还原系统真实排序。

title: Encoder Awakening via Adapters: Effective Domain-Adaptive Fine-tuning of Speech-LLMs
comment: Camera ready for IEEE SLT 2026 (figure1 revised)
summary: Speech Large Language Models (Speech-LLMs), typically built from a pre-trained speech encoder, a modality projector, and an LLM fine-tuned with Low-Rank Adapters (LoRA), have shown strong Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) performance on general-domain speech. However, adapting them to domain-shifted speech, such as child or dialectal speech, remains challenging under limited target-domain data. Given the dominant role of the LLM in Speech-LLMs, with cross-entropy loss applied only at the LLM output, the speech encoder may receive insufficient adaptation to new acoustic conditions. In this paper, we propose Encoder Awakening via Adapters (EAVA), a simple yet effective domain-adaptive fine-tuning method for Speech-LLM-based ASR. First, lightweight adapters are inserted into each encoder layer and trained exclusively, enabling target-domain acoustic knowledge to be incorporated into the encoder while preserving its pre-trained knowledge. Second, the full model is jointly fine-tuned on the target domain with LoRA applied to the LLM. Experiments on three domain-shifted ASR datasets, covering child and dialectal speech, show that EAVA consistently outperforms vanilla fine-tuning and other baselines, achieving new state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 提出EAVA方法，通过在语音编码器各层插入轻量适配器并联合LoRA微调LLM，实现Speech-LLM在领域偏移语音（儿童、方言）上的自适应ASR提升。
AI.motivation: Speech-LLM（语音编码器+模态投影器+LoRA微调的LLM）在通用领域ASR表现优异，但在目标域数据有限的情况下，向儿童语音或方言等发生领域偏移的语音迁移时仍面临挑战。由于交叉熵损失仅施加在LLM输出端且LLM占主导地位，语音编码器对新声学条件的适配不足。
AI.method: EAVA（Encoder Awakening via Adapters）：第一步在编码器每一层插入轻量适配器并仅训练这些适配器，使目标域声学知识注入编码器，同时保留其预训练知识；第二步在全模型上对目标域进行联合微调，并对LLM应用LoRA。
AI.result: 在三个领域偏移ASR数据集（涵盖儿童语音与方言语音）上，EAVA一致优于普通微调及其他基线方法，取得新的最优（SOTA）性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式“唤醒”语音编码器的领域适应能力并结合LLM的LoRA联合微调，可在目标域数据有限条件下有效提升Speech-LLM的领域偏移ASR性能。

title: Modeling the Developmental Shift in Telicity Acquisition
summary: Acquiring telicity, which is the distinction between bounded (e.g., ate an apple) and unbounded (e.g., ate apples) events, requires first language (L1) learners to map surface-level and semantic cues to abstract event structures, but the computational trajectory of this mapping is not well understood. We introduce a Difference in Surprisal method that uses GPT2 token surprisal over paired temporal adverbial diagnostics (in an hour versus for an hour) to automatically label telicity across English CHILDES corpora, validated against expert linguist judgments. Using these labels, we train diagnostic logistic regression classifiers on 12 syntactic and lexical semantic features to compare how child speech and child-directed speech encode telicity. The two models diverge: the child model reaches near perfect accuracy through a single deterministic cue, the presence of a post-verbal determiner, while the adult model relies more heavily on verb class and other lexical semantic features, with the determiner cue neutralized. This trajectory supports Syntactic Bootstrapping: learners first exploit high-frequency structural cues as a scaffold to bootstrap, before developing fully compositional, verb-based event structures.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"惊讶度差异法"，利用GPT2的token surprisal对时间状语诊断（in an hour/for an hour）自动标注英语CHILDES语料中动词的有界性（telicity），并训练逻辑回归分类器对比儿童言语与成人输入如何编码telicity。结果显示儿童模型依赖单一确定性线索（动词后限定词），而成人模型更依赖动词语义类别，支持句法启动假说。
AI.motivation: 儿童习得telicity需要将表层与语义线索映射到抽象事件结构，但这一映射的计算轨迹尚不清楚；现有研究缺乏大规模、自动化的telicity标注手段，难以系统比较儿童与成人在该结构上的编码差异。
AI.method: 提出"惊讶度差异法"（Difference in Surprisal），以GPT2对配对时间状语诊断（in an hour vs. for an hour）的token surprisal自动为英语CHILDES语料标注telicity，并与语言学家专家判断进行验证。基于标注结果，在12个句法与词汇语义特征上训练诊断性逻辑回归分类器，分别建模儿童言语与儿童导向言语对telicity的编码。
AI.result: 两个模型出现分化：儿童模型通过单一确定性线索——动词后限定词的存在——即可达到近乎完美的准确率；成人模型则更依赖动词类别及其他词汇语义特征，且限定词线索被中和（不起作用）。
AI.conclusion: 该发展轨迹支持句法启动（Syntactic Bootstrapping）假说：学习者先利用高频结构线索作为脚手架进行启动，随后才发展出完全组合性的、基于动词的事件结构。

title: A Calibrated Instrument for Measuring How Inference Optimizations Affect Output Quality
comment: 23 Pages. 6 tables in main text,5 tables in appendices. Code, prompts, and result files at https://github.com/jerrykaplan/Calibrated-Instrument
summary: Large language model optimization is an active research area, spanning quantization of model weights, early-exit methods for skipping layers, and speculative decoding. Each track uses its own quality measures, typically an idiosyncratic benchmark score. Few approach the measurement precision required by other scientific disciplines. We propose a rigorous methodology for measuring output quality, suitable for cross-system and cross-technique comparison. We score outputs with an LLM as a judge, but calibrate the judge formally: we compare its scores on two ordinary runs of a model given the same prompts, verifying that it shows no systematic preference between statistically equivalent outputs and measuring its per-sample noise. Each design also includes a 'null' condition, provably identical in distribution to the unmodified model, whose measured difference must be zero. With this one instrument we measure several acceleration techniques on the same prompts, so their quality costs can be compared. Perceived quality proves highly dependent on the domain of discourse. A 4-bit model was indistinguishable from its 16-bit original down to our design's +/-0.3-point resolution, in English prose and Chinese alike. At 3-bit precision the same prompts lost 0.5 points in English prose, 0.9 in Chinese, and 1.1 on multi-step math; early exit that cost 0.7 points on prose cost 2.5 on math, cutting correctly solved problems from 19 of 27 to 6. The pattern held for models from Alibaba and from Meta, but not its magnitude: the same quantizer cost Meta's model 1.8 points where it cost Alibaba's 0.7. A model's certainty about a token predicts how likely it is to differ from the full model's choice, but not how much that difference affects judged quality, so acceptance rules relying on certainty cannot distinguish errors that matter from errors that don't.

AI.tldr: 提出一种用LLM判官并形式化校准的严格输出质量测量方法，包含零假设条件与逐样本噪声估计，可在同一提示下跨系统、跨技术比较加速技术的质量代价；结果显示质量损失高度依赖语域（英语散文、中文、多步数学差异显著），且模型间损失幅度不同。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM优化研究（权重量化、提前退出、推测解码等）各用自家基准分数衡量质量，缺乏跨学科级别的测量精度，导致不同系统与技术之间无法可靠比较质量代价。
AI.method: 以LLM作为判官，但进行形式化校准：比较同一模型在相同提示下两次普通运行的得分，验证其对统计等价输出无系统性偏好，并测量逐样本噪声；每个设计加入"零"条件（分布上可证明与原模型相同），其测得差异须为零。用这一统一工具在相同提示上测量多种加速技术。
AI.result: 质量感知高度依赖语域。4-bit模型在英语散文与中文上与原16-bit模型在本设计±0.3分分辨率下不可区分；3-bit时同样提示在英语散文损失0.5分、中文0.9分、多步数学1.1分；提前退出在散文上损失0.7分，在数学上损失2.5分，正确题数从27题中的19题降至6题。该模式在阿里与Meta模型上均成立但幅度不同：同一量化器使Meta模型损失1.8分，而阿里模型损失0.7分。模型对某token的确定性可预测其与全模型选择不同的可能性，但不能预测该差异对评判质量的影响程度，因此依赖确定性的接受规则无法区分重要与不重要的错误。
AI.conclusion: 通过形式化校准的LLM判官可实现跨系统、跨技术的严格质量比较；质量代价随语域剧烈变化，不同模型的敏感度不同，且基于token确定性的接受规则不能区分对质量有实质影响的错误，故加速技术的质量评估必须按语域分别进行并采用校准测量。

title: Newer Is Not Fairer: Gender Stereotyping in Text-to-Image AI Across Model Generations
summary: Text-to-image generative models are widely used in professional and creative settings, yet how they represent gender across occupations -- and whether newer models are fairer -- remains poorly understood across multiple generations. We evaluate gender representation across 20 occupations, 5 prompt templates, and 4 Stable Diffusion model generations (SD 1.5, SD 2.1, SDXL, SD 3 Medium), generating 8,000 images with n = 100 per occupation-model cell (5 prompts x 20 images), and classifying all with DeepFace. Across the 8,000 open-source images, 76.4% show male subjects (95% CI [75.1%, 78.7%], p < 2.2 x 10^-16, Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted). More strikingly, 57.6% of images for historically female-coded occupations show male subjects (raw p = 3.43 x 10^-22, BH-adjusted p = 1.71 x 10^-21). All nine significant tests reported in this paper survive BH correction across 10 tests. When compared against U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics workforce data, models underrepresent women by 20-46pp on average, with particularly large deviations for near gender-balanced occupations: scientist (48% female in BLS, 82-99% male in model outputs) and cleaner (46% female in BLS, 80-92% male in outputs). Model generations do not improve steadily: bias worsens from SD 1.5 to SDXL before partially recovering in SD 3 Medium. A preliminary comparison with GPT-image-1 on five occupations suggests lower bias than open-source models, though the practical effect is small (Cramer's V = 0.080) and the comparison is exploratory. No model achieves gender parity.

AI.tldr: 对4代Stable Diffusion模型在20种职业、5种提示模板下生成8000张图像，用DeepFace分类性别，发现普遍存在男性过度表征，且偏见随代际并非单调改善。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像生成模型已广泛用于专业与创作场景，但其在职业维度上的性别表征方式、以及新版本模型是否更公平，在多代模型间仍缺乏系统理解。
AI.method: 覆盖20种职业、5种提示模板、4代Stable Diffusion（SD 1.5、SD 2.1、SDXL、SD 3 Medium），每个"职业-模型"单元生成n=100张（5提示×20张），共8000张图像，全部用DeepFace进行性别分类；并与美国劳工统计局（BLS）劳动力数据进行对比。统计采用Benjamini-Hochberg多重检验校正；另对5种职业与GPT-image-1做了初步探索性比较。
AI.result: 8000张开源图像中76.4%为男性（95% CI [75.1%, 78.7%]，p < 2.2×10^-16，BH校正）；历史上女性编码职业中57.6%的图像仍为男性（原始p=3.43×10^-22，BH校正后p=1.71×10^-21）。论文中全部9项显著检验在10项检验的BH校正后依然显著。相对BLS数据，模型平均低估女性20–46个百分点，性别较均衡的职业偏差尤为突出：scientist（BLS女性48%，模型输出82–99%为男性）、cleaner（BLS女性46%，输出80–92%为男性）。代际表现非单调改善：偏见从SD 1.5到SDXL加重，至SD 3 Medium部分回升。
AI.conclusion: 没有任何模型实现性别均等；与开源模型相比，GPT-image-1在5种职业上的初步比较显示偏见较低，但实际效应量很小（Cramer's V = 0.080）且属探索性结论。性别偏见问题在多代生成模型中持续存在且未随版本迭代稳定缓解。

title: SG-Mamba: Sparse Graph-Guided Mamba for Audio-Visual Speech Enhancement
summary: Lightweight audio-visual speech enhancement (AVSE) models face a critical trade-off between computational efficiency and cross-modal alignment accuracy. While simple concatenation lacks relational expressiveness, dense cross-attention incurs computational overhead and is prone to unreliable cross-modal correspondence under strong acoustic interference. We propose Sparse Graph-Guided Mamba (SG-Mamba), a lightweight AVSE framework that integrates a sparse heterogeneous graph with a linear-complexity Mamba backbone. The graph explicitly models modality-specific relations through content-adaptive attention and cross-frame audio-visual connections, while Mamba captures long-range temporal context. We further introduce an audio skip connection to preserve spectral detail without sacrificing noise suppression. Evaluated on LRS3, SG-Mamba achieves competitive or superior performance against strong lightweight baselines and reaches 13.091 dB SI-SDR under noise-only condition. It also remains robust in cluttered multi-speaker conditions with a competitive cost of 3.45 G MACs (or 6.90 G FLOPs). Results on VoxCeleb2 further suggest that explicit structural priors improve robustness, generalizability, and computational efficiency in lightweight AVSE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Sparse Graph-Guided Mamba (SG-Mamba)，一种轻量级音视频语音增强框架，将稀疏异质图与线性复杂度的Mamba主干相结合，在保持低计算成本的同时提升跨模态对齐与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 轻量级音视频语音增强(AVSE)模型面临计算效率与跨模态对齐精度之间的关键权衡：简单拼接缺乏关系表达能力，而密集交叉注意力带来计算开销，且在强声学干扰下跨模态对应关系不可靠。
AI.method: 提出SG-Mamba框架：1) 用稀疏异质图通过内容自适应注意力与跨帧音视频连接显式建模模态特定关系；2) 采用线性复杂度的Mamba主干捕获长程时序上下文；3) 引入音频跳跃连接以在抑制噪声的同时保留频谱细节。
AI.result: 在LRS3上，SG-Mamba相对强轻量级基线取得相当或更优的性能，纯噪声条件下达到13.091 dB SI-SDR；在嘈杂多人说话条件下保持鲁棒，计算成本为3.45 G MACs(6.90 G FLOPs)。在VoxCeleb2上的结果进一步表明显式结构先验提升了轻量级AVSE的鲁棒性、泛化性与计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 显式结构先验（稀疏异质图）结合线性复杂度序列建模，可有效缓解轻量级AVSE的效率-对齐权衡问题，在多种声学条件下实现性能与效率的良好平衡。

title: Gaze as Evidence for Common Grounding: A Cross-Corpus Analysis of MapTask and MUNDEX
comment: 16 pages, 17 tables, 2 figures; accepted to the MINT workshop at EMNLP 2026 (oral presentation)
summary: In collaborative tasks with asymmetric information, participants coordinate their understanding through interaction. We ask whether gaze provides evidence about grounding across two such tasks. Working from discrete behavioral annotations, we map HCRC MapTask (Anderson et al., 1991) and MUNDEX (Türk et al., 2023) into a shared partner/task/away vocabulary and compute gaze features around task-relevant dialogue units. In both corpora, aligned reference interpretations (MapTask) and UND (understood) judgments (MUNDEX) are associated with more task-directed gaze and with less partner-directed gaze, lower gaze entropy, and fewer gaze transitions. The associations are clearest for the participant leading the task: in giver-produced references, and in explainer judgments, which also co-vary with the explainee's gaze. In same-speaker MapTask reference chains, the speaker's gaze entropy is lower at the mention where a previously non-aligned referent becomes aligned. The best gaze feature groups improve modestly over controls under grouped cross-validation: temporal features in MapTask and raw proportions in MUNDEX. Because effects are small and several weaken when recurring participants rather than dialogues are the unit of inference, we treat gaze as one contributing cue to grounding, to be interpreted alongside task and dialogue context.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验目光（gaze）能否作为协作任务中"共同基础/grounding"的证据，将HCRC MapTask与MUNDEX两个语料映射到统一的伙伴/任务/离开词汇表，计算任务相关对话单元周围的目光特征。结果显示：对齐的指称解释与UND判断伴随更多任务导向目光、更少伙伴导向目光、更低目光熵和更少目光转换，且在任务主导者身上最明显；但效应较小且部分在更换推断单元后减弱，故目光应被视为grounding的一个贡献性线索。
AI.motivation: 在信息不对称的协作任务中，参与者通过互动建立共同理解（grounding）。作者希望探究目光是否能作为grounding的证据，并检验这一关联能否跨两个不同语料（MapTask与MUNDEX）稳健复现，从而判断目光作为沟通线索的普遍性。
AI.method: 基于离散行为标注，将HCRC MapTask（Anderson et al., 1991）与MUNDEX（Türk et al., 2023）映射到一个共享的"伙伴/任务/离开"（partner/task/away）词汇表，并围绕任务相关对话单元计算目光特征（如任务导向目光、伙伴导向目光、目光熵、目光转换等）。随后分析这些目光特征与对齐指称解释（MapTask）、UND（被理解）判断（MUNDEX）的关联，并通过分组交叉验证评估目光特征组的预测增益。
AI.result: 在两个语料中，对齐的指称解释（MapTask）与UND判断（MUNDEX）均与更多任务导向目光、更少伙伴导向目光、更低目光熵及更少目光转换相关。这些关联在任务主导者身上最清晰：在giver产生的指称中，以及在explainer的判断中（后者还与explainee的目光共变）。在MapTask同一说话者的指称链中，先前未对齐的指称变为对齐的那次提及处，说话者目光熵更低。在分组交叉验证下，最佳目光特征组相较控制变量仅有适度提升（MapTask中为时序特征，MUNDEX中为原始比例）。
AI.conclusion: 由于效应较小，且当推断单元从对话改为反复出现的参与者时部分效应减弱，作者将目光视为grounding的一个贡献性线索，而非独立决定因素，需结合任务与对话语境共同解释。

title: IRIS: Implicit Rendering Matters for Pose-Free Novel View Synthesis
summary: Novel view synthesis from unposed multi-view images remains challenging, as the model must jointly learn scene representations and camera parameters without pose supervision. Existing approaches largely fall into two extremes: implicit latent-space rendering is flexible and easy to optimize, but often yields weakly grounded camera estimation; explicit 3D representations provide stronger geometric grounding, but introduce heavier parameterization and more fragile optimization. In this paper, we present IRIS, a fully self-supervised framework that provides a practical middle ground between these two paradigms. Instead of decoding free latent tokens or reconstructing fully explicit 3D primitives, IRIS represents the scene as a latent neural field and renders novel views by querying this field under self-predicted cameras. Specifically, projected features from reference views are aggregated at sampled 3D points to form point-wise latent features, which are then composed along target rays for rendering. This design preserves the flexibility and optimization stability of implicit modeling, while introducing stronger geometric structure than unconstrained latent rendering. Extensive experiments show that IRIS achieves strong novel view synthesis quality with competitive pose accuracy under fully self-supervised learning. Our project page: https://leo-frank.github.io/IRIS

AI.tldr: 提出IRIS，一种完全自监督的无位姿多视图新视角合成框架，将场景表示为潜在神经场，在自预测相机下查询该场进行渲染，兼顾隐式建模的优化稳定性与显式表示的几何约束。
AI.motivation: 无位姿多视图新视角合成需在无位姿监督下联合学习场景表示与相机参数。现有方法存在两难：隐式潜在空间渲染灵活、易优化，但相机估计缺乏几何支撑；显式3D表示几何约束强，但参数化更重、优化更脆弱。
AI.method: IRIS不直接解码自由潜在token，也不重建完整显式3D基元，而是将场景建模为潜在神经场。具体地，将参考视图的投影特征在采样3D点上聚合为逐点潜在特征，再沿目标射线合成用于渲染；渲染在自预测相机下进行。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，在完全自监督设定下，IRIS在新视角合成质量上表现强劲，同时具备有竞争力的位姿估计精度。
AI.conclusion: IRIS在隐式潜在渲染与显式3D表示之间提供了实用折中：保留隐式建模的灵活性与优化稳定性，同时引入比无约束潜在渲染更强的几何结构。

title: SetPlanner: A Lightweight Plug-in Point-Set Planner for Frozen SAM
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to IEEE ICASSP 2027
summary: Segment Anything Models provide reusable priors, yet they require user prompts and cannot support fully automatic instrument segmentation. Automatic prompting is difficult for thin, articulated, reflective, and partly occluded tools, where several configurations can be valid. We formulate automatic prompting as lightweight point-set planning and isolate the point source under a frozen pathway. To this end, we present SetPlanner, a 1.52M-parameter plug-in point-set planner for frozen SAM. The plug-in preserves SAM's point-prompt interface and enables reuse across backbones. SetPlanner plans complete unordered K-point sets from geometry-aware targets with a permutation-aware conditional flow. SAM decodes eight candidates; their consensus readout yields a ground-truth-free prediction. Across three endoscopic datasets, SetPlanner wins all six transfer routes over a LoRA-adapted system. Under our frozen-pathway protocol, SetPlanner reaches 0.934 Dice on Kvasir-Instrument and recovers 96% of a 44.4-point localization gap, while candidate disagreement ranks low-Dice cases at AUROC 0.969.

AI.tldr: 提出SetPlanner——一个1.52M参数的即插即用点集规划器，为冻结SAM自动生成点提示，实现全自动器械分割，在三个内镜数据集上六个迁移路径全部优于LoRA方案。
AI.motivation: Segment Anything Models提供可复用的先验，但依赖用户提示，无法支持全自动器械分割。对细长、铰接、反光且部分遮挡的器械而言，自动提示困难，且存在多种有效配置。作者将自动提示建模为轻量级点集规划问题，并在冻结路径下隔离点来源。
AI.method: SetPlanner是一个1.52M参数的即插即用点集规划器，用于冻结的SAM，保留SAM的点提示接口并支持跨骨干复用。它从几何感知目标出发，以置换感知的条件流规划完整无序的K点集；SAM解码八个候选，通过一致性读出得到无需真值的预测。
AI.result: 在三个内镜数据集上，SetPlanner在全部六个迁移路径上均胜过LoRA适配系统。在冻结路径协议下，Kvasir-Instrument上Dice达0.934，恢复了44.4点定位差距中的96%；候选分歧对低Dice案例的排序AUROC为0.969。
AI.conclusion: SetPlanner以极轻量参数实现冻结SAM的自动点提示与全自动器械分割，跨数据集迁移优于LoRA适配方案，且候选一致性可作为无真值的可靠性指标，为冻结基础模型的自动提示提供可行范式。

title: CoAtNet-DeepMoE: A Convolution-Attention Hybrid with DeepSeek Mixture-of-Experts for Parameter-Efficient Tomato Disease Classification
summary: The world population is growing rapidly, and technology is improving in parallel. Meeting the huge demand for food for these 7 billion people not only depends on increasing food production but also on reducing food loss. Crop losses due to disease affect both the food supply and the financial and economic stability of a country. Tomatoes are among the top food-producing crops globally, and a significant portion of this production is lost due to disease. People have used Machine Learning techniques for feature extraction and early diagnosis of tomato diseases, and nowadays, Deep Learning-based models are widely used for disease recognition. However, most existing models are highly parameter-intensive, which increases the time required for training and inference. As a result, while lightweight models are more suitable for user-friendly applications, they often show a reduction in performance. To balance performance and model size, we propose CoAtNet-DeepMoE, a Convolution-Attention hybrid architecture for rich feature extraction, further enhanced with a DeepSeek Mixture of Experts to substantially reduce the number of parameters without sacrificing accuracy. We evaluate our model on both balanced and imbalanced datasets from Kaggle and PlantVillage, demonstrating robustness and achieving 99.80% accuracy, 99.80% precision, 99.80% recall, and 99.80% F1-score on Kaggle, and 99.83% accuracy, 99.85% precision, 99.76% recall, and 99.80% F1-score on PlantVillage, representing state-of-the-art performance with only 2.47M parameters. The source code will be available at https://github.com/nadimbrur/CoAt-MoE.

AI.tldr: 提出CoAtNet-DeepMoE混合架构，结合卷积-注意力与DeepSeek专家混合机制，在仅有2.47M参数下实现番茄病害识别的最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 全球人口增长带来巨大粮食需求，减少病害导致的作物损失至关重要。番茄是主要粮食作物，病害造成大量减产。现有深度学习病害识别模型参数庞大，训练与推理耗时长；而轻量模型虽适合应用部署，却往往性能下降。因此需要兼顾性能与模型规模。
AI.method: 提出CoAtNet-DeepMoE架构：采用卷积-注意力（Convolution-Attention）混合结构进行丰富特征提取，并引入DeepSeek专家混合（Mixture of Experts）机制，在保持精度的前提下大幅降低参数量。在Kaggle和PlantVillage的平衡与不平衡数据集上进行评估。
AI.result: Kaggle数据集：准确率99.80%、精确率99.80%、召回率99.80%、F1值99.80%；PlantVillage数据集：准确率99.83%、精确率99.85%、召回率99.76%、F1值99.80%。仅用2.47M参数即达到最先进性能，且在不平衡数据集上展现鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: CoAtNet-DeepMoE有效平衡了性能与模型规模，以极低参数量实现番茄病害识别的最先进水平，适合轻量级、用户友好的应用部署。源代码将发布于 https://github.com/nadimbrur/CoAt-MoE。

title: Correlation-Guided Encoder Selection for Multi-Encoder Large Audio-Language Models
summary: Multi-encoder fusion extends Large Audio-Language Models (LALMs) beyond speech-centric recognition, but selecting encoders via intuition or exhaustive search often introduces redundant representations and inflates an already constrained compute budget. We propose CUES (Correlation-gUided Encoder Selection), a lightweight heuristic that estimates complementarity through task- and category-level Pearson correlations between encoders' performance profiles, scoring a candidate set from single-encoder evaluations alone--without fusion training during selection. Evaluated on the XARES-LLM benchmark with a frozen SmolLM2-135M backbone (LoRA-adapted) via five-fold cross-validation, CUES consistently identifies the same configuration per track from held-out development splits alone, without using test data for selection. For the broad Track~A suite, CUES selects a cross-family trio (Whisper-medium, mHuBERT-147, and Dasheng-base), achieving a 4.3% relative gain over Whisper-medium (0.771 vs. 0.739). For Track~B text generation, it re-anchors on a focused, speech-only pair (mHuBERT-147 and WavLM-base-plus) and actively abstains from adding a divergent encoder, outperforming mHuBERT-147 by 6.3% (0.589 vs. 0.554). Rather than a failure to scale, this divergence is consistent with a diversity--interference trade-off that CUES navigates per track from correlation signals alone: across the evaluated pool, added cross-family diversity tends toward an inverted-U on broad audio tasks but toward steady degradation on text generation, which favors a focused, speech-anchored set.

AI.tldr: 提出CUES——一种基于任务级与类别级Pearson相关性估计编码器互补性的轻量启发式编码器选择方法，仅用单编码器评测即可评分候选组合，无需融合训练；在XARES-LLM基准上稳定选出各赛道最优配置。
AI.motivation: 多编码器融合可扩展LALM能力，但凭直觉或穷举选择编码器会引入冗余表示并加重算力负担。
AI.method: CUES通过编码器性能画像之间的任务级与类别级Pearson相关估计互补性，仅依据单编码器评测对候选集合打分，选择过程不进行融合训练；在XARES-LLM基准、冻结的SmolLM2-135M骨干（LoRA适配）上以五折交叉验证评估，仅用留出的开发集选型。
AI.result: Track A：选出跨家族三元组（Whisper-medium、mHuBERT-147、Dasheng-base），相对Whisper-medium取得4.3%相对提升（0.771 vs. 0.739）。Track B文本生成：聚焦为纯语音二元组（mHuBERT-147、WavLM-base-plus），主动放弃加入高差异编码器，相对mHuBERT-147提升6.3%（0.589 vs. 0.554）。
AI.conclusion: 该分化并非扩展失败，而与多样性—干扰权衡一致：在广谱音频任务上跨家族多样性呈倒U形，在文本生成上则持续退化、更偏好聚焦的语音锚定集合；CUES仅凭相关性信号即可按赛道导航该权衡。

title: AgroBench: A Reproducible Multimodal Benchmark for Weakly Supervised Crop Yield Learning from County Statistics and Pixel Observations
summary: Reliable agricultural yield statistics are typically reported at coarse administrative scales, whereas modern geospatial machine learning methods require spatially explicit, pixel level supervision. This mismatch has limited the development of large-scale benchmarks for crop yield learning using multimodal Earth observation data. A reproducible benchmark, AgroBench, is presented for transforming publicly available U.S. county level crop yield statistics into weakly supervised pixel-level crop time series. Each crop pixel time series is paired with a county-level yield value as a weak supervisory signal rather than a directly measured pixel-level yield label. Our geospatial data generation pipeline integrates USDA crop yield statistics with crop-specific land cover masks, Sentinel 2 multispectral imagery, Sentinel-1 synthetic aperture radar observations, climatic variables, and terrain information to produce temporally aligned multimodal sequences describing individual crop pixels throughout the growing season. The resulting benchmark contains over 13 million observations from 788,654 unique crop pixels spanning 5,107 county year combinations across eight growing seasons (2017 to 2024) for five major U.S. crops. To facilitate standardized evaluation, we establish a crop yield prediction benchmark using a Leave-One-Year-Out evaluation protocol and provide baseline results using representative machine learning models. By releasing the complete data generation pipeline, benchmark dataset, and evaluation protocol, AgroBench provides a reproducible foundation for future research in weakly supervised learning, multimodal remote sensing, spatiotemporal modeling, and geospatial foundation models for agriculture.

AI.tldr: AgroBench：将美国县级作物产量统计转化为弱监督像素级作物时序的基准数据集，含1300万+观测、5种作物、2017–2024八个生长季，并提供评估协议与基线。
AI.motivation: 可靠产量统计通常仅在粗粒度行政区尺度发布，而现代地理空间机器学习需要像素级空间显式监督，二者尺度不匹配，导致缺乏大规模、多模态的作物产量学习基准。
AI.method: 构建可复现的地理空间数据生成流程，将USDA县级产量统计与作物类型土地覆盖掩膜、Sentinel-2多光谱、Sentinel-1 SAR、气候变量与地形信息对齐融合，为每个作物像素生成生长季内的多模态时序，并以县级产量作为弱监督标签；采用留一年（Leave-One-Year-Out）评估协议并给出代表性机器学习模型基线。
AI.result: 数据集包含788,654个唯一作物像素、5107个县-年组合、8个生长季（2017–2024）、5种主要美国作物，超过1300万条观测；建立了标准化评估基准与基线结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过公开完整数据生成流程、基准数据集与评估协议，AgroBench为弱监督学习、多模态遥感、时空建模及农业地理空间基础模型研究提供了可复现的基础。

title: Exact semantic readout from compressed vector representations
summary: We characterize when compressed vector representations admit exact linear or affine readouts of a finite lexicon's truth conditions: one fixed map per predicate, sending each entity vector to the corresponding truth vector. A necessary and sufficient row-space condition determines existence; the augmented truth matrix has rank r, giving minimum dimension r in the linear case, and r-1 in the affine. Exact readouts return values in a shared truth basis on which Boolean connectives act unchanged; separability alone requires an intervening threshold. For binary relations, exact bilinear readout of identity or strict total order requires linearly independent entity vectors. Experiments with GloVe and word2vec distinguish exact affine recovery, linear separability, and held-out prediction: most predicates are strictly separable, but none admits an exact affine readout from the pretrained embeddings. Supervised transductive training attains exact affine recovery to numerical precision at every tested dimension meeting the bound. At the embeddings' original dimension, geometries constrained to exact linear recovery retain 98-99 percent of the pretrained variance on the feature norms, and 80-83 percent on the WordNet lexicon.

AI.tldr: 本文刻画了压缩词向量何时能通过精确线性或仿射读出恢复有限词库的真值条件，给出充要的行空间条件与最小维度（线性 r、仿射 r−1），并用 GloVe/word2vec 实验区分精确仿射恢复、线性可分性与留出预测。
AI.motivation: 探究压缩向量表示是否保留了谓词真值条件的线性/仿射可解码信息，即是否存在固定的每谓词映射把实体向量映为真值向量，从而厘清"语义可线性读出"的理论边界。
AI.method: 建立行空间充要条件：增广真值矩阵秩为 r 时，线性情形最小维度为 r，仿射为 r−1；精确读出要求共享真值基，布尔联结词在该基上不变，可分性则需额外阈值。二元关系上证明恒等或严格全序的精确双线性读出需实体向量线性无关。在 GloVe 与 word2vec 上做仿射恢复、线性可分与留出预测的对照实验，并进行有监督转导训练。
AI.result: 大多数谓词严格线性可分，但预训练嵌入均不支持精确仿射读出；有监督转导训练在满足维度下界的所有测试维度上达到数值精度的精确仿射恢复；在原始维度下，约束为精确线性恢复的几何在特征规范上保留 98–99% 预训练方差，在 WordNet 词库上保留 80–83%。
AI.conclusion: 精确线性/仿射读出受秩条件严格约束，预训练嵌入天然缺乏精确仿射可解码性，但可通过转导训练以极小方差损失实现，说明线性结构可被注入而基本保留下游几何信息。

title: Position Anchor Tuning: Towards Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Point Cloud Transformers
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) has recently emerged as a pivotal research direction for adapting pre-trained point cloud transformers to diverse downstream tasks. Although existing methods achieve excellent fine-tuning performance with high parameter efficiency, they ignore inference efficiency. To tackle this problem, a novel PEFT method termed position anchor tuning (PAT) is proposed in this paper. As multi-head attention (MHA) and feed-forward network (FFN) are computation-heavy blocks in pre-trained transformers, PAT decreases their computational cost through token aggregation-expansion pairs. Each pair comprises a token aggregation module (TAM) and a token expansion module (TEM). For MHA and FFN blocks, TAMs extract representative tokens from their input tokens based on position anchors in 3D space. These extracted tokens, rather than the original input tokens, are processed by the blocks, thereby reducing the number of tokens involved in computation. Then, TEMs propagate the learned representations back to the original input tokens. Since TAMs are solely responsible for capturing task-specific representations, base-sharing low-rank adaptation (BSLoRA) is further introduced to enable them to learn such representations effectively with only a small number of trainable parameters. Extensive experiments on widely used benchmarks demonstrate that PAT performs comparably to state-of-the-art methods while incurring significantly lower computational overhead and fewer trainable parameters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出位置锚定微调（PAT），一种针对预训练点云Transformer的参数高效微调方法，同时兼顾推理效率。PAT通过位置锚定的token聚合-扩展对来降低多头注意力和前馈网络的计算开销，并引入BSLoRA以少量可训练参数学习任务特定表示。
AI.motivation: 现有PEFT方法在点云Transformer上能以高参数效率取得优异微调性能，但忽略了推理效率；而MHA和FFN是计算密集型模块，其推理成本未被优化。因此需要在保持参数高效的同时降低推理计算开销。
AI.method: 提出PAT方法：在MHA和FFN中引入token聚合-扩展对，每对由TAM和TEM组成。TAM基于3D空间中的位置锚从输入token中提取代表性token，仅让这些代表性token进入计算，从而减少参与计算的token数量；TEM再将学到的表示传播回原始输入token。此外引入BSLoRA，使TAM能够以极少量可训练参数有效学习任务特定表示。
AI.result: 在广泛使用的基准上，PAT性能与SOTA方法相当，但计算开销显著更低，可训练参数也更少。
AI.conclusion: PAT在参数效率和推理效率两方面同时优化，为点云Transformer的高效微调提供了兼优方案。

title: ALPINE: Adaptive Localization for Parameter- and Sample-Efficient Few-Shot Learning
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Code, checkpoints, and reproduction manifests available at https://github.com/NeerajYadav-coder/alpine-fewshot
summary: Few-shot learning research is predominantly evaluated on accuracy alone, with limited attention to the parameter and training-sample budgets required to reach that accuracy - a real constraint for practitioners without large-scale compute. We present an ultra-lightweight (22,249-34,917 parameter) spatial-relational architecture for few-shot image classification that combines fixed Gabor edge-energy guidance with a windowed, content-adaptive patch locator. Under a strictly matched, iso-episode-budget protocol (250 meta-training episodes, 5 canonical seeds, 600 evaluation episodes per seed), our architecture achieves 5-shot accuracy gains, consistent across all five seeds, over Prototypical Networks, Relation Networks, and MAML on both CIFAR-FS and MiniImageNet, while using 27-53% fewer parameters than any baseline. It also converges in fewer training episodes, generalizes better to an unseen fine-grained domain (CUB-200-2011 birds, zero retraining), and is more robust to 50% occlusion and 25% spatial translation than all three baselines. A series of falsification ablations - zeroing relational tokens at inference and retraining without them entirely - shows that the architecture's pairwise relational computation, while present, is not the primary driver of its performance; the content-adaptive patch locator is. We report this honestly, together with a capacity sweep showing a genuine accuracy plateau near 22-35k parameters, and release full seed-level results and checkpoint hashes for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种超轻量（22,249–34,917 参数）的空间-关系架构，用于少样本图像分类，结合固定的 Gabor 边缘能量引导与窗口化内容自适应块定位器。在严格匹配的等回合预算协议下，该方法在 CIFAR-FS 和 MiniImageNet 上取得稳定的 5-shot 精度提升，参数比基线少 27–53%，且收敛更快、跨域泛化更强、抗遮挡与平移更鲁棒。消融实验表明性能主要来自内容自适应块定位器而非成对关系计算。
AI.motivation: 现有少样本学习研究主要以精度为评价指标，忽视了达到该精度所需的参数预算与训练样本预算，这对缺乏大规模算力的实践者构成实际约束。
AI.method: 提出一种超轻量空间-关系架构，将固定的 Gabor 边缘能量引导与窗口化、内容自适应的块定位器相结合；在严格匹配的等回合预算协议下评估（250 个元训练回合、5 个标准随机种子、每种子 600 个评估回合）。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR-FS 与 MiniImageNet 上，5-shot 精度在全部 5 个种子上一致优于 Prototypical Networks、Relation Networks 和 MAML，同时参数比任一基线少 27–53%；收敛所需训练回合更少；在未见过的细粒度域（CUB-200-2011 鸟类，零重训练）上泛化更好；对 50% 遮挡和 25% 空间平移更鲁棒。证伪消融（推理时置零关系 token、完全不使用关系 token 重训练）表明成对关系计算并非性能主因，内容自适应块定位器才是。容量扫描显示在约 22–35k 参数附近存在真实的精度平台。
AI.conclusion: 论文诚实地报告关系计算并非主要性能驱动因素，并发布完整种子级结果与检查点哈希以保证可复现性，强调在有限算力条件下的参数与样本预算约束。

title: Finder: Agentic Closed-Loop Object Finding for Embodied Grounding
summary: Finding the object referred to by language in a partially observed 3D scene is a core capability for embodied agents. Existing approaches either couple object search with online exploration, which can be costly when relevant observations have already been captured, or query pre-built open-vocabulary maps and scene graphs in a static, one-shot fashion. We present Finder, an agentic closed-loop object-finding primitive for embodied grounding. Instead of treating grounding as passive retrieval from a fixed scene representation, Finder maintains a typed loop state that links query-conditioned planning, scoped evidence gathering, candidate verification, and accept/continue/abort control. When evidence is incomplete or ambiguous, the loop can redirect subsequent perception and comparison rather than simply returning the top retrieved object. On open-vocabulary embodied Object Retrieval in Habitat/HM3D and real-world RGB-D scenes, Finder improves the averaged 1m success rate by 15.75 points over strong baselines. The same primitive also transfers to sequential object grounding and embodied object-centric question answering, improving spatial and temporal localization without changing the inner grounding protocol. Project page: https://finder-vln.github.io.

AI.tldr: 提出 Finder——一种面向具身接地的智能体式闭环物体寻找原语，将接地从静态检索转为查询驱动的闭环控制，在 HM3D 与真实 RGB-D 场景中 1m 成功率提升 15.75 点。
AI.motivation: 现有方法或将物体搜索与在线探索耦合（在观测已获得时代价高昂），或对预建开放词表地图与场景图做静态一次性查询，缺乏对不完整或歧义证据的再感知能力。
AI.method: Finder 维护类型化的循环状态，将查询条件化的规划、作用域受限的证据采集、候选验证以及接受/继续/中止控制串联为闭环；当证据不完整或存在歧义时，循环可重定向后续感知与比较，而非直接返回 top-1 检索结果。
AI.result: 在 Habitat/HM3D 开放词表具身物体检索及真实 RGB-D 场景上，平均 1m 成功率较强基线提升 15.75 个百分点；该原语还可迁移到序列物体接地与具身物体中心问答，在不改变内部接地协议的前提下提升时空定位性能。
AI.conclusion: 将具身接地建模为主动闭环控制而非被动检索，是提升部分可观测 3D 场景中语言指称定位的有效且可迁移的范式。

title: From a River in Gilead to the Inference Distributions of Large Language Models: Covert Dialect Bias and Linguistic Profiling at Scale
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to the 9th AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society (AIES 2026)
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in high-stakes domains such as housing screening. While alignment techniques mitigate explicit racial bias in generated text, they often leave covert attitudinal associations in internal probability distributions untouched. Adapting the matched-guise sociolinguistic paradigm, we examine covert dialect bias in housing-related social judgments across four varieties: Standard American English (SAE), African American Vernacular English (AAVE), Nigerian Standard English (NSE), and Nigerian Pidgin (NP). AAVE reflects the racialized dialect studied in prior covert-bias evaluations, whereas NSE and NP represent Black African, postcolonial varieties absent from this literature. Using 260 meaning-matched sentence quadruples and log-probability scoring over housing-relevant adjectives, we probe ten open-weight LLMs across three contexts varying in social proximity: tenant screening, neighbor acceptance, and roommate selection. Across all ten models, AAVE and NP are consistently associated with more negative adjectives than SAE, with NP penalized most severely. Crucially, each dialect is penalized via distinct stereotype clusters rather than a generic non-standard category. NSE, which carries institutional prestige, displays a context-dependent shift: favored over SAE in formal tenant screening but increasingly penalized as social proximity grows. Our findings reveal that LLMs inherit covert dialect bias along both racial identity and prestige dimensions, echoing documented human housing discrimination and demonstrating its reach across postcolonial English varieties.

AI.tldr: 该论文用匹配变体范式与对数概率评分，考察十款开源LLM在住房相关社会判断中对方言的内隐偏见。结果显示AAVE与尼日利亚皮钦语被稳定关联负面形容词，且各类方言经由不同刻板印象簇被惩罚，尼日利亚标准英语随社会距离增大而由受青睐转为受惩罚。
AI.motivation: LLM日益应用于住房筛选等高风险领域，现有对齐技术虽抑制了生成文本中的显性种族偏见，却未触及内部概率分布中的隐性态度关联。既有内隐偏见研究局限于AAVE这一种族化方言，缺乏对后殖民英语变体的考察，因而需要扩展方言偏见评估的范围与维度。
AI.method: 借鉴匹配变体（matched-guise）社会语言学范式，构建260组语义匹配的句子四元组，涵盖SAE、AAVE、NSE、NP四种变体；在租房筛选、邻里接纳、室友选择三种社会亲近度递增的情境下，对住房相关形容词进行对数概率评分，探测十款开源权重LLM。
AI.result: 十款模型中AAVE与NP均比SAE更常关联负面形容词，NP受罚最重；每种方言经由各自的刻板印象簇被惩罚，而非笼统的"非标准"类别；具机构声望的NSE呈情境依赖变化——正式租房筛选中优于SAE，随社会亲近度上升惩罚加剧。
AI.conclusion: LLM沿种族身份与声望两条维度继承了隐性方言偏见，与人类住房歧视文献相呼应，并表明该偏见已扩展至后殖民英语变体。

title: GeoCueFormer: Geometry-Guided Wavelet Representation and Prediction-Cued Dual-Stage Decoder for Underwater Semantic Segmentation
summary: Underwater semantic segmentation is essential for marine ecosystem monitoring, yet remains challenging due to severe visual degradation. Light absorption and scattering often lead to color shifts, low contrast, and blurred boundaries, making shallow detail features unreliable. Existing underwater segmentation methods improve RGB feature aggregation or boundary prediction, but still lack an explicit mechanism to distinguish structure-related details from degradation-induced responses. To address this limitation, we propose GeoCueFormer, a lightweight framework that combines geometry-constrained frequency enhancement with prediction-cued refinement. GeoCueFormer performs stage-specific wavelet enhancement on hierarchical encoder features to complement shallow boundary details while preserving deep structural semantics. A depth-derived spatial gate constrains shallow frequency enhancement toward geometry-consistent regions, and a prediction-cued dual-stage decoder further refines ambiguous high-resolution features. GeoCueFormer obtains 82.23% and 73.04% mIoU on SUIM and DUT, respectively. Under comparable model complexity and standard benchmark settings on SUIM and DUT, it achieves SOTA performance while maintaining a favorable accuracy-complexity trade-off. These results show that distinguishing structural details from degradation-induced interference is more effective for underwater segmentation.

AI.tldr: 提出GeoCueFormer，通过几何约束的频率增强与预测线索细化，区分结构细节与退化干扰，在水下语义分割任务上以轻量复杂度取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 水下语义分割对海洋生态监测至关重要，但光吸收与散射导致色偏、低对比度和边界模糊，浅层细节特征不可靠。现有方法虽改进RGB特征聚合或边界预测，却缺乏显式机制区分与结构相关的细节和退化引起的响应。
AI.method: GeoCueFormer为轻量框架，结合几何约束的频率增强与预测线索细化：对分层编码器特征进行阶段特定的子波增强，在保留深层结构语义的同时补充浅层边界细节；由深度导出的空间门约束浅层频率增强朝向几何一致区域；并采用预测线索的双阶段解码器细化模糊的高分辨率特征。
AI.result: 在SUIM和DUT上分别取得82.23%和73.04% mIoU；在相当模型复杂度和标准基准设置下达到SOTA，并保持优良的精度-复杂度权衡。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，区分结构细节与退化引起的干扰对于水下分割更为有效。

title: vidax: A Unified JAX Framework for Video Generative Models on Accelerator Meshes
summary: Open-source video generative models ship almost exclusively as PyTorch/CUDA reference implementations. This leaves Cloud TPU pods without a production-ready inference path, despite offering large, cost-effective accelerator memory pools ideal for long-sequence spatiotemporal attention. We present vidax, an open-source JAX/Flax inference engine and zero-copy PyTorch-to-JAX weight translator for modern video generation architectures. vidax covers a diverse set of spatiotemporal models --- including Diffusion Transformers, omnimodal Mixture-of-Transformers, 3D VAEs, text encoders, and native samplers --- with zero PyTorch dependency in the execution path. The framework unifies 1D tensor parallelism with DeepSpeed-Ulysses sequence parallelism on a single JAX sharding mesh, integrates TPU flash-attention kernels, and implements per-layer weight offloading to support reference resolutions that exceed single-device memory. We benchmark compile times, latency, and peak memory utilization on TPU v4-8 hardware, and document real-world numerical bugs surfaced during checkpoint translation. vidax is released open-source as a baseline for JAX and TPU video generation research.

AI.tldr: vidax 是一个开源 JAX/Flax 视频生成推理引擎，配套零拷贝 PyTorch 到 JAX 权重转换器，为 Cloud TPU 提供生产级视频生成推理路径。
AI.motivation: 开源视频生成模型几乎仅以 PyTorch/CUDA 参考实现发布，导致 Cloud TPU 缺乏生产可用的推理路径，而 TPU 内存池大且性价比高，适合长序列时空注意力计算。
AI.method: 构建名为 vidax 的开源 JAX/Flax 推理引擎，并设计零拷贝 PyTorch 到 JAX 权重转换器；覆盖 Diffusion Transformer、全模态 Mixture-of-Transformers、3D VAE、文本编码器与原生采样器，执行路径不依赖 PyTorch；在单一 JAX 分片网格上统一 1D 张量并行与 DeepSpeed-Ulysses 序列并行，集成 TPU flash-attention 内核，并实现逐层权重卸载以支持超单设备内存的参考分辨率。
AI.result: 在 TPU v4-8 硬件上对编译时间、时延和峰值内存占用进行了基准测试，并记录了权重转换过程中暴露的实际数值 bug。
AI.conclusion: vidax 以开源形式发布，可作为 JAX 与 TPU 视频生成研究的基线。

title: Not All Layers Need Tuning: Diagnosing and Directing Adaptation in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Fine-tuning a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model for a new deployment environment is expensive, yet most methods apply uniform-capacity adapters to every network region as if every region requires equal adjustment. This paper tests that assumption on five architecturally diverse VLAs (OpenVLA-OFT, $π_0$, SmolVLA, DTP, Octo; 93M-7B parameters). Measuring per-region adaptation cost as normalized parameter displacement under region-isolated fine-tuning reveals an adaptation spectrum in which appearance shifts concentrate cost in the vision encoder, instruction shifts in the language backbone, and novel-object shifts in the vision encoder together with the action head, across all five architectures. To exploit this structure, we introduce a pipeline that observes, diagnoses, allocates, and adapts. From ten unlabeled target observations and without fine-tuning, the diagnostic estimates per-region cost by combining reference-free gradient and Monte Carlo Dropout signals with a Centered Kernel Alignment score against a cached source reference; the allocator converts the estimates into variable-rank LoRA adapters under a parameter budget and freezes well-calibrated regions; and standard LoRA fine-tuning trains the resulting adapters. The diagnostic ranks regions within each deployment at a median Spearman of 0.91, and the allocation matches or exceeds uniform LoRA at every budget we tested on LIBERO and CALVIN. On a physical xArm-7, the pipeline matches full fine-tuning under an instruction-wording shift with 0.04% of its trainable parameters, and on five held-out scenes evaluated without retraining it leads every baseline, with 11-23 successes of 30 rollouts against 8-18 for the strongest parameter-efficient baseline at equal or larger budgets and 2-11 for full fine-tuning. These results suggest that adaptation cost in VLAs is structured enough to measure before fine-tuning begins.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种"观察—诊断—分配—适配"流水线，通过无标注目标观测预判VLA各区域的适配成本，并据此分配变秩LoRA适配器，实现远低于均匀LoRA与全量微调的参数预算下性能更优的部署适配。
AI.motivation: 微调VLA模型以适应新部署环境代价高昂，而现有方法普遍对每个网络区域施加等容量适配器，隐含假设"各区域需同等调整"。论文旨在检验并推翻这一假设，利用区域间适配成本的结构性差异降低适配成本。
AI.method: 在五种架构各异的VLA（OpenVLA-OFT、π₀、SmolVLA、DTP、Octo，93M–7B）上，以区域隔离微调下的归一化参数位移度量各区域适配成本；提出观察-诊断-分配-适配流水线：仅用10个无标注目标观测、无需微调，诊断阶段结合无参考梯度信号、MC Dropout信号与针对缓存源参考的CKA分数估计区域成本；分配器在参数预算下将估计转换为变秩LoRA并冻结良好校准区域；随后用标准LoRA微调训练。
AI.result: 成本呈"适配谱"：外观偏移集中于视觉编码器，指令偏移集中于语言主干，新物体偏移集中于视觉编码器与动作头，五种架构一致。诊断的区域排序中位Spearman为0.91；在LIBERO与CALVIN上各预算下分配均匹配或超过均匀LoRA。实体xArm-7上，指令措辞偏移下以0.04%可训练参数达到全量微调水平；五个留出场景不重训，30次 rollout 中成功11–23次，优于最强参数高效基线（8–18次，预算相等或更大）与全量微调（2–11次）。
AI.conclusion: VLA的适配成本具有足够结构，可在微调开始前被测量并据以分配适配容量，从而以极小参数预算获得更优的部署适配效果。

title: Mask 2D-3D: Adaptive Dual-Masked Autoencoder Network for Image-to-Point Cloud Registration
summary: Detection-free methods for image-to-point cloud registration are prone to erroneous correspondences caused by domain and modality discrepancies, limited sensitivity of feature extractors, and the presence of non-overlapping regions. The Masked Autoencoder (MAE) has shown strong performance in visual representation for images and point clouds. It may be helpful to apply this approach to image-to-point cloud registration, a task that requires unified feature extraction and accurate cross-modal correspondences. Standard MAE's random masking may overlook key regions due to limited camera views, reducing registration effectiveness. To address this, we propose the Intermodal Dual-MAE Framework (ID-MAE) with a Similarity-based RL Masking Strategy (SRLM), which adaptively masks informative positions by leveraging cross-modal similarity and reinforcement learning, thus narrowing the modality gap. Our method enhances cross-modal representation learning by enforcing representation consistency during feature extraction, thereby enabling more reliable 2D-3D correspondence estimation. Experiments on RGB-D Scenes v2 and 7-Scenes benchmarks show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in image-to-point cloud registration.

AI.tldr: 提出ID-MAE框架配合SRLM掩码策略，通过跨模态相似度与强化学习自适应掩码，缩小模态差距，在RGB-D Scenes v2与7-Scenes上取得图像到点云配准的SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 无检测的图像到点云配准易受域与模态差异导致的错误对应、特征提取器敏感度不足以及非重叠区域的影响；标准MAE的随机掩码受限于有限相机视角，可能忽略关键区域，降低配准效果。
AI.method: 提出ID-MAE（Intermodal Dual-MAE Framework），并设计基于相似度的强化学习掩码策略SRLM，利用跨模态相似度与强化学习自适应地掩蔽信息量大的位置；在特征提取中强制表征一致性，以增强跨模态表征学习并实现统一的特征提取。
AI.result: 在RGB-D Scenes v2和7-Scenes基准上，方法在图像到点云配准任务中达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过自适应掩码与跨模态表征一致性约束，ID-MAE有效缩小模态差距并提升2D-3D对应估计可靠性，验证了掩码自编码器在跨模态配准中的潜力。

title: Agora: Git as Shared Memory for Collective AutoResearch
summary: Research agents working in separate sessions need to know what others have tried and which results they can build on. Agora stores their contributions as an append-only directed acyclic graph (DAG) in Git. Each commit records a result, insight, hypothesis, verification, or report and links it to prior work. Searchable views show leading results, neglected branches, and verification status; diversity-aware recommendations suggest experiments beyond the current leaders. We report a run of nearly 12 days in which 13 language-model workers, with no assigned tasks or central planner, used Agora to solve a weight-transfer problem. Given 141 pretrained donor models and a frozen 119.6M-parameter attention--SSM hybrid whose dimensions match no donor, the workers had to initialize the target without training data or gradient updates. They published 1,703 contributions and reduced the development evaluator score from 3.39 to 1.899 bits per byte, closing 62% of the gap to a trained GPT-2 124M. The best method compresses donor next-token statistics into the target's embedding and output head, then adds short-range context through sparse edits to attention, feed-forward, and state-space blocks. Its 145-commit ancestry spans 15 accounts. Participants also posted 165 verifications of 95 targets, each by an account other than the target's author, with no reported failures. The run documents how agents reused and verified shared work. Measuring the effect on discovery per unit of compute requires a matched comparison.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Agora——一个基于 Git 的只追加有向无环图（DAG）协作基础设施，用于多会话研究代理共享并复用彼此的研究成果。13 个语言模型工作者在无任务分配、无中心规划者的情况下，历时近 12 天围绕一个权重迁移问题发布 1,703 条贡献，将开发评估器得分从 3.39 降至 1.899 bits/byte，缩小了与已训练 GPT-2 124M 之间 62% 的差距。
AI.motivation: 在不同会话中独立运行的研究代理彼此隔离，无法知晓他人已尝试过什么、哪些结果可以复用，导致重复探索与知识无法累积。因此需要一个可记录、可检索、可验证的共享工作层，使无中心协调的多个代理能够协同推进同一研究问题。
AI.method: Agora 将代理贡献存为 Git 中的只追加 DAG，每个提交记录一条结果、洞见、假设、验证或报告并链接到先前工作；提供可检索视图以呈现领先结果、被忽视分支与验证状态，并通过多样性感知推荐建议当前领先方向之外的实验。实验设置：13 个语言模型代理、无外部任务分配与中心规划者，给定 141 个预训练 donor 模型与一个冻结的 119.6M 参数 attention–SSM 混合目标模型（维度与任何 donor 均不匹配），要求在不使用训练数据和梯度更新的条件下完成目标模型初始化。最佳方法将 donor 的 next-token 统计压缩进目标的 embedding 与输出头，再通过对其 attention、前馈与状态空间块的稀疏编辑引入短程上下文。
AI.result: 历时近 12 天，共发布 1,703 条贡献，开发评估器得分由 3.39 降至 1.899 bits/byte，缩小与已训练 GPT-2 124M 差距的 62%；最佳方法的 145 次提交谱系跨越 15 个账户。参与者还针对 95 个目标发布了 165 次验证，每次验证均由非目标作者的其他账户完成，未报告失败案例。
AI.conclusion: 该运行记录了代理如何复用与验证共享工作，展示出去中心化多代理协作在无任务指派条件下解决开放研究问题的可行性。作者同时指出，要衡量单位算力对发现效率的影响，仍需进行匹配对照实验。

title: Beyond Pixel Similarity: Task-Aware Evaluation of GAN-Based Synthetic Sonar Data for Robotic Perception
comment: Accepted at Sim2Real and Classical Control: From Rigorous Theory to Data-Driven Robotics - IROS Workshop 2026
summary: Synthetic data can reduce the cost of collecting and annotating training data for robotic perception, but generating sensor observations that preserve the characteristics relevant to downstream perception remains challenging, particularly for sonar imagery. In this work, we investigate whether conventional image-fidelity metrics adequately reflect the downstream perception performance of GAN-generated synthetic sonar data. We employ a Pix2Pix conditional generative adversarial network with four discriminator configurations characterized by different receptive fields: PixelGAN, PatchGAN-16, PatchGAN-70, and ImageGAN. The models are trained using sonar imagery from two datasets and evaluated using conventional image-fidelity metrics, including Structural Similarity Index (SSIM), Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR), and Mean Squared Error (MSE). To complement these pixel-level measures with task-oriented evaluation, YOLOX-S, YOLOX-L, and Faster R-CNN detectors are trained exclusively on real sonar imagery and subsequently evaluated on the GAN-generated images using identical test samples and annotations across all discriminator configurations. The results reveal a discrepancy between image-fidelity and downstream object-detection performance: the configuration achieving the best SSIM, PSNR, and MSE does not consistently yield the best detection performance. In particular, PatchGAN configurations achieve strong downstream detection results despite not achieving the highest pixel-level similarity scores. These findings suggest, for the datasets and models considered, pixel-level image-fidelity metrics alone may not consistently capture the task-relevant realism of synthetic sonar observations and motivate the use of task-aware evaluation for synthetic sensor data intended for robotic perception.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨传统图像保真度指标能否反映GAN合成声呐数据的下游感知性能，发现在所考察的数据集与模型上，像素级保真度指标与目标检测性能并不一致。
AI.motivation: 合成数据可降低机器人感知中训练数据采集与标注成本，但生成能保留下游感知相关特征的传感器观测（尤其声呐图像）仍具挑战；同时，常用图像保真度指标是否真正反映下游感知性能尚不明确。
AI.method: 采用Pix2Pix条件生成对抗网络，设置四种不同感受野的判别器配置：PixelGAN、PatchGAN-16、PatchGAN-70与ImageGAN；基于两个数据集的声呐图像训练，并使用SSIM、PSNR、MSE等传统保真度指标评估。此外，仅用真实声呐图像训练YOLOX-S、YOLOX-L与Faster R-CNN检测器，在相同测试样本与标注下于GAN生成图像上进行评估，实现面向任务的评价。
AI.result: 图像保真度与下游目标检测性能之间存在差异：取得最优SSIM、PSNR与MSE的配置并未稳定获得最佳检测性能；PatchGAN配置虽未取得最高像素级相似度得分，却实现了较强的下游检测结果。
AI.conclusion: 在所考虑的数据集与模型范围内，仅凭像素级图像保真度指标可能无法一致地刻画合成声呐观测中与任务相关的真实感，因而有必要对面向机器人感知的合成传感器数据采用任务感知的评价方式。

title: Linguistic Triggers of Gender and Racial Bias in Open-Weight LLMs Applied to Recruitment
comment: Accepted at the 9th AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society (AIES 2026). Extended version with Appendices A-B (prompt templates and full stimulus set)
summary: Open-weight large language models are rapidly entering hiring pipelines, yet their discriminatory failure modes -- and the regulatory exposure these create under the EU AI Act high-risk classification (Annex III) and U.S. EEOC adverse-impact analysis -- remain poorly understood. We present the first systematic, multi-model audit of open-weight LLMs that treats job-posting language as the primary experimental variable, evaluating six models (Llama 3.2, Mistral, Gemma 3, Qwen 3, Phi 3, DeepSeek-R1) across four controlled experiments that jointly probe recruiter-simulation and job-seeker-simulation tasks. We find that (1) agentic posting language depresses recruiter recommendation scores for female candidates (r_rb = 0.309, p_Bonf = 7x10^-5; model-fixed-effects r_rb = 0.448), while communal language partially reverses the penalty; and (2) coded-exclusion language suppresses non-White recruiter scores at large effect sizes (r_rb = 0.646-0.758) and, on the job-seeker side, selectively deters non-White personas from expressing interest -- operationalizing a chilling-effect mechanism at scale. A label-ablation experiment isolates the explicit demographic persona label as the primary causal driver, and Word Embedding Association Tests corroborate these findings at the representational level (d = 1.01-1.45 under Caliskan et al.'s multi-word gender attribute lists). We translate these results into a concrete pre-deployment audit protocol -- posting-vocabulary scoring, persona-conditioned LLM probing, and adverse-impact flagging against the four-fifths threshold -- that operationalizes the documentation and risk-management obligations Annex III imposes on high-risk AI in recruitment.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次对六个开源权重大语言模型（Llama 3.2、Mistral、Gemma 3、Qwen 3、Phi 3、DeepSeek-R1）进行系统性歧视审计，将招聘广告用语作为核心实验变量，通过四项受控实验揭示招聘方模拟与求职者模拟任务中的偏见，并据此提出符合欧盟《人工智能法案》附件三要求的部署前审计协议。
AI.motivation: 开源权重LLM正快速进入招聘流程，但其歧视性失效模式及由此产生的监管风险（欧盟《人工智能法案》附件三高危分类、美国EEOC不利影响分析）尚缺乏系统认识，亟需可操作的审计方法。
AI.method: 以招聘广告语言为核心实验变量，跨六模型开展四项受控实验，涵盖招聘方模拟与求职者模拟任务；采用标签消融实验隔离人口统计人设标签的因果作用，并用词嵌入关联测试（WEAT）在表征层面验证。
AI.result: （1）代理性广告用语降低女性候选人的招聘推荐评分（r_rb=0.309，p_Bonf=7×10^-5；模型固定效应r_rb=0.448），共同体语言可部分逆转该惩罚；（2）编码排斥性语言大幅压低非白人候选人评分（r_rb=0.646–0.758），并在求职者侧选择性抑制非白人画像表达兴趣，形成规模化"寒蝉效应"；标签消融显示明确人设标签为主要因果驱动因素，WEAT在表征层面佐证（d=1.01–1.45）。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出一套具体的部署前审计协议——广告词汇评分、人设条件化LLM探测、对照四分之五阈值的不利影响标记——将附件三对招聘高危AI的文档与风险管理义务落地为可操作流程。

title: A Comprehensive Review of Generative Physical Artificial Intelligence
summary: The integration of large-scale foundation models with physical embodiments has led to significant advancements in robotics known as Generative Physical Artificial Intelligence (GPAI). These agentic AI systems autonomously perceive, reason, and act in complex real-world situations. This survey comprehensively analyzes GPAI systems, focusing on their architectural foundations, current applications, and key limitations. We introduce a taxonomy of five distinct approaches: Robot Foundation Models (RFMs) for cross-platform skill transfer; Vision-Language Action (VLA) models for end-to-end multi-modal perception and control; Large Behavior Models (LBMs) for human-like movement generation; Diffusion Policy Models (DPMs) for diffusion model-based temporally coherent action generation; and World Foundation Models (WFMs) for physics-compliant simulation and data generation. We examine how these approaches complement each other: WFMs generate training data for VLAs and DPMs, RFMs enable cross-platform deployment of learned policies, while LBMs provide motion priors for natural behavior. Through examples across autonomous vehicles, industrial automation, healthcare robotics, and humanoid systems, we identify significant performance improvements and summarize promising research directions in data-efficient learning, sim-to-real transfer, edge-compatible architectures, and safety frameworks. These insights advance embodied AI for IoT-connected environments where intelligent agents interact with networked sensors, actuators, and edge devices.

AI.tldr: 该综述系统梳理了生成式物理人工智能（GPAI）系统，提出五大类方法分类体系（RFM、VLA、LBM、DPM、WFM），分析其架构基础、互补关系、典型应用与关键局限，并总结数据高效学习、仿真到现实迁移、边缘适配架构与安全框架等研究方向。
AI.motivation: 大规模基础模型与物理实体结合推动了机器人学的显著进展，形成GPAI；此类智能体系统能够在复杂真实环境中自主感知、推理与行动，但现有研究缺乏对GPAI系统架构基础、应用现状与核心局限的系统性梳理，因此需要一份综合性综述来整合并厘清该领域。
AI.method: 采用综述与分类学方法，将GPAI系统划分为五类：面向跨平台技能迁移的机器人基础模型（RFM）；面向端到端多模态感知与控制的视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）；面向类人运动生成的大型行为模型（LBM）；基于扩散模型实现时间连贯动作生成的扩散策略模型（DPM）；面向物理合规仿真与数据生成的世界基础模型（WFM）。并分析各类方法之间的互补关系，结合自动驾驶、工业自动化、医疗机器人和人形系统等案例进行说明。
AI.result: 通过跨领域案例识别出显著的性能提升；阐明五类模型间的协同机制：WFM为VLA和DPM生成训练数据，RFM支持所学策略的跨平台部署，LBM为自然行为提供运动先验。
AI.conclusion: 总结了数据高效学习、仿真到现实迁移、边缘兼容架构与安全框架等有前景的研究方向，推动面向IoT连接环境的具身智能发展，使智能体能够与联网传感器、执行器及边缘设备交互。

title: Aligned Consensus Teaching for Label-Efficient Oriented Object Detection in Weakly-Aligned Visible-Infrared Imagery
summary: Visible-infrared object detection (VIOD) detects objects with oriented bounding boxes from paired visible and infrared images. Existing methods depend on costly dual-modality annotations. Semi-supervised learning can reduce this burden, but extending it from single-modal detection to VIOD is challenging. In the practical image-pair-level setting considered here, only a few pairs are labeled in both modalities, while the rest are completely unlabeled. This limited supervision creates three challenges: (i) too few labeled boxes for robust cross-modal alignment; (ii) pseudo-label errors caused by branch-wise misses accumulate during self-training; and (iii) tail-class annotations become critically scarce as the labeling budget decreases. We propose Aligned Consensus Teacher (ACT) for label-efficient VIOD in this setting. Its Cycle-Consistent Region Alignment (CRA) combines cycle consistency and sparse anchors with reliability-weighted regional matching. Cross-Modal Consensus Mean-Teacher (CMC-MT) forms consensus pseudo labels under pair-preserving views to recover branch-wise misses and supervise unlabeled pairs. Text-Guided Cross-Modal Instance Augmentation (TG-CMIA) uses a vision-language scene prior to compose tail-class instance pairs while preserving RGB--IR offsets. To the best of our knowledge, ACT is the first framework to study semi-supervised VIOD under this image-pair-level setting. Experiments on DroneVehicle and VEDAI show consistent gains across annotation ratios. With 10\% labeled pairs on DroneVehicle, ACT reaches 94.3\% of the mAP obtained by the same detector under full supervision. Code and models will be available on GitHub to facilitate future work.

AI.tldr: 提出ACT框架，首次在图像对级别的半监督设置下研究可见光-红外目标检测（VIOD），通过CRA、CMC-MT和TG-CMIA三个模块应对少标签带来的跨模态对齐、伪标签累积错误和尾部类别稀缺问题。
AI.motivation: VIOD依赖昂贵的双模态标注，半监督学习可降低标注负担，但从单模态检测扩展到VIOD面临困难。在图像对级别的实用设置中，仅有少量图像对双模态标注，其余完全无标注。这种有限监督带来三大挑战：(i) 标注框太少，难以实现稳健的跨模态对齐；(ii) 自训练过程中分支级漏检导致伪标签错误不断累积；(iii) 随着标注预算下降，尾部类别标注严重稀缺。
AI.method: 提出Aligned Consensus Teacher（ACT）框架，包含三个核心模块：1) Cycle-Consistent Region Alignment（CRA），结合循环一致性与稀疏锚点，并进行可靠性加权的区域匹配；2) Cross-Modal Consensus Mean-Teacher（CMC-MT），在保持图像对结构的视图下形成共识伪标签，以恢复分支级漏检并监督无标注图像对；3) Text-Guided Cross-Modal Instance Augmentation（TG-CMIA），利用视觉-语言场景先验合成尾部类别实例对，同时保持RGB-IR偏移。
AI.result: 在DroneVehicle和VEDAI数据集上，跨不同标注比例均取得一致性提升。在DroneVehicle上使用10%标注图像对时，ACT达到全监督下同检测器mAP的94.3%。
AI.conclusion: ACT是首个在图像对级别设置下研究半监督VIOD的框架，有效缓解了有限标注带来的跨模态对齐、伪标签累积错误和尾部类别稀缺问题，并在多个数据集和标注比例下验证了有效性。代码与模型将在GitHub上公开。

title: PRISM: Predictive Representation of Interaction Style and Motion for Social Robot Navigation
comment: ECCV 2026 Workshop on Agent in World
summary: Humans often observe others before interacting and adjust their behavior accordingly. Robot navigation in crowds, however, often represents pedestrians mainly by observed geometric states, leaving individual differences in interaction tendencies implicit. We propose PRISM (Predictive Representation of Interaction Style and Motion), a framework that infers interaction traits from passive observations of human-human interactions. PRISM encodes human trajectories into a continuous ordinal latent space with a transformer encoder trained by Rank-N-Contrast loss, and pairs each inferred trait with a temporal-stability score supplied to the navigation policy. In randomized crowd simulations, PRISM reduces collision rates over the geometry-only baseline and yields small improvements in navigation-time and path-length metrics. These results suggest the utility of passive latent-trait inference for social navigation in dynamic crowds.

AI.tldr: 提出PRISM框架，从被动观察的人-人交互中推断交互风格等潜在特质，并用于机器人人群导航，降低碰撞率。
AI.motivation: 人类在交互前会观察他人并相应调整行为，而现有机器人人群导航多仅以观测到的几何状态表示行人，忽略了交互倾向上的个体差异。
AI.method: PRISM用Transformer编码器将人类轨迹编码到连续的有序潜在空间，并使用Rank-N-Contrast损失训练；将推断出的特质与一个时间稳定性得分配对，输入导航策略中。
AI.result: 在随机化人群仿真中，PRISM相比仅使用几何信息的基线降低了碰撞率，并在导航时间和路径长度指标上有小幅改进。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，被动潜在特质推断对动态人群中的社交导航具有实用价值。

title: MCLC-NET: Multimodal Continual Learning for Leaf Counting
summary: Leaf counting is an important task in plant phenotyping for monitoring plant growth and estimating crop yield. Most existing methods rely on RGB images, but their performance is often affected by occlusion, lighting variations, and other real-world challenges. Additional modalities, such as depth and thermal images, can provide useful complementary information. However, multimodal leaf counting remains underexplored. Also, many existing methods assume that all training data are available simultaneously, which is impractical in real agricultural settings, where data is collected over time from multiple sources. To address these challenges, we propose MCLC-NET, a multimodal continual learning framework for leaf counting. It learns tasks sequentially using a memory-based strategy with a memory buffer to retain important samples from previous tasks. We also introduce MMLC, a real-world multimodal leaf-counting dataset designed for a domain incremental scenario (DIS) in CL. It contains RGB, depth, and thermal images collected across different crop types under varying environmental conditions, arranged in three orderings: crop-wise, time-wise, and mixed. Experimental results, averaged over three random seeds, demonstrate that MCLC-NET consistently outperforms existing methods across all three task orderings, achieving the lowest AMSE of 0.675$\pm$0.027, 0.542$\pm$0.069, and 0.745$\pm$0.057, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出多模态持续学习叶片计数框架MCLC-NET及真实数据集MMLC。
AI.motivation: 现有叶片计数方法多依赖RGB图像，易受遮挡、光照变化影响；深度与热成像等多模态信息未被充分利用；且多数方法假设训练数据可同时获取，不符合农业数据随时间、多来源采集的实际场景。
AI.method: 提出MCLC-NET多模态持续学习框架，采用基于记忆缓冲区的策略，保留前序任务的重要样本，按顺序学习任务；同时构建MMLC真实多模态叶片计数数据集，包含跨作物类型、不同环境条件下的RGB、深度和热成像图像，按作物维度、时间维度和混合方式设计三种任务排序，对应领域增量场景（DIS）。
AI.result: 在三种任务排序下，MCLC-NET均优于现有方法，三次随机种子平均后的AMSE最低，分别为0.675±0.027、0.542±0.069和0.745±0.057。
AI.conclusion: MCLC-NET结合多模态信息与持续学习策略，有效缓解真实农业场景中的数据顺序到达与模态互补问题；MMLC数据集为多模态叶片计数的持续学习研究提供了基准。

title: Colla-Q: Toward Collaborative Experts in MoE Quantization via Minimax Precision Balancing
comment: Accepted by the Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP) 2026
summary: In this paper, we present a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) quantization method based on activation entropy. Although quantization reduces memory and computational costs, it can substantially degrade performance. In particular, performance decline is pronounced in quantized MoE models, where individual experts have a small number of parameters that are sensitive to low-bit representation. Considering that MoE operates as an ensemble model with collaborative contributions from routed experts, a significant performance decline of a particular expert due to quantization can harm model performance. Therefore, we propose Colla-Q, a bit-allocation framework to maintain balanced performance across experts through an activation-entropy-based bit-width allocation algorithm. This approach encourages each expert to operate collaboratively in the quantized model, thereby 1) improving the overall MoE performance and 2) reducing the dependence on the calibration dataset. Since uniformly adjusting each expert's performance facilitates robustness and stability of the MoE model, the proposed MoE quantization method can generalize more consistently across different calibration datasets. Our code is available at: https://github.com/mmai-laboratory/Colla_Q

AI.tldr: 提出基于激活熵的MoE量化方法Colla-Q，通过比特分配维持专家间性能均衡以提升整体性能并降低对校准数据集的依赖。
AI.motivation: 量化虽降低内存与计算成本，但会显著损害性能，尤其在MoE模型中：单个专家参数量少、对低位表示敏感。由于MoE是各路由专家协同贡献的集成模型，某一专家因量化导致性能骤降会拖累整体模型性能。
AI.method: 提出Colla-Q比特分配框架，基于激活熵的比特宽度分配算法，实现跨专家的均衡性能分配，促使量化模型中的各专家协同工作。
AI.result: 1) 提升MoE整体性能；2) 减少对校准数据集的依赖；3) 统一调整各专家性能增强MoE的鲁棒性与稳定性，使其在不同校准数据集上泛化更一致。
AI.conclusion: 通过激活熵引导的比特分配维持专家间性能均衡，Colla-Q在提升量化MoE性能的同时降低校准数据依赖，并具备更好的跨数据集泛化一致性。代码已开源。

title: Stealthy in Semantics, Antagonistic in Space: Attacking Visible-Infrared Object Detectors via Object-Level Misalignment
summary: Visible-infrared object detectors are used for robust perception under challenging illumination and weather conditions. Current physical attacks apply conspicuous patches to spatially aligned target regions, which are noticeable to human observers. Meanwhile, most of these methods only perturb the appearance within the aligned region, without explicitly targeting the correspondence between modalities or the fusion process. In this paper, we propose CamoShift, an adversarial framework for visible-infrared object detection. By combining visual camouflage with object-level infrared shifting, CamoShift breaks cross-modal spatial alignment and disrupts fusion. Specifically, the Semantic Camouflage Module (SCM) generates a stealthy camouflaged patch that can be attached to the host object and maintains its effectiveness in the infrared branch through an RGB-IR adapter. The Object-level Spatial Decoupling Module (OSDM) shifts the infrared target evidence in a scale-aware manner, so as to break object-level correspondence and disrupt cross-modal fusion. Then, the Harmonic Adversarial loss (HarAdv loss) further balances attack strength and visual stealth during optimization. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to target both visual stealthiness and attack success in visible-infrared object detection. Extensive experimental results show that CamoShift achieves a superior balance between attack effectiveness and visual stealth. Code and models will be available on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CamoShift，一种面向可见光-红外目标检测的对抗攻击框架，通过视觉伪装与目标级红外偏移破坏跨模态空间对齐和融合，在攻击有效性与视觉隐蔽性之间取得优越平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有可见光-红外检测的物理攻击方法存在两方面不足：一是使用显眼的对抗 patch 贴于空间对齐的目标区域，易被人眼察觉；二是多仅在对齐区域内扰动外观，未显式针对模态间对应关系或融合过程。本文旨在同时兼顾视觉隐蔽性与攻击成功率。
AI.method: CamoShift 包含三个关键组件：（1）语义伪装模块（SCM）生成可附着于宿主目标、并通过 RGB-IR 适配器在红外分支保持有效性的隐蔽伪装 patch；（2）目标级空间解耦模块（OSDM）以尺度感知方式偏移红外目标证据，破坏目标级对应关系并干扰跨模态融合；（3）谐波对抗损失（HarAdv loss）在优化中平衡攻击强度与视觉隐蔽性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，CamoShift 在攻击有效性与视觉隐蔽性之间实现了优越的平衡，优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次在可见光-红外目标检测中同时针对视觉隐蔽性与攻击成功率进行对抗攻击设计，验证了破坏跨模态对齐与融合这一攻击思路的有效性。代码与模型将在 GitHub 上公开。

title: DualSQL: Text-to-SQL with Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: State-of-the-art Text-to-SQL systems are typically multi-agent pipelines centered around two fundamental tasks: schema linking and SQL generation. However, existing work trains separate models for each task, failing to leverage the synergy between these interrelated tasks. In this work, we propose DualSQL, a new Text-to-SQL system consisting of two agents powered by a single model backbone. The agents share the same model weights and agentic scaffold, enabling joint optimization through a robust multi-agent reinforcement learning (RL) framework. We design three database access tools to facilitate effective multi-step reasoning grounded to interactions with the databases. To improve training and avoid model collapse, we introduce a set of rollout guardrail mechanisms that stabilizes multi-agent RL training, supporting DualSQL to keep improving during training. We also introduce a new SQL correctness metric, robust execution match (REX), to more accurately judge SQL correctness and assign reward signals. Being trained on only 3755 examples, DualSQL-4B achieves an impressive 68.0% execution accuracy on the BIRD development set, matching previous 7B models. DualSQL-8B further improves to 71.1%, outperforming previous state-of-the-art single-model solutions with 32B parameters. These results demonstrate the strength of joint multi-agent reinforcement learning for building high performance Text-to-SQL pipelines.

AI.tldr: 提出 DualSQL，用单一模型骨干驱动两个智能体（schema linking 与 SQL 生成），通过多智能体强化学习联合优化，并引入 REX 指标；DualSQL-4B 在 BIRD 开发集达 68.0%，8B 达 71.1%，超过 32B 参数的单模型方案。
AI.motivation: 现有 Text-to-SQL 系统多为围绕 schema linking 与 SQL 生成两个核心任务的多智能体流水线，但通常为每个任务分别训练独立模型，未能利用这两个相互关联任务之间的协同效应，导致性能与参数效率受限。
AI.method: DualSQL 由两个智能体组成，共享同一模型权重与 agentic scaffold，实现联合优化；采用鲁棒的多智能体强化学习框架，并设计三个数据库访问工具支撑与数据库交互的多步推理。为提升训练稳定性、避免模型崩溃，引入一组 rollout guardrail 机制。此外提出新的 SQL 正确性度量 robust execution match (REX) 以更准确判定 SQL 正确性并分配奖励信号。
AI.result: 仅使用 3755 个训练样本，DualSQL-4B 在 BIRD 开发集上取得 68.0% 执行准确率，匹配此前 7B 模型水平；DualSQL-8B 进一步提升至 71.1%，超过此前具有 32B 参数的最先进单模型方案。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，联合多智能体强化学习对构建高性能 Text-to-SQL 流水线具有显著优势，可在小参数量与少训练数据条件下超越更大规模模型。

title: Multi-View Mixture-of-Experts with Vision-Language Reranking for Cross-View Object Geo-Localization
summary: Cross-view object geo-localization (CVOGL) locates a target in satellite imagery using drone or street-view queries. Existing methods train separate detectors for each viewpoint, leading to parameter redundancy and impeding cross-view knowledge sharing. Moreover, top-ranked satellite candidates are often visually similar, so visual appearance and categorical labels alone are insufficient to resolve such ambiguity. To address these, we propose MVLGeo, an efficient framework designed to unify multiple viewpoints and reduce model redundancy. First, we introduce environmental contextual text from the query view as cues to distinguish visually similar candidates via Vision-Language Reranking (VL-Rerank). Second, we design a multi-view Mixture-of-Experts architecture (MV-MoE) with a shared encoder and view-specific experts to reduce redundancy and promote knowledge sharing, while cross-view contrastive learning aligns their representations for consistency. Third, we introduce an adaptive elliptical prior (ESAM-Prior) as auxiliary positional encoding for anisotropic geometric perception. Extensive experiments on the CVOGL benchmarks confirm that MVLGeo, as a unified model for multiple query viewpoints, achieves state-of-the-art performance, demonstrating robustness to input degradation and generalization across viewpoints. Code and models will be available on GitHub to facilitate future work.

AI.tldr: 提出MVLGeo统一多视角跨视角目标地理定位框架，通过视觉-语言重排序、多视角专家混合架构和自适应椭圆先验，减少参数冗余并提升定位性能。
AI.motivation: 现有跨视角目标地理定位方法为每个视角单独训练检测器，导致参数冗余、难以共享跨视角知识；同时排名靠前的卫星候选图像视觉相似，仅靠视觉外观和类别标签无法消解歧义。
AI.method: 1) 引入查询视角的环境上下文文本作为线索，通过视觉-语言重排序（VL-Rerank）区分视觉相似的候选；2) 设计多视角专家混合架构（MV-MoE），共享编码器加视角专属专家以减少冗余、促进知识共享，并用跨视角对比学习对齐表征；3) 引入自适应椭圆先验（ESAM-Prior）作为辅助位置编码，实现各向异性几何感知。
AI.result: 在CVOGL基准上大量实验表明，MVLGeo作为面向多查询视角的统一模型达到最先进性能，对输入退化具有鲁棒性，并具备跨视角泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: MVLGeo以统一框架整合多视角查询，兼顾效率与精度，验证了文本线索重排序、专家混合与几何先验的有效性；代码与模型将开源以促进后续研究。

title: PageRecall: Measuring Page Selection in Literature-Grounded Question Answering
comment: Accepted at the 1st Workshop on Grounding Language Models (GroundLM 2026), co-located with EMNLP 2026. 9 pages. System description for the LitTraceQA shared task (team Everest)
summary: We describe our system for LitTraceQA (GroundLM @ EMNLP 2026): given a research question, retrieve the relevant papers from a pool of 27,487, cite the page and the table or figure where the answer lives, and answer in a requested format. Our main finding is that evidence grounding is limited by retrieval, not by reading. The page selector put the annotator's page, which we call the gold page, in front of the model that locates evidence only about half the time (52.6% gold-page recall), while that model, given the page, cited the right one in 45 of the 48 locators it emitted (94%). When the page was missing it rarely said so: of 45 such cases it returned nothing 14 times, a wrong page 24 times, and a correct page 7 times, so the pipeline failed quietly almost twice as often as it failed visibly. Since the failure was that the right page was never shown, the fix is to stop choosing: each retrieved paper fits in the model's context, so we show it whole. Page ranking survives only as a fallback inside papers too long to fit, which no test-split paper was, and gold-page recall reaches 100% on the papers we can parse. Separately, questions that identify their target by position rather than content, such as "the first author of the 24th reference", are served by parsing rather than retrieval: we resolve the bibliography into an addressable list, which also supplies identifiers the evidence metric scores. The final system scores 0.762 paper $F_1$, 0.441 evidence $F_1$ and 0.920 multiple-choice accuracy on the held-out test split.
