Because the pipeline depends on a closed model without seed control, we release a harness that verifies the paper's central claims against committed artifacts.

AI.tldr: LitTraceQA 系统表明：证据定位的瓶颈在检索而非阅读；将整篇论文喂给模型后，金标页召回提升至 100%，最终测试集达成 0.762 论文 F1、0.441 证据 F1 与 0.920 多选准确率。
AI.motivation: 在 27,487 篇论文池中回答研究问题，并给出答案所在的页码与表/图引用，是证据可溯问答的核心需求。作者希望定位端到端流程的失败环节，判断误差主要来自检索还是模型阅读能力。
AI.method: 先采用"页面选择器 + 证据定位器"的两段式流水线：选择器负责筛出候选页，定位器在给定页面中引用具体页码/表/图。诊断发现选择器仅 52.6% 金标页召回后，改为将每篇检索到的论文整篇送入模型上下文，页面排序仅保留作为超长论文的兜底策略。对按位置指代的问题（如"第 24 条参考文献的第一作者"）改用参考文献解析为可寻址列表，同时为证据指标提供标识符。
AI.result: 定位器在给定正确页面时 48 次引用中 45 次命中正确页（94%）；页面缺失时 45 例中 14 例不输出、24 例给错页、7 例反而正确，即静默失败约为显式失败的近两倍。改为整篇输入后，可解析论文上金标页召回达 100%。最终系统在留出测试集上取得 0.762 论文 F1、0.441 证据 F1、0.920 多选准确率。
AI.conclusion: 证据接地的主要限制来自检索而非阅读能力，因此应放弃页面挑选、直接整篇输入；位置型问题应由解析而非检索处理。由于流程依赖无法控制随机种子的闭源模型，作者发布校验工具，用已提交的工件复核论文核心结论。

title: TeochewBench: A Human-Reviewed Benchmark for Teochew Hanzi Translation
summary: Teochew has a substantial speaker community and exhibits distinctive lexical, syntactic, and pragmatic features, yet textual resources for evaluating large language models remain limited. We present TeochewBench, a human-reviewed benchmark comprising 300 Teochew Hanzi expressions for evaluating translation from Teochew Hanzi into Mandarin Chinese and English. The dataset covers five categories: basic vocabulary; everyday sentences; Teochew-specific expressions; tone, politeness, and context; and idiomatic, ambiguous, and culturally specific expressions. A primary Teochew-speaking reviewer examined all entries individually and revised them as needed, while two additional Teochew speakers verified selected items. Our main evaluation covers 11 official general-purpose post-trained models on the reviewed dataset in both translation directions, yielding 6,600 predictions. Two official base checkpoints provide 1,200 predictions for supplementary diagnostics, bringing the total to 13 models and 7,800 predictions. We additionally include a Hanzi-copy control, which returns the source input unchanged, to assess how shared Hanzi affect automatic scores for translation into Mandarin Chinese. Qwen3.5-27B achieved the highest overall chrF-style score among the evaluated checkpoints, at 60.63, followed by Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct at 56.61, Gemma-3-27B-IT at 56.36, and GLM-4-32B-0414 at 55.82. Across the 11 main-evaluation models, the mean chrF-style score decreased from 69.25 for low-specificity items to 27.52 for high-specificity items. High-specificity expressions received lower scores and exhibited smaller cross-model differences, suggesting that they constitute a shared low-scoring region across the model families evaluated here. The Hanzi-copy control further indicates that surface overlap in low-specificity items can substantially affect automatic scores for translation into Mandarin Chinese.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TeochewBench，一个经人工审核、包含 300 条潮州话汉字表达的基准，用于评测潮州话汉字到普通话和英语的翻译；对 13 个模型共 7800 条预测的评测显示，高特异性表达构成跨模型家族的低分共享区域，汉字复制对照表明表层重叠会影响自动评分。
AI.motivation: 潮州话拥有庞大的使用群体，并在词汇、句法和语用上具有鲜明特征，但用于评测大语言模型的文本资源仍然有限，缺乏可用的翻译评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 TeochewBench：300 条经人工审核的潮州话汉字表达，涵盖基础词汇、日常句子、潮州话特有表达、声调/礼貌/语境、习语歧义与文化特定表达五类；由一名母语审核者逐条检查修订，另两名潮州话使用者验证部分条目。主评测覆盖 11 个官方通用后训练模型，双向翻译共 6600 条预测；另加 2 个官方基座检查点的 1200 条预测作补充诊断，合计 13 个模型、7800 条预测。并设置“汉字复制”对照（原样返回输入），以评估共享汉字对译入普通话自动评分的影响。
AI.result: Qwen3.5-27B 取得最高总体 chrF 类分数 60.63，其后为 Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 56.61、Gemma-3-27B-IT 56.36、GLM-4-32B-0414 55.82。11 个主评测模型平均 chrF 类分数由低特异性条目的 69.25 降至高特异性条目的 27.52；高特异性表达得分更低且跨模型差异更小，构成跨模型家族的共享低分区。汉字复制对照进一步表明，低特异性条目的表层重叠会显著影响译入普通话的自动评分。
AI.conclusion: TeochewBench 为潮州话翻译提供了人工审核的评测基准；结果显示模型性能随表达特异性升高而显著下降，高特异性表达是各模型家族共同的薄弱环节，且基于表层重叠的自动指标在共享汉字场景下存在明显偏差。

title: Energy-Regularized Imitation Learning for Force- and Work-Aware Robotic Manipulation
comment: ECCV 2026 Workshop on Force-Grounded, Cross-View Articulated Manipulation
summary: This paper studies energy-aware manipulation as a physically grounded learning problem. We define a joint-space mechanical-work proxy from joint torque and angular displacement, and train a differentiable energy predictor that estimates this work from robot states and actions. The predictor converts a non-differentiable simulator-side physical quantity into a differentiable regularizer for fine-tuning a pretrained manipulation policy. We instantiate the framework with RVT-2 on RLBench and evaluate 12 manipulation tasks involving object contact, articulated motion, placement, pushing, and sweeping. The proposed fine-tuning reduces the average mechanical work from 208.8J to 204.4J (i.e., 2.1% reduction), while the mean task success rate also increases slightly from 86.2% to 86.9%. These results show that work-aware policy optimization can suppress physically inefficient motion without requiring an explicit differentiable dynamics model.

AI.tldr: 提出一个从关节力矩与角位移定义的关节空间机械功代理量，训练可微能量预测器将其转为可微正则项，用于微调预训练操作策略，在RLBench上以RVT-2实现。
AI.motivation: 将能量感知操作建模为具有物理基础的学习问题，希望在无需显式可微动力学模型的前提下，抑制物理效率低下的运动，实现工作感知的策略优化。
AI.method: 定义关节空间机械功代理量（由关节力矩与角位移构成）；训练可微能量预测器，从机器人状态与动作估计该机械功；将仿真器侧不可微的物理量转化为可微正则项，用于微调预训练操作策略。框架以RVT-2在RLBench上实例化，评估12个涉及物体接触、铰接运动、放置、推动与扫掠的操作任务。
AI.result: 微调使平均机械功从208.8J降至204.4J（降低2.1%），同时平均任务成功率由86.2%略升至86.9%。
AI.conclusion: 工作感知的策略优化能够在不需要显式可微动力学模型的情况下抑制物理效率低下的运动，且不损害甚至略微提升任务成功率。

title: T-SANDHI: Tone Sandhi-aware Adaptive Network with Decoupled Hybrid Injection for Low-resource Taiwanese Hokkien Speech Recognition
summary: In Taiwanese Hokkien automatic speech recognition (ASR), prior studies often treat tone sandhi as a major challenge under the assumption that models fail to process implicit phonological variations. However, our experiments on Taiwanese Hokkien reveal that speech foundation models actually handle tone sandhi variations effectively, and the real performance bottleneck stems from a localized confusion between these variations and retained citation tones. To address this, we propose T-SANDHI to explicitly decouple surface acoustics from underlying lexical intent on top of a frozen Whisper backbone. Using a lexicon-guided multi-task learning structure driven by text-derived pseudo labels, our lightweight hybrid injection module integrates independent citation and sandhi phonetic streams via dynamic gating. Extensive evaluation on the TAT-MOE corpus and two blind test sets demonstrates that this explicit disentanglement effectively resolves tonal mapping confusion, outperforming baselines with strict parameter efficiency.

AI.tldr: 在台湾闽南语ASR中，变调并非真正的性能瓶颈，真正的瓶颈是变调与不变调（本调）之间的局部混淆；作者提出T-SANDHI，在冻结的Whisper基础上显式解耦表层声学与底层词汇意图，显著缓解声调映射混淆。
AI.motivation: 以往研究普遍将变调（tone sandhi）视为台湾闽南语ASR的主要挑战，假设模型无法处理隐式的音系变化。但本文实验发现，语音基础模型实际上能有效处理变调变化，真正的性能瓶颈在于变调变体与保留本调（citation tones）之间的局部混淆。因此需要一种显式解耦的方法来解决这一混淆问题，而非单纯提升模型对变调的建模能力。
AI.method: 提出T-SANDHI方法，在冻结的Whisper骨干网络之上，显式地将表层声学与底层词汇意图解耦。核心包括：①词典引导的多任务学习结构（lexicon-guided multi-task learning）；②由文本衍生的伪标签（pseudo labels）进行驱动；③轻量级混合注入模块（lightweight hybrid injection module），通过动态门控（dynamic gating）整合相互独立的本调（citation）与变调（sandhi）语音流。
AI.result: 在TAT-MOE语料库及两个盲测集（blind test sets）上的大量评估表明，该显式解耦方法能有效解决声调映射混淆问题，在严格参数效率（strict parameter efficiency）约束下优于各项基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 台湾闽南语ASR的核心问题不是模型无法处理变调，而是变调与不变调之间的声调映射混淆；通过显式解耦表层声学与底层词汇意图，并借助本调/变调双流与动态门控，可在极低参数开销下有效提升识别性能。

title: Behavior2Value: Benchmarking and Empowering LLMs for Consumer Value Measurement from E-commerce Behaviors
summary: Human values are deep motivational orientations that shape human behaviors. In e-commerce, they reveal the stable drivers behind users' purchase decisions. Compared with short-term interests, consumer values better explain how users evaluate products before purchase. However, consumer values are often implicit in complex and fragmented behavioral trajectories, leaving value measurement from e-commerce behaviors largely underexplored. To this end, we propose the Behavior-to-Value (B2V) task, which aims to identify consumer values from e-commerce behavioral trajectories. Centered on this task, we first construct the E-commerce Consumption Value Taxonomy (ECVT) and introduce B2V-Bench, the first B2V dataset and benchmark, based on anonymized Taobao behavioral logs. B2V-Bench consists of real-world purchase decision episodes, covering 25 types of purchase behaviors, along with corresponding consumer value orientations manifested in each episode. To improve consumer value measurement accuracy, we further present B2V-Verifier, a behavior-to-value measurement model based on Value Verification Tuning, which learns to assess whether behaviors provide sufficient evidence for each value inference. Experiments show that B2V-Verifier outperforms strong LLM baselines, improving multi-label classification by 34\%. The dataset and code will be publicly released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Behavior-to-Value (B2V)任务，构建ECVT价值分类体系与B2V-Bench基准数据集，并提出基于价值验证微调的B2V-Verifier模型，从电商行为轨迹中推断消费者价值，多标签分类较LLM基线提升34%。
AI.motivation: 消费者价值是塑造购买行为的深层动机取向，相较短期兴趣更能解释用户购前对产品的评估方式。然而消费者价值常隐含于复杂、碎片化的行为轨迹中，从电商行为中测量价值的研究尚不充分，存在明显空白。
AI.method: 1) 提出B2V任务，从电商行为轨迹中识别消费者价值；2) 构建电商消费价值分类体系ECVT；3) 基于匿名化淘宝行为日志构建首个B2V数据集与基准B2V-Bench，包含真实购买决策片段、25类购买行为及对应价值取向；4) 提出B2V-Verifier，采用价值验证微调（Value Verification Tuning），学习判断行为是否为每项价值推断提供充分证据。
AI.result: B2V-Verifier优于强LLM基线，多标签分类性能提升34%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将消费者价值测量形式化为可计算任务，提供了分类体系、数据集与验证式建模方法，验证了行为证据充分性建模在价值推断中的有效性；数据集与代码将在录用后公开。

title: Beyond Accuracy: How Procedural Traces Shift the Decision Criterion of LLM Overseers
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the 60th Hawaii International Conference on System Sciences (HICSS)
summary: Organizations increasingly use oversight loops where one large language model (LLM) audits another's outputs alongside procedural traces of claimed steps. A common concern about such LLM-as-a-judge pipelines is that detailed traces make overseers gullible. Using signal detection theory, we audit five LLM overseers on 19 compliance tasks (4,551 analyzed judgments), varying only trace detail and evidence labeling. With disconfirming evidence always visible, error detection remains near ceiling. Instead, elaborate traces shift the decision criterion toward rejection, increasing false alarms in susceptible overseers. Without option labels, human-validated reason coding shows about 60% of false alarms cite an inability to tie evidence to its option. Labels eliminate this stated reason, yet residual rejection of correct work persists in those overseers and rises with trace detail. Procedural traces thus act as governance artifacts that shape oversight decisions. AI auditors should be evaluated by their decision criterion and false-alarm behavior, alongside accuracy.

AI.tldr: 该研究基于信号检测论审计5个LLM监督模型在19项合规任务上的4,551条判断，发现异议证据可见时错误检出率接近上限；详细的程序性轨迹（procedural traces）会使部分监督者的判定标准偏向拒绝，增加误报；缺少选项标签时约60%误报声称无法将证据对应到选项，标签可消除该理由但无法完全消除误判。
AI.motivation: 组织日益采用"LLM-as-a-judge"式监督回路，即一个大型语言模型审计另一个模型的输出及其所声称步骤的程序性轨迹。常见担忧是：过度详细的轨迹会让监督者变得轻信（gullible）。作者希望检验这一担忧是否成立，并厘清轨迹细节与证据标注对监督判断的实际影响。
AI.method: 采用信号检测论（signal detection theory）框架，对5个LLM监督者在19项合规任务上的判断进行审计，共分析4,551条判断。实验仅操纵两个变量：轨迹细节程度（trace detail）与证据标签（evidence labeling）。在异议证据（disconfirming evidence）始终可见的条件下，测量错误检出率、判定标准（decision criterion）与误报（false alarms），并结合人工验证的理由编码分析误报的归因。
AI.result: 在异议证据始终可见时，错误检出接近天花板（near ceiling），即监督者并不因细节轨迹而漏检错误。反而，详尽的轨迹使判定标准向拒绝方向移动，在易受影响的监督者中提高误报率。无选项标签时，人工验证的理由编码显示约60%的误报理由是"无法将证据与其选项对应"；加入标签可消除这一陈述理由，但在这类监督者中仍存在对正确工作的残余拒绝，且随轨迹细节增加而上升。
AI.conclusion: 程序性轨迹作为"治理性人工制品"（governance artifacts）会塑造监督决策，而非单纯提升或降低监督质量。评价AI审计者时，除准确率外，还应考察其判定标准与误报行为。这提示LLM监督管线的评估指标需要扩展。

title: CapMap-MS-TTA: 3rd Place Solution for the MUMU Track of the 8th LSVOS Challenge at ECCV 2026
summary: The MUMU track of the 8th Large-scale Video Object Segmentation (LSVOS) Challenge requires a single unified multimodal model to jointly solve image tagging (Task A), open-vocabulary object detection (Task B), and English captioning (Task C) under strict resource constraints (<=0.5B parameters and <=8 GB peak GPU memory). We present CapMap-MS-TTA, a training-free submission built on Microsoft Florence-2-base (~231M parameters), combining caption keyword mapping with multi-scale flip test-time augmentation. Task C uses the native <DETAILED_CAPTION> pathway with length/token sanitization. Task A maps the same detailed caption into the official quality/scene/event vocabularies via an expanded keyword lexicon with whole-word matching and a lightweight expand-hints stage. Task B runs Florence-2 open detection (<OD>) with multi-scale and horizontal-flip test-time augmentation (TTA), followed by label-aware non-maximum suppression (NMS). Without fine-tuning, the system improves our reproduced Florence-2 baseline from 15.16 to a best public score of 16.4815, and ranks 3rd on the final MUMU leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CapMap-MS-TTA，一个无需训练的提交方案，基于 Florence-2-base（约231M参数），用关键词映射与多尺度翻转TTA统一完成 MUMU 赛道的图像打标、开放词汇目标检测与英文描述三项任务，在资源约束下将复现基线从15.16提升至16.4815，最终排名第3。
AI.motivation: MUMU 赛道要求用单一统一多模态模型同时完成图像打标（任务A）、开放词汇目标检测（任务B）与英文描述生成（任务C），且受严格资源约束（≤0.5B参数、≤8GB显存峰值）。现有方案通常需分别针对不同任务进行微调，在此约束下难以兼顾，因此需要一种无需训练、单一模型即可统一解决的方案。
AI.method: 方法基于 Microsoft Florence-2-base（约231M参数），完全免微调。任务C直接使用原生 <DETAILED_CAPTION> 通路并做长度/token清洗；任务A将同一详细描述通过扩展关键词词典与整词匹配映射到官方质量/场景/事件词表，并加入轻量 expand-hints 阶段；任务B使用 Florence-2 开放检测（<OD>），结合多尺度与水平翻转测试时增强（TTA），再做标签感知非极大值抑制（NMS）。
AI.result: 在未微调的情况下，系统将复现的 Florence-2 基线得分从15.16提升至最佳公开分数16.4815，并在 MUMU 最终榜单上排名第3。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，在严格的参数与显存约束下，依托单一大模型的原生能力，配合关键词映射与多尺度翻转TTA等免训练后处理策略，即可有效统一完成多模态理解的多项子任务，并取得具竞争力的竞赛成绩。

title: Understanding Dynamic Scenes at Gigapixel Scale: Wide-Area Spatio-Temporal Perception from UAVs
summary: UAV-borne imaging has advanced from megapixel to gigapixel sensors, shifting aerial perception from recognizing individual targets to understanding entire dynamic scenes. We characterize this demand as Wide-area Spatio-temporal Scene Understanding (WSTU), which requires wide-area coverage, per-target resolution, and temporal continuity at once, a combination existing datasets lack. To fill this gap, we introduce an ultra-High-resolution (12768x9564) Airborne Remote-sensing Dataset (HARD) annotated at three levels for object detection, multi-object tracking, and scene-level visual question answering. Ultra-high-resolution imagery raises per-frame processing time to seconds. At that scale latency can no longer be ignored in evaluation. Thus, we propose a latency-aware metric for multi-object tracking called streaming-HOTA (s-HOTA). Extensive baseline experiments show how ultra-high-resolution processing reshapes each task. For detection, the end-to-end pipeline affects accuracy and speed as much as the detector itself does. For tracking, high latency charges the association axis far more unevenly than the detection axis, and association is where pipelines diverge. As a result, the pipeline that performs best offline can lose its lead under s-HOTA. For VQA, vision-language models remain weak at cross-frame identity binding and cannot transfer their single-frame gains to it. Together these findings show that the baselines we evaluate fall short of WSTU. HARD provides the data and the systematic baselines to advance it.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"广域时空场景理解（WSTU）"新任务范式，发布超高清（12768×9564）航空遥感数据集HARD（含检测、多目标跟踪、场景级VQA三级标注），并提出延迟感知的跟踪指标s-HOTA，系统基线实验揭示超高清处理对三类任务的重塑效应。
AI.motivation: 无人机成像已从百万像素发展到十亿像素传感器，空中感知任务从单目标识别转向对整个动态场景的理解。这种新需求被概括为WSTU，要求同时满足广域覆盖、单目标分辨率与时序连续性，而现有数据集无法同时满足这三点，因此存在数据与评测基准的空白。
AI.method: 构建超高清航空遥感数据集HARD（12768×9564），提供目标检测、多目标跟踪、场景级视觉问答三个层级的标注；针对超高清影像单帧处理达秒级、延迟不可忽略的问题，提出延迟感知的多目标跟踪指标streaming-HOTA（s-HOTA）；在此基础上开展三类任务的系统性基线实验。
AI.result: 检测任务中，端到端流水线对精度与速度的影响与检测器本身相当；跟踪任务中，高延迟对关联环节的影响远比对检测环节更不均衡，而流水线差异正体现在关联上，导致离线表现最佳的流水线在s-HOTA下可能失去领先优势；VQA任务中，视觉语言模型在跨帧身份绑定上仍很薄弱，无法将单帧增益迁移到跨帧场景理解。
AI.conclusion: 所评估的基线方法均未达到WSTU的要求。HARD数据集及配套的系统性基线为推进广域时空场景理解研究提供了数据基础与评测支撑。

title: A Lightweight CNN Integrated Compact Convolutional Transformer for Multi-Scale Feature Learning and reducing computational complexity for breast cancer mammography image detection and classification
summary: Over the years, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have demonstrated strong capability in cancer detection and classification using medical images. However, CNN-based models often struggle to capture long-range contextual dependencies. In such scenarios, integrating Compact Convolutional Transformer (CCT) architectures after the CCT layer allows CNN-extracted features to reshape into compact patch tokens using a CCT tokenizer, followed by the addition of positional embeddings to preserve spatial structure. Using 5-fold cross-validation, the model was tested on 3 sets of breast cancer mammography. With only 250,435 parameters, the model achieved 99%-100% accuracy across 3 datasets, indicating robust generalization. Explainable AI (XAI) was integrated into the model to explain the breast cancer classification process to enhance clinical trust. The results indicate that the proposed framework is suitable for computer-aided diagnosis systems, particularly in resource-constrained clinical environments. The novelty of the proposed CNN-integrated CCT overcomes the limitation of CNN's gradient degradation in the last layers by integrating convolutional tokenization with transformer-based learning. Lighter than ViT, which is effective in capturing long-range dependencies, the model has also proven efficient in breast cancer classification by capturing long-range dependencies among breast tissue regions.

AI.tldr: 提出一种CNN集成紧凑卷积Transformer（CCT）的乳腺癌乳腺X线分类框架，参数仅约25万，3个数据集上5折交叉验证准确率达99%–100%，并引入可解释AI提升临床可信度。
AI.motivation: CNN在医学图像癌症检测中表现强，但难以捕捉长程上下文依赖，且深层存在梯度退化问题；ViT虽擅长长程依赖但模型偏重。需要兼顾长程建模能力与轻量化，以适配资源受限的临床环境。
AI.method: 在CNN提取特征后接入CCT架构：通过CCT tokenizer将CNN特征重塑为紧凑patch token，并加入位置嵌入以保留空间结构；在3组乳腺癌乳腺X线数据集上采用5折交叉验证评估；集成可解释AI（XAI）解释分类过程。
AI.result: 模型仅含250,435个参数，在3个数据集上均取得99%–100%的准确率，表现出稳健的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该框架适用于计算机辅助诊断系统，尤其适合资源受限的临床环境；其创新性在于以卷积tokenization结合Transformer学习克服CNN末层梯度退化，并比ViT更轻量，在捕捉乳腺组织区域间长程依赖方面高效。

title: WISE: A Lightweight, Weakly-Supervised Model for Onboard Fire Smoke Detection and Localization
summary: Wildfire smoke detection from satellite imagery is critical for early warning and rapid response. For onboard satellite deployment, detection systems must operate under strict memory and latency constraints while providing spatially informative outputs for downstream decision-making. Existing tile-level classification methods are computationally efficient but lack spatial localization, whereas pixel-level segmentation approaches provide detailed masks yet are typically too computationally demanding for real-time onboard execution. To address this gap, we propose WISE (Weakly-supervised Inference-efficient Smoke Extraction), a deployment-oriented framework for onboard fire smoke detection and localization. WISE leverages only tile-level annotations through a teacher-student distillation strategy, where an offline teacher provides soft spatial supervision to a lightweight WISE-Student optimized for efficient onboard inference. The student jointly predicts tile-level smoke presence and smoke probability maps within a single forward pass, enabling spatially informative detection under strict computational constraints. WISE was evaluated through in-orbit execution aboard the ISS-mounted IMAGIN-e payload. Three model variants achieve average inference times of 0.10 s, 0.14 s, and 0.26 s per tile, indicating near-real-time per-tile inference within onboard resource limits. Ground-based experiments on Landsat 5 and Landsat 8 imagery further indicate effective detection and spatially informative localization. The best-performing variant achieves a mean tile-level F1 score of 0.964 and a mean pixel-level F1 score of 0.750 across 10 runs, while containing only 0.12M parameters and requiring approximately 3 GFLOPs. Together, these results indicate that WISE is a practical candidate for low-latency wildfire smoke monitoring from space under onboard resource constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出WISE框架，利用瓦片级弱监督与教师-学生蒸馏，实现星载轻量级野火烟雾检测与空间定位，单次前向同时输出瓦片分类与像素概率图。
AI.motivation: 星载野火烟雾检测需在严格内存与时延约束下提供空间定位信息。现有瓦片级分类计算高效但缺乏定位，像素级分割定位精细但计算量过大，难以实时星载部署，二者之间存在能力与效率的空白。
AI.method: WISE采用仅瓦片级标注的教师-学生蒸馏策略：离线教师网络提供软空间监督，指导面向高效星载推理的轻量WISE-Student；学生在单次前向中联合预测瓦片级烟雾存在性与烟雾概率图，实现受约束条件下的空间信息检测。
AI.result: 在ISS搭载的IMAGIN-e载荷上完成在轨验证，三种模型变体平均单瓦片推理时间为0.10 s、0.14 s、0.26 s；基于Landsat 5与Landsat 8的地面实验显示有效检测与空间定位，最优变体10次运行平均瓦片级F1为0.964、像素级F1为0.750，仅含0.12M参数、约3 GFLOPs。
AI.conclusion: WISE在星载资源约束下兼顾低时延与空间定位能力，是实用的空间野火烟雾监测候选方案。

title: Unified Response Geometry for Structured Pruning
summary: Structured pruning is commonly formulated as ranking individual channels, although channel responses can be complementary or cancel through downstream mixing. Motivated by these response interactions, we formulate pruning as the selection of a subset with large joint response capacity, followed by a separate functional realization step. Our unified response geometry maps each candidate set to \(M(D,R)=D^{1/2}RD^{1/2}\) and uses its determinant together with Schur-greedy residuals to select non-redundant coordinates. The same construction yields two information-conditioned instances: an unlabeled instance based on activation covariance, and a task-conditioned instance that combines activation and gradient variance for response scale with gradient correlation for complementarity. To convert the selected subset into an executable network, we fold predictable removed responses into successor weights through ridge compensation and recalibrate batch-normalization statistics, without fine-tuning the network. On ImageNet ResNet-50, the unlabeled instance reaches \(65.4\%\) and \(53.9\%\) Top-1 accuracy at 30\% and 40\% deletion, versus \(59.8\%\) and \(43.1\%\) for strength-only selection; the task-conditioned instance reaches \(67.7\%\) and \(56.3\%\) under the same protocol. A six-family screen shows architecture-dependent behavior, with positive relative contrasts in several convolutional and expansion-layer settings and clear boundary cases in windowed attention. These results support response geometry as a conditional principle for structured pruning, with its benefit determined jointly by the observed response and the architecture in which that response is realized.

AI.tldr: 该论文将结构化剪枝重新表述为"选择具有大联合响应能力的子集 + 单独的功能实现步骤"，提出统一的响应几何 M(D,R)=D^{1/2}RD^{1/2}，并实例化了无标签（基于激活协方差）与任务条件（结合激活、梯度方差与梯度相关性）两种版本，通过岭补偿折叠被移除响应并重校准BN，无需微调。
AI.motivation: 传统结构化剪枝把每个通道独立排序，忽视了通道响应在下游混合中可能互补或相互抵消，因而无法刻画通道集合的联合响应能力。作者由此希望以响应交互为核心，将剪枝从"逐通道打分"转变为"子集选择"问题。
AI.method: 将剪枝表述为先选择具有大联合响应能力的通道子集，再进行独立的功能实现。用统一响应几何 M(D,R)=D^{1/2}RD^{1/2} 把候选集合映射为矩阵，利用其行列式并结合 Schur 贪心残差挑选非冗余坐标。基于同一构造给出两个信息条件实例：无标签实例使用激活协方差；任务条件实例用激活与梯度方差刻画响应尺度、用梯度相关性刻画互补性。转换阶段通过岭补偿把可预测的被移除响应折叠进后继权重，并重新校准 BN 统计量，无需微调。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet ResNet-50 上，删除 30% 与 40% 时，无标签实例达到 65.4% 和 53.9% Top-1，而仅按强度选择为 59.8% 和 43.1%；任务条件实例在同一协议下达到 67.7% 和 56.3%。六族模型筛查显示行为依赖架构：若干卷积与扩张层设置中相对对比为正，而在窗口注意力结构中出现明显边界情形。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持响应几何作为结构化剪枝的条件性原则：其收益由观测到的响应与实现该响应的架构共同决定。

title: Cross-Lingual Parkinson's Disease Severity Assessment Using Pre-trained Speech Embeddings: A Multi-Class Evaluation
comment: Accepted and published at IEEE SLT 2026 - IEEE Spoken Language Technology 2026. OneVoice-MSD 2026: Multilingual Speech Technologies for Motor Speech Disorders. https://attend.ieee.org/slt-2026/ Please cite the conference version
summary: Parkinson's disease (PD) often manifests through speech impairments, facilitating accessible, non-invasive, and cost-effective severity assessment for early diagnosis and progression tracking. Despite advances in speech foundation models (SFMs), their cross-lingual generalization for PD severity multi-class classification remains underexplored due to limited labeled data, a lack of explainable methods and variability across languages and datasets. In this work, we evaluate pre-trained embeddings from four state-of-the-art open-source SFMs across three datasets in zero-shot and k-shot cross-lingual settings for multi-class PD severity assessment. Our results show that pre-trained speech embeddings enable meaningful cross-lingual transfer, although performance is sensitive to dataset properties, preprocessing, and adaptation strategy. Misclassifications under these conditions related to inter-speaker variability and atypical speech patterns highlight the need for more robust feature extraction and modeling for PD severity assessment while emphasizing the importance of explainability for reliable clinical insights.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了四种开源语音基础模型（SFM）的预训练嵌入在三个数据集上、零样本与k样本跨语言设置下进行帕金森病（PD）严重程度多分类的表现，发现预训练语音嵌入可实现有意义的跨语言迁移，但性能对数据集属性、预处理和适配策略敏感，且误分类与说话人间变异和非典型语音模式相关。
AI.motivation: PD常表现为语音障碍，语音为PD严重程度的无创、低成本、可及性高的评估提供了途径，有利于早期诊断与病程追踪。尽管语音基础模型（SFM）已有进展，但其在PD严重程度多分类中的跨语言泛化仍缺乏研究，原因包括标注数据有限、缺少可解释方法，以及语言和数据集间的变异性。
AI.method: 评估四种最先进的开源SFM的预训练嵌入，在三个数据集上、于零样本（zero-shot）与k样本（k-shot）跨语言设置下，进行PD严重程度多分类评估。
AI.result: 预训练语音嵌入可实现有意义的跨语言迁移，但性能对数据集属性、预处理流程和适配策略较为敏感；在此条件下的误分类与说话人间变异（inter-speaker variability）及非典型语音模式相关。
AI.conclusion: PD严重程度评估需要更稳健的特征提取与建模，同时应重视可解释性，以提供可靠的临床洞见。

title: Evolving Error States: Failure-Aware Progressive Repair for Ultrasound Lesion Segmentation
summary: Reliability under sparse and heterogeneous failures remains a fundamental challenge for medical image segmentation. High average accuracy can conceal a small set of structurally distinct and clinically consequential errors. Existing post-hoc correction methods alleviate this problem, but typically estimate false-positive and false-negative corrections from the same fixed prediction. This ignores the dynamic evolution of error states and limits the correction of complex cases. Inspired by iterative error feedback in structured prediction, we propose Failure-Aware Progressive Repair (FAPR). FAPR represents the current segmentation mask as a dynamic failure state and models each repair operation as a state-transition operator. Each accepted correction forms a new prediction state for subsequent error diagnosis and repair, enabling later operations to adapt to preceding changes. Conditional routing selectively activates necessary state transitions, while failure replay exposes the model to rare error states. By keeping the base segmentor frozen, FAPR preserves its established segmentation capability while improving difficult cases. Across three public ultrasound lesion segmentation benchmarks, FAPR improves mean DSC by 1.52%. On the very-hard subsets of BUSI and TN3K, the average gain reaches 13.77%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Failure-Aware Progressive Repair（FAPR），将分割掩码建模为动态失败状态，把修复操作视为状态转移算子，通过条件路由与失败重放实现迭代式后处理修复，在三个超声病灶分割基准上平均DSC提升1.52%，极难子集上提升达13.77%。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割中，稀疏且异质的失败是核心挑战：高平均精度会掩盖少量结构性、临床后果严重的错误。现有后处理纠正方法从同一固定预测中估计假阳/假阴修正，忽略了错误状态的动态演化，难以修复复杂病例。
AI.method: 受结构化预测中迭代误差反馈的启发，提出FAPR。该方法将当前分割掩码表示为动态失败状态，将每次修复操作建模为状态转移算子；每次被接受的修正形成新的预测状态，供后续错误诊断与修复使用，使后续操作能适应先前变化。条件路由选择性激活必要的状态转移，失败重放则让模型暴露于稀有错误状态。基础分割器保持冻结，以保留其已有分割能力。
AI.result: 在三个公开超声病灶分割基准上，FAPR使平均DSC提升1.52%；在BUSI和TN3K的极难子集上，平均增益达13.77%。
AI.conclusion: FAPR通过迭代式、状态转移驱动的渐进修复范式，在不破坏基础分割器能力的前提下显著改善困难病例的分割可靠性。

title: An Evaluation of AI-Supported Evidence-Based Learning for Public Speaking Skill Development
comment: Proceedings of the 54th Annual Conference of the European Society for Engineering Education (SEFI 2026)
summary: Public speaking is an essential skill in academic and professional contexts, but it often causes anxiety. Although several AI-based speech coaching tools exist, they typically provide generic feedback and lack model speeches for learning. This study addresses these gaps by developing a system that incorporates speech context into evaluation criteria, enabling more tailored feedback. It also generates improved model speeches in both text and audio formats to support example-based learning. The system was evaluated in a pilot study with seven undergraduate students over one to three weeks. Participants used the system repeatedly and practiced the same speech at least three times. Results showed improvements in public speaking performance for all participants. Filler word usage decreased, and anxiety levels dropped by 15.3% to 34.4%. Participants found the context-aware feedback and revised speeches useful and confidence-building. These findings suggest that context-aware feedback and model speeches can enhance public speaking skills and reduce anxiety. Future studies could explore video-based analysis of physical behavior during speeches.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个融入演讲情境(context-aware)的AI演讲辅导系统，提供个性化反馈并生成改进后的文本与音频范例演讲，经7名本科生1–3周试点验证，所有参与者演讲表现提升、填充词减少、焦虑下降15.3%–34.4%。
AI.motivation: 公开演讲是学术与职业场景中的关键技能，但常引发焦虑。现有AI语音辅导工具多提供通用(generic)反馈，且缺乏可供模仿学习的范例演讲(model speeches)，难以满足个性化与示例学习的需求。
AI.method: 将演讲情境(speech context)纳入评价标准，构建情境感知的反馈生成机制，以输出更具针对性的个性化反馈；同时生成改进后的范例演讲，包含文本与音频两种模态，以支持基于示例的学习(example-based learning)。采用试点研究(pilot study)：7名本科生，持续1–3周，反复使用系统并对同一演讲练习至少3次。
AI.result: 所有参与者的公开演讲表现均有提升；填充词(filler words)使用减少；焦虑水平下降15.3%至34.4%。参与者认为情境感知反馈与修订后的演讲范例有用，并有助于建立信心(confidence-building)。
AI.conclusion: 情境感知反馈与范例演讲可有效提升公开演讲技能并降低焦虑。未来研究可探索对演讲中身体行为的视频分析(video-based analysis of physical behavior)。

title: M2Tok: Multi-head Multi-codebook Discrete Action Tokenization for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Recent advancements have successfully adapted autoregressive language models to process multimodal signals, such as images and actions. Since raw action signals are continuous, effective tokenization is essential to map high-dimensional inputs into compact discrete tokens for autoregressive processing. However, existing discrete action tokenizers often suffer from high reconstruction loss, failing to preserve the fine-grained dynamics required for precise control. This "discretization bottleneck" significantly limits the performance ceiling of downstream Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. To address this, we propose ${M}^2$Tok, a Multi-head Multi-codebook Action Tokenizer designed to minimize reconstruction error and enhance policy performance. Our approach introduces two key structural innovations: (1) we decompose the latent action features into multiple heads, enabling the model to implicitly align specific heads with distinct action dimensions; (2) we assign independent codebooks to each head for quantization. By leveraging the combinatorial nature of multiple codebooks, we significantly expand the representational expressivity of the tokenizer, leading to substantially lower reconstruction loss compared to previous methods. We evaluate the ${M}^2$Tok-based VLA on the RoboTwin, Simpler-Env, and 3 zero-shot real-world tasks. Experimental results demonstrate our method not only achieves superior reconstruction fidelity but also significantly boosts the success rate of VLA models. Comprehensive ablation studies further confirm the effectiveness of the multi-head and multi-codebook mechanisms. Code is available at https://github.com/cpaaax/M2Tok.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 M²Tok，一种多头多码本的动作分词器，通过将潜在动作特征分解为多个头并为每个头分配独立码本，利用组合性扩展表征能力，降低重构损失并提升 VLA 模型性能。
AI.motivation: 自回归语言模型已可处理图像、动作等多模态信号，但原始动作信号连续，需有效分词将高维输入映射为紧凑离散 token。现有离散动作分词器存在高重构损失问题，难以保留精确控制所需的细粒度动态，这一"离散化瓶颈"限制了下游 Vision-Language-Action（VLA）模型的性能上限。
AI.method: 提出 M²Tok（Multi-head Multi-codebook Action Tokenizer），包含两项结构创新：(1) 将潜在动作特征分解为多个头，使模型隐式地将特定头与不同动作维度对齐；(2) 为每个头分配独立码本进行量化。借助多码本的组合特性显著扩展分词器的表征表达能力。
AI.result: 在 RoboTwin、Simpler-Env 及 3 个零样本真实世界任务上评估基于 M²Tok 的 VLA。实验表明该方法不仅取得更优的重构保真度，还显著提升 VLA 模型的成功率；消融实验进一步验证多头与多码本机制的有效性。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: M²Tok 通过多头多码本设计缓解离散化瓶颈，在降低重构损失的同时提升下游 VLA 策略性能，为连续动作信号的离散化提供了有效方案。

title: MS-RFD: Multi-Signal Release Frame Detection in Hammer Throw from Reconstructed 3D Trajectories
summary: Recent advances in artificial intelligence and computer vision are reshaping sports performance analysis by enabling automated detection, tracking, and performance analysis. In hammer throw, performance is strongly determined by the kinematic conditions at release, particularly release speed, release angle, and release height. However, identifying the release instant from video typically requires manual frame-by-frame inspection, which is subjective and cumbersome in real-world training scenarios. In this paper, we present a fully automatic multi-signal release frame detection (MS-RFD) method for hammer throw using reconstructed 3D hammer trajectories. The proposed method integrates four complementary kinematic signals: speed dynamics, angular velocity transition, radial distance relative to the rotation center, and post-release trajectory linearity. These signals are fused to score and verify candidate release frames. MS-RFD is evaluated through the throwing-distance estimation error obtained from the release parameters estimated at the detected frame. An ablation study analyzes the contribution of each signal and compares alternative candidate selection strategies. The results show that speed dynamics and radial expansion provide the strongest signals for release frame detection, while angular velocity and post-release linearity provide smaller refinements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出全自动多信号出手帧检测方法（MS-RFD），利用重建的链球三维轨迹融合速度动态、角速度转变、相对旋转中心的径向距离及出手后轨迹线性度四种运动学信号，对候选出手帧打分与验证；通过出手参数估计的投掷距离误差进行评估。
AI.motivation: 链球运动成绩高度取决于出手瞬间的运动学条件（出手速度、出手角度、出手高度），但从视频中确定出手时刻通常需要人工逐帧检查，主观性强且在真实训练场景中繁琐低效。因此需要实现出手帧的自动检测。
AI.method: 提出MS-RFD方法：基于重建的链球三维轨迹，提取并融合四种互补的运动学信号——速度动态、角速度转变、相对旋转中心的径向距离、出手后轨迹线性度；将这些信号融合以对候选出手帧进行打分和验证，并对各信号的贡献及不同候选选择策略进行消融研究。
AI.result: 以检测帧处估计的出手参数所对应的投掷距离估计误差作为评价指标。结果表明，速度动态和径向扩张是出手帧检测中最强的信号，角速度与出手后线性度提供较小的精化作用。
AI.conclusion: MS-RFD能够实现链球出手帧的全自动检测，多信号融合策略有效，其中速度动态与径向扩张贡献最大；该方法有望替代主观、繁琐的人工逐帧标注，服务于实际训练中的运动表现分析。

title: I code or AI code: A comparative evaluation of AI-rated scores in classroom observations
summary: Classroom observations are widely recognized as a key tool for establishing benchmarks of education quality and guiding pedagogical improvement, yet they remain resource-intensive and dependent on trained observers. This study evaluated the feasibility of using a LLM (GPT-5 model) to score teacher-child interactions in early childhood classrooms, benchmarked against human raters. The study analyzed 87 video-recorded observations from 38 classrooms across 30 kindergartens in Hong Kong. Using observation transcripts, the AI model was configured to apply the full Classroom Assessment Scoring System (CLASS) framework. AI-rated scores were then compared with human ratings by examining correlations and differences in mean scores of the CLASS domains and dimensions. The results showed greater convergence between AI and raters for the Emotional Support domain and, in particular, the Quality of Feedback dimension, which captures how teachers use feedback to extend children's learning. Greater divergence emerged for interactions that were more procedural or context-dependent, particularly within the Classroom Organization and Instructional Support domains. These findings suggest that transcript-based AI scoring may capture some of the relative variation in teacher-child interactions but cannot yet reproduce calibrated human judgements consistently across the full CLASS framework. AI-assisted observation may therefore be more appropriate as a preliminary screening tool rather than as a replacement for trained observers, providing teachers with evidence for reflection rather than high-stakes evaluation. Future research should examine whether domain-specific training and incorporation of contextual and visual information can improve alignment between AI and human rated scores.

AI.tldr: 该研究以香港30所幼儿园、38个班级的87段课堂录像为样本，评估GPT-5模型依据完整CLASS框架对师幼互动评分、并与人工评分对比的可行性。
AI.motivation: 课堂观察是建立教育质量基准和指导教学改进的关键工具，但资源消耗大且依赖受训观察者，因此需要探索LLM自动化评分的可行性与边界。
AI.method: 基于观察转录文本，配置AI模型应用完整CLASS框架进行评分，再通过相关性与均值差异分析，将AI评分与人工评分在CLASS各领域和维度上进行比较。
AI.result: AI与人工评分在情感支持领域、尤其是"反馈质量"维度上一致性较高；在程序性更强、依赖情境的互动中差异较大，集中体现在班级组织与教学支持领域。
AI.conclusion: 基于转录的AI评分能捕捉师幼互动的部分相对差异，但尚不能在全CLASS框架上稳定复现经过校准的人工判断，更适合作为初步筛查工具而非替代受训观察者，用于教师反思而非高风险评价；未来可探索分领域训练及融入情境与视觉信息以提升一致性。

title: Decoder-Agnostic Token Merging for Vision Transformers: A Systematic Study of G2TM
comment: Extended version of https://cea.hal.science/cea-05578363, to be published in Communications in Computer and Information Science (CCIS), Springer. Codes are available at https://github.com/vbercy/g2tm
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have achieved state-of-the-art performance across a range of computer vision tasks, mainly thanks to the self-attention mechanism. However, its complexity, increasing quadratically with the number of tokens, remains the major obstacle to ViT efficiency and deployment at scale. Token merging reduces this cost by aggregating redundant tokens. Yet existing methods are typically evaluated within a single architecture, leaving open whether their effectiveness stems from the merging mechanism itself or from the specific decoder they are paired with. We extend Graph-Guided Token Merging (G2TM), a single module inserted early in a ViT-based network, beyond its original Segmenter setting. We evaluate G2TM across three semantic segmentation frameworks (Segmenter, SETR, EoMT) and three decoder families (Linear, Transformer-, convolution-based), as well as standard ViT image classification. Our results show that G2TM's behavior and accuracy-efficiency trade-off are consistent across every tested architecture for a given backbone size, indicating that its effectiveness is a property of the encoder rather than the decoder. G2TM also generalizes well to image classification, achieving an even smaller degradation in accuracy compared to semantic segmentation. We further find that G2TM's optimal hyperparameters, resulting in a consistent drop in GFLOPs of 22-47% and an increase in throughput by up to 74% for segmentation models on ADE20K dataset, depend primarily on the backbone's pre-training recipe and on the target dataset, rather than on the decoder choice.

AI.tldr: 该研究将图引导令牌合并（G2TM）模块从原始的Segmenter设置扩展到三种语义分割框架和三种解码器族，并验证了标准ViT图像分类。结果表明G2TM的有效性来自编码器而非解码器，具有架构无关性，可减少22-47% GFLOPs并提升最高74%吞吐量。
AI.motivation: ViT的自注意力机制复杂度随令牌数量呈二次增长，严重制约其效率与规模化部署。令牌合并虽能通过聚合冗余令牌降低成本，但现有方法通常仅在单一架构内评估，无法判断其有效性究竟源于合并机制本身，还是源于与之配对的特定解码器。
AI.method: 将G2TM（图引导令牌合并）——一个早期插入ViT网络中的单一模块——扩展到其原始Segmenter设置之外。在三种语义分割框架（Segmenter、SETR、EoMT）和三种解码器族（线性、Transformer、卷积）上评估G2TM，同时也在标准ViT图像分类任务上进行测试。
AI.result: 在给定骨干网络规模下，G2TM的行为与精度-效率权衡在所有测试架构中保持一致，说明其有效性是编码器的属性而非解码器。G2TM在图像分类任务上泛化良好，精度下降甚至小于语义分割。在ADE20K数据集上，G2TM最优超参数带来稳定的GFLOPs下降（22-47%）和吞吐量提升（最高74%），且最优超参数主要取决于骨干网络的预训练配方和目标数据集，而非解码器选择。
AI.conclusion: G2TM的有效性具有架构无关性，是编码器层面的属性，可跨分割框架、解码器族和分类任务泛化，为其广泛部署提供了依据。

title: Too Good to Be Real? Diagnosing and Reducing the Gap Between AI Preference and Real User Engagement
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to generate and evaluate online content, yet it remains unclear whether the qualities they associate with higher engagement match what real users respond to. We study this question using 1.17 million answers to 25,978 questions from Zhihu, Quora, and Reddit, comparing real platform answers and AI-generated answers across four within-question engagement levels. We introduce Ontological Preference Measurement, which represents answers along three dimensions: logic, affect, and expression. We find a systematic gap between AI preference and real user engagement: as target engagement increases, LLMs add more explicit logical structure, while real user engagement is more strongly associated with affective and expressive salience. We call this tendency logic overbinding. Based on this diagnosis, we propose Ontology-Masked Reasoning Autoencoding (OMRA), a controlled intervention that masks and reconstructs over-explained spans while preserving stance, factual content, and coherence. Across four LLM families, OMRA reduces the measured gap by an average of 54.4%. In human evaluation, OMRA wins 62.4% of pairwise preference judgments against matched real platform answers, even though the real answers are more often judged to be human-written.

AI.tldr: 该论文基于知乎、Quora、Reddit共117万条答案，提出"本体论偏好度量"（逻辑、情感、表达三维度），揭示了LLM偏好与真实用户参与度之间的系统性差距（"逻辑过绑定"），并提出OMRA干预方法缩小该差距。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地用于生成和评估在线内容，但LLM所认为的"高参与度"特质是否与真实用户的响应相符尚不清楚。论文旨在量化并诊断AI偏好与真实用户参与之间的错配。
AI.method: 研究使用三个平台（知乎、Quora、Reddit）25978个问题下的117万条答案，在四个问题内参与度水平上对比真实平台答案与AI生成答案。提出本体论偏好度量（Ontological Preference Measurement），沿逻辑、情感、表达三个维度表征答案。基于诊断结果提出本体论掩码推理自编码（OMRA），一种受控干预方法，对过度解释的文本片段进行掩码与重构，同时保持立场、事实内容和连贯性。
AI.result: 实验发现系统性差距：随着目标参与度升高，LLM增加更多显式逻辑结构，而真实用户参与度与情感和表达显著性关联更强，作者称之为"逻辑过绑定"（logic overbinding）。在四个LLM家族上，OMRA平均将所测差距缩小54.4%。在人类评估中，OMRA在成对偏好判断中以62.4%的胜率胜过匹配的真实平台答案，尽管真实答案更常被判定为人类所写。
AI.conclusion: LLM对高参与度内容的偏好偏向显式逻辑结构，与真实用户偏好存在系统性错配；OMRA能有效缓解这一差距，且在不牺牲人类写作质感判断的前提下提升偏好表现，为对齐AI内容生成与真实用户响应提供了可操作的干预路径。

title: Made in Hungary: Comments on the performance of generative language models
summary: In recent years, three initiatives have emerged to develop generative language models in Hungary. The motivation behind them is the same. For Hungarian, no model with the given capability existed, or existing English-centric models offered limited proficiency. A detailed examination of the corresponding studies, however, reveals several methodological limitations. First, the reliability of the evaluation protocols is questionable. Contrary to the findings of Csibi et al. [2026], evaluation under the recommended inference settings shows that Qwen3-4B achieves higher scores than Racka-4B, its Hungarian-adapted version. Data contamination is evident in the work of Yang et al. [2025d] and Szentmihályi et al. [2025], potentially biasing the reported results. Second, the training pipelines fall short of current best practices in corpus curation and data mixture, which risks wasting substantial compute on low-quality data. The lack of controlled ablations prevents reliable assessment of these choices. Third, none of the three papers assessed forgetting or capability loss. Testing the adapted models on a subset of the original benchmarks indicates performance decline in all three cases, especially Racka-4B. These observations emphasize the importance of rigorous experimental design in language model development, given the significant computational and financial costs involved.

AI.tldr: 该文评述匈牙利语生成式语言模型的三项研发工作，指出其评估协议可靠性存疑、训练流程不符合最佳实践、且均未评估灾难性遗忘，并以复现实验证明模型性能下降。
AI.motivation: 匈牙利语缺乏具备相应能力的生成式语言模型，现有英语中心模型在匈牙利语上表现有限，因此出现了三项本土化研发工作；本文旨在审视这些工作的实验严谨性。
AI.method: 对三项研究进行方法学审查：在推荐推理设置下重新评测Qwen3-4B与其匈牙利语适配版Racka-4B；检查数据污染问题；评估语料筛选与数据配比是否遵循当前最佳实践、是否存在受控消融；并在原始基准子集上测试适配模型的能力损失。
AI.result: 与Csibi等[2026]结论相反，Qwen3-4B得分高于其匈牙利语适配版Racka-4B；Yang等[2025d]与Szentmihályi等[2025]的工作存在明显数据污染，可能使结果有偏；三项工作的训练流程缺乏受控消融，难以验证其语料与数据混合决策；三个适配模型在原始基准上均出现性能下降，Racka-4B尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 在计算与资金成本高昂的背景下，语言模型研发必须重视严谨的实验设计，包括可靠的评估协议、防止数据污染、受控消融以及遗忘与能力损失的评估。

title: Relationally Guided Use Case Modeling with LLMs
summary: Use case flows are important elements of use case modeling because they support downstream software engineering activities, including requirements analysis, architectural and detailed design, and test case generation. However, constructing them manually is costly and expertise-intensive, while existing automated approaches still struggle to preserve semantic consistency, control-flow logic, data-flow logic, and the intended system boundary, especially when identifying branch points and generating alternative flows. To address this problem, we propose FlowGen for complete use case flow construction. FlowGen uses LLM-based Semantic Information Processing (SIP) to extract semantic elements, constructs a Semantic Relational Graph (SRG) encoded by an enhanced R-GAT for basic flow generation (BFGen), and further supports branch point prediction through BPP and branch-conditioned alternative flow generation through AFGen. Evaluations on 13 public and 7 industrial datasets show that FlowGen consistently outperforms competitive baselines in all three core components. In particular, BFGen improves over the best baseline by 14% in Precision, 7-25% in Recall, 11-30% in F1, and 10-19% in AUC; BPP improves Precision by 30-110%, Recall by 33-91%, and F1 by 32-117%; AFGen improves Precision by 8-23%, F1 by 5-18%, and AUC by 0.6-2.5%. Moreover, we validate the effectiveness of the LLM-based SIP module and the attention preservation factor in BFGen, analyze the impact of requirement completeness on BFGen, and examine how different scopes of branch-related context affect AFGen.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出FlowGen，用于完整用例流构建，包含LLM语义信息处理、语义关系图、基本流生成、分支点预测和分支条件化备选流生成，并在20个数据集上全面超越基线。
AI.motivation: 用例流对需求分析、架构建模、详细设计和测试用例生成等下游软件工程活动至关重要，但人工构建成本高且依赖专家经验；现有自动化方法在保持语义一致性、控制流逻辑、数据流逻辑和系统边界方面仍有困难，尤其在识别分支点与生成备选流时表现不足。
AI.method: FlowGen包含四个部分：基于LLM的语义信息处理（SIP）提取语义元素；构建语义关系图（SRG），并用增强的R-GAT编码以生成基本流（BFGen）；通过BPP进行分支点预测；通过AFGen生成分支条件化备选流。
AI.result: 在13个公开数据集和7个工业数据集上，FlowGen在三个核心组件上均持续优于竞争基线：BFGen在Precision上提升14%，Recall提升7-25%，F1提升11-30%，AUC提升10-19%；BPP的Precision提升30-110%，Recall提升33-91%，F1提升32-117%；AFGen的Precision提升8-23%，F1提升5-18%，AUC提升0.6-2.5%。此外验证了LLM-based SIP模块和BFGen中注意力保留因子的有效性，分析了需求完整性对BFGen的影响，并考察了不同分支相关上下文范围对AFGen的影响。
AI.conclusion: FlowGen能够实现完整用例流构建，并在基本流生成、分支点预测和备选流生成方面显著优于现有方法，同时验证了关键模块有效性及需求完整性和分支上下文范围的影响。

title: A Comparative Transfer-Learning Study of CNN Backbones for Partial Face Recognition on the SoF Dataset
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables, accepted at The 6th International Conference on Electrical, Computer, Communications and Mechatronics Engineering (ICECCME 2026)
summary: Face recognition is widely deployed in surveillance, access control, and forensic workflows, yet accuracy degrades sharply once the face is occluded by accessories, foreground objects, or the frame edge. Because most faces in the wild are partial, robust partial face recognition (PFR) remains open. This paper compares three pretrained convolutional backbones, ResNet-50, VGG-16, and FaceNet, fine-tuned for PFR by transfer learning under identical preprocessing, splitting, and optimization protocols on the Specs-on-Faces (SoF) dataset. All three arms use a common 160x160 input and a frozen backbone with a trainable head under a fixed epoch budget and no per-backbone hyperparameter search. The FaceNet configuration, denoted PFN (Partial FaceNet), substantially outperforms the other two, reaching 97.4% test accuracy with macro-averaged 87.04% precision, 84.61% recall, and 84.17% F1 over the 112 identity classes, the highest accuracy and recall reported on SoF.

AI.tldr: 本文在SoF数据集上以统一协议微调ResNet-50、VGG-16与FaceNet三种骨干网络进行部分人脸识别对比，FaceNet配置（PFN）取得97.4%测试准确率及最高宏平均召回，为SoF上已报告的最佳结果。
AI.motivation: 真实场景中的人脸常被配饰、前景物体或画面边界遮挡而呈部分状态，现有全脸识别模型在遮挡下精度显著下降，鲁棒的部分人脸识别（PFR）仍是未解难题，亟需明确何种预训练骨干在该任务上更优。
AI.method: 在Specs-on-Faces（SoF）数据集上，对ResNet-50、VGG-16、FaceNet三种预训练卷积骨干采用迁移学习微调：统一预处理、数据划分与优化协议，输入统一为160×160，冻结骨干、仅训练分类头，固定训练轮数且不进行逐骨干超参数搜索。
AI.result: FaceNet配置（PFN）显著优于其余两种骨干，测试准确率达97.4%，在112个身份类别上宏平均精确率87.04%、召回率84.61%、F1值84.17%，其中准确率与召回率均为SoF上已报告的最高水平。
AI.conclusion: 在完全相同的训练与评估条件下，FaceNet作为骨干在部分人脸识别上表现最佳，说明其人脸特异性的预训练特征比通用分类骨干（ResNet-50、VGG-16）更适配遮挡人脸任务，PFN可作为SoF上的强基线。

title: Visual Autoregressive Priors for RAW-to-sRGB Image Signal Processing
comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026 Workshop on Low-Level Vision Frontiers (LoViF). 13 pages, 4 figures
summary: RAW-to-sRGB image signal processing (ISP) must recover perceptually faithful colors and fine details from sensor measurements, often under imperfect spatial alignment and missing camera metadata. This paper presents, to the best of our knowledge, the first application of visual autoregressive (VAR) next-scale prediction over a discrete image codebook to the RAW-to-sRGB ISP task. We adapt a frozen 1.10\,B-parameter VAR backbone for RAW-conditioned ISP with only 32.93\,M trainable parameters (2.99\%), and propose a frequency-decomposed color loss that separately supervises low-frequency tone via wavelet LL cosine similarity and chromatic edges via detail-band $\ell_1$. On the Zurich RAW-to-sRGB benchmark, the method improves PSNR-Y from 21.31 to 21.89\,dB and reduces LPIPS from 0.276 to 0.218 on the full 1,204-image test set. Diagnostic experiments show that the VAR prior preserves structure well, but continuous color transfer remains the dominant bottleneck: oracle affine correction recovers 3.8\,dB, while learned color heads yield marginal gains.

AI.tldr: 本文将视觉自回归（VAR）下一尺度预测首次应用于RAW-to-sRGB ISP任务，仅训练2.99%参数，并提出频率分解颜色损失，在Zurich RAW-to-sRGB基准上提升PSNR-Y并降低LPIPS。
AI.motivation: RAW-to-sRGB ISP需在不完美的空间对齐与缺失相机元数据条件下，恢复感知真实的颜色与细节，现有方法在颜色保真上仍受限。
AI.method: 基于冻结的1.10B参数VAR骨干，仅微调32.93M参数（2.99%）实现RAW条件化ISP；提出频率分解颜色损失，用小波LL余弦相似度监督低频色调，用细节带ℓ1监督色度边缘。
AI.result: 在Zurich RAW-to-sRGB基准的1204张测试集上，PSNR-Y由21.31提升至21.89 dB，LPIPS由0.276降至0.218。诊断实验显示VAR先验结构保持良好，但连续颜色迁移是主要瓶颈：oracle仿射校正可恢复3.8 dB，学习式颜色头增益有限。
AI.conclusion: VAR下一尺度预测可有效应用于RAW-to-sRGB ISP并保持结构，但颜色迁移仍是核心瓶颈，需针对性改进颜色建模。

title: Rollback the World, Keep the Reflection: Rollback-Induced Reflection for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly tackle long-horizon tasks through multi-step environment interaction, yet a single erroneous action can alter subsequent states and observations, causing errors to compound over time. Existing methods either correct the context without repairing altered environment states or restore earlier states while discarding useful experience, making it difficult to both eliminate failure conditions and avoid repeating past mistakes. We argue that reliable recovery should instead be treated as a rollback-boundary control problem that jointly determines when to intervene, where to resume, and what information should survive recovery. Based on this view, we propose Rollback-Induced Reflection (RIR), a unified recovery framework that restores execution to a selected prior state while carrying forward reusable knowledge distilled from the abandoned trajectory to guide subsequent decisions. We further characterize recovery through a unified operator over rollback depth and retained memory, providing a general view of state restoration and knowledge retention. Experiments on three long-horizon benchmarks show that RIR consistently improves average task performance across multiple LLM backbones, with structured reflection memory preserving useful experience and selective rollback enabling efficient recovery.

AI.tldr: 该论文将LLM智能体的可靠恢复问题形式化为"回滚边界控制"问题，提出统一恢复框架RIR，在恢复至先前状态的同时保留从被放弃轨迹中提炼的可复用知识，并用一个关于回滚深度与保留记忆的统一算子刻画恢复过程。三个长时程基准实验表明RIR在多LLM骨干上一致提升平均任务表现。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在长时程多步环境交互中，单次错误动作会改变后续状态与观测，导致误差随时间累积。现有方法存在两类缺陷：一是仅修正上下文而不修复已改变的环境状态，二是恢复早期状态却丢弃了有用的经验，因而难以同时消除失败条件并避免重蹈覆辙。
AI.method: 作者主张可靠恢复应视为"回滚边界控制"问题，需联合决定何时干预、从哪里恢复以及哪些信息应在恢复后保留。据此提出Rollback-Induced Reflection（RIR），将执行恢复到选定的先前状态，同时携带从被放弃轨迹中提炼的可复用知识以指导后续决策；并引入一个在回滚深度与保留记忆上的统一算子来刻画恢复过程。
AI.result: 在三个长时程基准上，RIR在多种LLM骨干上均一致提升平均任务性能；结构化反思记忆能够保留有用经验，选择性回滚实现了高效恢复。
AI.conclusion: 可靠恢复是一个需权衡回滚边界与知识保留的联合控制问题；通过统一算子在状态恢复与知识保留之间取得平衡，RIR验证了"回滚到先前状态+携带反思记忆"这一范式的有效性。

title: SEA-LION-v4.8: A Technical Report
summary: We introduce Nemotron-SEA-LION-v4.8, a family of Southeast Asian Languages In One Network (SEA-LION) models built upon NVIDIA Nemotron 3. The family includes 30B-A3B and 120B-A12B models, with both continued-pretrained base checkpoints and post-trained variants. We adapt the models using Southeast Asian, reasoning, code, and multilingual parallel data, followed by post-training with supervised fine-tuning and online on-policy distillation. On SEA-HELM, the 30B-A3B model improves the overall SEA score from 46.06 to 51.57, while the 120B-A12B model improves from 49.30 to 63.44. Across seven Southeast Asian languages, we observe broad capability gains with the 120B-A12B model showing broader and more consistent improvements across tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于NVIDIA Nemotron 3构建的东南亚语言模型系列Nemotron-SEA-LION-v4.8，包含30B-A3B与120B-A12B两种规模，提供继续预训练基座与后训练变体，在SEA-HELM基准上显著提升东南亚语言综合得分。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型在东南亚语言上的能力相对薄弱，需要针对该区域语言进行专门适配；同时验证Nemotron 3架构在多语言、特别是东南亚语言场景下的可扩展性与有效性。
AI.method: 以NVIDIA Nemotron 3为基座，构建SEA-LION系列模型（30B-A3B、120B-A12B），提供继续预训练基座与后训练变体；采用东南亚语言、推理、代码及多语言平行数据进行适配，随后进行监督微调（SFT）与在线同策略蒸馏（on-policy distillation）后训练。
AI.result: 在SEA-HELM上，30B-A3B模型整体SEA得分由46.06提升至51.57；120B-A12B模型由49.30提升至63.44。在七种东南亚语言上均观察到能力普遍提升，其中120B-A12B在各任务上提升更广且更稳定。
AI.conclusion: 针对性的数据适配与在线同策略蒸馏后训练能有效提升东南亚语言能力；模型规模是影响提升幅度与稳定性的关键因素，120B-A12B表现优于30B-A3B。

title: Knowledge-Graph Based Augmentation versus Retrieval Augmented Generation for Cultural-Related Question Answering
comment: Accepted at EMNLP ORACLE workshop 2026. Camera-ready version
summary: Large language models (LLMs) suffer from a long-tail deficit: culturally specific facts, particularly those concerning underrepresented regions such as Latin America, appear too rarely in pretraining corpora to be reliably memorized. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) addresses this by grounding generation in external text, but structured alternatives such as Knowledge Graphs (KGs) offer tighter control over what enters the context, along with potential gains in explainability and updatability. We benchmark Graph-RAG against standard RAG on LatamQA, a culturally grounded multiple-choice dataset spanning eight thematic categories. The graphs are built end-to-end from Wikipedia articles with KGGen, a recent open-domain extractor, without manual curation in our main setting. G-Retriever is competitive with RAG and reduces the error of the base LLM by 72\% with a standard KG and 78\% with a benchmark-aware variant, the gap to RAG narrowing further as the graph is oriented toward task-relevant content. The trained projection transfers zero-shot to Portuguese without target-language fine-tuning, indicating multilingual reach.

AI.tldr: 本文针对大语言模型在拉丁美洲等欠代表地区文化事实上的长尾缺陷，构建了文化导向多选题数据集 LatamQA，并在其上对比 Graph-RAG（G-Retriever）与标准 RAG。图谱由 Wikipedia 文章经 KGGen 自动抽取而成。结果显示 G-Retriever 与 RAG 相当，可将基座模型错误率降低 72%（标准 KG）至 78%（任务感知变体），且训练所得投影可零样本迁移至葡萄牙语。
AI.motivation: LLM 存在长尾缺陷：文化特定事实（尤其拉丁美洲等欠代表地区）在预训练语料中出现频率过低，难以可靠记忆。RAG 通过外部文本缓解此问题，但知识图谱等结构化方案能更严格控制进入上下文的内容，并具备可解释性与可更新性优势。作者希望验证 Graph-RAG 在此类文化长尾任务上相对标准 RAG 的表现。
AI.method: 构建文化导向多选题数据集 LatamQA，覆盖八个主题类别；使用近期开放域抽取器 KGGen，端到端从 Wikipedia 文章自动构建知识图谱，主实验不做人工筛选；以 G-Retriever 作为 Graph-RAG 代表，与标准 RAG 进行基准对比，并设置任务感知的图谱变体与零样本葡萄牙语迁移测试。
AI.result: G-Retriever 与标准 RAG 表现相当；相比基座 LLM，标准 KG 使错误率降低 72%，基准感知（benchmark-aware）变体降低 78%；当图谱朝任务相关内容倾斜时，与 RAG 的差距进一步缩小；训练得到的投影无需目标语言微调即可零样本迁移至葡萄牙语，表明具备多语言泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 结构化 Graph-RAG 在文化长尾知识上可与文本 RAG 竞争，并可通过任务导向的图谱构建进一步逼近甚至优化 RAG 效果，同时展现出跨语言迁移潜力，为欠代表区域的文化事实问答提供了可解释、可更新的替代方案。

title: Visual Graph Reasoning via Knowledge Compilation
comment: Accepted at the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM '26)
summary: Visual graph reasoning requires answering graph-theoretic questions directly from graph images, where graph topology and state are conveyed visually rather than given in symbolic form. Despite recent progress of vision-language models (VLMs), current approaches to visual graph reasoning still fail on simple visual graph problems. This reveals a fundamental limitation of existing approaches: they prioritize final-answer supervision over the intermediate recovery of an explicit graph representation that preserves graph topology and state from visual input. To address this limitation, we propose VGCompiler, a compilation-centric paradigm for visual graph reasoning via knowledge compilation. VGCompiler organizes reasoning around two compilers: a representation compiler that recovers a structure-preserving intermediate graph representation from visual input, and an operation compiler that compiles query intent under the recovered graph state into an executable graph operation. Specifically, we build VGCompiler on Qwen3-VL-8B and train it with reinforcement learning guided by a layered reward over executability, compiled graph validity, representation quality, and operation quality. VGCompiler uses a frozen observer to summarize graph and question conditions into lightweight signatures, enabling archive retrieval and code reuse across similar regimes. Experiments on three benchmarks GVLQA, VisionGraph, and VGCURE, show that Qwen-VGCompiler, built on an 8B backbone, surpasses the strongest closed-source VLM baseline by 28.9% and the strongest code-based baseline by 23.7%, while maintaining high efficiency. We further evaluate VGCompiler on three real-world domains, including metro routing, logistics delivery, and network fault assessment, where it generalizes across heterogeneous visual graphs and domain-grounded tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出VGCompiler，一种以知识编译为核心的视觉图推理解析范式：通过表示编译器从图像恢复保留拓扑与状态的中间图表示，再用操作编译器将查询意图编译为可执行图操作，并配合分层强化学习训练，在三大基准上平均超越最强闭源VLM 28.9%、超越代码基线23.7%。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在视觉图推理任务上即便面对简单问题也会失败。根本原因在于：现有方法只关注最终答案的监督，而忽视了从视觉输入中恢复出保留图拓扑与状态的显式图表示这一关键中间步骤。缺乏显式表示导致推理过程不可解释、不可复用，也难以跨任务泛化。
AI.method: 提出VGCompiler编译中心范式，包含两个编译器：表示编译器负责从视觉输入恢复结构保持的中间图表示；操作编译器负责在恢复的图状态下将查询意图编译为可执行的图操作。模型基于Qwen3-VL-8B构建，采用强化学习训练，奖励为覆盖可执行性、编译图有效性、表示质量和操作质量的分层奖励。此外引入冻结观察器，将图与问题条件压缩为轻量签名，实现相似情境下的档案检索与代码复用。
AI.result: 在GVLQA、VisionGraph、VGCURE三个基准上，基于8B骨干的Qwen-VGCompiler分别超越最强闭源VLM基线28.9%、超越最强代码基线23.7%，同时保持高效。在地铁线路规划、物流配送、网络故障评估三个真实领域任务中也验证了跨异构视觉图与领域任务的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉图推理重构为知识编译问题，显式恢复中间图表示并编译可执行操作，能有效突破现有VLM在视觉图推理上的瓶颈；分层奖励强化学习与签名检索复用机制进一步提升了性能与效率，并展现出跨领域泛化潜力。

title: Attention Dispersion as a Diagnostic Signal for Hallucination in Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) frequently exhibit hallucinations, presenting a major barrier to reliability in complex reasoning tasks. While traditional detection methods rely on output-based confidence metrics, these logits are often miscalibrated by modern alignment techniques. In this paper, we investigate the temporal volatility of internal attention mechanisms as an alternative diagnostic signal for hallucination that does not depend on output calibration. By introducing an unsupervised metric for attention dispersion, we show that epistemic uncertainty leaves a measurable trace within intermediate layers, where spikes in attention entropy are associated with reasoning breakdowns. We evaluate our approach on mathematical reasoning benchmarks (GSM8K and MATH-500) using the Qwen2.5 model family (1.5B and 3B parameters), finding statistically significant AUC improvements of up to +0.076 over output-based baselines across all tested conditions. These findings suggest that attention dispersion is a promising complement to traditional hallucination detection methods, requiring further investigation across broader model families and task domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以内部注意力弥散度（attention dispersion）作为幻觉检测信号，避免依赖输出置信度校准问题。在GSM8K与MATH-500上，用Qwen2.5（1.5B/3B）验证，AUC最高提升+0.076。
AI.motivation: 传统幻觉检测依赖输出端置信度（logits），但现代对齐技术（如RLHF）常导致logits校准失准，使其作为可靠性指标存在偏差。作者希望寻找不依赖输出校准的替代诊断信号，并关注推理崩溃时的内部不确定性痕迹。
AI.method: 提出一种无监督的注意力弥散度（attention dispersion）度量；观察中间层注意力熵的尖峰与推理崩溃（reasoning breakdowns）的关联，将其作为认知不确定性（epistemic uncertainty）在中间层的可测痕迹，用于幻觉检测。
AI.result: 在数学推理基准GSM8K与MATH-500上，使用Qwen2.5系列（1.5B与3B参数），相比输出端基线在全部测试条件下取得统计显著的AUC提升，最高达+0.076。
AI.conclusion: 注意力弥散度是有前景的幻觉检测补充信号，可弥补传统输出校准方法的不足；但需在更广泛模型家族与任务域上进一步验证，其泛化性与通用性尚待确认。

title: Can MiniMax-H3 Reason About the Physical World? An Evaluation of Omni-Modal Generative Model
summary: Recent Omni-Modal Generative Models (Omni-Models) have advanced content generation toward unified modeling of text, images, video, and audio. MiniMax-H3 exemplifies this transition by combining multimodal context understanding with joint audio-visual generation in a shared latent framework. Its unified architecture raises a fundamental question: Can multimodal alignment improve the model's world reasoning, and what new evaluation paradigms do omni-modal inputs enable? To investigate this question, this work introduces a comprehensive evaluation framework organized around four complementary dimensions of physical world reasoning. Unlike existing evaluation frameworks for video generation and world models, which are often constrained by limited input modalities and evaluation settings where prompts closely match the target video content, our evaluation is specifically designed to exploit the multimodal inputs of Omni-Model. We construct a diverse set of novel tasks that require models to integrate complementary information across modalities. Specifically, we consider four scenarios, including implicit prompts paired with multiple frames, audio-image, prefix-videos, and audio-video inputs. Every single modality provides only partial evidence about the underlying event, requiring the model to jointly reason over the complementary semantic cues to infer latent event states and future dynamics. Across 517 evaluation instances, MiniMax-H3 achieves an overall success rate of 41.97%. Video-based Decision Reasoning yields the highest success rate at 56.00%, while Audio-based Disambiguation Reasoning is the weakest, reaching only 27.40%. These results indicate that effective multimodal integration remains key to fully exploiting the benefits of diverse input modalities. The project is available at https://github.com/gulucaptain/MiniMax-H3-Reason.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向Omni-Modal生成模型（以MiniMax-H3为对象）物理世界推理能力的评估框架，围绕四个互补维度构建517个评测实例，检验模型跨模态互补信息整合与潜在事件状态推断能力。MiniMax-H3总体成功率41.97%，视频决策推理最高（56.00%），音频消歧推理最低（27.40%），表明多模态有效整合仍是关键瓶颈。
AI.motivation: Omni-Modal生成模型（如MiniMax-H3）将多模态理解与联合音视频生成统一在共享潜空间中，由此引出核心问题：多模态对齐能否提升模型的世界推理能力，以及全模态输入带来何种新评测范式。现有视频生成与世界模型评测框架多受限于输入模态单一，且提示与目标视频内容高度匹配，无法充分利用全模态模型的输入优势。
AI.method: 构建面向物理世界推理的综合评估框架，围绕四个互补维度组织评测。设计四类需跨模态整合互补信息的新任务场景：隐式提示+多帧、音频+图像、前缀视频、音频+视频。每种单一模态仅提供关于潜在事件的部分证据，要求模型联合推理互补语义线索以推断潜在事件状态与未来动态。共构建517个评测实例。
AI.result: 在517个评测实例上，MiniMax-H3总体成功率为41.97%。其中视频驱动的决策推理成功率最高，达56.00%；音频驱动的消歧推理最弱，仅为27.40%。
AI.conclusion: 多模态对齐对Omni-Model的世界推理具有提升潜力，但效果高度依赖模态整合质量。有效的多模态整合仍是充分发挥多样输入模态优势的关键；当前模型在音频相关推理上存在明显短板，跨模态互补语义整合能力有待加强。项目已开源。

title: When Keywords Drop but Classifiers Hold: Soft Refusals under KV Cache Compression
summary: KV cache compression is widely used for long context LLM inference under memory constraints, while deployed systems typically score refusals after generation with keyword filters or learned classifiers. Such monitors are intended to indicate whether a model declined a harmful request under the serving regime actually used. However, it remains unclear whether matched compression that preserves task accuracy also preserves agreement between lightweight lexical monitors and stronger refusal classifiers. We study this with a paired protocol on n=200 harmful prompts with a long filler context: each prompt is answered once under full retention and once under matched eviction after a shared prefill, and the same replies are scored by keyword heuristics, the HarmBench Llama-2-13B classifier, an auxiliary LLM judge, and humans on disagreements. On Qwen2.5-3B, keyword refusal falls from 98.0% to 80.5% (McNemar p~1e-8) while classifier refusal stays near ceiling (99.0%-99.5%) and MMLU accuracy is unchanged (50.0%); human labels predominantly follow the classifier, consistent with soft refusals. The gap is not universal and weakens under short fillers and paired SnapKV, so safety auditing under compression should rely on several judges matched to the serving context rather than on keyword rates alone.

AI.tldr: 在长上下文KV cache压缩场景下，关键词拒绝率显著下降（98.0%→80.5%），而分类器拒绝率维持近上限，说明仅凭关键词监测会高估压缩带来的安全性退化。
AI.motivation: 部署系统常用关键词过滤或学习型分类器对生成结果进行拒绝评分，以判断模型是否拒绝了有害请求。但尚不清楚：在保持任务精度的匹配压缩下，轻量词汇监测器与更强拒绝分类器之间的一致性是否仍然保持。这直接影响压缩条件下安全审计结论的可靠性。
AI.method: 采用配对协议，在n=200条有害提示（附长填充上下文）上，每条提示在共享prefill后分别在全保留与匹配淘汰两种条件下各生成一次回答；对同一批回答分别用关键词启发式、HarmBench Llama-2-13B分类器、辅助LLM评判器打分，并由人工标注分歧样本。在Qwen2.5-3B上进行验证，并测试短填充与配对SnapKV的稳健性。
AI.result: Qwen2.5-3B上关键词拒绝率由98.0%降至80.5%（McNemar p≈1e-8），而分类器拒绝率保持在99.0%–99.5%的近上限水平，MMLU准确率不变（50.0%）。人工标签主要与分类器一致，符合"软拒绝"现象。该差距并非普遍存在，在短填充与配对SnapKV条件下会减弱。
AI.conclusion: KV压缩下的安全审计不应仅依赖关键词拒绝率，而应采用多个与部署上下文相匹配的评判器；保持任务精度的压缩未必保持轻量监测器与强分类器之间的一致性。

title: PDA++: Field-Aligned Planning and Scene-Adaptive Insertion in Remote Sensing
comment: Extended journal version of our ICML 2026 paper "Plan, Decouple, Assimilate: Physics-Aware Object Insertion in Remote Sensing Imagery"
summary: Remote sensing recognition is often constrained by scarce observations of rare targets and costly annotations, making realistic synthetic augmentation particularly valuable for few-shot and long-tailed scenarios. Object insertion provides an efficient way to increase target diversity while preserving authentic background scenes, but realistic insertion in overhead imagery requires the generated target to adapt coherently to its surrounding environment. To this end, we propose PDA++, a unified environment-aware object insertion framework organized as Plan, Decouple, and Assimilate. Planning determines scene-compatible poses through an affordance field that combines geometric clearance with structure- and scale-aware cues. Decoupling introduces a pose-conditioned background that provides precise spatial guidance together with target-scene context, allowing the reference object to preserve its identity while adapting to the target observation. This construction also naturally provides pixel-level masks for segmentation augmentation. Assimilation further improves local coherence by aligning multi-scale texture distributions through optimal transport. On the optical benchmark, PDA++ achieves a whole-image FID of 6.28 and improves average few-shot recognition mAP50 by 17.69 points, corresponding to a 28.8% relative gain over the real-data baseline. On SAR imagery, it improves ship detection by 4.10 mAP50 points and remains effective under cross-dataset transfer and amorphous-target insertion. Code is available at https://github.com/lisheyu972/PDA_PLUS.

AI.tldr: PDA++是一个环境感知的目标插入框架，通过Plan-Decouple-Assimilate三阶段流程，在遥感图像中生成适应环境的合成目标，显著提升少样本与长尾场景的识别性能。
AI.motivation: 遥感识别受限于稀有目标观测稀缺与标注成本高昂，少样本和长尾场景下尤其需要逼真的合成数据增强。目标插入能在保留真实背景的同时高效增加目标多样性，但俯视图像中的逼真插入要求生成目标能与其周围环境协调适配。
AI.method: 提出PDA++统一环境感知目标插入框架，包含Plan（规划）、Decouple（解耦）、Assimilate（同化）三阶段。规划阶段通过结合几何间隙与结构、尺度感知线索的affordance field确定场景兼容姿态；解耦阶段引入姿态条件背景，提供精确空间引导与目标-场景上下文，使参考目标在保持身份的同时适应目标观测，并自然提供像素级分割掩码；同化阶段通过最优传输对齐多尺度纹理分布以增强局部一致性。
AI.result: 在光学基准上，PDA++达到全图FID 6.28，少样本识别平均mAP50提升17.69个点，相对真实数据基线获得28.8%的相对增益。在SAR影像上，舰船检测提升4.10个mAP50点，并在跨数据集迁移与无定形目标插入场景下依然有效。
AI.conclusion: PDA++通过环境感知的姿态规划、姿态条件背景解耦与多尺度纹理同化，实现了逼真且场景协调的遥感目标插入，有效缓解少样本与长尾识别中的数据稀缺问题，并在光学与SAR任务上均验证了有效性与泛化能力。

title: Pose2Muscle: Structured Spatio-Temporal Decoding for Discrete Muscle Activity Estimation from Human Pose
summary: Muscle activity is fundamental to human movement, and understanding its patterns is critical for injury prevention and rehabilitation. Conventional muscle activity monitoring relies on specialized sensors such as surface electromyography, which limits its practicality for long-term real-world use. Existing studies suggest that muscle-related information can be inferred from human pose. However, the substantial gap between externally observable pose and internal muscle activation, limits the accuracy and generalization of current approaches. In this study, we propose Pose2Muscle, a pose-driven framework for discrete muscle activity estimation without requiring sEMG signals at inference time. Instead of directly regressing continuous sEMG signals, Pose2Muscle reformulates muscle estimation as a structured prediction problem over discrete muscle activity states, yielding a more stable and interpretable target space. The framework combines multi-scale spatio-temporal attention to capture motion patterns at complementary spatial and temporal scales with a directed acyclic graph-based decoder that maintains multiple candidate muscle-state hypotheses and performs structured trajectory inference over time. To support this task, we construct PoseEMG-43, a synchronized pose-sEMG dataset containing 2,992 movement instances from 43 daily-life actions performed by 14 participants. Experiments show that Pose2Muscle consistently outperforms representative retrieval- and pose-based baselines. It achieves an Adjacent-level Accuracy of 86.36% and a Pearson correlation coefficient of 0.8821 under the Random Split, and 63.97% and 0.6795, respectively, under the Subject-Level Split. These results demonstrate the feasibility of inferring structured muscle-state patterns from human pose and suggest the potential of Pose2Muscle for muscle-aware movement analysis when direct physiological sensing is impractical

AI.tldr: 提出Pose2Muscle，一种仅凭人体姿态即可估计离散肌肉活动状态的框架，无需推理时使用sEMG；并构建同步姿态-sEMG数据集PoseEMG-43，性能优于检索与姿态基线。
AI.motivation: 肌肉活动监测对损伤预防与康复至关重要，但依赖表面肌电（sEMG）等专用传感器，难以长期在真实场景使用。虽然可从姿态推断肌肉信息，但外部可观测姿态与内部肌肉激活之间存在巨大鸿沟，导致现有方法的精度与泛化性受限。
AI.method: 将肌肉估计重构为对离散肌肉活动状态的结构化预测问题（而非直接回归连续sEMG），以获得更稳定、可解释的目标空间。框架结合多尺度时空注意力以捕获互补空间与时间尺度的运动模式，并采用有向无环图（DAG）解码器，维护多个候选肌肉状态假设并随时间进行结构化轨迹推断。同时构建PoseEMG-43数据集：包含14名受试者执行43个日常动作的2,992个同步姿态-sEMG运动实例。
AI.result: Pose2Muscle持续优于代表性检索式与姿态式基线。随机划分下相邻层级准确率86.36%、Pearson相关系数0.8821；受试者级划分下分别为63.97%与0.6795。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明从人体姿态推断结构化肌肉状态模式具有可行性，在直接生理传感不可行时，Pose2Muscle对肌肉感知运动分析具有应用潜力。

title: Understanding AI Provider Recommendations in Local Service Markets
summary: When someone asks an AI assistant which doctor to see or which firm to trust with their savings, the answer is a referral. We audit AI provider recommendations in four registry-backed service domains across the 100 largest U.S. metropolitan areas, matching every recommendation against the official registry for its domain (Medicare clinician and facility records, and SEC adviser disclosures), under three conditions: an open-weight model, a proprietary model without web search, and the same proprietary model with search. Without search, both models largely fabricate recommendations in the domains the web covers thinly. Only 4% of the open-weight model's recommended doctors and 11% of the proprietary model's match a clinician in the queried city, and the open-weight matches are name coincidences: its matched clinicians are no likelier to be primary-care doctors than names drawn at random from the registry. With search, 64-71% of recommendations in the same domains match a real provider. Search also changes who is recommended. Without it, recommended advisory firms carry SEC misconduct disclosures at 3.6 times the registry base rate, even after adjusting for firm size; with search, significantly below it. Restaurants, where quality and visibility are separately measurable, show a 3-5x review-count premium but a rating premium of at most a tenth of a star. Finally, search largely removes the metro-size penalty: without it, real recommendations concentrate in the largest metros; with it, match rates are similar across metro-size terciles. Whether an AI referral is trustworthy depends strongly on its retrieval configuration rather than on the underlying model alone, yet an answer produced without retrieval often carries no sign that its recommendations were never verified.

AI.tldr: 该论文审计了AI助手在四个注册表支撑的服务领域中给出的推荐，发现推荐的可信度高度依赖检索配置：无检索时模型大量编造推荐，有检索时匹配率大幅提升，但无检索的答案往往没有未经验证的提示。
AI.motivation: 当用户向AI助手询问该看哪位医生或将储蓄托付给哪家公司时，AI给出的答案本质上是一种"转诊/推荐"。这类推荐直接影响用户的重要决策，但人们不清楚AI推荐是否经过核查、是否可靠。作者希望量化审计AI推荐的准确性及其对检索配置的依赖，以揭示潜在风险。
AI.method: 作者在四个有官方注册表支撑的服务领域中，覆盖美国100个最大都市区，将每一条推荐与对应领域的官方注册表（Medicare临床医生与机构记录、SEC投顾披露）进行匹配，设置三种条件：开源权重模型、无网络搜索的专有模型、以及同一专有模型开启搜索。并且对餐厅这一质量与知名度可分别测量的领域做了对照分析。
AI.result: 无搜索时，两个模型在网络覆盖稀疏的领域大量编造推荐：开源模型推荐的医生仅4%、专有模型仅11%与所查询城市的临床医生匹配；且开源模型的匹配只是姓名巧合——其匹配到的临床医生为初级保健医生的概率与从注册表随机抽名无异。开启搜索后，同一领域的69%/64-71%推荐匹配到真实提供者。搜索也改变了被推荐对象：无搜索时被推荐的投顾公司带有SEC不当行为披露的比例是注册表基准率的3.6倍（即使校正公司规模后仍如此），有搜索时则显著低于基准率。餐厅领域呈现3-5倍评论数溢价但评分溢价至多十分之一星。搜索还基本消除了都市规模惩罚：无搜索时真实推荐集中于最大都市，有搜索时各都市规模三分位的匹配率相近。
AI.conclusion: AI转诊是否可信很大程度上取决于其检索配置，而非仅取决于底层模型本身；然而不使用检索生成的答案往往没有任何迹象表明其推荐从未经过核实。

title: Visual Input and Its Framing Affect Attribute-based Descriptions Produced by Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) are commonly used with only a single text prompt as the input, or plus an image. In this paper, we demonstrate that when the image exists, even if the text prompt is not about the specific instance (but only the concept it belongs to) in that image, the response would still be affected. For example, when the text prompt only asks for the attribute descriptions of a dog breed, an image depicting a specific dog from that breed would shift the response. Further, how the specific instance is framed in that image would determine towards which the response shifts. Detailed analyses also reveal that in the response, physical terms increase from 18% for text-only to 45% (40%) for subject-focused (subject-in-situation) framings. Overall, the unexpected effects of visual cues on LVLMs highlight the need to understand the presence of an image and its framing when evaluating the robustness of LVLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了一种LVLM的视觉提示偏差：当图像存在时，即使文本提示只涉及概念而非图中具体实例，模型响应仍会被图像内容及其构图方式所影响。
AI.motivation: 以往LVLM多以单一文本提示或文本加图像作为输入，但人们普遍假定文本提示若未指向图中的具体实例，图像便不应干扰响应。作者质疑这一假定，希望探究图像存在与否及其构图方式是否会无意中影响模型输出，从而揭示评估LVLM鲁棒性时需考虑的新因素。
AI.method: 作者设计实验，在文本提示仅询问某犬种属性描述（概念层面）的情况下，分别输入纯文本、包含该品种具体犬只的图像，并对图像采用两种构图框架：subject-focused（主体聚焦）与subject-in-situation（主体置于情境中）。通过对比不同条件下的响应，分析响应偏移方向及用词构成的变化。
AI.result: 实验发现，即使文本提示与图中具体实例无关，图像仍会改变响应，且构图框架决定响应偏移的方向。在响应中，物理性词汇的比例从纯文本的18%上升至主体聚焦框架的45%和主体置于情境框架的40%。
AI.conclusion: 视觉线索对LVLM存在意料之外的影响，说明在评估LVLM鲁棒性时，必须同时考虑图像是否存在及其构图框架，而不仅关注文本提示内容。

title: Faithful yet Collusive: Why Chain-of-Thought Monitoring Cannot Detect Collusion in LLM Pricing Agents under Oligopolistic Competition
comment: 20 pages, Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026
summary: Large language models (LLM) deployed as autonomous pricing agents may sustain supracompetitive prices through tacit coordination. We develop a causal graph divergence framework that separately measures structural faithfulness and intent faithfulness of LLM pricing agents in Bertrand competition. Across nine LLMs under duopoly and triopoly conditions, collusive behavior and chain-of-thought (CoT) faithfulness dissociate along both dimensions: the most collusive model accurately reports cooperative intent yet reasons structurally unfaithfully, while the most structurally faithful model sustains supra-Nash pricing under both market structures. These findings establish that CoT monitoring alone cannot serve as a standalone safeguard against algorithmic collusion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出因果图散度框架，将LLM定价代理的忠实性拆分为结构忠实性与意图忠实性两个维度，在Bertrand竞争中发现共谋行为与思维链忠实性在两种维度上相互分离，证明仅靠CoT监控无法作为防范算法共谋的独立保障。
AI.motivation: LLM被部署为自主定价代理时，可能通过默契协调维持超竞争价格，带来算法共谋风险。现有对思维链（CoT）监控作为安全保障的假设缺乏对忠实性的细粒度、可分离的检验，因此需要区分"结构忠实性"与"意图忠实性"来准确评估共谋与推理忠实性之间的关系。
AI.method: 提出因果图散度框架（causal graph divergence framework），将LLM定价代理的忠实性分解为结构忠实性与意图忠实性两个维度；在Bertrand竞争的寡头（双寡头与三寡头）条件下对九个LLM进行测试。
AI.result: 在九种LLM、双寡头与三寡头条件下，共谋行为与CoT忠实性在两个维度上均发生分离：最倾向于共谋的模型能准确报告合作意图，但其结构推理不忠实；而结构最忠实的模型在两种市场结构下均维持超纳什（supra-Nash）定价。
AI.conclusion: 共谋行为与推理忠实性并不一致，CoT监控无法单独作为防止算法共谋的保障，需要引入结构层面的额外监测机制。

title: Market Signal Injection: Adversarial Context Manipulation of LLM Pricing Agents
comment: 30 pages, Accepted to FinNLP 2026 Workshop @ EMNLP 2026
summary: Large language model (LLM) pricing agents may respond to how market data is presented, even when its numerical values remain unchanged. We introduce market signal injection (MSI), an attack that manipulates numerical formatting, competitor ordering, or qualitative market commentary without issuing explicit instructions. We evaluate nine open-weight models in simulated Bertrand duopoly and triopoly markets and three proprietary models in duopoly markets. Sentiment-based attacks produce the largest behavioral shifts, which propagate to other firms and alter profits and consumer surplus. Susceptibility varies across model families, and larger models are not consistently more robust. Matched neutral-text controls and a rule-based agent support a framing-based account of these shifts under the fixed demand parameters of our simulation. Episode-held-out probes distinguish baseline from attacked activations in all eleven re-evaluated model--condition pairs: linear AUC is 1.00 and MLP AUC ranges from 0.93 to 0.99. This separability does not by itself identify harmful pricing decisions. Input canonicalization removes the tested sentiment attacks, while decision boundary anchoring, which combines prompt constraints with output projection, provides partial mitigation under the tested adaptive attacks. These results identify data presentation as an attack surface for LLM pricing agents and motivate defenses that account for interactions among agents.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"市场信号注入"(MSI)攻击,证明LLM定价代理会被市场数据的呈现方式(格式、排序、定性评论)操控,进而改变定价行为并影响利润与消费者剩余,并给出激活可分性证据与两类防御手段。
AI.motivation: LLM定价代理在市场中自主决策,其输入包含市场数据的呈现形式。现有研究多关注显式指令注入,忽略了"数据如何呈现"本身可能成为攻击面:即使数值不变,仅改变格式、竞争者排序或情绪化评论,也可能诱导代理偏离理性定价。这关系到市场效率与消费者福利,需要系统量化其影响机理与可防御性。
AI.method: 提出MSI攻击,在不发出显式指令的前提下操控数值格式、竞争者排序或定性市场评论。在模拟Bertrand双寡头与三寡头市场中评测9个开源权重模型,并在双寡头市场评测3个专有模型。采用匹配的中性文本对照与规则型代理作基线,以支持"框架效应"解释;通过留出回合的探针区分基线与受攻击激活;并评估输入规范化与决策边界锚定(提示约束+输出投影)两类防御,包括自适应攻击测试。
AI.result: 基于情绪的攻击造成最大的行为偏移,并向其他厂商传播,改变利润与消费者剩余。易感性因模型家族而异,更大模型并未持续更稳健。留出回合探针在全部11个重新评测的"模型-条件"组合上均可区分基线与受攻击激活(线性AUC=1.00,MLP AUC为0.93-0.99),但该可分性本身不能识别有害定价决策。输入规范化可消除所测情绪攻击;决策边界锚定在测试的自适应攻击下提供部分缓解。
AI.conclusion: 数据呈现构成LLM定价代理的一个攻击面,框架效应而非数值变化即可系统性改变多代理市场结果。防御需考虑代理间的相互作用,单一激活可分性或单向防御不足以保障定价安全。

title: Online Multi-Camera 3D Tracking via ID Prediction over Recurrent Sparse Queries
summary: Online multi camera 3D tracking must maintain scene global identities across synchronized views, yet query-based trackers carry these identities only implicitly in the instance bank, where they fragment upon query interruption. We present an online architecture that recovers association accuracy by predicting IDs explicitly over recurrent sparse queries. An outside-in Sparse4D detector fuses calibrated views into world frame 3D detections while propagating a sparse query bank, and a causal MOTIP ID decoder associates detections against a finite trajectory memory. We adapt MOTIP's relative-ID prediction and recycled slot runtime to globally fused 3D observations, and introduce metric spatial gating and proximity based newborn recovery. On the official 2026 AI City Challenge Track 1 test set, our method raises HOTA from 29.63 with native instance bank identities to 38.01, primarily through an AssA increase from 20.83 to 31.10, and ranks third on the public leaderboard. Full-sequence validation over all 9,000 frames of each scene shows that decoupled ID training improves HOTA over native identities, whereas continuing detector training alongside the detached ID objective produces scene-dependent gains and losses.

AI.tldr: 提出一种在线多相机3D跟踪架构，将ID预测从隐式实例库解耦为对递归稀疏查询的显式预测，在2026 AI City Challenge Track 1上把HOTA从29.63提升至38.01。
AI.motivation: 在线多相机3D跟踪需在同步视图间维持场景级全局身份，但基于查询的跟踪器仅在实例库中隐式携带身份，一旦查询中断身份就会碎片化，导致关联精度（AssA）偏低。
AI.method: 采用outside-in的Sparse4D检测器，将标定视图融合到世界坐标系下的3D检测并传播稀疏查询库；使用因果MOTIP ID解码器，将检测与有限轨迹记忆进行关联；把MOTIP的相对ID预测与回收槽（recycled slot）运行时适配到全局融合的3D观测；引入度量空间门控（metric spatial gating）和基于邻近度的新生目标恢复机制。
AI.result: 在2026 AI City Challenge Track 1官方测试集上，HOTA由原生实例库身份的29.63提升至38.01，主要来自AssA从20.83增至31.10，公开榜单排名第三。对每场景全部9,000帧的全序列验证显示：解耦ID训练相对原生身份能提升HOTA；而将检测器训练与解耦ID目标同时进行则产生随场景变化的增益与损失。
AI.conclusion: 显式、解耦的ID预测可有效缓解查询中断导致的身份碎片化，显著提升多相机3D跟踪的关联精度；检测与ID目标的联合训练效果不稳定，建议对二者进行解耦处理。

title: JigSync: Gauge-Resolved Synchronization for Jigsaw Reassembly under Unknown Piece Orientation
summary: Square jigsaw reassembly requires recovering the spatial arrangement of shuffled fragments from their visual content and pairwise relationships. While recent studies have made substantial progress, existing benchmarks typically assume that all fragments are provided upright, reducing reassembly to a permutation problem. We study the generalized problem in which each fragment may also have gone through an unknown rotation. For this setting we establish a gauge-unobservability theorem: the minimum of the weighted least-squares objective is exactly invariant under a uniform global rotation of arbitrary magnitude, so no residual-based criterion can recover the global orientation. The theorem further identifies how the issue of global orientation can be resolved: an orientation anchor estimated from the content of a single fragment, lying outside its scope, suffices.
