To address the above, we propose JigSync, which attains 63.8% and 31.8% absolute accuracy (AA) on GAP-3 and GAP-5, respectively, the highest reported on both, while additionally recovering a rotation per piece that neither benchmark requires. We release JigSync, a degradation protocol that sweeps shape, erosion, photometry, grid size, and rotation independently.

AI.tldr: 本文将方形拼图重组推广到碎片带未知旋转的场景，提出规范不可观测性定理证明基于残差的准则无法恢复全局朝向，并给出解决方案 JigSync。
AI.motivation: 现有拼图重组基准通常假设所有碎片正立，将问题简化为排列问题，忽略了碎片可能经历未知旋转这一更一般的实际情形。
AI.method: 建立规范不可观测性定理：加权最小二乘目标的最小值在任意幅度的统一全局旋转下完全不变；据此指出需借助单个碎片内容估计的朝向锚点来消解全局朝向歧义，并据此提出 JigSync 方法。
AI.result: JigSync 在 GAP-3 和 GAP-5 上分别取得 63.8% 和 31.8% 的绝对准确率（AA），均为已报道的最高水平，同时额外恢复每块的旋转量。作者还发布了一套可独立扫描形状、腐蚀、光度、网格尺寸与旋转的退化协议。
AI.conclusion: 该工作把拼图重组从纯排列问题拓展到含未知旋转的广义问题，从理论上界定了全局朝向的不可恢复性及解决途径，并通过 JigSync 在基准上取得领先结果。

title: Emotion Experience, Expression, and Perception: Emotion Analysis on Multimodal Social Media Posts
comment: Accepted for publication at EMNLP 2026 main conference
summary: Emotions are an essential aspect of human communication, particularly on social media, where authors frequently combine text and images to convey their emotions. Yet prior work on emotion analysis of social media posts has overlooked two important aspects in regard to measuring how well readers can reconstruct the authors' intent: (1)~the image modality, with most work focusing solely on text, and (2)~the real-world events that trigger the expressed emotions, and their relationship to the post content. We therefore study the relation between (a) the author's experience of the event that caused them to write a social media post and (b) the content of the post, with a focus on readers' capability to reconstruct that emotion expression. To do that, we introduce the Multimodal Multi-Emotion-Model dataset Mult2EMo, created by collecting annotations from both authors and readers on the posts and their triggering events. We find that reconstruction is possible but challenging for both human readers and computational models. We show that understanding the triggering event is crucial for accurate reconstruction, and that reconstruction is particularly challenging when posts rely heavily on the image to express emotion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Mult2EMo 数据集，结合作者与读者对社交媒体帖文及其触发事件的标注，研究多模态（文本+图像）情感表达的可重构性，发现人机重构均有挑战，触发事件理解是关键，图像主导型帖文尤难。
AI.motivation: 现有社交媒体情感分析研究存在两点不足：一是多聚焦文本、忽视图像模态；二是忽视引发情感的真实事件及其与帖文内容的关系。作者希望从“读者能否重构作者情感意图”这一角度重新审视该问题。
AI.method: 构建 Multimodal Multi-Emotion-Model 数据集 Mult2EMo，同时收集作者与读者对帖文及其触发事件的标注，据此研究（a）作者经历触发事件与其（b）帖文内容之间的关系，并评估人类读者与计算模型的情感重构能力。
AI.result: 情感重构是可能的，但对人类读者和计算模型而言都颇具挑战；理解触发事件对准确重构至关重要；当帖文主要依赖图像表达情感时，重构尤为困难。
AI.conclusion: 情感分析需同时纳入图像模态与触发事件信息，Mult2EMo 为多模态情感重构研究提供了作者—读者双视角的基准与实证依据。

title: MSR: Multiple Subject Reference for Video Generation
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures. Model weights and inference workflows are publicly available
summary: Conditioning a video generator on multiple images requires preserving appearance while associating each reference with its intended role. We present MSR (Multiple Subject Reference), a slot-aware conditioning scheme for LTX-based video generation. Each reference image is independently encoded as a static clip and represented by a separate latent-token group. A compact Fourier-feature multilayer perceptron adds a numeric slot embedding, while slot-dependent temporal offsets modify the group's rotary coordinates. The reference groups are prepended to noisy target tokens and serve as clean context during target-only flow-matching training. We implement this scheme through low-rank adaptation and release the resulting weights and inference workflows. Qualitative examples demonstrate compositions containing distinct characters and referenced environments in realistic and stylized scenes. Development observations suggest reduced reference confusion relative to an earlier continuous-reference baseline, while similar clothing, complex garments, and viewpoint changes remain challenging. We describe the conditioning mechanism, the retained training configuration, and the observed strengths and limitations of the released system. A supplementary audio-reference experiment adds voice conditioning while keeping the visual parameters frozen.

AI.tldr: 提出MSR（多主体参考）槽位感知条件方案，基于LTX视频生成模型，通过独立编码参考图、傅里叶特征MLP槽位嵌入与槽位相关时间偏移，并经LoRA实现，公开发布权重与推理流程，可生成多角色与参考环境的组合视频，但仍存在相似服装、复杂服饰与视角变化的挑战。
AI.motivation: 多图条件下的视频生成需要同时保持外观一致性并将每张参考图关联到其预期角色/语义槽位，而此前的连续参考基线容易出现参考混淆（reference confusion）。
AI.method: MSR槽位感知条件方案：每张参考图独立编码为静态clip，形成独立的潜token组；用紧凑的傅里叶特征MLP注入数值槽位嵌入，并以槽位相关的时间偏移修改该组的旋转坐标（RoPE）；参考组前置于噪声目标token，在仅目标流匹配训练中作为干净上下文；通过低秩适配（LoRA）实现，并公开发布权重与推理流程；附录还加入音频参考实验，在视觉参数冻结下增加语音条件。
AI.result: 定性示例展示了包含不同角色与参考环境的写实与风格化场景组合；开发观察显示，相较早期连续参考基线，参考混淆减少；但相似服装、复杂服饰与视角变化仍是难点。音频参考实验在冻结视觉参数的前提下实现了语音条件。
AI.conclusion: 论文阐述了该条件机制、保留的训练配置以及发布系统的优势与局限，表明槽位感知的独立token分组条件能有效缓解多参考混淆，并为多主体视频生成提供了可复现的LoRA权重与工作流。

title: A Non-Linear Neuron Based Detection of Isolated Pixels in Binary and Grayscale Images using Contrast Sensitive Receptive Fields
summary: Identifying isolated points is important in image processing applications such as medical imaging, astronomy and quality control management. Other domains, such as cybersecurity, also present challenges that can be framed as image processing problems. One example of particular interest is the identification of anomalous single nodes in spatially organised networks where groups of nodes in different regions share similar feature values. This task can involve both binary and more complex grayscale images. However, existing methods face limitations: template matching is infeasible for grayscale images, while 2nd order derivative based methods are highly sensitive to noise and require user-specified thresholds. To overcome these issues, a novel method is proposed for detecting meaningful single-pixel deviations in images. This approach modifies and extends a neuron model, originally designed for anomaly detection, to operate on spatially diameter limited receptive fields that incorporate excitatory and inhibitory regions. The result is a method that is free from user-specified thresholds and parameters, and can be applied to both binary and grayscale images, providing an effective, robust and efficient solution.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于改进神经元模型的无阈值单像素异常点检测方法，适用于二值与灰度图像。
AI.motivation: 孤立点识别在医学影像、天文学、质量控制及网络安全（空间组织网络中的异常单节点检测）中很重要，但现有方法受限：模板匹配无法用于灰度图像，二阶导数方法对噪声敏感且需用户设定阈值。
AI.method: 修改并扩展一个原用于异常检测的神经元模型，使其作用于具有兴奋区与抑制区的空间直径受限感受野。
AI.result: 获得一种无需用户指定阈值和参数的方法，可同时应用于二值与灰度图像。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为单像素偏差检测提供了有效、鲁棒且高效的解决方案。

title: Prosthesis-Aware 3D Human Pose Estimation: A Dataset and Benchmark for RSP Users
summary: Recovering 3D human body motion from video is important for applications such as rehabilitation assessment and sports performance evaluation. For prosthesis users, this requires capturing both natural body joints and the geometry of the prosthetic device, a challenge that existing methods are not designed to address. Model-based estimators rely on body models trained on non-amputee individuals and cannot represent prosthesis geometry, while model-free methods lack body kinematic priors and are unreliable under occlusion. This challenge is particularly prominent for users of running-specific prostheses (RSPs), where the RSP has a complex curved geometry and moves dynamically during exercise. To fill this gap, we collect RSP3D, the first 3D dataset of RSP users, covering essential daily-life and exercise actions from participants with varied amputation conditions, using a multi-camera marker-based motion capture setup. We formally define the task of prosthesis-aware 3D pose estimation, evaluate representative methods in a zero-shot setting, and confirm their individual limitations. We further propose a hybrid baseline combining model-based body joint estimation with model-free RSP shape recovery, establishing a starting point for future research.

AI.tldr: 论文提出首个针对跑步专用假肢（RSP）使用者的3D数据集RSP3D，形式化定义“假肢感知3D姿态估计”任务，并在零样本设置下评估现有方法，进而提出融合模型基人体关节估计与无模型假肢形状恢复的混合基线。
AI.motivation: 从视频恢复3D人体运动对康复评估、运动表现分析等应用具有重要意义。对假肢使用者而言，需同时捕捉自然人体关节与假肢几何形状，而现有方法无法胜任：模型基估计器依赖在非截肢人群上训练的人体模型，无法表示假肢几何；无模型方法缺乏人体运动学先验，在遮挡下不可靠。跑步专用假肢（RSP）几何呈复杂曲线且运动时动态变化，该问题尤为突出。
AI.method: 采集RSP3D数据集：首个RSP使用者的3D数据集，采用多相机、基于标记点的运动捕捉装置，覆盖不同截肢条件的参与者的日常与运动动作。形式化定义假肢感知3D姿态估计任务，在零样本设置下评估代表性方法以确认其各自局限，并提出混合基线：结合模型基人体关节估计与无模型RSP形状恢复。
AI.result: 构建了首个RSP使用者3D数据集RSP3D；在零样本设置下验证了现有代表性方法在假肢感知3D姿态估计任务上各自存在局限；所提混合基线为未来研究提供了起点。
AI.conclusion: 现有模型基与无模型方法均无法有效处理假肢使用者的3D运动恢复问题，RSP3D数据集与假肢感知姿态估计任务填补了这一空白，混合基线为后续研究奠定基础。

title: Vocabulary-Guided Gait Recognition
summary: What is a gait? Appearance-based gait networks consider a gait as the human shape and motion information from images. Model-based gait networks treat a gait as the human inherent structure from points. However, the considerations remain vague for humans to comprehend truly. In this work, we introduce a novel paradigm Vocabulary-Guided Gait Recognition, dubbed Gait-World, which attempts to explore gait concepts through human vocabularies with Vision-Language Models (VLMs). Although VLMs have achieved the remarkable progress in various vision tasks, the cognitive capability regarding gait modalities remains limited. The success element in Gait-World is the proper vocabulary prompt where this paradigm carefully selects gait cycle actions as Vocabulary Base, bridging the gait and vocabulary feature spaces and further promoting human understanding for the gait. How to extract gait features? Although previous gait networks have made significant progress, learning solely from gait modalities on limited gait databases makes it difficult to learn universal gait features for practicality. Therefore, we propose the first Gait-World model, dubbed α-Gait, which guides the gait network learning with vocabulary knowledge from VLMs. However, due to the heterogeneity of the modalities, directly integrating vocabulary and gait features is highly challenging as they reside in different embedding spaces. To address the issues, α-Gait designs Vocabulary Relation Mapper and Gait Fine grained Detector to map and establish vocabulary relations in the gait space for detecting corresponding gait features. Extensive experiments on CASIA-B, CCPG, SUSTech1K, Gait3D and GREW reveal the potential value and research directions of vocabulary information from VLMs in the gait field.

AI.tldr: 该文提出词汇引导的步态识别新范式Gait-World，并实现首个模型α-Gait，利用视觉语言模型的词汇知识引导步态网络学习，在多个数据集上验证了词汇信息的潜力。
AI.motivation: 现有步态网络分为基于外观（图像中的形状与运动）与基于模型（点云固有结构）两类，但其对"步态"的考量对人而言仍模糊难懂；同时，由于步态数据库有限，仅从步态模态学习难以获得通用步态特征。视觉语言模型虽在多种视觉任务中表现优异，但对步态模态的认知能力仍然有限，因此需要引入人类词汇来探索步态概念。
AI.method: 提出新范式Gait-World，通过人类词汇与视觉语言模型探索步态概念；核心是精心选择步态周期动作作为Vocabulary Base，作为合适的词汇提示，用以桥接步态与词汇的特征空间。基于该范式提出首个模型α-Gait，以VLM的词汇知识引导步态网络学习。针对词汇与步态特征因异质性而处于不同嵌入空间的问题，设计Vocabulary Relation Mapper与Gait Fine-grained Detector，在步态空间中映射并建立词汇关系，从而检测对应步态特征。
AI.result: 在CASIA-B、CCPG、SUSTech1K、Gait3D和GREW五个数据集上的大量实验表明，来自视觉语言模型的词汇信息在步态领域具有潜在价值并指出了新的研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 该工作开创了词汇引导的步态识别范式Gait-World，并验证了α-Gait的可行性，说明借助VLM词汇知识可提升步态特征学习，为步态领域的跨模态研究提供了新方向。

title: Understanding Reliability in LLM-based Human Behavior Simulation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate human survey responses and behavioral reactions, yet unreliable simulations can mislead social science conclusions. However, existing evaluations focus on end-to-end scores, leaving it unclear how different aspects of the simulation process interact to determine reliability. We propose ReliMap, which decomposes LLM-based human behavior simulation into three structured layers and evaluates reliability at both the individual level (R1) and population level (R2) across three configuration dimensions: model capacity, profile completeness, and population coverage. Through experiments across four simulation tasks and eleven LLMs, we find that all models exhibit substantial distributional bias without profile conditioning. Profile conditioning reduces this bias with diminishing returns. Larger models benefit more, and attribute informativeness matters more than quantity. Critically, R1 gains do not reliably transfer to R2--individual and population-level reliability can move in opposite directions. At the population layer, increasing coverage reduces variance but not systematic bias, with R2 stabilizing at around 50-100 individuals. These findings highlight that reliable simulation cannot be achieved by optimizing any single layer in isolation, but requires coordinated improvement across all three.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReliMap框架，将LLM人类行为模拟分解为三个结构化层次，从个体(R1)和群体(R2)两个层面评估可靠性，发现个体层面提升不能可靠迁移到群体层面，需三层协同优化。
AI.motivation: LLM被越来越多用于模拟人类问卷回答与行为反应，但不可靠的模拟会误导社会科学结论。现有评估只关注端到端分数，无法揭示模拟过程不同方面如何交互决定可靠性。
AI.method: 提出ReliMap，将基于LLM的人类行为模拟分解为三个结构化层次，在个体层(R1)和群体层(R2)两个层面评估可靠性，并考察三个配置维度：模型能力、画像完整度、群体覆盖度。在四个模拟任务和十一个LLM上开展实验。
AI.result: 无画像条件时所有模型都存在显著分布偏差；画像条件可降低偏差但收益递减。更大的模型获益更多，属性信息性比数量更重要。R1的提升不能可靠迁移到R2，个体与群体可靠性可能朝相反方向变化。群体层上，增加覆盖度降低方差但不减少系统性偏差，R2在约50-100个个体时趋于稳定。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的模拟无法通过孤立优化任何单一层次实现，而需要在三个层次上协同改进。

title: Dependency-Aware Trajectory Refinement for Efficient Multi-Turn Agent Fine-Tuning
summary: Multi-turn agent trajectories often contain redundant rounds (failed tool calls, parallel sub-queries, verification-only steps) that inflate both training and inference cost. We propose viewing each trajectory as a \emph{round-level dependency DAG} that exposes which rounds are globally load-bearing for the final answer, and fine-tune agents on trajectories refined through this DAG. Given an LLM-annotated DAG, these edits are deterministic and interpretable, with optional rephrasing. Models trained on these refined trajectories consistently outperform those trained on the original trajectories at lower inference cost. Specifically, across four multi-modal QA benchmarks, our refinements improve downstream accuracy by up to $1.7$\,pp over vanilla SFT (and $5.7$\,pp over an LLM-deletion baseline) while reducing per-sample inference messages by up to approximately $40\%$ and inference tokens by up to approximately $48\%$, translating to substantial savings in compute and serving cost. Code is available.

AI.tldr: 将多轮智能体轨迹建模为轮级依赖DAG，识别并删除对最终答案无关键作用的冗余轮次，用精炼轨迹微调模型，在四个多模态QA基准上同时提升准确率并大幅降低推理成本。
AI.motivation: 多轮智能体轨迹普遍包含冗余轮次（失败的工具调用、并行子查询、仅验证步骤），这些轮次同时抬高了训练与推理成本，但现有方法缺乏对"哪些轮次对最终答案真正关键"的显式判定机制。
AI.method: 把每条轨迹表示为一个轮级依赖DAG，用以揭示哪些轮次对最终答案具有全局支撑作用；基于LLM标注的DAG对轨迹进行精炼，编辑操作是确定且可解释的，并可选进行改写（rephrasing）；随后在精炼后的轨迹上对智能体进行微调。
AI.result: 在四个多模态QA基准上，相比原始轨迹的SFT（vanilla SFT），精炼轨迹将下游准确率提升最高1.7个百分点，相比LLM删除基线提升最高5.7个百分点；同时每样本推理消息数减少约40%、推理token数减少约48%，显著降低计算与serving成本。
AI.conclusion: 以轮级依赖DAG为工具对多轮轨迹做可解释、确定性的精炼，是一种在提升下游性能的同时显著压缩推理开销的有效微调策略，具有可观的计算成本收益。

title: StrucPhysVideo: Learning Physical Dynamics from Structured Captions and Robot Actions
summary: Modeling physical dynamics, including how objects move, interact, and change state, is central to video world models for embodied AI. We present StrucPhysVideo, a family of video world models that bridges physics-focused data curation with language- and action-conditioned prediction of scene evolution. Our data pipeline combines motion-aware video segmentation, quality and content filtering, and physical relevance verification with structured annotations of objects, materials, and temporally localized interactions. By disentangling camera motion from object behavior and explicitly describing contact, deformation, and state transitions, the pipeline provides supervision grounded in observable physical events. Building on these data, we introduce StrucPhysVideo-TI2V, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) text-image-to-video model trained with a curriculum that progressively emphasizes physical dynamics while retaining general-domain video data. StrucPhysVideo-TI2V achieves state-of-the-art performance on Physics-IQ Verified, scoring 45.5% and outperforming Cosmos3-Super-Image2Video by 2.8 percentage points. Caption ablations across backbones further demonstrate the effectiveness of physics-focused supervision. We further extend StrucPhysVideo-TI2V to StrucPhysVideo-IA2V, an interactive image-action-to-video world model that predicts visual outcomes from robot end-effector commands. Action conditioning, causal autoregressive generation, and few-step distillation enable incremental robot rollouts with only four denoising steps. Together, StrucPhysVideo advances physical dynamics modeling from image- and language-conditioned video prediction toward action-driven interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出 StrucPhysVideo 视频世界模型系列，结合物理导向数据策管与语言/动作条件预测，TI2V 在 Physics-IQ Verified 达 45.5%，并扩展至动作驱动的交互式世界模型。
AI.motivation: 物理动力学建模（物体运动、交互、状态变化）是具身智能视频世界模型的核心，但现有模型缺乏 grounded 在可观测物理事件上的监督信号，且多局限于图像与语言条件，难以支持动作驱动的交互预测。
AI.method: 1) 数据管线：运动感知视频分割、质量与内容过滤、物理相关性验证，并结构化标注物体、材质与时间定位交互；解耦相机运动与物体行为，显式描述接触、形变与状态转移。2) 基于该数据构建 StrucPhysVideo-TI2V，稀疏 MoE 文本-图像到视频模型，采用逐步强调物理动力学同时保留通用域数据的课程学习。3) 扩展为 StrucPhysVideo-IA2V：图像-动作到视频世界模型，以机器人末端执行器指令为条件，使用动作条件化、因果自回归生成与少步蒸馏实现仅 4 步去噪的增量式机器人 rollout。
AI.result: StrucPhysVideo-TI2V 在 Physics-IQ Verified 上取得 45.5% 的最新最优性能，超过 Cosmos3-Super-Image2Video 2.8 个百分点；跨 backbone 的 caption 消融进一步验证物理导向监督的有效性。
AI.conclusion: StrucPhysVideo 将物理动力学建模从图像与语言条件的视频预测推进到动作驱动的交互，为具身智能世界模型提供了数据、模型与交互范式的统一框架。

title: Occluded Gait Recognition with Mixture of Experts: An Action Detection Perspective
summary: Extensive occlusions in real-world scenarios pose challenges to gait recognition due to missing and noisy information, as well as body misalignment in position and scale. We argue that rich dynamic contextual information within a gait sequence inherently possesses occlusion-solving traits: 1) Adjacent frames with gait continuity allow holistic body regions to infer occluded body regions; 2) Gait cycles allow information integration between holistic actions and occluded actions. Therefore, we introduce an action detection perspective where a gait sequence is regarded as a composition of actions. To detect accurate actions under complex occlusion scenarios, we propose an Action Detection Based Mixture of Experts (GaitMoE), consisting of Mixture of Temporal Experts (MTE) and Mixture of Action Experts (MAE). MTE adaptively constructs action anchors by temporal experts and MAE adaptively constructs action proposals from action anchors by action experts. Especially, action detection as a proxy task with gait recognition is an end-to-end joint training only with ID labels. In addition, due to the lack of a unified occluded benchmark, we construct a pioneering Occluded Gait database (OccGait), containing rich occlusion scenarios and annotations of occlusion types. Extensive experiments on OccGait, OccCASIA-B,Gait3D and GREW demonstrate the superior performance of GaitMoE.OccGait is available at https://github.com/BNU-IVC/OccGait.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出GaitMoE，从动作检测视角建模步态序列，通过时序专家和动作专家混合在遮挡下检测准确动作，并构建遮挡步态数据库OccGait，在多数据集上取得优越性能。
AI.motivation: 真实场景中广泛存在的遮挡导致步态信息缺失、噪声以及身体在位置和尺度上的错位，给步态识别带来挑战。作者认为步态序列中的动态上下文信息本身具有解决遮挡的特性：相邻帧的步态连续性可用整体身体区域推断被遮挡区域，步态周期可实现整体动作与遮挡动作间的信息融合。
AI.method: 将步态序列视为动作组合，引入动作检测视角，提出基于动作检测的专家混合模型GaitMoE，包括时序专家混合MTE和动作专家混合MAE。MTE通过时序专家自适应构建动作锚点，MAE通过动作专家从动作锚点自适应构建动作提议。动作检测作为代理任务与步态识别进行端到端联合训练，仅使用身份标签。此外构建了首个统一遮挡基准数据库OccGait，包含丰富遮挡场景及遮挡类型标注。
AI.result: 在OccGait、OccCASIA-B、Gait3D和GREW上的大量实验表明GaitMoE具有优越性能。OccGait已开源。
AI.conclusion: GaitMoE通过动作检测代理任务与专家混合机制有效利用步态动态上下文解决遮挡问题，并借助新建的OccGait基准验证了方法的有效性，为遮挡步态识别提供了新视角与数据支撑。

title: Toward AI-Assisted Poultry Coccidiosis Diagnosis: Evaluating Gemini and BiomedParse on Eimeria Microscopy Images
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables, accepted at IEEE International Conference on Sustainability, Innovation and Technology (ICSIT 2026)
summary: Coccidiosis caused by Eimeria parasites is a major economic burden in poultry production, and effective control depends on accurate species-level diagnosis. This study evaluates whether a general-purpose multimodal large language model can support such diagnosis. Google Gemini was assessed on 4,225 mi- croscopy images covering the seven fowl-infecting Eimeria species under two prompting conditions, one without candidate labels and one with a predefined class list, and was further tested for pathology-report generation, while BiomedParse was examined for parasite segmentation. Without candidate labels, the model produced broad and taxonomically inconsistent outputs. With candidate labels, overall accuracy reached only 14.9%, with a strong bias toward E. tenella at 74% and no correct classifications for E. acervulina, E. mitis and E. praecox. Generated treatment reports were coherent but unverified, and segmentation was only partial. Current multimodal models are therefore not yet reliable for standalone Eimeria diagnosis without domain-specific fine- tuning and expert validation.

AI.tldr: 通用多模态大模型（Gemini）在7种禽类艾美耳球虫显微图像诊断中表现不佳，需领域微调与专家验证。
AI.motivation: 球虫病是家禽生产的重要经济负担，有效防控依赖准确的种级诊断，因此需要评估通用多模态大模型能否支持此类诊断。
AI.method: 在4,225张覆盖7种感染家禽的艾美耳球虫显微图像上评估Google Gemini，设置两种提示条件（无候选标签、有预设类别列表），并测试其病理报告生成能力；同时检验BiomedParse的寄生虫分割性能。
AI.result: 无候选标签时输出宽泛且分类学不一致；有候选标签时总体准确率仅14.9%，严重偏向E. tenella（74%），对E. acervulina、E. mitis和E. praecox均无正确分类。生成的治疗报告连贯但未经核实，分割仅部分成功。
AI.conclusion: 当前多模态模型尚不能作为独立的艾美耳球虫诊断工具，需领域特定微调与专家验证。

title: Planning or Improvisation? Stress-Testing the Poetry Planning Site on Open Models and Open Cross-Layer Transcoders
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Code, data and analysis scripts: https://github.com/PCfVW/poetry-planning-site . An earlier version was submitted to the BlackboxNLP 2026 special track on reproducibility and reliability in interpretability analyses; this version adds a rerun composition-horizon experiment (36 runs, 8,640 sampled lines) and a transcoder-free activation-patching test
summary: Lindsey et al. (2025) report that Claude 3.5 Haiku plans rhymes: features for candidate rhyme words are active on the newline before a line is written, and a suppress-and-inject intervention redirects the line only when applied there (their Figure 13). We test how far this generalizes on seven cells crossing four open models (0.6B to 2.6B parameters) with six open cross-layer transcoders (CLTs), on one consumer GPU, decomposing the claim into position specificity (C1), newline site identity (C2), and a newline-resident plan (C3). This is a stress test rather than a faithful reproduction: attribution graphs are unavailable for these CLTs, so features are found bottom-up from decoder vectors. C1 generalizes, in every cell and in all 247 of 444 prompt-by-inject pairs with a detectable effect, but the effective position is the final prompt token, adjacent to emission, and only two cells reach behaviorally meaningful probabilities. C2 and C3 are not recovered by any probe: a census of every active feature finds no rhyme-anticipating enrichment at the newline, and steering the newline while the model composes the whole line, over 36 runs and 8,640 sampled lines, shows why. That intervention is strong but one token long, making the injected word the first word of the composed line in 703 of 720 samples and leaving the rhyme six words later untouched. A final test drops the transcoder entirely: patching the newline's whole residual, at every layer, from a minimal-pair poem whose third line ends on a different rhyme moves the rhyme in 11 of 1,260 composed lines against 4 at baseline, with a design resolving 1.4%. We read this as a boundary condition rather than a refutation: at this scale and with these transcoders, the causal site is emission-adjacent. We reproduce Figure 13's shape, not its mechanism. Code and data are public (code: github.com/PCfVW/poetry-planning-site).

AI.tldr: 该研究在7个配置单元（4个开源模型，0.6B–2.6B参数，6个跨层转码器CLT）上测试"Claude 3.5 Haiku在换行符处规划押韵"这一发现的泛化性，将原论断分解为位置特异性(C1)、换行位点身份(C2)和换行驻留规划(C3)。结果：C1可泛化，但有效位置其实是紧邻输出的最后一个提示词元；C2与C3均未被任何探针复现。作者将其解读为边界条件而非反驳——复现了图13的形态，而非其机制。
AI.motivation: Lindsey等(2025)报告Claude 3.5 Haiku会在写下一行之前的换行符处激活候选押韵词特征，且"抑制-注入"干预只有施加在换行符处才能改写该行。本文旨在检验这一因果机制的泛化能力：在更小的开源模型与开源转码器（无归因图可用）条件下，该"换行符即规划位点"的结论是否仍成立，从而厘清其适用边界。
AI.method: 压力测试而非严格复现。在单张消费级GPU上，于7个单元（4个开源模型0.6B–2.6B参数 × 6个开源跨层转码器CLT）中，自底向上从解码向量寻找特征（因CLT无归因图）。将原论断分解为三项可检验子命题：C1位置特异性、C2换行位点身份、C3换行驻留规划。采用抑制-注入干预、全活跃特征普查、换行词元转向实验(36次运行、8,640条采样行)，以及最终去除转码器、跨层残余补丁实验(1,260条生成行，设计分辨率1.4%)。
AI.result: C1在全部7个单元、444个提示-注入对中可检测效应的247对里均泛化，但有效位置是紧邻输出的最后一个提示词元，且仅2个单元达到行为上有意义的概率。C2与C3未被任何探针复现：活跃特征普查未发现换行处存在押韵预期性富集；换行转向干预虽强但仅一个词元长，使注入词在703/720个样本中成为所组诗行的首词，六词之后的押韵未被触及。去除转码器的残余补丁实验仅使11/1,260行押韵改变（基线为4），设计分辨率1.4%。
AI.conclusion: 在此规模与这些转码器条件下，因果位点是"紧邻输出"而非换行符本身。作者将结果定位为边界条件而非对原研究的反驳：复现了Figure 13的形态，但未复现其机制。代码与数据已公开。

title: DR.WILSS: Diffusion-Based Replay for Weakly Supervised Continual Semantic Segmentation
summary: Weakly supervised class-incremental semantic segmentation (WILSS) aims to train a segmentation model over multiple steps, each introducing new concepts to be learned with only image-level supervision. We introduce DR$.$WILSS, an innovative approach to address catastrophic forgetting in continual learning using diffusion-based generative replay. Our framework leverages language clues to guide the diffusion process, employing self-inpainting and regularization techniques to efficiently produce replay data, aiding the learning process. By generating high-quality replay data, the information from previously learned classes can be preserved during continual updates, a critical challenge in incremental learning scenarios. To further align the statistics of replay data with those of training samples, we apply LoRAs to the generative model. Experimental results demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks and generative architectures, while avoiding storage of training data and the use of additional resource-demanding tools during training. The proposed technique enables an optimal tradeoff between training complexity and inference-time accuracy, making DR$.$WILSS a promising solution for real-world applications.

AI.tldr: 提出DR.WILSS框架，利用基于扩散模型的生成式重放缓解弱监督类增量语义分割中的灾难性遗忘，并通过语言线索、自修复与正则化及LoRA对齐统计，达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 弱监督类增量语义分割（WILSS）需在多步训练中仅用图像级监督学习新类别，但持续更新易导致对旧类别的灾难性遗忘；同时需避免存储训练数据与引入高资源消耗工具。
AI.method: 采用基于扩散模型的生成式重放；用语言线索引导扩散过程；结合自修复（self-inpainting）与正则化高效生成重放数据；对生成模型应用LoRA以对齐重放数据与训练样本的统计分布。
AI.result: 在多个基准与多种生成架构上取得最先进性能；训练中无需存储训练数据，也无需额外高资源工具；在训练复杂度与推理精度间实现最优权衡。
AI.conclusion: DR.WILSS通过扩散生成式重放有效保留旧类信息，缓解增量学习遗忘，兼顾效率与精度，适合实际应用。

title: M-SQE: Multilingual Skill Quality Estimation for Enhancing Language Equality in Agentic Skill Use
summary: Agent skills, reusable procedural documents that extend LLM agents beyond their parametric memory, have become an important interface for deploying agents on real-world tasks. Community-maintained skill libraries built around this interface are growing rapidly. However, this ecosystem remains deeply English-centric: our audit finds that low-resource languages such as Swahili and Hindi have no in-language skill content, so retrieval often returns a skill written in a different language than the query, degrading accuracy and recall. A practical solution is to synthesize in-language skills for retrieval but the quality can be unreliable, so relevance in this setting alone often surfaces a related but unusable candidate. To address this, we propose M-SQE, a post-retrieval Multilingual Skill Quality Estimation framework that scores candidates via a Theory view for intrinsic quality and an Action view for task-grounded utility, unified into a domain-conditioned final score. We evaluate M-SQE across three skill-use domains: general, tool-use, and cultural tasks. Empirically, we build three-layer candidate skill pools mirroring today's ecosystem, where M-SQE's task success exceeds existing baseline's average by at least +3.5 points across three different retrievers. Particularly, M-SQE lifts the lowest-resource languages most (+12.9pp on Hindi and +5.6pp on Swahili) and achieves strong performance across all six culture regions, thereby moving agentic skill use toward linguistic and cultural equality.

AI.tldr: 提出M-SQE后检索多语言技能质量估计框架，从理论质量与任务实用性两个视角统一打分，在低资源语言和文化任务场景显著提升智能体技能检索的成功率。
AI.motivation: 智能体技能库生态以英语为中心，低资源语言（如斯瓦希里语、印地语）缺乏本地语言技能内容，检索常返回与查询语言不一致的技能，导致准确率与召回率下降；直接合成语言内技能质量又不可靠，单靠相关性会返回"相关但不可用"的候选。
AI.method: M-SQE（多语言技能质量估计）作为后检索框架，对候选技能进行双视角评估：Theory view衡量内在质量，Action view衡量任务落地实用性，并将两者融合为领域条件化的最终分数；评估覆盖通用、工具使用与文化任务三个领域，并构建模拟现生态的三层候选技能池。
AI.result: 在三种不同检索器上，M-SQE的任务成功率平均超过现有基线至少+3.5分；对最低资源语言提升最大（印地语+12.9pp、斯瓦希里语+5.6pp），并在全部六个文化区域均取得优异表现。
AI.conclusion: M-SQE有效缓解智能体技能使用中的语言与文化不平等，推动智能体技能生态向语言与文化公平方向发展。

title: Disentangling Long-Term Memory via Latent Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning
summary: Personalized agents are required to reason over long-term history interactions to infer both explicit preferences and implicit behavioral evidence. While early flat retrieval methods score memory fragments independently and neglect the distributed information, current structured memory frameworks rely on query-agnostic static graphs that fail to capture the context-dependent relations. Crucially, raw textual memories are inherently entangled and noisy, making fine-grained personalization and cross-session reasoning computationally prohibitive. To this end, we present LGM, a novel neuro-symbolic framework that shifts long-term memory disentanglement into a continuous latent space. Specifically, (i) instead of persisting fixed graphs, we design a tailored latent graph construction with a sparse autoencoder. Subject to each query, it maps historical interactions into latent memory nodes and disentangles the memory traces into sparse concept activations, dynamically synthesizing query-aware relational edge weights. (ii) A graph encoder then treats the query embedding as a conditioning preference to direct non-linear message passing across the task-specific latent subgraph. This yields a highly expressive memory representation for effective activations. Extensive experiments on long-term personalization benchmarks demonstrate that LGM significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in capturing both explicit and implicit preferences while enabling personalized responses.

AI.tldr: 提出神经符号框架LGM，将长期记忆解耦迁移到连续隐空间，通过稀疏自编码器构建查询感知的隐图并动态合成关系边权重，结合图编码器实现个性化推理，在长期个性化基准上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 个性化智能体需要基于长期历史交互推理显式偏好与隐式行为证据。早期扁平检索方法独立打分记忆片段，忽略分布式信息；现有结构化记忆框架依赖与查询无关的静态图，无法捕捉上下文相关关系。此外，原始文本记忆本身纠缠且噪声大，导致细粒度个性化与跨会话推理计算代价高昂。
AI.method: LGM为神经符号框架，将长期记忆解耦置于连续隐空间：(i) 不持久化固定图，而是用稀疏自编码器构建定制的隐图——针对每个查询将历史交互映射为隐记忆节点，把记忆痕迹解耦为稀疏概念激活，并动态合成查询感知的关系边权重；(ii) 图编码器将查询嵌入作为条件偏好，引导任务特定隐子图上的非线性消息传递，生成高表达力的记忆表示以实现有效激活。
AI.result: 在长期个性化基准上的大量实验表明，LGM在捕捉显式与隐式偏好方面显著优于最先进基线，并能够生成个性化响应。
AI.conclusion: LGM通过将长期记忆解耦迁移至连续隐空间并实现查询感知的动态图构建与条件化消息传递，有效解决了静态图缺乏上下文相关性与文本记忆噪声纠缠的问题，为长期个性化推理提供了高效且表达力强的方案。

title: CSWAM: Better Causal Semantic Representations for Out-of-Distribution Generalization in World Action Models
summary: FastWAM-style world action models enable efficient action-only inference, but generalize poorly under visual distribution shifts. Their reconstruction-oriented representations emphasize appearance-specific details, limiting generalization to unseen scenes and objects. Without observation history, the model also lacks temporal evidence for robustly identifying task-relevant state changes and motion in unfamiliar visual conditions. To address these limitations, we present the Causal Semantic World Action Model (CSWAM), which augments FastWAM with a causal semantic expert built on V-JEPA 2.1. V-JEPA provides temporally grounded representations of semantic state changes and motion with less dependence on appearance-specific details. The expert learns their future evolution from a sparse history of current and past observations and shares the history-derived context with both the video and action streams through causal attention. At inference, CSWAM conditions action denoising on the current video state and observed semantic history, retaining efficient action-only inference. We conduct simulation and real-robot experiments to evaluate generalization under distribution shifts. With embodied pretraining, CSWAM raises Randomized success on RoboTwin 2.0 Clean-to-Randomized transfer from 10.16% to 45.18%, a gain of 35.02 percentage points over FastWAM. Across two real-robot tasks and three OOD difficulty levels, CSWAM improves average success over FastWAM by 42.5 percentage points, from 27.5% to 70.0%.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出因果语义世界动作模型（CSWAM），在FastWAM基础上引入基于V-JEPA 2.1的因果语义专家，利用当前与稀疏历史观测学习语义状态变化与运动的未来演化，并通过因果注意力与视频及动作流共享历史上下文，从而在保持高效纯动作推理的同时显著提升视觉分布偏移下的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: FastWAM类世界动作模型虽支持高效的纯动作推理，但在视觉分布偏移下泛化较差。其面向重建的表征侧重外观细节，难以迁移到未见场景与物体；同时缺乏观测历史，无法为识别任务相关状态变化与运动提供鲁棒的时间证据。因此需要一种减少外观依赖、利用时序语义信息的方法来提升分布偏移下的泛化性能。
AI.method: 提出CSWAM：在FastWAM上增加一个基于V-JEPA 2.1的因果语义专家。V-JEPA提供具时间基础的语义状态变化与运动表征，弱化对外观细节的依赖；该专家从当前与历史的稀疏观测中学习其未来演化，并通过因果注意力将历史归纳出的上下文同时共享给视频流与动作流。推理时，CSWAM以当前视频状态与观测到的语义历史为条件进行动作去噪，保持高效的纯动作推理。
AI.result: 在仿真与真机实验中评估分布偏移下的泛化：经具身预训练后，CSWAM将RoboTwin 2.0的Clean-to-Randomized迁移中的Randomized成功率从10.16%提升至45.18%，较FastWAM提升35.02个百分点；在两个真机任务、三个OOD难度级别上，平均成功率从27.5%提升至70.0%，较FastWAM提升42.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 引入基于V-JEPA 2.1的因果语义专家并共享因果历史上下文，可在不牺牲纯动作推理效率的前提下，显著改善世界动作模型在视觉分布偏移下的泛化能力，仿真与真机结果均验证了有效性。

title: GeoCond: A Conditioning-Aware Reliability Adapter for Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
summary: Feed-forward 3D foundation models such as VGGT predict cameras, depth, and point maps in a single pass, but can fail silently under low overlap, low parallax, and extreme relative rotation. Stratified analyses over these factors show that these failures are governed by geometric conditioning and are poorly captured by native aleatoric confidence. We introduce GeoCond, a lightweight reliability adapter for frozen feed-forward 3D backbones. GeoCond reads the backbone's predicted geometry and outputs pose-level uncertainty and a refinement gate. During training, it can be supervised by frame-permutation orbit variance, ground-truth pose error when labels are available, or cycle residuals from unlabelled independent pose graphs. At inference, the default head requires only one backbone pass and a small MLP. On VGGT, GeoCond improves out-of-distribution (OOD) AUSE (area under the sparsification-error curve; lower is better) from $0.32$ to $0.20$ over native confidence, transfers zero-shot to outdoor extreme-view scenes, and avoids the collapse caused by applying bundle adjustment uniformly. Across multiple backbones, cycle-distilled variants provide a ground-truth-free adaptation route, including cases where permutation variance vanishes on equivariant models. The same reliability signal supports gated refinement, pose-graph weighting, calibration, curation, and capture decisions. Reliable feed-forward 3D reconstruction requires not only predicting geometry, but also knowing when that geometry should be trusted.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出GeoCond——一个轻量级可靠性适配器，用于冻结的前馈3D基础模型（如VGGT），通过输出位姿级不确定性来识别低重叠、低视差、极端相对旋转等几何条件不良下的静默失败。
AI.motivation: 前馈3D基础模型（如VGGT）能单次前向预测相机、深度和点图，但在低重叠、低视差和极端相对旋转下会静默失效；分层分析表明这些失败由几何条件（geometric conditioning）主导，且原生的偶然不确定性（aleatoric confidence）难以刻画这些失败。因此需要一种无需重训练骨干、能判断几何何时可信的可靠性评估机制。
AI.method: GeoCond是一个面向冻结前馈3D骨干的轻量级可靠性适配器：读取骨干预测的几何，输出位姿级不确定性与精化门控。训练可用三种监督信号：（1）帧置换轨道方差；（2）有标注时的真值位姿误差；（3）无标注时来自独立位姿图的循环残差。推理时默认头仅需一次骨干前向加一个小MLP。
AI.result: 在VGGT上，GeoCond将OOD的AUSE（稀疏化误差曲线下面积，越低越好）从0.32降至0.20，优于原生置信度；可零样本迁移到户外极端视角场景；并避免了统一施加bundle adjustment导致的崩溃。在多个骨干上，循环蒸馏变体提供了无真值适配路径，包括置换方差在等变模型上消失的情况。同一可靠性信号还支持门控精化、位姿图加权、校准、数据筛选与采集决策。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的馈前3D重建不仅需要预测几何，还需要知道几何何时应当被信任。GeoCond提供了一种可泛化、支持多下游任务的可靠性信号。

title: Divide and Conquer: Mixture-of-Bottleneck Experts in Informative Ordinal Space for Video-based Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
summary: Video-based Multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) must handle information from text, audio, and image sequence in human speaking videos, yet current methods often fail to integrate modalities with task awareness. Most models treat video sentiment prediction as a single task, overlooking its ordinal nature, and their fusion strategies struggle to capture diverse unique and synergic cues across modalities. To address these limitations, we adopt a divide-and-conquer perspective by reformulating MSA as an ordinal regression problem and decoupling it into polarity recognition and intensity prediction. Driven by information theory, we introduce a Mixture-of-Bottleneck (MoB) framework that assigns different latents to polarity- and intensity-specific experts for different modalities. With the learning of information bottleneck, each expert learns compact and task-relevant representations while filtering out redundancy and noise. A multimodal bottleneck routing fusion module then fuses these expert latents with hard mining strategy, guiding the prediction in the ordinal sentiment space. Extensive experiments on 4 MSA datasets and 4 language models show that MoB effectively leverages informative latents from diverse modalities and captures general sentiment structure. Beyond stronger performance, MoB comprehensively captures fine-grained intra- and inter-modal dynamics, enabling more trustworthy localization of nuanced video sentiment signals.

AI.tldr: 该论文将视频多模态情感分析重新表述为有序回归问题，并分解为极性识别与强度预测两个子任务，提出基于信息瓶颈的混合瓶颈（MoB）框架，为不同模态的极性和强度专家分配不同隐变量，并通过多模态瓶颈路由融合模块进行融合。
AI.motivation: 现有视频多模态情感分析方法难以以任务感知的方式整合模态，多数模型将视频情感预测视为单一任务，忽视了其有序性质，且融合策略难以捕捉跨模态的独特与协同线索。因此需要一种能够兼顾任务分解与信息筛选的新框架。
AI.method: 采用分而治之的思路，将MSA重构为有序回归问题，解耦为极性识别和强度预测。基于信息论引入Mixture-of-Bottleneck（MoB）框架，为不同模态的极性/强度专家分配不同隐变量；通过学习信息瓶颈，每个专家获得紧凑且任务相关的表示，过滤冗余与噪声；随后使用多模态瓶颈路由融合模块，结合硬挖掘策略融合专家隐变量，在有序情感空间中引导预测。
AI.result: 在4个MSA数据集和4个语言模型上的大量实验表明，MoB能有效利用来自不同模态的信息隐变量并捕捉通用情感结构；除性能更强外，还能全面捕捉细粒度的模态内与模态间动态，实现更可信的细粒度视频情感信号定位。
AI.conclusion: MoB通过有序回归重构、任务分解与信息瓶颈驱动的专家建模及路由融合，提升了视频多模态情感分析的性能与可解释性，验证了任务感知和模态差异化表示在MSA中的有效性。

title: CADSplat: Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting Aided by CAD Models for Robust, Photorealistic Digital-Twin Reconstruction
summary: We present CADSplat, a framework that reconstructs photorealistic, geometrically accurate digital twins from sparse ($<15$ views), wide-baseline posed images of an object by regularizing 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) with an explicit CAD shape prior. Using such a prior requires finding a CAD model whose shape resembles the object depicted in the images and determining the pose of each camera relative to the object. We obtain both by matching segmented object silhouettes against silhouettes rendered from a CAD library and keeping the camera-to-object poses of the best-matching model. We then anchor 3D Gaussian primitives to the surface of the retrieved model and jointly optimize the 3DGS parameters, the camera-to-object registration, and a non-rigid deformation field to account for shape differences between the physical object and the CAD model. Across two real-world datasets, CADSplat outperforms unconstrained, few-shot, and mesh-texturing baselines and degrades gracefully to as few as 3 views. Our experiments show that most of the gain in rendering quality comes from how the splats are constrained---a fixed set of splats tied to a surface and moved by a single smooth deformation field---rather than from the CAD shape itself. The CAD model adds shape knowledge where views are scarcest, in the sparsest captures and on strongly self-occluded objects, and it places every camera in the object's own frame. This enables applications beyond novel-view synthesis, such as markerless augmented reality registration, per-image object pose estimation, physical simulations, and the transfer of part labels from the design to the reconstruction.

AI.tldr: CADSplat 利用 CAD 形状先验正则化 3DGS，从稀疏宽基线图像重建高保真数字孪生，并揭示主要增益来自"固定表面锚定 + 单一平滑形变场"的 splat 约束方式，而非 CAD 形状本身。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角（<15 视图）与宽基线的物体重建中，3DGS 因缺乏几何约束而容易过拟合、产生漂浮伪影。已有稀疏视角方法多依赖深度或多视图正则，缺少显式形状知识；作者希望引入 CAD 形状先验，在视角最稀疏、自遮挡严重的区域补充几何信息，同时在同一框架内解决相机—物体位姿配准问题，以支撑新视角合成之外的 AR 配准、位姿估计、物理仿真与部件标签迁移等应用。
AI.method: 1) 从输入图像分割物体轮廓，与 CAD 库中渲染的轮廓进行匹配，检索形状相似的 CAD 模型并同时获得相机—物体位姿；2) 将 3D 高斯原语锚定在检索 CAD 模型的表面上；3) 联合优化 3DGS 参数、相机—物体配准以及一个非刚性形变场，以弥补真实物体与 CAD 模型之间的形状差异。
AI.result: 在两个真实世界数据集上，CADSplat 优于无约束 3DGS、少样本方法与网格贴图（mesh-texturing）基线，并在仅 3 个视图时仍能优雅退化。消融表明，渲染质量的主要增益来自 splat 的约束方式——一组绑定于表面、由单一平滑形变场驱动的固定 splat——而非 CAD 形状本身。CAD 形状在视角最稀疏和强自遮挡物体上贡献额外的形状知识，并将所有相机统一到物体自身坐标系中。
AI.conclusion: CAD 先验的价值更多体现在极稀疏与自遮挡场景下的形状补全，以及提供统一物体坐标系，而非直接提升渲染质量；该统一坐标系使方法可扩展到无标记 AR 配准、逐图像物体位姿估计、物理仿真和设计部件标签向重建结果的迁移等下游任务。

title: ActionPiece: Rethinking Action Tokenization for Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Action tokenizers play a central role in autoregressive vision-language-action (VLA) models, determining both the targets for policy training and the executable commands recovered from predicted tokens. Their fidelity is commonly evaluated using pointwise reconstruction metrics such as mean squared error (MSE), yet small individual errors do not fully characterize how faithfully action adjustments across demonstrations are preserved. After compression, similar actions may still cluster around a representative motion, while the adjustments needed for different contexts are diminished, distorted, or even reversed. We introduce physical rank consistency (PRC) to measure how well tokenization preserves local physical distance rankings after reconstruction. Evaluating decoded actions provides a common reference across token vocabularies and decoder architectures, complementing pointwise accuracy with a measure of relational fidelity. We further present ActionPiece, which preserves physical action relationships through joint supervision of representation learning and quantization. Physical rank preservation supervises near-far ordering in encoder and quantized feature distances, while quantization regularization applies the same ordering to codeword assignment distributions. Both objectives augment reconstruction, producing discrete action tokens for standard autoregressive policy learning and execution through a frozen decoder. Under the same Qwen3-VL-4B policy training setup, ActionPiece achieves 94.8% on LIBERO and 68.8% on unseen LIBERO-Plus, with additional evaluations reaching 71.9% on SimplerEnv and 51.5% across VLA-Arena L0-L2. Component ablations show that the two objectives jointly improve PRC and policy success, demonstrating the value of physical relationship supervision for action tokenization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出物理秩一致性（PRC）指标衡量动作分词器对局部物理距离排序的保持能力，并提出ActionPiece，通过表示学习与量化的联合监督（物理秩保持+量化正则）在保持重构精度的同时维护动作关系，在LIBERO等基准上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 动作分词器在自回归VLA模型中至关重要，决定策略训练目标与可执行指令。但其保真度常用MSE等逐点重构指标评估，无法刻画跨示范的动作调整是否被忠实保留。压缩后相似动作可能聚集于代表运动附近，而不同情境所需的调整被削弱、扭曲甚至反转，因此需要关系层面的保真度度量。
AI.method: 提出物理秩一致性（PRC），衡量分词器重构后局部物理距离排序的保持程度，以解码动作为统一参考，跨词表与解码器架构可比。同时提出ActionPiece：联合监督表示学习与量化。物理秩保持监督编码器与量化特征距离的近—远排序；量化正则将相同排序施加于码字分配分布。两目标作为重构的补充，生成离散动作token，供标准自回归策略学习，并通过冻结解码器执行。
AI.result: 在相同Qwen3-VL-4B策略训练设置下，ActionPiece在LIBERO达94.8%，未见过的LIBERO-Plus达68.8%；SimperEnv达71.9%，VLA-Arena L0-L2达51.5%。组件消融显示两个目标共同提升PRC与策略成功率。
AI.conclusion: 逐点重构指标不足以保证动作分词的关系保真度，PRC提供了补充性度量。ActionPiece通过物理关系监督实现更忠实的动作分词，验证了物理关系监督对动作分词及下游策略性能的价值。

title: Beyond Random Couplings: Contrastive Noise Alignment in Generative Flows
summary: Diffusion and flow-matching models are typically trained by corrupting data through independently sampled Gaussian noise. While simple and scalable, this forward process induces arbitrary data-noise couplings, forcing the network to learn high-curvature transports between unrelated endpoints. Existing optimal-transport methods reduce this burden by reassigning fixed noise samples to data, but the source noise distribution itself remains passive. To address this, we introduce Contrastive Noise Alignment (CNA), a training-time method that creates dynamic, contrastive couplings by optimizing the noise representations directly. By modeling the noise batch as an interacting particle system, CNA employs a cross-modal InfoNCE objective to align noise particles with their paired data targets. To prevent spatial collapse, this alignment is regularized using an angular entropy term and a radial norm penalty. We show theoretically that this equilibrium asymptotically preserves Gaussian structures, maintaining tractability during inference. Empirically, CNA improves the alignment between noise and data, reduces flow curvature, and provides better generation quality with fewer required sampling steps. For few-step, pixel-space generation (2-4 NFEs), CNA reduces FID by over 50\% compared to standard rectified flow, and by at least 24\% against Optimal Transport baselines.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出对比噪声对齐（CNA），一种训练期方法，通过将噪声批次建模为交互粒子系统并优化噪声表示，构建动态对比耦合，从而降低流曲率并提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散与流匹配模型通常用独立采样高斯噪声腐蚀数据，这种前向过程产生任意的数据-噪声耦合，迫使网络学习高曲率传输。现有最优传输方法虽将固定噪声样本重新分配给数据，但源噪声分布本身仍是被动的，未得到优化。
AI.method: CNA将噪声批次视为交互粒子系统，采用跨模态InfoNCE目标将噪声粒子与其配对的数据目标对齐，并引入角度熵项与径向范数惩罚以防止空间塌缩，从理论上保证平衡态渐近保持高斯结构。
AI.result: CNA改善了噪声与数据的对齐，降低了流曲率，在更少采样步数下获得更好生成质量。在少步像素空间生成（2-4 NFEs）中，相比标准rectified flow，FID降低超过50%；相比最优传输基线，FID至少降低24%。
AI.conclusion: 通过直接优化噪声表示形成动态对比耦合，CNA在保持推理可处理性的同时显著提升少步生成效率与质量，为扩散与流匹配训练提供新思路。

title: Learning A Unified Template for Gait Recognition
summary: "What I cannot create, I do not understand."Human wisdom reveals that creation is one of the highest forms of learning. For example, Diffusion Models have demonstrated remarkable semantic structure and memory in image generation, understanding, and restoration, which intuitively benefits representation learning. However, current gait networks rarely embrace this perspective, relying primarily on learning by contrasting gait samples under varying complex conditions, leading to semantic inconsistency and uniformity issues. To address these issues, we propose Origins with generative capabilities whose underlying philosophy is that different entities are generated from a unified template, inherently regularizing gait representations within a consistent and diverse semantic space to capture accurate gait differences. Admittedly, learning this unified template is exceedingly challenging, as it requires the comprehensiveness of the template to encompass gait representations with various conditions. Inspired by Diffusion Models, Origins diffuses the unified template into timestep templates for gait generative learning, and meanwhile transfers the unified template for gait representation learning. Especially, gait generative and representation learning serve as a unified framework for end-to-end joint training. Extensive experiments on CASIA-B, CCPG,SUSTech1K, Gait3D, GREW and CCGR-MINI demonstrate that Origins performs unified generative and representation learning, achieving superior performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Origins 框架，受扩散模型启发，将统一模板扩散为时间步模板以进行步态生成学习，同时迁移统一模板用于步态表征学习，实现生成与表征的端到端联合训练，在多个数据集上取得优越性能。
AI.motivation: 现有步态网络主要依赖在不同复杂条件下对比步态样本来学习，导致语义不一致性与均匀性问题；而扩散模型在图像生成中展现了语义结构与记忆优势，有益于表征学习，因此作者希望将"创建即理解"的生成视角引入步态学习。
AI.method: 提出 Origins，其核心思想是不同实体由统一模板生成，从而在一致且多样的语义空间内正则化步态表征。受扩散模型启发，将统一模板扩散为多个时间步模板用于步态生成学习，同时迁移该统一模板用于步态表征学习，二者构成统一的端到端联合训练框架。
AI.result: 在 CASIA-B、CCPG、SUSTech1K、Gait3D、GREW 和 CCGR-MINI 等数据集上的大量实验表明，Origins 实现了统一的生成与表征学习，并取得优越性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一模板驱动的生成与表征联合学习，Origins 有效缓解了语义不一致与均匀性问题，验证了生成式视角在步态表征学习中的有效性与泛化能力。

title: Semantic-ITC: A Frame-wise Indoor Mobile Laser Scanning Dataset and Benchmark for Semantic Segmentation
summary: Semantic labels for indoor mobile laser scanning (MLS) frames remain largely absent from current point cloud semantic segmentation benchmarks, which mainly focus on reconstructed indoor scenes or outdoor LiDAR perception. This paper introduces Semantic-ITC, to the best of our knowledge the first public dataset and benchmark for frame-wise indoor MLS semantic segmentation. The dataset contains 52 indoor sequences, 79,108 MLS frames, and 1.23 billion labeled points collected in classrooms, corridors, meeting rooms, offices, and study areas. Labels are attached directly to measured LiDAR points in each frame using 16 semantic classes covering structural elements, furniture, room equipment, vegetation, and other indoor objects. Semantic-ITC preserves the sparse, non-uniform, and frame-wise sampling pattern of indoor MLS, making it distinct from scene-level reconstructed point clouds and mesh-based indoor datasets. The annotations are produced by a hybrid workflow that combines predictions from a visual foundation model applied to synchronized RGB images, structural information from BIM, and manual refinement, with the final labels assigned to the original LiDAR frames. A single-frame benchmark is provided, and the best baseline reaches 79.27\% mIoU. Remaining errors are concentrated around object boundaries and ambiguous indoor classes, indicating the challenges of indoor MLS segmentation under sparse frame geometry and long-tailed class distributions. The dataset provides a public benchmark for evaluating semantic segmentation directly on measured indoor MLS frames and supports future studies on frame-wise indoor MLS semantic segmentation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了首个公开的室内移动激光扫描逐帧语义分割数据集与基准 Semantic-ITC，包含 52 个序列、79,108 帧、12.3 亿标注点，最优基线达 79.27% mIoU。
AI.motivation: 现有语义分割基准主要面向重建的室内场景或室外 LiDAR 感知，缺乏针对室内 MLS 逐帧的语义标签，难以直接评估在稀疏、非均匀、逐帧采样几何下的分割性能。
AI.method: 构建 Semantic-ITC 数据集：采集课堂、走廊、会议室、办公室与学习区共 52 个室内序列的 MLS 帧；标注直接附着于每帧实测 LiDAR 点，覆盖结构、家具、房间设备、植被等 16 类；采用视觉基础模型（作用于同步 RGB 图像）预测、BIM 结构信息与人工精修相结合的混合标注流程，并将最终标签映射回原始 LiDAR 帧；提供单帧分割基准。
AI.result: 最优基线达到 79.27% mIoU；残余误差主要集中在物体边界和易混淆的室内类别，反映了稀疏帧几何与长尾类别分布带来的挑战。
AI.conclusion: Semantic-ITC 为直接在实测室内 MLS 帧上进行语义分割评估提供了公开基准，并支持后续逐帧室内 MLS 语义分割研究。

title: Size Matters: Foundation Model for Czech HTML documents
summary: Creating universal, high-quality representations of web documents in high-traffic industrial environments requires models that are both performant and economic. Existing approaches, however, often depend on large models, overlook the structural information inherent in HTML, or are constrained by short context windows, limiting their ability to process real-world web pages. We present HTML-LM, a compact foundation model with 154 million parameters that addresses these limitations through HTML-aware training and a ModernBERT-based architecture. It was trained on 100 million web documents using multiple objectives, including masked language modeling, bag-of-words prediction, and contrastive distillation from large language models. Consequently, HTML-LM sets a new state-of-the-art for classification and regression applications in the Czech Internet domain, surpassing both larger encoders and small-sized LLMs. The model is deployed in production, processing thousands of web documents per second, and released to the community under the CC BY-NC 4.0. https://huggingface.co/Seznam/html-lm.

AI.tldr: HTML-LM：面向工业级网页文档的紧凑型HTML感知基础模型，154M参数，在捷克互联网域分类与回归任务上达到SOTA，已投入生产并开源。
AI.motivation: 工业高流量环境下，网页文档通用高质量表示需兼顾性能与经济性；现有方法依赖大模型、忽视HTML结构信息，或受限于短上下文窗口，难以处理真实网页。
AI.method: 提出HTML-LM，基于ModernBERT架构的154M参数紧凑基础模型，采用HTML感知训练；在1亿网页文档上以多目标训练，包括掩码语言建模（MLM）、词袋预测（bag-of-words prediction）以及来自大语言模型的对比蒸馏（contrastive distillation）。
AI.result: 在捷克互联网域的分类与回归任务上刷新SOTA，超越更大规模的编码器及小型LLM；模型已部署生产环境，每秒处理数千网页文档。
AI.conclusion: HTML-LM以紧凑参数规模实现高效、高质量的网页表示，验证了HTML感知与多目标蒸馏的有效性，并以CC BY-NC 4.0协议向社区开放（https://huggingface.co/Seznam/html-lm）。

title: DiT-Garment: Garment Dynamics with Diffusion Transformers
summary: We present DiT-Garment to model dynamic 3D clothing over human body models in arbitrary motion. Unlike existing methods, DiT-Garment can animate garments with unseen designs and physical materials, while allowing for direct inference of deformations for any target pose. To achieve this, we leverage a 2D diffusion transformer architecture to learn 3D deformations in a 2D UV-space. As the result is non-deterministic, our generative model learns the distribution of possible outcomes. The template garment is represented as a 3D triangle mesh spatially aligned with a 3D human body model in a standardized pose. To work with different garment designs without the need of a common template or complex graph convolution operations, the diffusion transformer is conditioned on a 3D position map of the template, represented in UV-space, which allows to implicitly learn a deformation of the 3D space around the body in standard pose. Further conditioning on body motion and physical parameters allows to physically ground the model. We quantitatively and qualitatively evaluate DiT-Garment on both synthetic and real data. While only trained on synthetic simulations of automatically generated cloth designs, our method generalizes to captured and artist-made garment designs. Code and data are available for research purposes at https://dumoulina.github.io/dit-garment/.

AI.tldr: DiT-Garment 提出一种基于 2D 扩散 Transformer 的生成模型，在 UV 空间学习任意运动下人体模型的动态 3D 服装形变，可处理未见过的服装设计与物理材质并直接推断任意目标姿态的形变。
AI.motivation: 现有方法难以对不同设计的服装与物理材质进行动态建模，通常依赖共同模板或复杂的图卷积操作，且难以直接对任意目标姿态推断形变。论文旨在解决跨设计、跨材质的 3D 服装动态动画与泛化问题。
AI.method: 利用 2D 扩散 Transformer 架构在 2D UV 空间学习 3D 形变；将模板服装表示为与标准姿态人体模型空间对齐的 3D 三角网格；以模板在 UV 空间中的 3D 位置图作为条件，隐式学习标准姿态下身体周围 3D 空间的形变，避免依赖共同模板与复杂图卷积；进一步以身体运动和物理参数为条件，使模型具备物理基础。
AI.result: 在合成数据与真实数据上进行了定量和定性评估。仅使用自动生成服装设计的合成仿真训练，模型即可泛化到真实扫描与艺术家制作的服装设计。
AI.conclusion: DiT-Garment 通过 UV 空间的扩散 Transformer 建模，实现了对未见设计、物理材质及任意目标姿态的动态 3D 服装建模，具有较强的泛化能力，代码与数据已公开。

title: Learning from Distributed Eyes: Leveraging Collaborative Perception for Automated Model Adaptation
summary: In autonomous driving, perception models often struggle to generalize to new environments due to domain shifts. While unsupervised model adaptation offers a feasible solution without labor-intensive manual labeling, existing methods that rely solely on the ego-vehicle's data often lead to inferior pseudo-labeling performance. To address this critical issue, we propose LDE, Learning from Distributed ``Eyes", a novel framework that transforms collaborative perception (CP) into a source of high-quality supervision for model adaptation. This pseudo-labeling approach is hyperparameter-insensitive and relatively reliable, assuming CP often outperforms single-agent's perception. However, naively implementing this approach encounters (1) the communication bottleneck of sharing rich features under time and bandwidth constraints, (2) the view discrepancy between the CP view and the learner's Field of View (FoV), and (3) the unreliability even in CP-generated labels. To address these issues, we design an adaptation-oriented feature sharing mechanism that selectively transmits the most critical information for adaptation, an FoV filtering method that meticulously eliminates mismatched labels, and a curriculum learning strategy to progressively exploit pseudo labels. Extensive experiments on 3D object detection tasks demonstrate that LDE consistently outperforms both the pre-trained models and state-of-the-art unsupervised adaptation methods.

AI.tldr: 提出LDE框架，将协同感知（CP）转化为高质量监督来源，用于自动驾驶感知模型的无监督域自适应，通过面向自适应的特征共享、FoV过滤和课程学习策略解决通信瓶颈、视角差异与标签不可靠问题，在3D目标检测任务上超越预训练模型与现有无监督自适应方法。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶感知模型在域偏移下泛化能力差，无监督自适应虽能免去人工标注，但仅依赖自车数据的伪标签质量低下。而协同感知通常优于单智能体感知，可提供更可靠的监督信号，因此作者希望把CP作为伪标签来源。直接实现该思路会面临三个挑战：时间与带宽约束下的特征共享通信瓶颈、CP视角与学习者FoV之间的视角差异、以及CP生成标签本身仍存在不可靠性。
AI.method: LDE（Learning from Distributed "Eyes"）框架将协同感知作为模型自适应的监督来源。具体设计三个组件：（1）面向自适应的特征共享机制，选择性传输对自适应最关键的信息以缓解通信瓶颈；（2）FoV过滤方法，细致剔除视角不匹配的伪标签以处理视角差异；（3）课程学习策略，渐进式地利用伪标签以应对标签不可靠问题。该伪标签方法对超参数不敏感且相对可靠。
AI.result: 在3D目标检测任务上的大量实验表明，LDE持续优于预训练模型以及当前最先进的无监督自适应方法。
AI.conclusion: LDE证明了协同感知可作为自动驾驶无监督域自适应的有效高质量监督来源，通过针对性的特征共享、FoV过滤与课程学习设计可克服CP伪标签的三重挑战，从而稳定提升跨域3D检测的性能。

title: Align, Integrate, and Fire: Efficient Token-Level Alignment for Zero-Shot SpeechLLMs
summary: While Large Language Models excel in natural language processing, efficiently extending their capabilities to spoken input remains a significant challenge. Existing methods for building SpeechLLMs often rely on computationally expensive full-model fine-tuning, or employ parameter-efficient projectors that suffer from inefficient token sequence lengths and costly full-model supervision. In this paper, we introduce Aligned Continuous Integrate-and-Fire, a highly efficient framework for zero-shot speech processing. Our method dynamically compresses continuous acoustic frames into the exact discrete token length of the target text utilizing explicit Dynamic Time Warping alignments. This allows our initial training stage to establish a robust acoustic-to-semantic bridge using lightweight distance metrics, entirely bypassing the computationally expensive LLM forward pass. For subsequent fine-tuning, we propose a memory-efficient knowledge distillation objective that targets a single LLM layer, performing competitively with full-model cross-entropy training at a fraction of the computational cost. Through extensive evaluations on Automatic Speech Recognition and Speech Translation, we demonstrate that our method achieves superior performance compared to prior parameter-efficient baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出Aligned Continuous Integrate-and-Fire框架，利用DTW对齐将连续声学帧压缩至目标文本token长度，通过轻量距离度量建立声学-语义桥接（免LLM前向），并采用单层知识蒸馏微调，以低计算成本在ASR和语音翻译上超越参数高效基线。
AI.motivation: 将大语言模型的能力高效扩展到语音输入存在挑战：现有SpeechLLM构建方法要么依赖计算昂贵的全模型微调，要么使用参数高效投影器，但后者存在token序列长度低效与全模型监督代价高的问题。
AI.method: 提出Aligned Continuous Integrate-and-Fire框架，面向零样本语音处理：1）利用显式动态时间规整（DTW）对齐，将连续声学帧动态压缩到与目标文本完全一致的离散token长度；2）初始训练阶段仅用轻量距离度量建立声学到语义的桥接，完全跳过昂贵的LLM前向传播；3）后续微调采用内存高效的知识蒸馏目标，仅针对单个LLM层进行监督。
AI.result: 在自动语音识别（ASR）和语音翻译任务上进行广泛评估，该方法相比此前的参数高效基线取得更优性能；单层知识蒸馏目标以远低于全模型交叉熵训练的计算成本达到具有竞争力的效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过DTW引导的长度压缩与单层知识蒸馏，可在无需全模型前向与全模型监督的条件下高效构建SpeechLLM，在零样本语音任务上兼顾性能与计算效率。

title: Machine Translation between English and Syriac (East Syriac Dialect) using Statistical Machine Learning
summary: UNESCO considers the Assyrian (Syriac) language an endangered language. Although Assyrians speak the language worldwide, the speaking population is uncertain (ranging from 500,000 to 1,500,000). Syriac is also one of the least studied languages in Natural Language Processing (NLP). Despite advances in Machine Translation (MT) over the past decade, the lack of publicly available corpora and the orthographic complexity of the Syriac script, specifically the Madnkhaya script, have left this language entirely ignored in the computational linguistics literature. This study develops the first phrase-based Statistical MT (SMT) model for English-to-Assyrian MT using the Moses framework. We created a dataset of 38,847 sentence pairs from the complete English and Syriac Bible, merging a pre-existing New Testament dataset with an Old Testament built from scratch through PDF extraction, using custom segmentation scripts and manual alignment review by three bilingual annotators. The Syriac side of the corpus undergoes diacritic removal and Byte-Pair Encoding tokenization to reduce orthographic sparsity before training. We trained and evaluated six models using different configurations and splitting-scheme ratios, language model order, distortion limits, and the inclusion of an Operation Sequence Model. The best-performing configuration achieves a word-level BLEU score of 23.54. Human evaluation by 11 native Assyrian speakers resulted in mean adequacy and fluency scores of 3.42 and 3.34 out of 5, respectively. These results are consistent with comparable low-resource SMT models trained on Biblical corpora for morphologically rich Semitic languages. The corpora, scripts, and trained model are publicly available, providing the research community with the first systematically curated English-Syriac dataset and a reproducible baseline for future MT and broader NLP work on this endangered language.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了首个英语-亚述语（叙利亚语）短语级统计机器翻译模型，基于Moses框架，利用自建38,847句对的圣经平行语料，最佳配置BLEU为23.54，人工评测充分性3.42、流畅性3.34，并公开语料与模型。
AI.motivation: 亚述语（叙利亚语）被UNESCO列为濒危语言，使用者数量估计在50万至150万之间，且在NLP领域研究极少。尽管机器翻译技术近十年取得进展，但该语言因缺乏公开语料以及Madnkhaya书写系统的正字法复杂性，在计算语言学文献中被完全忽视。作者希望填补这一空白，为这一濒危语言建立首个系统性英-叙平行语料与可复现的MT基线。
AI.method: 采用基于短语的统计机器翻译（SMT）方法，使用Moses框架构建英语到亚述语的翻译模型。数据集共38,847句对，由已有的新约语料与从零构建的旧约语料合并而成；旧约语料通过PDF抽取、自定义分词脚本以及三名双语标注者的人工对齐审核获得。叙利亚语侧经过变音符号去除与Byte-Pair Encoding（BPE）分词以缓解正字法稀疏性。共训练并评估了六个模型，比较了不同配置与切分比例、语言模型阶数、扭曲限制以及是否引入操作序列模型（Operation Sequence Model）。
AI.result: 最佳配置达到词级BLEU分数23.54。由11名亚述语母语者进行的人工评测显示，平均充分性得分为3.42、流畅性得分为3.34（满分5分）。这些结果与针对形态丰富的闪米特语、基于圣经语料训练的低资源SMT模型表现相当。
AI.conclusion: 该研究公开了语料、脚本和训练模型，为研究社区提供了首个系统性整理的英语-叙利亚语数据集，以及面向这一濒危语言的未来机器翻译与更广泛NLP研究的可复现基线。

title: A Probe Shift Is Not a Fairness Fix: The Limits of Representation Steering in Speech Models
summary: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems exhibit unequal error rates across speaker groups, motivating interventions on their internal representations. We ask whether speaker-linked attributes that are linearly readable from pretrained ASR encoders yield useful directions for reducing group word-error-rate (WER) gaps. Across Whisper-medium, HuBERT-large, and Wav2Vec2-large on Common Voice and the Speech Accent Archive, we probe every encoder layer for metadata-derived sex/gender, age, and native/accent labels; construct centroid and probe-derived directions; inject them at selected layers; and compare downstream probe trajectories with matched WER changes. Sex labels are highly decodable (best macro-F1 0.924--0.941), native/accent labels are also above chance (0.544--0.696), and age is weaker (0.354--0.397). Of 22 post-selected reruns, nine have 95% paired-bootstrap intervals entirely below zero, yet every absolute source-group WER reduction is below 0.7 percentage points. Conversely, a local target-class probe rate can rise from 8.09% to 99.87% while WER worsens. Linear readability is therefore neither evidence of causal use nor a reliable mitigation method. Our results motivate evaluating speech-bias interventions jointly at representation, propagation, and task levels.

AI.tldr: 预训练ASR编码器中线性可读的说话人属性方向并不能可靠地用于缩小组间WER差距。
AI.motivation: ASR系统在不同说话人群体上错误率不均等，常通过干预内部表征来缓解，但"线性可读性"是否意味着该属性被因果使用、以及能否据此有效减偏，尚不明确。
AI.method: 在Whisper-medium、HuBERT-large、Wav2Vec2-large上，基于Common Voice与Speech Accent Archive，对编码器每一层探测由元数据派生的性别、年龄、母语/口音标签；构建质心方向与探针派生方向，注入选定层，并比较下游探针轨迹与匹配的WER变化。
AI.result: 性别标签高度可解码（最佳macro-F1 0.924–0.941），母语/口音高于随机（0.544–0.696），年龄较弱（0.354–0.397）。22次事后筛选重跑中9次的95%配对bootstrap区间完全低于零，但所有源组WER绝对降幅均小于0.7个百分点；反之，局部目标类探针率可从8.09%升至99.87%而WER反而变差。
AI.conclusion: 线性可读性既非因果使用的证据，也不是可靠的减偏手段；应在表征、传播与任务三个层面联合评估语音偏见干预。

title: SVMemAgent: A Streaming Video Memory Agent for Query-Agnostic Online Frame Selection
summary: Most keyframe selection studies focus on offline settings, assuming access to the full video and query in advance. In contrast, real-world streaming scenarios require online frame selection under unknown video duration, without access to either the query or future frames during selection. To address this, we introduce Streaming Video Memory (SVMem), a compact and representative memory of previously observed content, updated continuously as the video stream unfolds. Building on this setting, we propose the Streaming Video Memory Agent (SVMemAgent), which dynamically maintains a memory by deciding at each timestep whether to replace an existing memory frame with the incoming frame or discard it. SVMemAgent is trained using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with task-driven rewards derived from diverse question-answer pairs, implicitly exposing the policy to a distribution of queries during training so that SVMem retains generally informative frames at inference, when queries are unavailable. Experiments on both online and offline video benchmarks show that SVMemAgent consistently outperforms online frame selection baselines and achieves competitive performance with offline methods that assume access to the full video and query. Through task-driven rewards, SVMemAgent learns an emergent keyframe selection policy that prefers frames containing textual information, which may benefit downstream VideoQA tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出流式视频记忆(SVMem)与智能体SVMemAgent，在未知时长、无查询和未来帧的条件下在线选帧，用GRPO训练，性能优于在线基线并接近离线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有键帧选择研究多为离线设定，默认可预先获得完整视频与查询；而真实流式场景需在未知视频时长、且帧选择时无法获取查询和未来帧的情况下进行在线选帧，这一差距亟需解决。
AI.method: 提出Streaming Video Memory (SVMem)，作为对已观测内容的紧凑且具代表性的记忆，随视频流持续更新；在其上构建SVMemAgent，在每个时间步决定用新到帧替换现有记忆帧还是丢弃。智能体使用Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)训练，奖励来自多样问答对的任务驱动信号，从而在训练中隐式暴露于查询分布，使推理时（无查询）仍保留通用信息性帧。
AI.result: 在在线与离线视频基准上，SVMemAgent持续优于在线帧选择基线，并与假设可访问完整视频和查询的离线方法性能相当。任务驱动奖励使其学习到涌现式键帧选择策略，偏好包含文本信息的帧，可能有益于下游VideoQA任务。
AI.conclusion: 通过任务驱动强化学习，SVMemAgent在严格在线约束下实现接近离线的选帧效果，并自发形成对下游任务有利的选帧偏好；SVMem为流式视频理解提供了紧凑且具代表性的记忆框架。

title: Accuracy- and Real-Time-Aware 4D Radar Preprocessing for Autonomous Driving Perception Systems
comment: 7 pages, 7 figures, Transactions of the Korean Society of Automotive Engineers
summary: 4D radar has emerged as a promising next-generation sensor for improving the robustness of autonomous driving perception systems because of its stable sensing capability under adverse weather conditions. However, deploying 4D radar in embedded environments with limited hardware resources requires radar-representation preprocessing that jointly considers perception accuracy, real-time performance, and computational complexity. This paper proposes a preprocessing framework for 4D-radar-based 3D object detection. First, Percentile-based 3D Shape Preservation (P3DP) extracts point clouds from radar tensors while preserving object-shape information and suppressing noise and false alarms. Second, Multi-frame-based Noise Point Discrimination using Kernel Density Estimation (MF-KDE) improves the density and reliability of sparse radar point clouds. Finally, Embedded \& NetScore (ENS) evaluates suitability for embedded deployment by jointly considering accuracy, real-time performance, adverse-weather robustness, and model complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套面向4D雷达3D目标检测的预处理框架，包含P3DP点云提取、MF-KDE噪声点判别与ENS嵌入式部署评估三部分，兼顾精度、实时性与复杂度。
AI.motivation: 4D雷达在恶劣天气下具有稳定感知能力，是提升自动驾驶感知鲁棒性的下一代传感器。但在硬件资源受限的嵌入式环境中部署时，需要一种同时考虑感知精度、实时性能与计算复杂度的雷达表征预处理方法。
AI.method: 提出三模块预处理框架：（1）Percentile-based 3D Shape Preservation（P3DP），从雷达张量中提取点云，在保留目标形状信息的同时抑制噪声与虚警；（2）Multi-frame-based Noise Point Discrimination using Kernel Density Estimation（MF-KDE），利用核密度估计提升稀疏雷达点云的密度与可靠性；（3）Embedded & NetScore（ENS），综合精度、实时性、恶劣天气鲁棒性与模型复杂度评估嵌入式部署适用性。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果，仅说明该框架通过P3DP、MF-KDE与ENS分别实现形状保持的点云提取、稀疏点云密度与可靠性提升，以及嵌入式部署适用性的多维度评估。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为4D雷达在嵌入式平台上的3D目标检测提供了一套兼顾精度、实时性、鲁棒性与复杂度的预处理与评估方案。

title: STUNet-Fusion: Spatiotemporal Needle-Tip Localization in Ultrasound Video via Multi-Channel Motion Fusion
summary: Needle-tip localization in ultrasound remains challenging because the needle may appear weak, discontinuous, or partially invisible, while imaging artifacts and anatomical structures can produce similar responses. To address this problem, we propose STUNet-Fusion, a spatiotemporal framework for needle-tip localization in ultrasound videos. The proposed method formulates the input as a tri-channel spatio-temporal fusion tensor, comprising grayscale appearance, grid-based motion feature, and raw frame difference. A shared ResNet-34 encoder extracts spatial features, ConvLSTM integrates temporal dependencies, and a U-Net decoder reconstructs a dense probability heatmap. The final coordinates are extracted via a soft-argmax operation to achieve sub-pixel localization accuracy. Experimental results demonstrate that this spatiotemporal fusion strategy significantly improves localization robustness compared to conventional baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出STUNet-Fusion时空框架，用于超声视频中的针尖定位：将输入构造成三通道时空融合张量，结合共享ResNet-34编码器、ConvLSTM时序建模与U-Net解码器生成概率热图，并通过soft-argmax获得亚像素坐标。实验表明该融合策略显著提升定位鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 超声图像中针尖定位面临诸多挑战：针体可能出现信号微弱、不连续或部分不可见，同时成像伪影和解剖结构会产生与针尖相似的响应，易造成误定位。传统基于单帧的方法难以稳定区分针尖与干扰结构，因此需要引入时空信息以提升定位的鲁棒性与准确性。
AI.method: 将输入表示为三通道时空融合张量，分别包含灰度外观、基于网格的运动特征和原始帧差；采用共享权重的ResNet-34编码器提取空间特征；使用ConvLSTM整合时序依赖关系；利用U-Net解码器重建稠密概率热图；最后通过soft-argmax操作从热图中提取坐标，实现亚像素级定位精度。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所提出的时空融合策略相较于常规基线方法显著提高了针尖定位的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: STUNet-Fusion通过显式的时空融合张量、ResNet-34编码、ConvLSTM时序建模、U-Net热图重建及soft-argmax亚像素取点，有效缓解了超声中针尖信号弱与伪影干扰等问题，验证了时空融合在针尖定位任务中的有效性与优越性。

title: HAP: A Hand-Driven Active Perception Framework for Egocentric Head Motion Prediction
summary: Egocentric motion forecasting has primarily focused on hands and manipulated objects, leaving future human head motion comparatively underexplored. During manipulation, the head both redirects perception toward the target to acquire task-relevant evidence and coordinates with body and hand motion. We therefore formulate future six Degree of Freedom (6-DoF) head-motion prediction conditioned on observed hand motion and inferred target context, and propose HAP, a Hand-Driven Active Perception framework. HAP infers confidence for each target object from observed hand motion and object geometry. Then constructs a dynamic Predictive Target-Centric Amodal Occlusion Graph (P-TAOG) representing current and potential occlusion among candidate objects. Directed graph and causal temporal reasoning encode the evolving target conditioned perceptual state, which is fused with hand and head motion history. A horizon-wise gate then blends the learned trajectory with a constant velocity prior. We further introduce Bottle, an egocentric RGB-D dataset of object manipulation toward specified targets, with coordinated head and hand motion under changing target visibility. Experiments on the public dataset and Bottle show that HAP achieves lower head motion prediction errors than representative baselines, supporting the value of hand driven intention and dynamic occlusion reasoning for anticipating human head motion. Code will be released at https://HAP-ego.github.io/HAP.

AI.tldr: 提出HAP框架，以手部运动和目标上下文为条件预测6-DoF头部运动，并构建P-TAOG图与Bottle数据集，实现更低预测误差。
AI.motivation: 第一人称运动预测主要关注手和被操作物体，未来头部运动研究相对不足。而在操作过程中，头部既将感知重定向至目标以获取任务相关证据，又与身体和手部运动协调，因此头部运动预测具有重要价值。
AI.method: 提出HAP（手驱动的主动感知）框架：从观测手部运动和物体几何推断各目标物体的置信度；构建动态的预测性目标中心非模态遮挡图（P-TAOG）表示候选物体当前与潜在的遮挡关系；用有向图和因果时序推理编码不断演变的目标条件感知状态，并与手部和头部运动历史融合；最后通过逐时间跨度门控将学习到的轨迹与匀速先验融合。同时发布Bottle数据集，为第一人称RGB-D物体操作数据集，目标指定且目标可见性变化下有协调的头手运动。
AI.result: 在公开数据集和Bottle上的实验表明，HAP的头部运动预测误差低于代表性基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持手部驱动意图与动态遮挡推理在预测人类头部运动中的价值。代码将发布于 https://HAP-ego.github.io/HAP。

title: CARA: Collision-Aware Resolution Adaptation for Multiresolution Hash Encoding Based Image Fitting
summary: Multiresolution hash encodings have recently enabled fast and high-fidelity implicit neural representations by storing multi-scale features in fixed-size hash tables along a geometric resolution schedule. However, the standard design is data-agnostic: different resolution levels receive identical hash-table capacity despite large differences in image frequency content. As a result, some levels experience severe hash collisions while others underutilize parameters, leading to inefficient capacity allocation. To address this issue, we propose Collision-Aware Resolution Adaptation (CARA), a method that assigns per-level resolutions by balancing the effective information load across hash levels. This adaptive allocation reduces capacity bottlenecks and improves parameter efficiency. In addition, we introduce an invertible pixel-shuffle transform that reduces hash load factors by redistributing spatial information, thereby mitigating collision-induced information loss without enlarging the hash tables. To support evaluation on extremely high-resolution data, we also curate, to the best of our knowledge, the first uncompressed whole-slide image dataset for academic research. Experiments on Kodak images, gigapixel natural images, and raw whole-slide images demonstrate that CARA consistently improves the fidelity-parameter trade-off. Our method matches state-of-the-art performance while using only $27.76%$ of the parameters, and achieves up to $6.11$ dB PSNR improvement at comparable parameter counts. Code is provided in the supplementary.

AI.tldr: 提出CARA，按哈希层级自适应分配分辨率并引入可逆像素重排变换，缓解哈希碰撞与容量分配不均，在多个数据集上以极少参数达到或超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 标准多分辨率哈希编码采用数据无关的几何分辨率安排，各层级哈希表容量相同，但图像不同尺度的频率内容差异显著，导致部分层级严重碰撞、部分层级参数冗余，容量分配低效。
AI.method: 1) CARA：依据各哈希层级的有效信息负载，为其自适应分配分辨率，平衡层间负载以缓解容量瓶颈；2) 可逆像素重排（invertible pixel-shuffle）变换：通过重分布空间信息降低哈希负载因子，在不扩大哈希表的前提下减少碰撞造成的信息损失；3) 构建首个未压缩全切片图像（WSI）数据集用于极高分评估。
AI.result: 在Kodak图像、十亿像素自然图像及原始全切片图像上，CARA持续改善保真度-参数权衡：仅用27.76%参数即匹配SOTA性能；在参数量相当情况下PSNR最高提升6.11 dB。
AI.conclusion: 数据无关的均匀哈希容量分配并非最优，按信息负载自适应调整分辨率并结合可逆空间重排，可显著提升隐式神经表示的参数效率与重建保真度。

title: Sim-to-Real Traffic Scene Understanding by Decoupling Semantics from Caption Generation with V-JEPA
comment: Winner of Track 2 at the AI City Challenge 2026, with the paper published at the ECCV conference 2026 (ECCV-W)
summary: Track 2 of the AI City Challenge 2026 requires both visual question answering (VQA) and traffic event description generation under a challenging synthetic-to real domain shift. Existing vision-language approaches often entangle semantic understanding with language generation, making them susceptible to hallucination and inconsistent reasoning across event phases. In this work, we propose a decoupled semantic understanding framework that first resolves predefined traffic questions into structured semantic facts and subsequently uses these facts to guide caption generation. A frozen V-JEPA encoder extracts predictive scene representations, while a lightweight Llama-based predictor produces answers for VQA queries. To improve reliability, we introduce a training-free structured refinement mechanism that exploits statistical priors, inter-question relationships, and temporal event consistency to correct prediction errors. The refined semantic facts are then provided to Qwen3-VL-8B to generate pedestrian and vehicle descriptions for each traffic event. Experimental results on the official 2026 AI City Challenge Track 2 benchmark show that the proposed method achieves 87.09% VQA accuracy and an overall S2 score of 60.0853, ranking first among all participating teams. These results demonstrate that predictive world representations combined with structured semantic refinement enable more accurate and reliable traffic understanding, leading to higher-quality lan guage generation.

AI.tldr: 提出解耦的语义理解框架，先经VQA解析结构化语义事实，再引导交通事件描述生成，在2026 AI City Challenge Track 2排名第一（VQA准确率87.09%，S2得分60.0853）。
AI.motivation: 该赛道需在合成到真实的域迁移下同时完成视觉问答与交通事件描述生成；现有视觉-语言方法将语义理解与语言生成耦合，易产生幻觉且跨事件阶段的推理不一致。
AI.method: 解耦框架：冻结的V-JEPA编码器提取预测性场景表征，轻量Llama预测器回答预设交通问题得到结构化语义事实；引入免训练结构精炼机制，利用统计先验、问题间关系与时间事件一致性纠正错误；精炼后的事实交给Qwen3-VL-8B生成行人与车辆描述。
AI.result: 在2026 AI City Challenge Track 2官方基准上VQA准确率87.09%，总S2得分60.0853，位列所有参赛队伍第一。
AI.conclusion: 预测性世界表征结合结构化语义精炼可实现更准确可靠的交通理解，进而提升语言生成质量。

title: Variational Quantum Transformer Architecture for Synthetic Language Generation
comment: Accepted for publication in the QNLPAI 2026 proceedings (Springer Lecture Notes in Computer Science, LNCS). 10 pages, including references and appendix, 2 figures
summary: We propose a compact NISQ-compatible quantum transformer architecture for synthetic QNLP sequence modelling. The model preserves the autoregressive next-token interface of a classical transformer, but replaces attention and feed-forward sublayers with variational quantum encoder blocks, connector circuits, decoder blocks and a direct two-qubit measurement readout. Token contexts are angle-encoded into small quantum registers, processed by parallel variational heads and encoder integration circuits and conditioned through decoder ancillae to produce a distribution over a four-token vocabulary. We evaluate several architecture variants on deterministic and lexicographic grammar-generation tasks against a compact classical transformer baseline. The quantum models are trainable end-to-end and learn nontrivial grammar structure, including perfect deterministic generation in individual runs and high lexicographic validity in the strongest variant. The classical baseline remains more accurate and stable and the quantum models are sensitive to initialization. The contribution is therefore not a claim of quantum advantage, but a concrete architecture and evaluation of transformer-inspired QNLP sequence modelling under near-term quantum constraints.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种紧凑、兼容NISQ的量子Transformer架构，用于合成QNLP序列建模：保留经典Transformer的自回归下一词元接口，但用变分量子编码块、连接电路、解码块及双量子比特直接测量读出替代注意力与前馈子层。
AI.motivation: 在近期量子硬件约束下，探索如何将Transformer式序列建模范式迁移到量子自然语言处理（QNLP）任务中，并给出具体可训练架构与评估，而非宣称量子优势。
AI.method: 将词元上下文角度编码到小规模量子寄存器，经并行变分头与编码器整合电路处理，并通过解码辅助量子比特条件化，输出四词元词表上的分布；在确定性与字典序语法生成任务上，将多个架构变体与紧凑经典Transformer基线对比，端到端训练。
AI.result: 量子模型可端到端训练并学到非平凡语法结构：个别运行实现完美确定性生成，最强变体在字典序任务上具有高有效率；经典基线在准确性与稳定性上更优，量子模型对初始化敏感。
AI.conclusion: 贡献不在于量子优势，而在于提出一种面向近期量子约束的Transformer启发式QNLP序列建模架构与评估，为该方向提供可复现的基线与经验证据。

title: Perceptual Refinement of an End-to-End Video Streaming Pipeline via Generative AI Layers
comment: 28 pages. Submitted to ACM Transactions on Multimedia Computing, Communications and Applications (TOMM), special issue on MMSys and co-located workshops. Extended version of the NOSSDAV 2025 paper ELVIS (arXiv:2512.14185). Code: https://github.com/emanuele-artioli/presley
summary: Traditional codecs treat every region of a frame alike; a generative layer can instead degrade the regions a viewer attends to least and reconstruct them at the client. We present PRESLEY, which extends the prior conference work ELVIS by replacing destructive block removal with adaptive in-place degradation under a removability mask, signaling per-block strength in a bit-packed side channel, and restoring via generative backbones conditioned on transmitted visual priors rather than unconditioned in-painting. We separate the problem into three goals: choosing which blocks to degrade, degrading them so the encoder spends fewer bits, and restoring them. Against its predecessor at matched rate, PRESLEY achieves a decisive mean -56.4% BD-rate reduction on delivered background quality across 13 rate ladders spanning multiple codecs and dataset families. Against pristine baselines, PRESLEY defines the operating regime of generative transport: delivering substantial bitrate savings (up to -29.4% BD-rate) and superior background quality (17/23 sequences) in the target bit-starved regime, while maintaining foreground fidelity bit-exact. We further map where the theoretical headroom in this class of architecture lies. Using an exact leave-one-superblock-out combinatorial oracle as an additive empirical bound, we show that existing complexity heuristics already capture 83.3% of bit-cost savings, bounding remaining cost-axis headroom at about 5% of total bitrate. We then identify and model the primary unaddressed axis -- post-restoration damage -- which disperses widely (4.9-8.4 dB). We prove that this damage is predictable before transmission (held-out rho = +0.400), establishing the feasibility of transmit-time restorability modeling and defining the roadmap for joint rate-distortion-restoration selection rules.

AI.tldr: PRESLEY 用自适应原位退化替代 ELVIS 的破坏性块移除，在可移除掩码下压缩码率，并用生成式骨干恢复，背景质量较前作平均降低 56.4% BD-rate。
AI.motivation: 传统编解码器对帧内各区域一视同仁，而生成式层可对观众关注度最低的区域进行退化并在客户端重建，从而节省码率。作者希望改进前作 ELVIS 的破坏性块移除方式，探索生成式传输的可行性与理论上限。
AI.method: 将问题分解为三个目标：选择需退化的块、退化以降低编码比特、以及恢复。用自适应原位退化在 removability mask 下取代破坏性移除；通过 bit-packed 边信道传递每块强度；用条件于传输视觉先验的生成式骨干恢复，而非无条件 in-painting。
AI.result: 与前作在匹配码率下，跨 13 条码率阶梯、多编解码器与数据集，背景质量平均 BD-rate 降低 56.4%。与原始基线相比，在比特匮乏场景下达到最多 -29.4% BD-rate 且背景质量更优（17/23 序列），前景保真度保持比特精确。用 leave-one-superblock-out 组合 oracle 作为加性经验上界，显示现有复杂度启发式已捕获 83.3% 的比特成本节省，剩余成本轴空间约占总码率 5%。识别并建模主要未解决轴——恢复后损伤，其分布较广（4.9–8.4 dB），并证明该损伤在传输前可预测（held-out rho = +0.400）。
AI.conclusion: PRESLEY 界定了生成式传输的工作区间，证明了传输时可恢复性建模的可行性，并为联合率-失真-恢复选择规则给出了路线图。

title: Learning Where to Focus: Self-Supervised Multi-Scale ViTs for Histopathology
comment: 13 pages, 5 figures, plus supplementary material. Accepted at DAGM GCPR 2026
summary: Pathologists diagnose diseases by first locating suspicious tissue and then examining it at higher magnification, whereas self-supervised vision transformers (ViTs) allocate the same spatial resolution to every image region despite diagnostic evidence being sparse and spanning multiple biological scales. Recent pathology foundation models have substantially improved representation quality by scaling training data and model capacity, but largely retain uniform tokenization.
