We instead investigate whether pathology representations can be improved by learning where to allocate spatial resolution during self-supervised learning. To this end, we propose CRAFT (Coarse-to-fine Region-Adaptive Feature Tokenization), a DINO-based framework that learns image-dependent mixed-scale representations by using self-supervised attention to selectively refine informative regions while preserving coarse context, together with a symmetric cross-scale regularization objective that encourages complementary coarse and fine representations. Across CAMELYON16, TCGA-Lung subtype classification, and TCGA-LUAD survival prediction, CRAFT consistently outperforms comparable-scale self-supervised methods while requiring lower inference computation. Despite using only a compact 22M parameter backbone trained on comparatively small pathology datasets, CRAFT remains competitive with, and often surpasses, substantially larger pathology foundation models.

AI.tldr: CRAFT 提出一种基于 DINO 的粗到细区域自适应特征 token 化框架，利用自监督注意力动态分配空间分辨率，在病理图像上以更小模型和更低计算量超越同规模自监督方法，并可媲美更大基础模型。
AI.motivation: 病理诊断流程是先定位可疑组织再高倍镜观察，诊断证据稀疏且跨多个生物尺度；而现有自监督 ViT 对所有图像区域统一分配空间分辨率（uniform tokenization），即便病理基础模型通过扩大数据与容量提升表征质量，仍保留均匀 token 化，未针对诊断证据的稀疏多尺度特性优化空间分辨率分配。
AI.method: 提出 CRAFT（Coarse-to-fine Region-Adaptive Feature Tokenization），一个基于 DINO 的框架：利用自监督注意力选择性细化信息量高的区域，同时保留粗粒度上下文，从而学习图像相关的混合尺度表征；并引入对称跨尺度正则化目标，鼓励粗、细表征互补。
AI.result: 在 CAMELYON16、TCGA-Lung 亚型分类、TCGA-LUAD 生存预测三个任务上，CRAFT 一致优于同规模自监督方法，且推理计算量更低；仅用 22M 参数紧凑骨干并在相对较小的病理数据集上训练，仍可媲美并常超越显著更大的病理基础模型。
AI.conclusion: 学习“在何处分配空间分辨率”可有效提升病理自监督表征，混合尺度自适应 token 化兼具体验性能与计算效率优势。

title: On-the-Fly Homographies Calibration for Multi-Camera Tracking
summary: Precise multi-camera tracking traditionally relies on rigorous 3D site calibration, yet this requirement is often operationally impossible in large-scale deployments. Privacy regulations frequently prohibit recording video for offline calibration; limited bandwidth precludes synchronizing high-resolution streams from hundreds of cameras; and covering immense physical sites with calibration targets is logistically infeasible. We present a multi-camera homography calibration system designed to overcome these barriers through "on-the-fly" geometric refinement. Starting from coarse manual homographies, we introduce a centroid-based projection optimization (PO) that continuously aligns the ground-plane geometry using live detection streams. Because PO operates asynchronously on already-transmitted, lightweight metadata, it adds zero computational latency to the real-time tracker. This allows the system to adapt automatically to camera movements or environmental changes without human intervention. This optimized geometry feeds a multi-camera bird's-eye-view (BEV) tracker that fuses detections and unifies trajectories across zones. Crucially, by operating strictly on live anonymous metadata, our solution ensures a privacy-safe, zero-overhead, and resilient tracking pipeline that maintains global consistency in dynamic environments where static, recorded-video calibration is impossible.

AI.tldr: 提出一种"即时"多相机单应性标定系统：以粗标定为起点，用基于质心的投影优化（PO）借助实时检测流持续校正地平面几何，并馈入多相机鸟瞰图（BEV）跟踪器统一跨区轨迹，实现隐私安全、零额外开销且可自动适应相机移动的鲁棒跟踪。
AI.motivation: 精确多相机跟踪通常依赖严格的3D现场标定，但大规模部署中该要求往往在操作上不可行：隐私法规常禁止录制视频以进行离线标定；带宽受限难以同步数百路高分辨率视频流；用标定物覆盖巨大物理场地在后勤上也不现实。
AI.method: 从人工粗单应矩阵出发，引入基于质心的投影优化（PO），利用实时检测流持续对齐地平面几何；PO以异步方式仅作用于已传输的轻量级元数据。该优化后的几何被输入多相机BEV跟踪器，用于融合检测结果并统一跨区域轨迹。
AI.result: PO不增加实时跟踪器的计算时延，使系统无需人工干预即可自动适应相机移动或环境变化；整体流程仅依赖实时匿名元数据，保持动态环境下的全局一致性。
AI.conclusion: 该方案在无法进行静态录像标定的场景下，提供了隐私安全、零开销且具备弹性的多相机跟踪流水线。

title: 4D Radar Perception Algorithms for Autonomous Driving: A Review
comment: 12 pages, 9 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to IEEE Sensors Journal
summary: Research on 4D millimeter-wave radar perception algorithms has flourished in recent years, extending from signal processing and object detection to semantic segmentation, motion estimation, occupancy prediction, and dynamic scene reconstruction. This review organizes the field according to the evolution of perception tasks and algorithms. It first introduces radar fundamentals, data representations, and quality-enhancement methods, and then reviews object-level perception, motion and localization, local and dense spatial perception, and dynamic scene understanding. Across these directions, we compare radar-only learning, multimodal fusion, and cross-modal supervision and knowledge distillation. Particular attention is paid to how elevation, Doppler measurements, and radar physical priors are exploited across tasks. We further summarize the task coverage, input data, annotations, and evaluation protocols of existing datasets, clarifying the empirical support for different research directions. Finally, we discuss the common challenges and future directions of 4D radar perception for autonomous driving. This review provides a task-oriented perspective on the transition from sparse object perception to dynamic spatial understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇4D毫米波雷达感知算法综述，按感知任务与算法演进组织，覆盖雷达基础、数据表示、质量增强，以及目标级感知、运动与定位、局部与稠密空间感知、动态场景理解，并比较纯雷达学习、多模态融合与跨模态监督/知识蒸馏，重点关注高度、多普勒与雷达物理先验的利用，同时总结数据集与评测协议。
AI.motivation: 4D毫米波雷达感知算法近年快速发展，任务范围从信号处理和目标检测扩展到语义分割、运动估计、占据预测与动态场景重建，领域成果分散，缺乏按感知任务与算法演进串联的系统梳理；同时需要明确高度、多普勒测量和雷达物理先验在不同任务中的作用，以及现有数据集对各类研究方向的实证支撑情况。
AI.method: 采用任务导向的综述方法：先介绍雷达基本原理、数据表示与质量增强方法；再按目标级感知、运动与定位、局部与稠密空间感知、动态场景理解四类方向进行梳理；在各方向中对比纯雷达学习、多模态融合、跨模态监督与知识蒸馏三类范式；并归纳现有数据集的任务覆盖、输入数据、标注与评测协议。
AI.result: 系统整理了4D雷达感知从稀疏目标感知到动态空间理解的任务谱系与算法范式，明确了高度、多普勒测量及雷达物理先验在各类任务中的利用方式，并汇总了现有数据集在任务覆盖、输入模态、标注类型与评测协议方面的支持情况与不足。
AI.conclusion: 该综述以任务导向视角刻画了4D毫米波雷达感知由稀疏目标感知向动态空间理解的转变过程，并讨论了面向自动驾驶的共同挑战与未来方向。

title: PULSE: Unlocking Practical Image Compression on Single-Thread CPU
summary: Despite recent progress in learned image compression, existing methods remain computationally expensive on resource-constrained hardware, particularly CPUs. We introduce PULSE, a practical codec that enables (1) low-latency decoding on diverse hardware platforms with an ultra-low-complexity 5.2 kMAC/pixel neural receiver, and (2) efficient bit-exact entropy coding with an integer linear CDF predictor and a meta prior. To recover compression performance under this tight budget, we introduce an agentic evolution process guided by heuristic probes that iteratively improves the architecture through human-LLM collaboration. PULSE decodes a 1080p image in 126 ms on a single CPU thread while achieving compression performance comparable to HM. After perceptual optimization, PULSE competes with larger perceptual codecs like MS-ILLM. Codes are at https://github.com/microsoft/GenCodec/tree/main/PULSE

AI.tldr: PULSE：面向受限硬件的超低复杂度图像编解码器，仅5.2 kMAC/pixel，单CPU线程1080p解码126ms，压缩性能接近HM并可比MS-ILLM。
AI.motivation: 现有学习式图像压缩方法在资源受限硬件（尤其CPU）上计算开销过大，难以实用。作者希望在严格计算预算下同时实现低延迟解码与高效熵编码，并尽量保持压缩性能。
AI.method: 提出PULSE实用编解码器：采用超低复杂度5.2 kMAC/pixel神经接收器实现多平台低延迟解码；使用整数线性CDF预测器加meta先验实现比特精确的高效熵编码；并引入由启发式探针引导的agentic进化流程，通过人-LLM协作迭代优化网络架构以弥补压缩性能损失。
AI.result: 单CPU线程126ms解码1080p图像，压缩性能与HM相当；经感知优化后可与MS-ILLM等更大的感知编解码器竞争。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: PULSE证明在极低计算预算下，通过人-LLM协作的架构搜索与整数化熵编码设计，仍可达到传统与感知压缩的竞争力，为资源受限平台上的实用学习式图像压缩提供了可行路径。

title: PACT: Can Enterprise AI Assistants Be Trusted Under Pressure?
comment: 26 pages, 12 figures, 17 tables. Includes technical appendix; Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/trace-ai-labs/pact; Code: https://github.com/trace-ai-labs/pact
summary: As corporate AI adoption continues to grow, enterprise-grade LLM agents are being deployed into sensitive contexts such as hiring, healthcare, and finance. In these contexts, compliance with rules specified in an agent's system context is a first-order legal concern. Currently, no evaluation framework systematically measures which LLM models tend to violate compliance rules, especially under pressure from a persistent user, a hurried manager, or circumstances where violation is convenient or attractive. We introduce PACT (Pressure-Applied Compliance Testing), a benchmark for rule-following under pressure in AI agents assisting employees in daily tasks across twelve regulated enterprise domains and forty-eight scenarios, each set in a realistic multi-turn conversation. Each benchmark item pairs a standing rule against a rule-violating shortcut, and applies a battery of pressures across different wordings and system-prompt modes. We construct PACT component by component under strict LLM-as-judge auditing to ensure samples are unambiguous, ungameable, and realistic enough to avoid eliciting evaluation-aware behavior. We use PACT to profile LLM compliance across six complementary metrics that create a holistic picture of an AI assistant's robustness under pressure and throughout multi-turn conversations, its transparency, and ability to correctly discern where a rule applies. We aggregate this profile into PACTScore, a reliability-weighted compliance rate over all items and modes. Our results across 22 common LLM models spanning multiple providers and sizes show substantial variability in compliance across models and metric dimensions. Even the strongest assistants mis-apply a rule on 6 to 10% of items, and ordinary user pressure raises the violation rate by 65% on average. PACT highlights compliance risks in LLM assistants, motivating guardrails and careful model selection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PACT，一个面向企业级 LLM 智能体的“压力合规测试”基准，覆盖 12 个受监管领域、48 个场景，通过多轮对话与多种施压方式系统评估模型遵守系统规则的能力，并给出综合指标 PACTScore。
AI.motivation: 企业 AI 智能体已进入招聘、医疗、金融等敏感场景，遵守系统上下文中的规则属于首要法律关切。然而目前缺乏系统性评估框架，无法衡量哪些 LLM 模型在持续用户施压、上级催促或违规更具诱惑力的情况下更容易违反合规规则。
AI.method: 构建 PACT 基准：每个样本由一条常设规则与一条违规捷径配对，置于真实多轮对话中，并施加不同措辞与系统提示模式下的多种压力。样本按组件在严格的 LLM-as-judge 审计下逐步构建，确保无歧义、不可被投机利用且足够真实，避免诱发“评估感知”行为。评估使用 6 项互补指标，刻画压力下多轮对话中的鲁棒性、透明度及规则适用边界的辨别能力，并聚合为按可靠性加权的合规率 PACTScore。
AI.result: 在覆盖多个厂商与不同规模的 22 个常见 LLM 上，合规性在模型间和指标维度间差异显著。即便最强助手也会在 6%–10% 的样本上误用规则；普通用户压力平均使违规率上升 65%。
AI.conclusion: PACT 揭示了 LLM 助手在企业敏感场景中的合规风险，说明需要引入防护栏（guardrails）并谨慎选择模型，以降低规则违反带来的法律与业务风险。

title: Weakening Neurons: An Input-Output Functionality in Transformers with Outsize Influence
summary: We analyze the learned input-output behavior of GLU-based neurons in large language models (LLMs). We propose a simple analysis method: For each neuron, we compute the cosine similarities between its input (reading) and output (writing) weight vectors. In this scheme, a strong negative cosine similarity indicates the neuron weakens the direction it detects in the residual stream, so we call this a weakening neuron. This allows us to gain a number of novel insights. First, we show that nine different LLMs have similar patterns: weakening neurons appear mostly in late layers whereas their counterparts, (conditional) strengthening neurons, are frequent in early-middle layers. Second, we find that weakening neurons display surprising behavior: even though there are few, they activate often and have a large influence on model behavior. Third, weakening neurons have a strong effect on model output when gate values are negative -- which is surprising since negative gate values are not expected to encode functionality.

AI.tldr: 论文提出用输入(reading)与输出(writing)权重向量的余弦相似度来分析基于GLU的LLM神经元；负余弦对应"弱化神经元"，其削弱残差流中检测到的方向。九个LLM呈现一致模式：弱化神经元集中于后层，强化神经元多见于前中层；弱化神经元数量少但激活频繁、影响大，且在门控值为负时对输出影响显著。
AI.motivation: 理解LLM内部神经元的输入-输出功能机制，尤其是GLU类神经元如何读写残差流信息，缺乏简洁可解释的分析工具，以及门控值为负时的功能含义尚不明确。
AI.method: 提出简单分析方法：对每个神经元计算其输入(reading)权重向量与输出(writing)权重向量的余弦相似度；强负余弦定义为弱化神经元，正/条件正定义为(条件)强化神经元；并在九个不同LLM上进行统计与干预分析，考察层分布、激活频率、门控值为负时的影响。
AI.result: 九个LLM模式相似：弱化神经元主要出现在后层，强化神经元频繁出现在前中层；弱化神经元数量虽少但激活频繁且对模型行为影响大；弱化神经元在门控值为负时对输出有强影响，这一现象出乎意料。
AI.conclusion: 基于读写权重余弦相似度的分析揭示了GLU神经元的功能分化：弱化与强化神经元在层间分布不同，且少数弱化神经元具有不成比例的显著影响，提示负门控值也承载功能，为LLM可解释性提供新视角。

title: Devanagari Handwritten Character Recognition Using TrOCR: A Transformer-Based Model with Real-Time Web Deployment
comment: Presented and accepted at the 16th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT), 2025
summary: Devnagari is a one of the ancient language of the Indian subcontinent consisting of 36 vowels, 14 consonants and 10 numerals. The accurate recognition of handwritten Devnagari characters is challenging due to high complexity of Devnagari scripts. This paper presents a method to fine tune the pre trained TrOCR model to accurately recognize Devanagari handwritten characters. The Methodology consists of a preprocessing mechanism where input images are standardized into RGB format, tokenized in batches and integrated with Hugging Face Dataset. The pre-trained microsoft/trocr-base-handwritten model is fine-tuned over a dataset of nearly 5000 character images that are uniformly partitioned in the ratio 8:1:1 for training, evaluation and testing. Further optimization is done is the training process through mixed precision training, gradient checkpointing, and early stopping mechanism. The model achieves a character error rate (CER) of 3.95% and a character-level accuracy of 96.05%, outperforming the previous CNN based models. A scalable web application is developed using Vite.js, Golang, and FastAPI which practically deploys the OCR model and serves character recognition task with a latency less than 5 seconds per request. This study demonstrates the use of TrOCR model to build a scalable handwritten Devnagari character recognition system and also a foundation to future research on Devnagari Script Recognition using Transformers.

AI.tldr: 该论文微调预训练TrOCR模型识别手写天城文字符，字符错误率3.95%、准确率96.05%，优于CNN模型，并部署为可扩展Web应用。
AI.motivation: 天城文包含36个元音、14个辅音和10个数字，属于南亚次大陆古老文字，其手写字符因文字系统复杂度高而难以准确识别；同时此前基于CNN的模型性能有限，作者希望借助Transformer类OCR模型提升识别精度。
AI.method: 对输入图像统一为RGB格式、按批次分词并集成Hugging Face Dataset完成预处理；在约5000张字符图像上微调预训练模型microsoft/trocr-base-handwritten，数据按8:1:1划分为训练、验证、测试集；训练中采用混合精度训练、梯度检查点和早停机制进行优化；最后使用Vite.js、Golang和FastAPI开发可扩展Web应用部署模型。
AI.result: 模型取得3.95%的字符错误率（CER）和96.05%的字符级准确率，性能超过此前基于CNN的模型；部署后的Web应用单次请求识别延迟低于5秒。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了利用TrOCR模型构建可扩展手写天城文字符识别系统的可行性，并为未来基于Transformer的天城文文字识别研究奠定基础。

title: FIVE-VLA: Fast and EffectIVE Autonomous Driving with Recurrent Action Memory
summary: State-of-the-art vision-language-action models (VLA) for autonomous driving face critical limitations: excessive parameter counts, inefficient high-resolution image processing, and lack of temporal memory. We introduce Fast and EffectIVE VLA (FIVE-VLA) to address these through two key contributions. First, we employ an efficient vision encoder that processes high-resolution ($448 \times 896$) images while generating only 98 tokens, over $5\times$ fewer than existing approaches, and bypass text generation entirely for single-pass trajectory prediction. Second, we propose Recurrent Action Memory (RAM), a lightweight module that conditions action prediction on previous action tokens, providing temporal context critical for manoeuvres such as overtaking and emergency braking. With only 641M parameters, FIVE-VLA completes $\sim$10% more routes without traffic rule infractions than the previous state-of-the-art VLA on the challenging Bench2Drive closed-loop driving benchmark. Non-reactive open-loop simulation on the large-scale real-world NVIDIA Physical AI AV dataset shows 10.2% and 7.7% lower collision-violation rates than SimLingo in single- and four-view settings, respectively. Additionally, FIVE-VLA runs at $\sim$30 fps on an A100 and $\sim$4 fps on a T4 GPU (proxy to an edge device), representing an 8-30$\times$ speedup over previous methods.

AI.tldr: 提出FIVE-VLA，通过高效视觉编码器与循环动作记忆模块，在仅641M参数下实现自动驾驶视觉-语言-动作模型的高效闭环驾驶与更快推理。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶VLA模型存在参数规模过大、高分辨率图像处理效率低、缺乏时序记忆三大局限，难以满足实时与边缘部署需求。
AI.method: 两项核心设计：1）高效视觉编码器，处理448×896高分辨率图像仅生成98个token（比现有方法少5倍以上），并完全跳过文本生成，直接单次轨迹预测；2）循环动作记忆（RAM），轻量模块以历史动作token为条件进行动作预测，提供超车、紧急制动等机动所需时序上下文。
AI.result: 仅641M参数，在Bench2Drive闭环基准上完成路线的比例比先前SOTA VLA高约10%且无交通违规；在NVIDIA Physical AI AV数据集开环非反应式仿真中，单视图与四视图碰撞违规率分别比SimLingo低10.2%和7.7%；在A100上约30 fps、T4（边缘代理）上约4 fps，较先前方法加速8–30倍。
AI.conclusion: FIVE-VLA以紧凑参数规模同时提升驾驶安全性与推理效率，验证了高效视觉编码与循环动作记忆在自动驾驶VLA中的有效性。

title: VibeAvatar: Aligning Phonetic Kinematics and Human Aesthetics for High-Fidelity Talking Avatar Synthesis
summary: Multi-modal talking avatar synthesis aims to generate realistic talking videos from a reference portrait and speech. Despite rapid progress in diffusion-based methods, existing approaches still struggle to jointly achieve accurate lip articulation, human-preferred motion aesthetics, and efficient inference. We observe that phonetic accuracy and motion aesthetics arise from fundamentally different sources and should be addressed at complementary stages rather than learned implicitly by a single generator. Based on this insight, we propose VibeAvatar, which disentangles these two objectives through a Phonetic Kinematics Adapter (PKA) that converts recognition-oriented speech features into phonetic-kinematic conditions at the conditioning stage, and an Aesthetic Motion Policy (AMP) that optimizes a flow-consistent stochastic sampling policy via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) at the post-training stage. With a lightweight flow-based motion generator operating in a compact 1D warp-based latent motion space, VibeAvatar achieves state-of-the-art results in articulation, aesthetics, and efficiency on both objective metrics and user studies, while generating a 10-second 512px video in under 10 seconds with only $\sim$3GB VRAM.

AI.tldr: VibeAvatar提出将口型准确性与动作美感解耦，通过音素运动适配器（PKA）和美学运动策略（AMP，基于GRPO）在条件与后训练阶段分别优化，实现高效高质说话头像合成。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的说话头像合成方法难以同时兼顾准确口型、符合人类偏好的动作美感与高效推理。作者观察到语音准确性与动作美感来源本质不同，应由互补阶段分别处理，而非单一生成器隐式学习。
AI.method: 提出VibeAvatar：1）音素运动适配器（PKA）在条件阶段将识别导向的语音特征转换为音素-运动条件；2）美学运动策略（AMP）在后训练阶段通过组相对策略优化（GRPO）优化流一致的随机采样策略；并采用轻量流式运动生成器，在紧凑的1D warp潜在运动空间中运行。
AI.result: 在客观指标与用户研究中，VibeAvatar在口型清晰度、动作美感和效率上均达到SOTA；生成10秒512px视频耗时不到10秒，仅需约3GB显存。
AI.conclusion: 通过将音素准确性与动作美感解耦到条件与后训练两个互补阶段，并结合轻量1D潜在空间生成，VibeAvatar有效兼顾了真实感、美学质量和推理效率。

title: GenStream: Semantic Streaming Framework for Generative Reconstruction of Human-centric Media
comment: 9 pages. Published at ACM MM 2025. Code: https://github.com/emanuele-artioli/genstream
summary: Video streaming dominates global internet traffic, yet conventional pipelines remain inefficient for structured, human-centric content such as sports, performance, or interactive media. Standard codecs re-encode entire frames, foreground and background alike, treating all pixels uniformly and ignoring the semantic structure of the scene. This leads to significant bandwidth waste, particularly in scenarios where backgrounds are static and motion is constrained to a few salient actors. We introduce GenStream, a semantic streaming framework that replaces dense video frames with compact, structured metadata. Instead of transmitting pixels, GenStream encodes each scene as a combination of skeletal keypoints, camera viewpoint parameters, and a static 3D background model. These elements are transmitted to the client, where a generative model reconstructs photorealistic human figures and composites them into the 3D scene from the original viewpoint. This paradigm enables extreme compression, achieving over 99.9% bandwidth reduction compared to HEVC for the continuous data stream. We partially validate GenStream on Olympic figure skating footage and demonstrate potential for high perceptual fidelity under minimal data. While acknowledging the significant computational costs shifted to the client and challenges in generalization, GenStream opens new directions in volumetric avatar synthesis, canonical 3D actor fusion across views, and personalized viewing experiences, laying the groundwork for scalable, intelligent streaming in the post-codec era.

AI.tldr: 提出GenStream语义流媒体框架，用结构化元数据替代稠密视频帧，由客户端生成模型重建人物并合成到3D场景，实现相对HEVC超99.9%的带宽压缩。
AI.motivation: 传统视频编解码器对整帧像素统一处理，忽略场景语义结构，在背景静态、运动仅集中于少数显著主体的场景（如体育、表演、交互媒体）中造成大量带宽浪费。
AI.method: 不再传输像素，而是将每个场景编码为骨架关键点、相机视角参数与静态3D背景模型的组合元数据；客户端接收这些元素后，用生成模型重建逼真人体并按照原始视角合成到3D场景中。
AI.result: 在连续数据流上相比HEVC实现超过99.9%的带宽压缩；在奥林匹克花样滑冰素材上进行了部分验证，显示在极少数据下具备较高感知保真度的潜力。
AI.conclusion: GenStream为体化替身合成、跨视角规范3D演员融合及个性化观看体验开辟了新方向，为后编解码时代的可扩展智能流媒体奠定基础；但客户端计算开销显著增加，泛化能力仍存在挑战。

title: Towards Transparent Diagnostics: Investigating Architectural Trade-offs and Explainability in Malaria Detection
summary: More than 80 countries have reported malaria cases with 610 thousand deaths and are projected to increase. Identifying malaria early and accurately helps save lives and effective way to diagnose malaria is through microscopic methods that are labor intensive and require experts with special equipment. Deep learning (DL) has shown promising results in medical diagnosis. Here, we explored various DL models: ResNet18, MobileNetV2, EfficientNet-B2, VGG19 and proposed model ResNet18+TTA (ResNet18 backbone with modified classification head and test time augmentation) for detecting malaria presence using blood smears taken from the NIH Malaria dataset. Our experiment shows MobileNetV2 achieved 96.85 % accuracy with smallest model size (8.49 MB) and fastest inference (1.35 ms). The ResNet18+TTA model achieved 97.96 % accuracy, 0.996 AUC with longest inference time (13.32 ms). Larger architecture outputs a larger model size with moderate accuracy. Upon further pruning, ResNet18+TTA model gained a slight improvement in accuracy and reduced inference time. GRAD-CAM, SHAP and LIME provide explainable AI (XAI) insights into model predictions, using explanation agreement and divergence to evaluate predictive reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文利用NIH疟疾数据集，对比ResNet18、MobileNetV2、EfficientNet-B2、VGG19及提出的ResNet18+TTA模型进行疟疾血涂片检测，其中ResNet18+TTA达到97.96%准确率和0.996 AUC，MobileNetV2以最小模型（8.49 MB）和最快推理（1.35 ms）达到96.85%准确率，并结合剪枝与XAI方法评估模型可靠性。
AI.motivation: 全球80多个国家报告疟疾病例，死亡达61万且预计上升，早期准确识别可挽救生命。传统显微诊断依赖专家和专用设备，劳动强度大。深度学习在医学诊断中展现潜力，因此作者探索并改进深度学习模型以实现高效、自动化的疟疾检测。
AI.method: 基于NIH疟疾数据集的血涂片，比较ResNet18、MobileNetV2、EfficientNet-B2、VGG19等模型，并提出ResNet18+TTA（改进分类头的ResNet18骨干+测试时增强）。同时进行模型剪枝，并使用GRAD-CAM、SHAP和LIME提供可解释性分析，通过解释一致性与差异性评估预测可靠性。
AI.result: MobileNetV2准确率96.85%，模型最小（8.49 MB），推理最快（1.35 ms）。ResNet18+TTA准确率97.96%，AUC 0.996，推理时间最长（13.32 ms）。更大架构模型体积更大但准确率中等。经剪枝后，ResNet18+TTA准确率略有提升且推理时间减少。
AI.conclusion: ResNet18+TTA在准确率和AUC上表现最优，MobileNetV2在效率上最佳，剪枝可进一步优化性能。结合XAI方法可评估模型预测的可靠性，为疟疾自动诊断提供有效方案。

title: STRETCH the Boundaries: A Unified Self-Taught Framework for Progressive LLM Evolution
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often suffer from capability stagnation in self-improvement training because fixed difficulty levels fail to adapt to their evolving proficiency. To address this issue, we propose STRETCH (Self-Taught Reasoning Evolution via Targeted CHallenge), a unified framework inspired by cognitive scaffolding theory. STRETCH introduces a dynamic Stretch Zone mechanism that continuously aligns question difficulty with the model's solving capability. Within a single parameter space, the model alternates between a Scaffolder that generates adaptive, boundary-pushing challenges and a Learner that that optimizes its solving trajectories through reinforcement learning. This dual-loop co-evolution effectively stabilizes training, mitigates reward hacking and promote progressive reasoning growth. Experiments on both negotiation and operation research benchmarks demonstrate that STRETCH consistently outperforms strong prompting and domain-specific baselines. Further scaffolder configuration analysis shows that dynamic difficulty alignment is critical for sustained capability improvement and synchronized reasoning evolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STRETCH框架，通过动态“拉伸区”机制将题目难度与模型能力持续对齐，在同一参数空间内让模型交替扮演出题者与解题者进行双循环协同进化，在谈判与运筹基准上稳定超越强基线。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在自我提升训练中常出现能力停滞，根源在于固定的难度水平无法适配模型不断演进的解题熟练度。
AI.method: 受认知支架理论启发，提出统一的STRETCH框架：引入动态Stretch Zone机制，持续将问题难度与模型求解能力对齐；在单一参数空间内，模型在生成自适应、边界推进挑战的Scaffolder与通过强化学习优化求解轨迹的Learner两个角色间交替，形成双循环协同进化。
AI.result: 在谈判（negotiation）与运筹学（operation research）两类基准上，STRETCH持续优于强提示方法与领域专用基线；Scaffolder配置分析表明，动态难度对齐对持续能力提升与推理同步演进至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 动态难度对齐是实现LLM持续自我提升的关键，双角色协同进化的STRETCH能稳定训练、缓解奖励劫持并推动推理能力渐进增长。

title: Fallacy Benchmarks Measure Scheme Recognition, Not Fallacy Detection
comment: 13 pages. v2: reordered results and abstract to foreground the scheme-recognition finding; no changes to data or numbers. Data: https://github.com/fine2006/the-concealment-hypothesis
summary: Fallacy-detection benchmarks pair fallacy classes with a single "valid" or "none" class that takes everything data collection did not label as a fallacy. A detector has two jobs, deciding whether an argument is fallacious and naming which fallacy it commits, and the false-positive rate is meant to measure the first. We show that what these benchmarks actually score is scheme recognition, the ability behind the second job. Their own test sets already show it: when a classifier misses a fallacy, the error lands on "none" rather than on another fallacy type, so detection is failing while classification holds. The reason is what the valid class lacks. The negatives that separate the two jobs are correct arguments using the same argumentation scheme as a fallacy, and they are scarce: nearly absent from the four benchmarks we examined, and rare even under deliberate search. A detector is therefore never tested where recognizing a scheme and judging its use come apart, and can pass on recognition alone. We construct the missing arguments, together with a control condition from the same pipeline that differs only in scheme, so whatever generation contributes, it contributes to both. The classifier labels the scheme-matched negatives as the source fallacy, and labels the wrong-scheme negatives as the scheme they actually use 85.9% of the time and as the source type 0.4%. The classifier has learned which scheme an argument uses, not whether it uses it correctly. The over-flagging follows: a model that scores 16.6% on CoCoLoFa's own valid class flags 58.9% of the constructed arguments. The same dissociation appears in three zero-shot LLM detectors that never saw these benchmarks. We release the items as Scheme Foils. A reported false-positive rate should not be trusted as a measure of detection until the valid class has been audited for scheme-matched coverage.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出，当前谬误检测基准实际度量的是"论证方案识别"而非"谬误检测"，原因是"valid/none"类中缺少与谬误使用相同论证方案的正确论证，作者构建Scheme Foils数据集加以验证并呼吁审计该类。
AI.motivation: 谬误检测基准将谬误类别与一个"valid/none"类配对，检测器需完成两项任务：判定论证是否有谬误、命名谬误类型，而假阳性率本应用来度量前者。作者质疑这些基准实际评分的是"方案识别"（即第二项任务的能力）。
AI.method: 1. 分析四个基准的测试集，观察分类器漏判谬误时，错误是否落在"none"而非其他谬误类型上，以证明检测失败而分类未失败。2. 指出valid类缺失的关键负例：使用与谬误相同论证方案的正确论证；并说明其在四个基准中几乎不存在，即使刻意搜索也很罕见。3. 构建此类缺失论证及一个仅方案不同的对照条件，使生成贡献对两者一致。4. 在三个零样本LLM检测器上复现该解离现象，并将数据发布为Scheme Foils。
AI.result: 分类器将方案匹配的负例标注为源谬误类型；将错误方案负例按实际使用方案标注的比例达85.9%，标注为源谬误类型的比例仅0.4%。即分类器学到的是论证使用何种方案，而非是否使用正确。过判现象随之出现：在CoCoLoFa自身valid类上得分16.6%的模型，却将58.9%的构建论证判为谬误。同一解离现象在三个从未见过这些基准的零样本LLM检测器中同样出现。
AI.conclusion: 当前基准的假阳性率误导性地测量了方案识别而非谬误检测。在valid类未经过方案匹配覆盖度审计之前，报告中的假阳性率不应被信任为检测度量。作者发布Scheme Foils数据以支持后续审计与改进。

title: DyMT-ESB: Dynamic Multi-Turn Evaluation of Social Bias in User-LLM Interactions
summary: Warning: This paper contains examples of stereotypes and social bias. LLMs are increasingly used in interactive settings by the general public, making the evaluation of model behavior in multi-turn conversational scenarios important for safety, including stereotyping-related harms. However, existing multi-turn social bias evaluations often rely on pre-specified or template-based user inputs that do not adapt to model responses and typically assume a fixed dialogue length in advance. In this paper, we study social bias dynamics in response-conditioned multi-turn interactions using a controlled evaluation protocol that generates follow-up user queries from the evolving dialogue history and allows evaluation over variable numbers of turns. Experimental results show that LLMs exhibit social bias even in coherent, response-conditioned multi-turn interactions, revealing late-emerging bias, non-monotonic bias patterns, and bias re-emergence. These results motivate evaluations that extend beyond fixed-turn, pre-scripted protocols. Our findings highlight the importance of analyzing social bias as a turn-level dynamic phenomenon.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多轮对话中社会偏见的动态演变，采用由对话历史生成后续用户查询的受控评测协议，发现LLM存在晚期出现、非单调及重新出现的偏见模式。
AI.motivation: LLM日益被公众用于交互场景，多轮会话中的安全性评估愈发重要，包括刻板印象相关危害。但现有多轮社会偏见评估多依赖预设或模板化用户输入，无法适应模型回应，且预先假定固定对话长度，难以刻画真实交互中的偏见动态。
AI.method: 采用受控评测协议，基于不断演变的对话历史生成后续用户查询（response-conditioned），并支持在可变轮数下进行评估，从而研究响应条件下的多轮交互中社会偏见的动态变化。
AI.result: 实验表明，即使在连贯的、响应条件下的多轮交互中，LLM仍表现出社会偏见，并揭示出晚期出现的偏见、非单调的偏见模式以及偏见的重新出现等现象。
AI.conclusion: 结果呼吁超越固定轮数、预设脚本式的评测协议，强调应将社会偏见作为轮级动态现象进行分析。

title: Video-Based Markerless Motion Capture for Clinical and Rehabilitation Biomechanics: A PRISMA-ScR Scoping Review of Validated Architectures, Clinical Readiness, and Emerging Methods
summary: Background.. Video-based markerless motion capture promises movement analysis without the cost, space and skin-marker constraints of optoelectronic systems, with particular potential for clinical and rehabilitation settings. Whether validated pipelines yet deliver clinically acceptable biomechanics, and how they relate to the underlying computer-vision research, remains unclear. Methods. We conducted a scoping review following the PRISMA extension for Scoping Reviews, with a registered protocol and searches of PubMed, Scopus and IEEE Xplore (January 2015 to February 2026; the computer-vision scan was updated to July 2026). A dual-tier design paired a primary corpus of validated biomechanical studies with a complementary, curated and deliberately non-exhaustive corpus of emerging computer-vision work, used qualitatively. We charted study characteristics, pipeline architecture, validation methods and joint-angle accuracy. Results. We included 117 studies, most published from 2024 onward and conducted on healthy adults walking in a laboratory. Pipelines formed five architectural families across monocular and multi-camera modalities; most reported raw joint angles without biomechanical refinement. Sagittal lower-limb agreement clustered around 5 to 6{\textdegree}, generally short of clinical acceptability, while out-of-plane kinematics, kinetics, and pathological or older populations were rarely validated. Emerging computer-vision building blocks (foundation-model mesh recovery, differentiable inverse kinematics, video-based kinetics) were almost absent from validated studies. Conclusions. Video-based markerless capture is not yet interchangeable with marker-based systems for clinical joint kinematics, and it remains barely validated where rehabilitation needs it most: older and pathological populations, out-of-plane kinematics, and kinetics. Mapping this evidence gap onto emerging computer-vision advances, we propose hypothesis-generating design guidelines, not a validated method, to steer the next generation of pipelines toward accessible, clinically meaningful movement analysis.

AI.tldr: 该文是一篇范围综述（117项研究），系统梳理了基于视频的无标记动作捕捉流程的架构、验证方法与关节角度精度，指出其尚未达到临床可接受的关节运动学水平。
AI.motivation: 光电子动作捕捉系统受成本、空间与皮肤标记限制，而基于视频的无标记动作捕捉在临床与康复场景具有潜力。然而，现有已验证流程是否达到临床可接受的生物力学精度、以及其与底层计算机视觉研究的关系尚不清晰。
AI.method: 遵循PRISMA-ScR开展范围综述，注册方案并检索PubMed、Scopus与IEEE Xplore（2015年1月至2026年2月，计算机视觉检索更新至2026年7月）。采用双层设计：主语料为已验证的生物力学研究，辅以经过筛选、刻意非穷尽且定性使用的计算机视觉新兴研究语料。提取研究特征、流程架构、验证方法与关节角度精度。
AI.result: 纳入117项研究，多发表于2024年之后，主要在实验室对健康成人步行进行。流程归为五种架构族，涵盖单目与多相机模态；多数仅报告原始关节角度，未经生物力学优化。矢状面下肢一致性集中在5–6°，普遍未达临床可接受水平；面外运动学、动力学及病理或老年人群极少被验证。新兴计算机视觉模块（基础模型网格恢复、可微逆运动学、基于视频的动力学）在已验证研究中几乎缺席。
AI.conclusion: 基于视频的无标记捕捉在临床关节运动学上尚不能与基于标记的系统互换使用，且在康复最需要的人群（老年与病理人群）、面外运动学与动力学方面验证不足。将这一证据缺口映射到新兴计算机视觉进展，作者提出假设生成性的设计指南（非已验证方法），以引导下一代流程走向可及且具临床意义的动作分析。

title: Selection Is Retrieval, Abstention Is Not: On-Device Tool Routing over 70 Korean-English Actions
summary: An AI assistant that calls tools makes two decisions on every request: which tool to invoke, and whether any available tool applies. In the usual design a single language model makes both, by emitting a call or by declining to emit one. On a device that has to answer without a server, the language model is what makes that design expensive, dominating both the latency and the memory of the router. The common alternative is to remove the model completely and rank the catalog of local actions with a retriever instead. That substitution is not symmetric across the two decisions. A retriever returns its highest-scoring candidate for every input and cannot signal that the catalog holds no valid action. Our earlier study found that constraining a decoder to a tool grammar repairs malformed output without improving the choice. What the substitution costs in each decision has not been measured. We evaluate the two decisions separately over 600 Korean and English requests and a catalog of 70 local actions. The router may also ask for a missing slot, reply, or delegate. Half the in-catalog requests reuse catalog vocabulary and half paraphrase it, separating lexical overlap from the action requested. Character 3-gram BM25 selects 162 of 164 lexically matched requests and 85 of 166 paraphrases. Restricting the candidate set to seven raises the paraphrase figure to a mean of 0.825 over five trials. No classifier over its score features separates in-catalog from out-of-catalog above 0.697 area under the curve, where the frozen encoder multilingual-e5-base reaches 0.806. Using that encoder for abstention alone keeps 376 of the requests local and misroutes 9 of the 150 needing delegation. Abstention, not selection, is where a neural component is required. A neural ranker improves every quality metric and is rejected on latency and memory rather than accuracy.

AI.tldr: 在端侧工具路由中，选择与弃权两个决策的代价并不对称：检索器无法表达"无适用工具"，弃权才是唯一必须依赖神经组件的环节。
AI.motivation: 端侧必须无服务器应答，语言模型主导路由器的时延与内存开销；常见替代方案用检索器完全取代模型，但此前未测量这一替代在"选哪个工具"和"是否调用工具"两个决策上各自的代价。作者先前研究仅发现工具语法约束可修正格式错误、不能改善选择。
AI.method: 将两个决策分开评估：600条韩语与英语请求、70个本地动作目录；请求可含缺槽追问、直接回复或委派。目录内请求一半复用目录词表、一半改写表述，以分离词汇重叠与真实动作意图。以字符3-gram BM25作为检索基线，采用统计分类器与分数特征做目录内/外判别，并与冻结编码器multilingual-e5-base对比；用该编码器仅承担弃权判断。
AI.result: 字符3-gram BM25对164条词汇匹配请求选中162条，对166条改写请求仅选中85条；将候选集限制为7时，五轮试验的改写选中率均值升至0.825。基于其分数特征的分类器判别目录内外的最优AUC不超过0.697，而冻结编码器multilingual-e5-base达到0.806。仅用该编码器做弃权，可保留376条请求在本地，150条需委派请求中错路由9条。
AI.conclusion: 弃权而非选择才是需要神经组件的环节；神经排序器虽提升全部质量指标，但因时延与内存被否决，而非因准确率。

title: Voice of Reason: Reinforcement Learning for Spoken Math
summary: Speech language models enable richer spoken interactions between humans and machines than cascaded systems, allowing access to paralinguistic information and lower latency. However, their accuracy on mathematical reasoning benchmarks has lagged behind those of text models. Reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards has been instrumental in extending text models' capabilities for solving complex problems and limiting hallucinations. In this work, we explore applying RL to the GLM-4-Voice speech model (Zeng et al., 2024) to bridge the gap between textual and spoken mathematical problem solving. We first adapt the model to the domain using supervised fine-tuning on synthesized spoken question-answering data. We then show that, even without extra reasoning tokens, RL improves the accuracy on GSM8K beyond levels previously achieved for speech models only with supplementary reasoning traces. When combined with existing streaming reasoning techniques, we show further gains to 74.8% free-form accuracy. This establishes a new state-of-the-art for mathematical spoken abilities with speech-native models.

AI.tldr: 本文将强化学习（RL，带可验证奖励）应用于GLM-4-Voice语音语言模型，先在合成的语音问答数据上做监督微调，再通过RL提升语音数学推理能力，在GSM8K上无需额外推理token即超越以往语音模型水平，结合流式推理技术后自由形式准确率达74.8%，创语音原生模型数学能力新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 语音语言模型支持更丰富的口语交互（可利用副语言信息、延迟更低），但在数学推理基准上准确率落后于文本模型。文本模型通过带可验证奖励的强化学习（RL）显著提升了复杂问题求解能力并抑制幻觉，因此作者希望将RL迁移到语音模型上，缩小文本与口语数学解题能力之间的差距。
AI.method: 以GLM-4-Voice语音模型为基座：首先在合成的口语问答数据上进行监督微调（SFT），使模型适配目标领域；随后应用带可验证奖励的强化学习（RL）进一步提升数学推理能力，并在部分实验中结合已有的流式推理（streaming reasoning）技术；同时考察在无需额外推理token条件下的表现。
AI.result: RL在不增加额外推理token的情况下，使GSM8K准确率超越了此前语音模型仅依靠补充推理轨迹才能达到的水平；结合流式推理技术后，自由形式（free-form）准确率进一步提升至74.8%，在语音原生模型的数学口语能力上建立了新的最先进水平（SOTA）。
AI.conclusion: 带可验证奖励的强化学习可有效迁移至语音语言模型，缩小其与文本模型在数学推理上的差距，并与流式推理技术协同带来增益，为语音原生模型的数学口语能力设定了新的SOTA。

title: HearInContext: A Benchmark for Implicit Context in Speech Recognition
summary: Contextual ASR can benefit from semantic cues or from target words explicitly provided in the context. We introduce HearInContext, a Mandarin-English benchmark that pairs shared synthetic speech with assistant replies supporting different interpretations. The benchmark comprises 3,764 semantic test cases built around homophones. Implicit contexts exclude candidate words; explicit contexts name the target. No-context and unrelated-context controls measure the benefit of relevant history and sensitivity to irrelevant history. Context-capable models benefit from implicit cues but achieve higher target recall with explicit hints. Fine-tuning Qwen3-ASR-1.7B improves implicit-context target recall by 11.4 percentage points in both Mandarin and English, while absolute CER/WER changes on AISHELL-1 and LibriSpeech remain below 0.1 percentage points. Gains extend to explicit conditions excluded from fine-tuning and to Mandarin hotword recognition on real recordings. Code and data are available at https://github.com/OPPO-Mente-Lab/HearInContext

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 HearInContext，一个中英双语基准，通过同音词场景评估上下文感知 ASR 的语义与显式线索利用能力，并验证微调可显著提升隐式上下文目标召回率。
AI.motivation: 上下文感知 ASR 既可利用语义线索，也可利用上下文中显式给出的目标词，但缺乏系统性基准来区分并量化这两种上下文信息的贡献，同时需要考察模型对相关与无关历史上下文的敏感度。
AI.method: 构建 HearInContext 基准：将共享的合成语音与支持不同解读的助手回复配对，包含 3,764 个围绕同音词的语义测试用例；设置隐式上下文（不含候选词）、显式上下文（直接写出目标词）、无上下文与无关上下文四种对照条件；对 Qwen3-ASR-1.7B 进行微调并在 AISHELL-1 与 LibriSpeech 上评估通用识别性能变化。
AI.result: 具备上下文能力的模型可从隐式线索中获益，但在显式提示下目标召回率更高；微调 Qwen3-ASR-1.7B 使中英文隐式上下文目标召回率均提升 11.4 个百分点，而在 AISHELL-1 与 LibriSpeech 上的 CER/WER 绝对变化低于 0.1 个百分点；增益可泛化到未参与微调的显式条件以及真实录音中的中文热词识别。
AI.conclusion: HearInContext 为上下文感知 ASR 提供了可区分的评测框架，证明语义与显式线索均有效且显式线索效果更强，微调可在不损害通用识别性能的前提下大幅提升上下文目标召回率并具备良好泛化性。

title: Generalist-Specialist Mixture-of-Experts for Rare Pathology Detection in Multimodal Imaging
summary: AI models for multimodal medical imaging must balance modality-specific specialization with cross-modal shared representations, a trade-off that pure Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures currently fail to satisfy. Expert-based routing improves in-domain learning but may sacrifice cross-modal signals, which appear particularly important for rare (low-prevalence) pathologies in our experiments. To resolve this, we introduce Generalist-Specialist-MoE (GS-MoE), a two-branch (MoE) architecture that couples a cross-modal generalist model with distinct modality-specific specialists (experts) via domain-constrained feature fusion. On RadImageNet (1.35M images, 165 pathologies, three modalities), GS-MoE recovers detection of six low-prevalence pathologies on which every baseline scores F1 $=$ 0, with per-class gains up to +0.60 F1. It attains this while even slightly exceeding dense and specialist-only MoE aggregate baselines (MCC 0.770), while using ${\sim}53\%$ fewer active parameters at inference than the strongest investigated dense model.

AI.tldr: 提出GS-MoE双分支架构，用跨模态通才模型与模态专属专家经域约束特征融合，兼顾共享表示与专化，在低流行度病理检测上大幅提升。
AI.motivation: 多模态医学影像AI需在模态专属专化与跨模态共享表示间取得平衡，而纯MoE架构难以满足该权衡：专家路由提升域内学习却可能牺牲跨模态信号，这在实验中表现为对低流行度（罕见）病理尤为重要。
AI.method: 提出Generalist-Specialist-MoE（GS-MoE），一种双分支MoE架构：将跨模态通才模型与多个模态专属专家（specialists）通过域约束的特征融合（domain-constrained feature fusion）耦合起来。
AI.result: 在RadImageNet（1.35M图像、165种病理、三种模态）上，GS-MoE恢复了对六种低流行度病理的检测（所有基线在此F1=0），单类F1提升最高+0.60；同时在聚合指标上略超密集模型与仅专家MoE基线（MCC 0.770），且推理时激活参数比最强密集模型少约53%。
AI.conclusion: 通过通才-专家双分支与域约束融合，GS-MoE在保持甚至略优聚合性能的同时显著提升罕见病理检测能力并大幅降低推理激活参数量，为多模态医学影像中的专化-共享权衡提供了有效方案。

title: RankGround: Efficient High-Resolution GUI Grounding via Lightweight Reranker-Guided Crop Selection
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26)
summary: Graphical User Interface (GUI) grounding is a fundamental perception task for multimodal agents, enabling them to interpret natural language instructions and interact with digital interfaces. Existing methods face a fundamental trade-off between accuracy and efficiency: direct full-image inference often fails to capture small or visually similar UI elements, while multi-crop strategies improve localization at the cost of multiple expensive Vision-Language Model (VLM) calls per query. To address this challenge, we propose RankGround, a two-stage framework that achieves accurate GUI grounding with a single VLM call per query. Central to our approach is GroundRanker, a lightweight multimodal reranker that identifies the most promising crop from a dense candidate set. Because no off-the-shelf ranking dataset is available, we construct ranking supervision data from existing grounding datasets. A strict containment criterion and boundary-aware positive augmentation improve alignment and spatial coverage in cluttered layouts. GroundRanker is then trained with a two-stage curriculum: a pointwise objective first learns coarse containment, and a listwise objective refines subtle semantic and spatial distinctions among visually similar crops. Experimental results show that RankGround consistently outperforms strong baselines while reducing computational cost. It achieves 1.4 times faster inference and improves localization accuracy by 5.5% on average over the second-best method across all backbones and screen scales, establishing a new state of the art in both efficiency and precision for GUI grounding.

AI.tldr: 提出 RankGround 两阶段框架，通过 GroundRanker 轻量级多模态重排序器，在单次 VLM 调用下实现高精度 GUI grounding。
AI.motivation: 现有 GUI grounding 方法在精度与效率间存在根本性权衡：直接全图推理难以捕捉小目标或视觉相似的 UI 元素，而多裁剪策略虽提升定位能力，却需要每次查询多次调用昂贵的 VLM。
AI.method: 提出 RankGround 两阶段框架，核心为 GroundRanker——一个从密集候选集中识别最优裁剪区域的轻量级多模态重排序器。由于缺乏现成排序数据集，从现有 grounding 数据集构建排序监督数据，采用严格包含准则与边界感知正样本增强以提升对齐与杂乱布局下的空间覆盖。训练采用两阶段课程：先以 pointwise 目标学习粗略包含关系，再用 listwise 目标精炼视觉相似裁剪间的细微语义与空间差异。
AI.result: RankGround 在所有骨干网络与屏幕尺度上持续优于强基线并降低计算成本：推理速度提升 1.4 倍，定位精度较次优方法平均提升 5.5%，在效率与精度上均达到新的 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: RankGround 以单次 VLM 调用实现高精度 GUI grounding，在效率与精度两方面同时建立新标杆，验证了重排序范式在该任务上的有效性。

title: AffordanceWAM: Affordance-Aware Joint World-Action Modeling for Robot Manipulation
summary: Generalizable robot manipulation requires predicting how a scene will evolve, identifying where interactions are feasible, and determining how to act. Action-labeled robot videos directly supervise control but are costly and limited in diversity, whereas egocentric human videos capture diverse interactions but lack robot actions and differ in embodiment and appearance. We introduce AffordanceWAM, an affordance-aware generative World Action Model that represents object-centric spatiotemporal affordance through Scalar Affordance and Affordance Heatmap, within the generated future World. This representation grounds visual prediction in task-relevant objects and interaction regions for action generation, and provides shared interaction targets across human and robot videos. Built on a pretrained video diffusion Transformer, AffordanceWAM uses separately parameterized World and Action Experts, coupled through Masked Joint Self-Attention, to jointly predict future RGB observations, Scalar Affordance fields, Affordance Heatmaps, and continuous robot actions under a unified flow-matching objective. Human videos supervise all three future-World streams, whereas robot trajectories additionally provide action supervision, enabling transfer without human action labels or retargeting. Experiments on RoboCasa, CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D, and real-world manipulation demonstrate consistent gains over RGB-only and robot-data-only baselines. Under fixed robot supervision, RoboCasa performance improves monotonically as affordance-annotated human video scales. These results support affordance as an effective interface for both vision-language-action learning and human-to-robot transfer.

AI.tldr: AffordanceWAM 是一个"可供性感知"的生成式世界动作模型，以物体为中心的时空可供性表示（标量可供性 + 可供性热力图）作为人类视频与机器人视频之间的共享交互接口，在统一流匹配目标下联合预测未来 RGB、可供性场、可供性热力图与机器人动作，实现无需人类动作标注的跨具身迁移。
AI.motivation: 通用机器人操作需要预测场景演化、识别可行交互位置并决定如何行动。动作标注的机器人视频可直接监督控制，但采集成本高、多样性有限；自我中心人类视频交互多样，却缺少机器人动作且存在具身与外观差异。因此需要一种能连接两者的中间表示，实现可扩展的人到机器人迁移。
AI.method: 提出 AffordanceWAM，基于预训练视频扩散 Transformer，设置独立参数化的 World Expert 与 Action Expert，通过 Masked Joint Self-Attention 耦合，在统一 flow-matching 目标下联合预测未来 RGB 观测、Scalar Affordance 场、Affordance Heatmap 及连续机器人动作。可供性表示以物体为中心，将视觉预测锚定到任务相关物体与交互区域；人类视频监督三个未来世界流，机器人轨迹额外提供动作监督，从而无需人类动作标签或重定向。
AI.result: 在 RoboCasa、CALVIN ABC→D 及真实世界操作任务上，方法相对仅 RGB 与仅机器人数据的基线取得一致提升。在固定机器人监督量下，RoboCasa 性能随可供性标注人类视频规模增加而单调提升。
AI.conclusion: 可供性可作为视觉-语言-动作学习与人到机器人迁移的有效接口，兼具可扩展性与跨具身泛化能力。

title: Tracing individual knowledge trajectories in a changing field: the case of general relativity and gravitation
comment: 43 pages including Supplementary Material (11+1 figures, 4+6 tables). Submitted to Frontiers in Complex Systems
summary: Historians have reconstructed the twentieth-century transformation of general relativity and gravitation (GRG) at the field level and through individual careers, but connecting these scales requires a way to compare researchers with the changing field over time. We develop such a comparison, setting a researcher's publications and references against GRG field literature from the same, earlier, and later two-year periods. Building on Own Vocabulary and Embedding Density Estimation from our earlier two-case study (arXiv:2501.00391), we extend the analysis to the fifty most-published authors in a NASA/ADS corpus of about 180,000 GRG records (1911 to 2000) and add two citation-based measures, Referenced Vocabulary and Citation Identity. The four measures compare an author's written language, cited literature, semantic neighbourhood, and cited-authority configuration with the surrounding field. The earlier cases suggested that closer field-vocabulary alignment accompanies a denser semantic neighbourhood. Across the fifty authors this holds only partially. Written and cited vocabularies tend to move together, usually resembling later GRG literature as the field turned towards astrophysical and cosmological research. Semantic neighbourhoods more often lie where the field's publications were concentrated in earlier periods, while co-citation patterns follow no single temporal direction, and the two citation measures frequently place the same researcher differently despite drawing on identical reference lists. Individual trajectories can thus combine vocabulary tied to later field states with older semantic or citation structures, and these divergent cases mark patterns for closer historical investigation. The approach transfers to other fields with defensible corpus boundaries and adequate coverage of texts, references, and disambiguated author identities.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种将研究者与引力与广义相对论（GRG）领域文献进行跨时段比较的方法，基于词汇与嵌入密度估计，并结合引文指标，对50位高产作者进行量化分析，发现作者个体轨迹在词汇、语义邻域和引文结构上呈现不同步的时间方向。
AI.motivation: 历史学已在领域层面和个人职业生涯层面重建了20世纪广义相对论与引力（GRG）的转变，但连接这两个尺度需要一种能将研究者与随时间变化的领域进行对比的方法，以识别值得深入历史考察的个体轨迹模式。
AI.method: 以NASA/ADS约18万条GRG记录（1911—2000年）为语料，选取50位发文最多的作者。在前期两案例研究（arXiv:2501.00391）的Own Vocabulary与Embedding Density Estimation基础上，扩展引入两项基于引文的指标——Referenced Vocabulary与Citation Identity。四项指标分别将作者的写作语言、引用文献、语义邻域与被引权威配置，与同一时期、此前及此后两年期的GRG领域文献进行对比。
AI.result: 早期案例显示词汇对齐越紧密则语义邻域越密集，但在50位作者中此关系仅部分成立。写作词汇与引用词汇倾向同步变化，通常更接近后期GRG文献（领域转向天体物理与宇宙学研究）。语义邻域更常定位于领域出版集中较早的时期；共被引模式无统一时间方向；两项引文指标虽基于相同参考文献列表，却常将同一研究者置于不同位置。
AI.conclusion: 个体研究轨迹可同时包含与领域后期状态相关联的词汇，以及更早的语义或引文结构，这些分歧案例标示出值得深入历史考察的模式。该方法可迁移至其他具备合理语料边界且文本、参考文献与消歧作者身份覆盖充分的领域。

title: Mask IPL: Noise-Free Intrinsic Position Learning via Computation Graph Clipping for Event-Based Spike-Driven Tracking
summary: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) match the event-driven nature of event cameras and naturally extract spatiotemporal features. These properties have motivated a series of recent studies on event-based tracking with SNNs. Intrinsic Position Learning (IPL) acquires strong position information without introducing additional parameters, making it a mainstream approach for position encoding in event-based spike-driven tracking. However, the mechanism behind its effectiveness lacks systematic theoretical analysis. Moreover, our analysis reveals that IPL introduces noise in both forward and backward propagation. The former increases inference error, while the latter prevents parameters from converging to better solutions. This paper presents a systematic analysis of IPL and demonstrates that its effectiveness stems from the synergy between IPL and multi-stage convolution. The zero blocks in the joint tensor act as zero padding for convolution, and the resulting boundary effect propagates layer by layer through multi-stage convolution. Every parameter update is therefore driven by a gradient that perceives the relative displacement between template and search frames. Positional encoding added after the convolutional stage cannot provide this information. We further propose a simple Computation Graph Clipping method that applies a validity mask determined by the layout to the operations of every layer, making invalid regions equivalent to zero padding in both forward and backward propagation. This eliminates the noise without introducing additional parameters and makes the actual gradient coincide with the ideal gradient. We name the improved method Mask IPL. Without increasing parameters or computational cost, Mask IPL improves the AUC of the Tiny-scale tracker on FE108, FELT, and VisEvent, and consistently improves the Base-scale tracker as well.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统分析了脉冲神经网络事件跟踪中IPL位置编码有效的机理，指出其有效性源于IPL与多级卷积的协同（零块相当于零填充，边界效应逐层传播使梯度感知模板与搜索帧的相对位移），同时揭示IPL在前向和反向传播中引入噪声；提出无额外参数的计算图裁剪方法Mask IPL，用有效性掩码消除噪声，使实际梯度逼近理想梯度，在FE108、FELT、VisEvent上提升Tiny-scale与Base-scale跟踪器AUC。
AI.motivation: 事件相机具有事件驱动特性，脉冲神经网络（SNN）与之天然匹配并能提取时空特征，因此基于SNN的事件跟踪成为研究热点。IPL（Intrinsic Position Learning）在不增加参数的前提下获得较强位置信息，已成为事件驱动脉冲跟踪中位置编码的主流方案，但其有效性机理缺乏系统的理论分析；作者进一步发现IPL在前向传播中引入噪声导致推理误差增大，在反向传播中引入噪声使参数无法收敛到更优解。
AI.method: 首先对IPL进行系统理论分析，证明其有效性来自IPL与多级卷积的协同作用：联合张量中的零块对卷积相当于零填充，由此产生的边界效应经多级卷积逐层传播，使每次参数更新都由能够感知模板帧与搜索帧相对位移的梯度驱动，而卷积阶段之后加入的位置编码无法提供该信息。随后提出计算图裁剪（Computation Graph Clipping）方法：依据布局确定有效性掩码并施加于每一层的运算，使无效区域在前向与反向传播中等价于零填充，从而在不引入额外参数的情况下消除噪声，使实际梯度与理想梯度一致，改进方法命名为Mask IPL。
AI.result: 在不增加参数与计算开销的前提下，Mask IPL在FE108、FELT、VisEvent数据集上提升了Tiny-scale跟踪器的AUC，同时也一致地提升了Base-scale跟踪器。
AI.conclusion: IPL的有效性并非来自其本身，而是源于IPL与多级卷积的协同所产生的边界效应驱动梯度；IPL本身会带来前向推理误差与反向收敛障碍。Mask IPL通过基于布局的有效性掩码实现计算图裁剪，在不增加参数和计算成本的情况下消除该噪声、对齐实际与理想梯度，并在多个事件跟踪基准上取得一致的性能提升。

title: LocQE: Principled Domain Adaptation for Localisation Quality Estimation by Leveraging Post-Edits
summary: Learned quality estimation (QE) models such as COMETKiwi are widespread and work well for general machine translation evaluation. However, they are known to struggle on unseen domains, limiting their performance in a real-world localisation context. We show that they are insensitive to some important factors in localisation, such as whether numbers are translated accurately, or even whether the correct number of spaces and punctuation are preserved in a translation. Further, a key capability for optimisation of machine translation is the ability of QE models to accurately rank different translations of a single segment, which suffers significantly from the domain transfer. In the absence of large-scale direct assessment data, we propose principled fine-tuning approaches to reduce the domain gap with even small amounts of post-editing data. Using a multi-task fine-tuning approach and a simple tokeniser intervention, we create a QE model which proves markedly better at distinguishing preferred post-edits from rejected initial translations in a localisation context. We show that preferences and artificial continuous scores stabilise each other, and argue that to calibrate metrics both in terms of their absolute scores and comparisons between translation of the same source, both types of signal are needed.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对质量估计(QE)模型(如COMETKiwi)在未见过领域(尤其是本地化场景)表现不佳的问题,提出基于多任务微调与分词器干预的方法,仅用少量后编辑数据即可显著提升模型区分优选后编辑与拒收初译的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有QE模型如COMETKiwi在通用机器翻译评测上表现良好,但在真实本地化场景中存在明显的领域迁移问题:对数字翻译是否准确、空格与标点数量是否保留等本地化关键因素不敏感;同时在单片段多译文排序(优化机器翻译的关键能力)上也因领域迁移而大幅退化。而大规模直接评估(direct assessment)数据的缺乏限制了改进空间。
AI.method: 在缺乏大规模直接评估数据的前提下,作者提出有原则的微调方法来缩小领域差距,仅依赖少量后编辑(post-editing)数据:采用多任务微调(multi-task fine-tuning)策略,并结合一个简单的分词器(tokeniser)干预手段,构建面向本地化场景的QE模型。方法同时利用偏好信号与人工连续评分信号。
AI.result: 所构建的QE模型在本地化场景中区分优选后编辑与拒收初译的能力显著优于基线;实验表明偏好信号与人工连续评分信号能够相互稳定,两者结合对度量指标的校准更有效。
AI.conclusion: 仅需少量后编辑数据即可通过多任务微调与分词器干预有效缓解QE模型的领域迁移问题。作者主张,要使度量指标在绝对分数与同一源句不同译文比较两方面都得到良好校准,偏好信号与连续评分信号二者缺一不可。

title: The Temporal Tug-of-War: Visualizing and Detecting RAG Conflicts in Diffusion Models via Trajectory Variance
comment: Accepted at the UncertaiNLP Workshop at EMNLP 2026
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) introduces a specific failure mode in discrete diffusion language models: when retrieved context contradicts parametric knowledge, the iterative denoising process becomes a visible battleground between competing knowledge sources. We identify temporal semantic divergence as an observable for detecting these conflicts and introduce the Trajectory Variance Score (TVS), a simple and interpretable measure of this divergence. TVS computes the mean pairwise cosine distance of answer embeddings across independent stochastic denoising trajectories, capturing the temporal tug of war between parametric and contextual attractors. Requiring as few as two parallel inference runs, TVS is computationally lightweight. Across four diverse datasets (Synthetic, SciQ, PopQA, and CounterFact), a simple Logistic Regression classifier using TVS achieves $70.10\%$ accuracy and $0.7647$ AUROC on LLaDA. On Dream 7B, increasing the number of trajectories from two to five improves accuracy from $63.91\%$ to $69.62\%$. More complex sequential models provide only marginal improvements over the linear classifier. Evaluation across LLaDA and Dream 7B demonstrates that conflict-induced trajectory dynamics and their key properties transfer across distinct diffusion architectures.

AI.tldr: 提出轨迹方差分数（TVS），通过量化离散扩散语言模型去噪轨迹的发散程度来检测检索上下文与参数知识冲突，轻量且可跨架构迁移。
AI.motivation: RAG在离散扩散语言模型中引入特定失效模式：当检索上下文与参数知识矛盾时，迭代去噪过程成为两类知识源的拉锯战场，此类冲突缺乏可观测的检测手段。
AI.method: 识别"时间语义发散"作为冲突可观测量，提出TVS——计算多条独立随机去噪轨迹上答案嵌入的平均成对余弦距离，捕捉参数吸引子与上下文吸引子之间的时间拉锯；仅需两条并行推理即可计算，成本极低；配合简单逻辑回归分类器。
AI.result: 在LLaDA上，基于TVS的逻辑回归分类器达70.10%准确率、0.7647 AUROC；Dream 7B上轨迹数从2增至5，准确率由63.91%升至69.62%；更复杂的序列模型仅带来边际提升。
AI.conclusion: 冲突诱导的轨迹动力学及其关键特性在LLaDA与Dream 7B等不同扩散架构间可迁移，表明TVS具有跨模型通用性。

title: "If I Had to Buy Just ONE: Galaxy S26 Ultra": Auditing AI-Generated Product Recommendations
summary: Consumers increasingly use AI chatbots for advice on what to buy. With companies like OpenAI and Google monetising their AI through advertising, this raises difficult questions about the bias and impartiality of such advice. In response, we conduct an AI audit of popular chatbots using real commercial-advice queries. First, we curate a dataset of 2,528 real commercial-advice queries (ConsumerQ). Then, we evaluate 1,536 responses to product queries from popular AI chatbots: ChatGPT (chatbot and API), Google Gemini (chatbot and API), and Google Search (AI Overviews). We find that ChatGPT expresses a first-person product preference in 79% of product-recommending responses, compared with 7% for Gemini and 2% for AI Overviews, while the products recommended often change across repeated requests. Displayed sources vary strongly: for the same query, the ChatGPT and Gemini interfaces share only 5.4% of domains on average, with no domain in common in 76.7% of comparisons. APIs provide a different view from their corresponding interfaces, with mean domain overlaps of 12.0% for ChatGPT and 14.8% for Gemini, and also differ in the types and layers of source information they expose. Our findings show that neither isolated responses nor API observations can be assumed to represent the commercial advice consumers encounter. Independent audits of AI-mediated commercial advice should therefore account for repeated responses, consumer-facing conditions, and the source layer being observed.

AI.tldr: 该论文对主流AI聊天机器人进行AI审计，发现其商业建议存在严重的偏好表达、结果不稳定与来源差异问题，指出单一响应或API观测均无法代表消费者实际接触到的商业建议。
AI.motivation: 消费者越来越多地借助AI聊天机器人获取购买建议，而OpenAI、谷歌等企业正通过广告将AI变现，这使此类建议的偏见与公正性成为亟待回答的问题。
AI.method: 构建包含2,528条真实商业咨询查询的数据集（ConsumerQ），并对ChatGPT（聊天界面与API）、Google Gemini（聊天界面与API）及Google Search（AI Overviews）的1,536条产品查询响应进行审计，比较第一人称偏好表达、重复请求下的推荐变化、展示来源及界面与API的域名重叠情况。
AI.result: ChatGPT在79%的产品推荐响应中表达第一人称产品偏好，Gemini为7%，AI Overviews为2%，且推荐产品在重复请求间常发生变化；同一查询下ChatGPT与Gemini界面平均仅共享5.4%的域名，76.7%的比较无任何共同域名；API与对应界面视角不同，ChatGPT平均域名重叠12.0%、Gemini为14.8%，且所披露来源信息的类型与层级也不同。
AI.conclusion: 孤立的单次响应或API观测均不能代表消费者实际遇到的商业建议；对AI介导商业建议的独立审计应纳入重复响应、面向消费者的实际条件以及所观测的来源层级。

title: Geometry beneath the Waves: Dense Priors for Sparse-View Underwater 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Underwater 3D reconstruction remains challenging under sparse views, where scattering, absorption, and suspended particles degrade feature correspondences and geometric estimation. Although feed-forward geometry foundation models offer an alternative to conventional Structure-from-Motion, their direct application underwater produces noisy and fragmented geometry that limits subsequent 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). We propose a sparse-view underwater reconstruction framework that adapts feed-forward geometry to underwater degradation and exploits its dense geometric priors for view synthesis. First, we adapt VGGT using LoRA and teacher--student distillation, training on synthetically degraded underwater images while preserving clean geometric supervision. This improves robustness to underwater appearance distortions without modifying the pretrained prediction heads. Second, the predicted dense geometry initialises an intermediate 3DGS representation that generates geometry-guided pseudo-views, increasing view overlap and strengthening feature tracks for subsequent RUSplatting optimisation. Experiments on SeaThru-NeRF and Submerged3D demonstrate improved reconstruction quality under sparse-view conditions. On SeaThru-NeRF, our method improves RUSplatting from 24.37 to 27.11 dB PSNR and increases SSIM from 0.7611 to 0.8634, while achieving the best average PSNR and LPIPS on Submerged3D. These results demonstrate the potential of domain-adapted geometric priors for robust sparse-view underwater 3D reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种稀疏视角水下重建框架，通过将前馈几何模型（VGGT）域适应到水下退化，并利用其稠密几何先验初始化中间3DGS表示以生成伪视角，从而增强特征匹配，提升后续RUSplatting优化质量。
AI.motivation: 水下3D重建在稀疏视角下困难重重：散射、吸收和悬浮颗粒破坏特征对应与几何估计。前馈几何基础模型虽可替代传统SfM，但直接应用于水下会产生噪声大、碎片化的几何，限制后续3DGS效果。
AI.method: 1) 用LoRA和教师-学生蒸馏对VGGT进行域适应，在合成退化水下图像上训练并保留干净几何监督，增强对水下外观畸变的鲁棒性且不修改预训练预测头；2) 用预测的稠密几何初始化一个中间3DGS表示，生成几何引导的伪视角，增大视角重叠、强化特征轨迹，服务于后续RUSplatting优化。
AI.result: 在SeaThru-NeRF和Submerged3D上验证，稀疏视角重建质量提升。在SeaThru-NeRF上，将RUSplatting从24.37提升至27.11 dB PSNR，SSIM从0.7611提升至0.8634；在Submerged3D上取得最佳平均PSNR和LPIPS。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明域适应几何先验对鲁棒的稀疏视角水下3D重建具有潜力。

title: A Scalable Framework for Automated NER Annotation Correction in Low-Resource Languages
summary: Poor quality or noisy annotations in Named Entity Recognition (NER), as in any other NLP task, make it challenging to achieve state-of-the-art performance. In this paper, we present a multi-step framework to enhance the annotation quality of NER datasets by employing automated techniques. We propose a frequency-based iterative approach that leverages self-training and a dual-threshold mechanism to enhance inference confidence. Experimental evaluations on different NER datasets demonstrate significant improvements in NER performance with respect to the original datasets. This work further explores the potential of generative Large Language Models (LLMs) to perform NER for low-resource languages.

AI.tldr: 提出一种多步骤自动化框架，利用基于频率的迭代方法、自训练与双阈值机制提升NER数据集标注质量，并在多数据集上验证性能提升，同时探索生成式LLM在低资源语言NER中的应用潜力。
AI.motivation: NER任务中低质量或噪声标注会阻碍模型达到最优性能，因此需要提升数据集标注质量的方法。
AI.method: 构建多步骤自动化框架，采用基于频率的迭代方法，结合自训练（self-training）与双阈值机制来提升推理置信度；并探索生成式大语言模型（LLM）用于低资源语言NER。
AI.result: 在多个不同NER数据集上的实验表明，相较于原始数据集，NER性能获得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 自动化标注增强框架能有效改善NER数据质量与模型性能，生成式LLM在低资源语言NER中也展现潜力。

title: TeleAntiFraud 2.0: A Refreshable, Profile-Grounded, and Audio-Based Benchmark for Telecom Fraud Detection
summary: Telecom fraud scripts evolve rapidly and are often designed to resemble routine service conversations, creating two key requirements for audio-based telecom-fraud evaluation. First, benchmarks must incorporate newly observed scam patterns without overwriting previously established test sets. Second, they must distinguish fraud from lawful, near-domain calls rather than relying on topic-separated negative examples. We present TeleAntiFraud 2.0, constructed with our Mixed-Tree Anti-Fraud Generation Pipeline and evaluated under a monthly frozen evaluation protocol. The pipeline transforms online fraud-case abstracts into profile-grounded scenarios, expands them through mixed-tree generation, realizes fraud and non-fraud dialogue paths under shared contexts, renders validated dialogues as role-matched speech, and freezes the resulting audio, labels, prompts, manifests, and provenance records for each monthly evaluation set. Each frozen set contains 900 Chinese calls, comprising 600 fraud and 300 near-domain non-fraud cases. Controlled text experiments show that three classifiers achieve perfect macro-averaged F1 (Macro-F1) when evaluated against unrelated or ordinary negatives, but drop to 0.65-0.68 with near-domain sibling negatives. Full-set audio and automatic-speech-recognition plus large-language-model (ASR+LLM) evaluations further reveal class-prior shortcuts, prediction collapse, and snapshot sensitivity. Together, these findings establish near-domain construction and collapse-aware reporting as core requirements for evaluating audio-based telecom-fraud models under realistic confusable conditions. The accompanying research artifact includes the construction code, evaluation scripts, manifests, and documentation. Our dataset and code are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TeleAntiFraud-2_0-EEB2/.

AI.tldr: 提出 TeleAntiFraud 2.0 音频电信诈骗评测基准，采用 Mixed-Tree 生成流水线与月度冻结评测协议，强调近域负样本与坍塌感知报告。
AI.motivation: 电信诈骗话术演化快且模仿常规客服对话，现有基准难以在不覆盖旧测试集的情况下纳入新骗术，且多用话题区分的负样本，无法区分诈骗与合法近域通话，导致评测失真。
AI.method: 构建 Mixed-Tree Anti-Fraud Generation Pipeline：将线上诈骗案例摘要转化为画像锚定场景，经混合树扩展，在共享语境下生成诈骗与非诈骗对话路径，渲染为角色匹配语音，并冻结音频、标签、提示、清单与溯源记录，按月发布评测集（每套900条中文通话，600诈骗+300近域非诈骗）。
AI.result: 控制文本实验中，三个分类器在无关或普通负样本下达到完美 Macro-F1，但在近域同源负样本下降至0.65–0.68；全集音频及 ASR+LLM 评测进一步暴露类别先验捷径、预测坍塌与快照敏感性问题。
AI.conclusion: 近域构造与坍塌感知报告应成为真实易混条件下音频电信诈骗模型评测的核心要求；研究工件包含构建代码、评测脚本、清单与文档。

title: Toward Markerless Video-based Tremor Analysis: Objective Quantification of Pathological Tremor in Mouse Preclinical Models
summary: Tremor is a movement disorder characterized by involuntary, rhythmic oscillations of body parts and is a hallmark of several neurological conditions, including Parkinson's disease and essential tremor. Elucidating its underlying mechanisms relies heavily on mouse models, which offer genetic manipulability and translational relevance to human neural circuitry. Accordingly, these models are indispensable for studying tremor pathophysiology. So far, electromyography and accelerometers have been used as methods to quantitatively observe tremors in mice. However, these methods have several drawbacks, such as high costs and complex setups. In particular, the invasive surgical implantation of devices causes significant stress to the animals. Although RGB-based methods offer non-invasive and cost-effective alternatives, they often lack the sensitivity required to detect subtle tremors. Therefore, this paper addresses these challenges by achieving mouse tremor severity estimation using conventional RGB cameras only. To address the challenging task of isolating tremor-related vibrations while the mouse itself is also in motion, our pipeline incorporates segmentation-based pre-processing to extract the mouse region and a Tremor Score Estimation Module that captures subtle tremors with high sensitivity. In the experiments, we assessed tremors in unrestrained mice using a non-invasive method with two standard cameras. The results demonstrated a strong correlation with accelerometer measurements and confirmed that the method accurately captured the intensity-dependent characteristics of tremors. The project page is available at https://isogawalab.github.io/Video-based-Tremor-Analysis-Project/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种仅用普通RGB相机的非侵入式小鼠震颤严重程度估计方法，通过分割预处理与震颤分数估计模块，在无束缚小鼠中实现与加速度计高度相关的震颤量化。
AI.motivation: 震颤是帕金森病、特发性震颤等神经系统疾病的标志性症状，其机制研究高度依赖小鼠模型。现有定量观测手段（肌电图、加速度计）成本高、装置复杂，且侵入式手术植入会给动物带来显著应激；RGB方法虽非侵入且低成本，但灵敏度不足，难以检测细微震颤。
AI.method: 仅使用普通RGB相机进行小鼠震颤严重程度估计。针对小鼠自身运动与震颤振动难以分离的难题，流程包含：基于分割的预处理以提取小鼠区域，以及一个高灵敏度捕捉细微震颤的震颤分数估计模块。实验中用两台标准相机以非侵入方式评估无束缚小鼠的震颤。
AI.result: 结果与加速度计测量值呈强相关，并证实该方法能准确刻画震颤的强度依赖性特征。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为小鼠震颤研究提供了一种非侵入、低成本且灵敏的RGB相机替代方案，有望替代传统肌电/加速度计手段，减轻动物应激并提升实验可及性。

title: Bootstrapping Conversational Recommendation Agents At Spotify: Synthetic Data Generation and Self-Improvement Loops
summary: Conversational recommendation agents are a new paradigm for content discovery, enabling users to express complex intents through natural language (e.g., "recommend Italian indie artists I haven't heard before"). A central challenge in building such agents is optimizing agent planning -- deciding how to select, sequence, and invoke tools -- particularly in cold-start settings where real user interactions are not yet available. We introduce a pipeline for multi-turn synthetic data generation and a self-improvement loop to address this challenge. The synthetic data pipeline transforms single-turn prompts into realistic multi-turn conversations, enabling systematic evaluation before launch. The self-improvement loop combines variance-based contrastive optimization with iterative refinement through a coding agent, automatically identifying and fixing planning and tool-use errors. Our approach improves quality by +8% on top of a highly optimized manual prompt. The system has been productionized and significantly accelerated iteration cycles for the launch of a conversational recommendation agent at Spotify. Online A/B tests demonstrate its effectiveness, with +14% user listening, +5% increase in weekly active users, and a 5% reduction in skip rate compared to a prior experience supporting only session refinement. This work provides a practical framework for accelerating the development of conversational recommendation agents in industry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套面向对话式推荐智能体的多轮合成数据生成管线与自我改进循环，用于优化智能体的规划与工具调用，并在Spotify落地验证。
AI.motivation: 对话式推荐智能体需通过自然语言表达复杂意图，其核心挑战在于优化智能体规划（工具的选择、排序与调用），尤其在缺乏真实用户交互数据的冷启动场景下难以系统评估与迭代。
AI.method: 方法包含两个部分：（1）多轮合成数据生成管线，将单轮提示转换为逼真的多轮对话，支持上线前系统性评估；（2）自我改进循环，结合基于方差的对比优化与通过编码智能体进行的迭代精炼，自动识别并修复规划与工具使用中的错误。
AI.result: 在高度优化的人工提示基础上质量再提升+8%；在线A/B测试显示用户收听量+14%、周活跃用户+5%、跳过率下降5%（相较仅支持会话精炼的既有体验）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为工业界加速对话式推荐智能体的开发提供了可落地的实践框架，并已实现产品化，显著加快迭代周期。

title: FRAUDSkill: Structured Frozen-Weight Skill Optimization for Audio Anti-Fraud Detection
summary: Large audio-language models have shown promise for anti-fraud detection by directly processing speech and reasoning over fraud-related evidence. Their deployment, however, requires predictions to follow a predefined label space and a structured decision protocol consisting of service-scenario identification, fraud detection, and conditional fraud-type classification. Existing fine-tuning and prompt-based approaches typically encode task knowledge, constraints, and decision rules into model parameters or manually maintained prompts, making them difficult to adapt as fraud patterns and labeling policies evolve. To this end, we propose FRAUDSkill, a structured frozen-weight adaptation framework that leaves the underlying audio-language model unchanged while optimizing an external layer of skill programs, route-specific policies, and decision rules. We further combine structured output control with validation-guided multi-path inference to ensure protocol-compliant predictions. On the TeleAntiFraud benchmark, FRAUDSkill achieves 73.50% Macro-F1, outperforming the shared frozen-model baseline by 31.96% while reducing invalid outputs to 1.94%. Extensive experiments demonstrate that external skill optimization provides an effective and adaptable solution for structured audio anti-fraud detection without modifying the underlying model. The source code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/FRAUDSKILL-114514.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出FRAUDSkill框架，在冻结音频语言模型权重的前提下，通过外部技能程序、路由策略和决策规则实现结构化音频反诈检测，并在TeleAntiFraud基准上显著优于共享冻结模型基线。
AI.motivation: 现有音频语言模型反诈方法依赖微调或人工提示，将任务知识、约束与决策规则编码进模型参数或手工提示中，难以适应不断演变的诈骗模式与标注政策；而实际部署要求预测遵循预定义标签空间及包含服务场景识别、诈骗检测与条件式诈骗类型分类的结构化决策协议。
AI.method: 提出FRAUDSkill，一种结构化冻结权重适配框架：保持底层音频语言模型不变，仅优化外部技能程序层、路由特定策略与决策规则；结合结构化输出控制与验证引导的多路径推理，确保预测符合协议要求。
AI.result: 在TeleAntiFraud基准上，FRAUDSkill取得73.50% Macro-F1，较共享冻结模型基线提升31.96%，并将无效输出降至1.94%。
AI.conclusion: 大量实验表明，外部技能优化为结构化音频反诈检测提供了一种有效且可适配的解决方案，无需修改底层模型；源代码已公开。

title: Zero-Shot Cross-Lingual Recognition of Sign Language Handshapes
comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Sign Language Processing (WSLP), EMNLP 2026
summary: Sign language processing advances rapidly for high-resource languages such as American Sign Language (ASL), yet most of the world's sign languages lack the phonological annotations new methods require. We present the first zero-shot cross-lingual framework for handshape recognition, transferring from ASL to Catalan Sign Language (LSC). Our approach leverages the decomposition of handshapes into five phonological features -- selected fingers, flexion, spread, thumb position, and thumb contact -- shared across both languages, to decode LSC handshapes from predicted features via a composite phonological distance metric. We evaluate three architectures (MLP, SL-GCN, SHuBERT) trained on two ASL corpora (PopSign, Sem-Lex) against a 37-handshape, single-signer LSC benchmark. Zero-shot transfer proves viable once recording-format disparities are harmonized, reaching 80.0% phonological feature accuracy and 54.5% expected handshape accuracy. Phonological decomposition thus offers a bridge for extending sign language technologies to low-resource languages without any target-language video training labels.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出首个面向手形识别的零样本跨语言框架，从美国手语（ASL）迁移至加泰罗尼亚手语（LSC），在无任何目标语言视频标注下实现可行性迁移。
AI.motivation: 手语处理在ASL等高资源语言中发展迅速，但全球多数手语缺乏新方法所需的音系标注数据，导致技术难以推广至低资源语言，因此需要寻找无需目标语言标注的跨语言迁移途径。
AI.method: 利用ASL与LSC共享的五项手形音系特征（选指、屈曲、展开、拇指位置、拇指接触）进行分解，先由模型预测这些特征，再通过复合音系距离度量解码LSC手形。实验训练三种架构（MLP、SL-GCN、SHuBERT），数据来自两个ASL语料库（PopSign、Sem-Lex），测试于37个手形、单被试的LSC基准。
AI.result: 在统一录制格式差异后，零样本迁移可行，达到80.0%的音系特征准确率和54.5%的期望手形准确率。
AI.conclusion: 音系分解为在无目标语言视频训练标签的情况下，将手语技术扩展至低资源语言提供了可行桥梁。

title: DISTA-Net++: Rethinking Infrared Small Target Unmixing Beyond Sub-Pixel Separation
summary: Long-range infrared imaging frequently confronts dense target clusters whose diffraction-limited signatures merge into a single indistinguishable blob, concealing the number, sub-pixel positions, and radiant intensities of the underlying sources. While deep learning has advanced general object detection, resolving such Closely-Spaced Infrared Small Targets (CSIST) remains largely unexplored, owing to a systemic infrastructure void and a fundamental paradigm mismatch. The dominant formulation, which reduces unmixing to a blind, discrete sub-pixel separation, is inherently insufficient: without semantic guidance, the ill-posed inverse problem admits ambiguous solutions plagued by false and missed detections, while grid-based discretization locks predictions onto fixed lattice centers, chaining precision to prohibitively expensive grid refinement. We argue that CSIST unmixing should instead be informed and continuous. To ground this paradigm shift, we establish the first comprehensive open-source ecosystem for the field, comprising the large-scale CSIST-100K benchmark, a tailored metric suite, and the GrokCSO toolkit. Upon this foundation, we propose DISTA-Net++, which anchors a dynamic deep unfolding backbone with two synergistic mechanisms: a Count-Guided Prior that injects the global target count as an explicit semantic constraint to regularize the solution space, and a Continuous Coordinate Rectification that regresses off-grid offsets to decouple localization accuracy from grid resolution. Extensive experiments validate our paradigm: even under the most economical 3x division, DISTA-Net++ surpasses 7x-division state-of-the-art methods by 16.15% in CSO-mAP and 62.96% in count accuracy at merely one-sixth of their computation, demonstrating that unmixing precision need not be purchased with finer discretization. The complete ecosystem is available at https://github.com/GrokCV/GrokDet.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"信息引导+连续化"的CSIST解混新范式，构建首个开源生态（CSIST-100K基准、专用指标、GrokCSO工具包），并提出DISTA-Net++，通过计数引导先验与连续坐标修正，在低网格划分下大幅超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 远距离红外成像中，密集目标簇的衍射受限信号融合为单一模糊斑块，隐藏了目标数量、亚像素位置与辐射强度。现有主流做法将解混简化为盲的、离散的亚像素分离，缺乏语义引导导致病态逆问题解模糊（虚警与漏检），且基于网格的离散化将精度锁定在固定晶格中心，使精度受限于代价高昂的网格细化。因此需要转向"信息引导且连续"的解混范式。
AI.method: 1) 构建首个全面开源生态：大规模CSIST-100K基准、定制化指标套件、GrokCSO工具包；2) 提出DISTA-Net++，以动态深度展开（deep unfolding）为骨干；3) 引入计数引导先验（Count-Guided Prior），将全局目标计数作为显式语义约束以正则化解空间；4) 引入连续坐标修正（Continuous Coordinate Rectification），回归离网格偏移，使定位精度与网格分辨率解耦。
AI.result: 在最经济的3×划分下，DISTA-Net++在CSO-mAP上超越7×划分的SOTA方法16.15%，计数准确率超越62.96%，而计算量仅为后者的六分之一，证明解混精度无需以更细离散化为代价。
AI.conclusion: CSIST解混应被"信息引导且连续化"；语义计数约束与连续坐标回归可有效破解病态逆问题与网格离散化瓶颈，在低计算成本下实现更高精度。所构建的开源生态为该方向提供了基础设施。

title: Dimensionality reduction for AI based hyperspectral image classification based on XAI
comment: The paper has been presented at the Annual Workshop of the Austrian Association for Pattern Recognition (OAGM) 2023 - Patterns in One Health - Oct 24-25, 2023, Vienna, Austria
summary: This research addresses the challenge of limited material recycling in wood recycling processes by leveraging artificial intelligence (AI)-based dimensionality reduction. Our study explores the application of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) in multi-channel hyperspectral imaging (HSI), extending beyond RGB channels to over 200 spectral channels. Dimensionality reduction within this context involves streamlining the feature space for AI system training and inference. Focusing on explainable AI (XAI) methods, this paper contributes to a broader research initiative, presenting a solution framework that enhances the sustainability and efficiency of wood recycling processes.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用基于AI的降维方法，通过多通道高光谱成像（超过200个光谱通道）和卷积神经网络，提升木材回收过程的可持续性与效率。
AI.motivation: 木材回收过程中材料回收率有限，需要通过技术手段改善回收的可持续性与效率。
AI.method: 采用卷积神经网络（CNN）处理多通道高光谱成像（HSI）数据，突破RGB三通道限制，使用超过200个光谱通道；通过降维精简特征空间以支持AI系统的训练与推理，并聚焦可解释AI（XAI）方法。
AI.result: 提出了一个解决方案框架，将AI降维与XAI方法结合应用于木材回收场景，扩展了光谱通道的使用范围。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为提升木材回收过程的可持续性和效率提供了基于AI降维与可解释性方法的框架，并作为更广泛研究计划的一部分。

title: Beyond frequency measures: Can contextual embeddings capture meaning change in scientific texts?
summary: Identifying technological trends is a core scientometric task, yet traditional frequency-based approaches struggle to capture substantial meaning shifts of domain-specific terms. We hypothesise that contextual embeddings can complement frequency dynamics to effectively track diachronic semantic change. We compare frequency and embedding-based approaches across Astrophysics and NLP corpora spanning from 2010 to 2024. Candidate terms are extracted using KeyBERT (utilizing SciBERT as its underlying language model) and filtered for significant frequency increases using Fisher's exact test. These terms are then evaluated for genuine semantic shift by domain experts to establish ground-truth labels. To quantify semantic drift, each term's contextual embedding ''clouds'' from the two discrete periods are compared using multiple metrics: cosine distance, average pairwise distance, Hotelling-type T 2 , and maximum mean discrepancy. Results indicate that frequency-based methods align slightly better with human judgments of ''trend-related terms'' than semantic metrics (Precision@50 of 0.62 vs 0.60 in Astrophysics). The two signals show a correlation of around 0.6. Several terms identified exclusively by embedding metrics (e.g., ''primordial black holes'') represent critical conceptual developments invisible to pure frequency analysis. These findings indicate that semantic metrics may capture complementary information, highlighting the value of integrating contextual embeddings into scientometric trend analysis.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了基于频率与基于上下文嵌入的语义漂移方法在科技趋势识别中的效果，发现两者互补：频率方法略更贴合专家判断，但嵌入方法能捕捉频率分析忽略的概念性发展。
AI.motivation: 识别科技趋势是科学计量学的核心任务，但传统基于频率的方法难以捕捉领域专有术语的重大语义变化（meaning shift）。作者假设上下文嵌入可以补充频率动态，从而有效追踪跨时段的语义变化。
AI.method: 在天体物理与NLP语料（2010–2024）上比较频率与嵌入方法。用KeyBERT（底层语言模型为SciBERT）提取候选术语，通过Fisher精确检验筛选频率显著上升的术语；由领域专家评估真实语义漂移以建立金标准标签。对语义漂移的量化采用多种指标比较两个时段术语的上下文嵌入"云"：余弦距离、平均成对距离、Hotelling型T²以及最大均值差异（MMD）。
AI.result: 频率方法在与人类对"趋势相关术语"判断的一致性上略优于语义指标（天体物理中Precision@50为0.62 vs 0.60）；两种信号的相关系数约为0.6。部分仅由嵌入指标识别出的术语（如"原初黑洞"）代表频率分析无法察觉的关键概念发展。
AI.conclusion: 语义指标可捕捉互补信息，将上下文嵌入整合进科学计量趋势分析具有重要价值。

title: Using OCR Heads to Verbalize Image Semantics
summary: How do VLMs map from pixels to semantics? To understand this general question, we focus on a narrow one: studying how VLMs perform optical character recognition (OCR). Across four models, we identify attention heads causally necessary for OCR, and discover that these are in fact general-purpose heads that output interpretable semantic features across all image tokens. For example, pointing these heads at an image token containing the word "bike" causes Qwen3-VL-8B to output "bike," but pointing them at a bird wing causes the model to output the token "feathers." We collapse these heads' attention weights into a single verbalization lens transformation that reveals interpretable semantic features in hidden states across all layers. When combined with projection to vocabulary space, we can obtain interpretable labels starting from layer 0, showing that image representations are in fact aligned with language in early layers. We find that we can also use the inverse of this transformation to edit non-word concepts, e.g., replacing a tractor with a revolver in a naturalistic image, providing causal evidence that this subspace is useful for more than just OCR. Our results are an example of how the study of specific mechanisms can shed light on broader interpretability problems.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过OCR作为切入点，揭示VLM中存在因果必要的通用语义注意力头，并构建"言语化透镜"变换，证明图像表征在早期层即与语言对齐，且该子空间可用于编辑非词汇概念。
AI.motivation: 核心问题是VLM如何从像素映射到语义。作者选择OCR这一狭窄任务作为突破口，希望借助具体机制的研究来反哺更广泛的VLM可解释性问题。
AI.method: 在四个VLM模型上定位对OCR因果必要的注意力头；发现这些头是输出可解释语义特征的通用头；将它们的注意力权重坍缩为单一的"言语化透镜"（verbalization lens）变换，并结合投影到词表空间，从而在各层隐藏状态中读取语义标签；进一步利用该变换的逆变换编辑图像中的非词汇概念。
AI.result: 指向含"bike"的图像token时Qwen3-VL-8B输出"bike"，指向鸟翼时输出"feathers"；结合词表投影后可从第0层起获得可解释标签，表明图像表征在早期层就与语言对齐；逆变换可将自然图像中的拖拉机替换为左轮手枪，提供该子空间不仅服务于OCR的因果证据。
AI.conclusion: 特定机制（OCR注意力头）的研究能够揭示VLM中通用语义子空间的存在及其跨层、跨概念的适用性，为理解像素到语义的映射提供了可解释性视角。

title: Open ultrasound foundation model for robust segmentation and clinical measurement across heterogeneous settings
comment: The PDF includes the Supplementary Information
summary: Ultrasound is the most widely deployed imaging modality worldwide, yet clinical AI remains fragmented into narrow single-task models that fail when device, operator, or anatomy changes. Here we present SonoCorpus, an open resource unifying 456,963 images and 1,626,085 expert masks from 53 public datasets spanning 24 clinical applications and 17 countries, and SonoBase, an interactive segmentation foundation model pretrained on it. Across fifteen evaluation datasets introducing new organs, devices, operators, and geographies, SonoBase outperforms SAM2, MedSAM2, and the concept-promptable MedSAM3 on every dataset and matches per-dataset specialist models trained on the same data; on fully external data it exceeds the accuracy these baselines achieve on their own in-distribution benchmarks.
