Ejection fraction derived from its segmentations falls within inter-observer variability (6.63\% error), with fewer misclassifications at the defibrillator-candidacy threshold than either promptable baseline (13\% versus 18--42\%); fetal head-circumference (1.81~mm) and gestational-age (1.2 days) errors fall below inter-observer variability. Where a baseline fails outright, one in four test cases, SonoBase recovers a usable segmentation in 81\% of them, including on handheld probes operated by minimally trained users in two low- and middle-income countries (Sierra Leone and Tanzania). Five labeled examples can help the model adapt to a new setting, and the identical training protocol transfers well to newer models such as SAM3, locating the advantage in ultrasound-specific pretraining rather than any single architecture. To ensure reproducibility and enable the community to build on SonoBase as a platform, we release all checkpoints, optimizer states, data-split indices, deduplication hashes, and starter code.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了迄今最大规模的超声开放资源SonoCorpus（456,963张图像、1,626,085个专家掩膜，覆盖53个公开数据集、24类临床应用、17个国家），并基于其预训练交互式分割基础模型SonoBase。SonoBase在15个评测数据集上全面超越SAM2、MedSAM2和MedSAM3，并达到与同数据训练的单任务专家模型相当的性能；其分割结果导出的射血分数、胎儿头围与孕龄误差均低于观察者间变异，且在基线模型完全失败的病例中81%可恢复出可用分割，5个标注样本即可适应新场景。
AI.motivation: 超声是全球部署最广的影像模态，但临床AI仍以孤立的单任务模型为主，一旦设备、操作者或解剖部位发生变化即失效，缺乏统一、可迁移的超声基础模型与大规模开放数据资源。
AI.method: 整合53个公开数据集构建SonoCorpus（456,963张图像、1,626,085个专家掩膜，涵盖24类临床应用、17个国家），并在此数据上以统一训练协议预训练交互式超声分割基础模型SonoBase；通过15个引入新器官、新设备、新操作者和新地域的评测数据集，与SAM2、MedSAM2、MedSAM3及同数据训练的单任务专家模型进行对比，并开展外部数据、低资源手持探头场景、少样本自适应及训练协议向SAM3迁移等实验。
AI.result: SonoBase在每个评测数据集上均优于SAM2、MedSAM2和MedSAM3，并匹配按数据集训练的专家模型；在完全外部数据上，其精度超过基线在各自分布内基准上的表现。由其分割导出的射血分数误差为6.63%（处于观察者间变异范围内），除颤器适应证阈值处的误分类率为13%（基线为18%–42%）；胎儿头围误差1.81 mm、孕龄误差1.2天，均低于观察者间变异。在基线完全失败（占测试用例四分之一）的情况下，SonoBase在81%的病例中恢复出可用分割，包括塞拉利昂和坦桑尼亚两国由受训极少的用户操作手持探头采集的图像。5个标注样本即可帮助模型适应新场景，且相同训练协议可良好迁移至SAM3等新模型，表明优势源自超声特异性预训练而非特定架构。所有检查点、优化器状态、数据划分索引、去重哈希和入门代码均已公开。
AI.conclusion: SonoBase证明了超声特异性大规模预训练是构建跨设备、跨操作者、跨解剖与跨地域通用分割模型的关键，其性能在多项临床关键指标上已达到或优于观察者间变异水平，并在低资源场景下展现出强鲁棒性与少样本自适应能力；该工作通过开放数据、模型权重与完整训练配置，为社区提供了可复现、可扩展的超声AI基础平台。

title: Copy What Is Seen, Generate What Is Not: Training-Free Anomaly-Aware Video Restoration
summary: A surveillance system that detects an anomaly often has to repair the footage as well, yet the two tasks are studied in isolation: training-free anomaly detectors stop at a score or a label, while training-free video editing answers to a user prompt rather than to a detector. This paper proposes AVR (Anomaly-aware Video Restoration), which closes that gap with frozen pretrained models alone and generates content only where the clip offers no evidence to copy. Motion evidence first gates open-vocabulary proposals into spatio-temporal masks. A background prior computed from the clip then fills every pixel the anomaly ever uncovers, leaving diffusion to synthesize only what no frame showed, and a frozen verifier decides per clip whether to trust a classical, a prior-anchored, or a background-conditioned restorer. Extensive experiments on three surveillance datasets, under both full-reference anomaly injection and real anomalies, show that AVR leads full-frame fidelity under oracle masks, matches three trained video inpainters inside the edited region, and outperforms a detect-then-generate pipeline on the masks it produces itself, while suppressing both the residual anomaly and the flicker of free diffusion.

AI.tldr: 提出 AVR（Anomaly-aware Video Restoration），仅用冻结的预训练模型，将免训练异常检测与视频修复打通，在异常处生成内容而非复制证据。
AI.motivation: 异常检测与视频修复长期被孤立研究：免训练检测器只输出分数或标签，免训练视频编辑只响应提示词而非检测器，导致监控场景中"检测到异常后还需人工修复"的断层。
AI.method: 运动证据先将开放词汇提议门控为时空掩码；由片段计算的背景先验填充异常曾暴露的每个像素，扩散模型只合成任何帧都未呈现的内容；冻结验证器按片段决定采用经典修复器、先验锚定修复器还是背景条件修复器。
AI.result: 在三个监控数据集上，涵盖全参考异常注入与真实异常两种设定：在 oracle 掩码下全帧保真度领先；在编辑区域内与三个训练过的视频修复器相当；在自身生成的掩码上优于"先检测后生成"流程；同时抑制残余异常与自由扩散的闪烁。
AI.conclusion: AVR 证明仅靠冻结预训练模型即可统一异常感知与视频修复，实现免训练、异常驱动的修复，并兼顾保真度与时间稳定性。

title: ReFigBench: Benchmarking Scientific Figure Reconstruction as Editable PowerPoint Artifacts
summary: Multimodal coding agents are expected to turn visual inputs into usable artifacts, and they act through a harness, the layer of tools, context management, and execution environment around the model. Existing evaluations often isolate short tool calls, API traces, or screenshot resemblance, and a low score under these proxies cannot say whether the model saw poorly, planned poorly, or was failed by its harness. We study scientific overview figure reconstruction, an agent task in which a source image must become an editable PowerPoint slide that preserves text, topology, layout, and native document structure. We introduce ReFigBench, a benchmark and evaluation framework built on 1,000 real overview figures retrieved from arXiv papers with full provenance. Coding agents from four model families reconstruct every figure under two workflows, direct code generation and a specialized PPTX workflow, and the strongest model runs inside two commercial harnesses, yielding ten configurations. Evaluation combines deterministic artifact checks, repeated automated scoring by judges from two model families, and blinded human comparisons. Perception remains a bottleneck that iterative rendering only partly repays. Whether workflow effort converts into quality depends on the model together with its harness, since the same model gains from the specialized workflow inside one harness and loses inside the other, and the harness shifts scores even under an identical direct prompt. The specialized workflow erases native connectors in every configuration, human judges still prefer its renderings in most matchups, and even the strongest agent falls short of the rubric ceiling. These results expose the tension between fidelity and editability as the central challenge for practical multimodal document agents.

AI.tldr: 提出 ReFigBench，用 1000 张 arXiv 综述型示意图评估多模态编码智能体将其重建为可编辑 PPTX 的能力，发现感知仍是瓶颈，且工作流收益取决于模型与 harness 的组合。
AI.motivation: 现有评估多局限于短工具调用、API 轨迹或截图相似度，低分无法区分是模型看不好、规划差，还是被其 harness（工具、上下文管理与执行环境层）拖累；同时缺乏对"视觉输入→可用文档产物"这一端到端任务的真实评测。
AI.method: 构建 ReFigBench 基准与评估框架：1,000 张带完整来源信息的 arXiv 综述型示意图；四个模型家族的编码智能体在两种工作流（直接代码生成、专用 PPTX 工作流）下重建；最强模型另在两个商业 harness 中运行，共十种配置；评估结合确定性产物检查、两个模型家族评委的重复自动打分，以及盲测人工比较。
AI.result: 感知仍是瓶颈，迭代渲染仅部分弥补；工作流投入是否转化为质量取决于模型与 harness 的组合——同一模型在一个 harness 中从专用工作流获益、在另一个中反而受损，且即使提示词相同 harness 也会改变分数；专用工作流在所有配置下都会抹除原生连接线，但人工评委在多数对比中仍偏好其渲染结果；最强智能体也未达到评分标准上限。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示了保真度与可编辑性之间的张力，是实用多模态文档智能体的核心挑战。

title: EviGen: Predictive Evidence Scaffolding for Verifiable Clinical Rationale Generation
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 29 pages, 4 figures, 23 tables
summary: Longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs) capture years of patient history across notes, codes, labs, and procedures, and contain evidence needed to reason about likely clinical outcomes. However, comprehensive clinician review of these records is impractical, and LLM-based processing is costly and often unreliable, missing some relevant observations while hallucinating others. We therefore propose EviGen, a three-layer framework for verifiable clinical rationale generation that addresses these challenges. The first layer is a patient-conditioned retriever that uses learnable queries to find evidence predictive of, not just textually relevant to, a clinical outcome and ranks it by prediction attribution scores. The second layer is an LLM generator that consumes this ranked evidence as a scaffold to produce a clinical rationale grounded in the retrieved spans. The third layer is a process-supervised verifier that checks the generated rationale at the reasoning-step level, flagging unreliable claims. Across three medical prediction datasets, EviGen improves prediction performance and rationale faithfulness over full-context LLM and RAG baselines, and is preferred by clinical reviewers in a usability evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出 EviGen 三层框架，用于可验证的临床推理生成：患者条件检索器、LLM 生成器与过程监督验证器。
AI.motivation: 纵向电子健康档案（EHR）包含判断临床结局所需证据，但人工全面审阅不现实，LLM 直接处理成本高且不可靠，会遗漏相关观察并产生幻觉。
AI.method: 三层框架：1）患者条件检索器，用可学习查询检索对结局具有预测性（而非仅文本相关）的证据，并按预测归因分数排序；2）LLM 生成器，以排序后的证据为脚手架生成基于检索片段的临床推理；3）过程监督验证器，在推理步骤级别检查生成内容并标记不可靠断言。
AI.result: 在三个医学预测数据集上，EviGen 在预测性能与推理忠实度上均优于全上下文 LLM 与 RAG 基线，并在可用性评估中被临床评审者偏好。
AI.conclusion: EviGen 通过检索—生成—验证的分层设计，实现了可验证的临床推理生成，兼顾预测性能与推理可信度。

title: Decodable but Misrouted: Sparse Features Uncover a Readout Gap in Vision-Language Models for Harmful Meme Detection
summary: When large vision-language models misclassify harmful memes, the failure may reflect missing internal evidence or an inability to route represented evidence to their outputs. We distinguish these cases in Gemma-3 and Qwen3.5 using sparse autoencoders, role-conditioned probes, causal interventions, and recovery experiments across six harmful content benchmarks, with additional Spanish and Hindi-English code-mixed evaluations. Sparse readouts outperform native prediction on all six primary binary tasks: Qwen averages $0.740$ versus $0.432$ for native macro-F1, residual reconstruction reaches $0.486$, and Gemma improves from $0.532$ to $0.714$. These gains measure how accessible the label is to a supervised readout; they do not show that the model's native generation already applies such a decision rule. Under the evaluated scales, Qwen silent-feature ablation is $24-63$ times more probe-sensitive, whereas routed-feature patching on literal yes/no tasks is $16-140$ times more output-sensitive. Native-only threshold calibration explains much, but not all of the gap: on five tasks with matched probe scores, it recovers $69.8$\% of the raw native-to-probe difference, while direct routing adds $0.094$ mean macro-F1 beyond calibrated native scoring. Joint gold-label, probe-KL, and pairwise LoRA supervision improves dedicated FHM prediction, but a gold-only adapter performs better on the shared seven-task mean. A case study of Gemma-3-12B on the Facebook Hateful Memes dataset finds a distributed rank-32 image-prompt interaction, reaching $0.756$ versus $0.685$ native macro-F1. Robustness controls show that the signal is not explained solely by accompanying OCR and depends on paired visual evidence, and that it extends beyond English. In many of the errors we study, the evidence is represented but does not reach the answer; therefore, routing is a common bottleneck in harmful meme classification.

AI.tldr: 该研究用稀疏自编码器、角色条件探针、因果干预与恢复实验，区分有害表情包分类失败是"内部证据缺失"还是"证据未能路由到输出"，发现多数错误属于后者，路由是常见瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型在有害表情包分类上频繁误判。误判可能源于两种机制：一是模型内部未表征出判别证据；二是证据已被表征却无法被路由到输出决策。既有工作未将二者区分开，因而无法判定瓶颈究竟在表征还是路由。
AI.method: 在Gemma-3与Qwen3.5上，于六个有害内容基准（另含西班牙语及印地语—英语语码混合评测）开展实验：(1) 稀疏自编码器提取稀疏读出特征；(2) 角色条件探针（role-conditioned probes）测量标签可及性；(3) 因果干预——静默特征消融（silent-feature ablation）与路由特征补丁（routed-feature patching）；(4) 恢复实验，包括原生阈值校准与直接路由；(5) LoRA微调对比（金标签、探针-KL、成对监督）；(6) Gemma-3-12B在Facebook Hateful Memes上的rank-32图文交互案例研究及OCR、视觉证据依赖性等鲁棒性控制。
AI.result: 稀疏读出在全部六个二分类任务上均优于原生预测：Qwen宏F1平均0.740对原生0.432，残差重建达0.486；Gemma由0.532提升至0.714。Qwen静默特征消融对探针的敏感度是路由补丁的24–63倍，而字面yes/no任务上路由补丁对输出的敏感度是前者的16–140倍。原生阈值校准在五个探针分数匹配任务上恢复了69.8%的原生—探针差距，直接路由再额外带来0.094平均宏F1。联合金标签、探针-KL与成对LoRA监督提升专用FHM预测，但仅金标签适配器在七任务共享均值上更优。Gemma-3-12B案例中发现分布式rank-32图文交互，宏F1达0.756对原生0.685。鲁棒性控制表明信号并非仅由OCR解释，依赖成对视觉证据，并可跨英语之外的语言。
AI.conclusion: 在所研究的多数错误中，判别证据已被模型表征，但未能到达答案；因此路由而非表征是当前规模下有害表情包分类的主要瓶颈。稀疏读出提升仅反映标签对监督读出器的可及性，并不证明原生生成已应用该决策规则。

title: PersonaPath: Towards Knowledge-Centric Personalized Learning Path Planning
summary: Adaptive learning systems commonly formulate learning path planning as Exercise-Centric (EC) recommendation, where the next step is inferred from item-level interaction logs. Evaluating goal-oriented guidance additionally requires explicit learner goals and curriculum-scale prerequisites: learners with similar exercise records may need different paths toward their targets. We therefore study Knowledge-Centric (KC) personalized learning path planning, where a planner must reason over learner profiles, mastery states, and prerequisite knowledge structures to decide which textbook, unit, and concept should be studied next. To support this setting, we introduce PersonaPath, a benchmark that pairs 2,000 fine-grained learner personas with a hierarchical knowledge graph of 347 textbooks, 1,751 units, and 4,092 concepts across 77 subjects. We evaluate representative LLMs on PersonaPath. Results show that even the strongest LLM reaches only a 29.5% final pass rate in Basic Education, and that the main bottleneck lies in adaptivity, where no model exceeds 44.7% in tailoring paths to individual learners.

AI.tldr: 该文提出知识中心（KC）个性化学习路径规划任务与PersonaPath基准，发现现有LLM在面向个体适配的学习路径规划上表现有限。
AI.motivation: 现有自适应学习系统多采用以习题为中心（EC）的推荐，仅依据题目级交互日志推断下一步，缺乏显式学习目标与课程级先修结构，难以评估目标导向的路径引导；学习记录相似的 learners 可能需要不同的通向目标的路径。
AI.method: 定义知识中心（KC）个性化学习路径规划任务，要求规划器基于学习者画像、掌握状态与先修知识结构，决定下一步应学习的教材、单元与概念；构建PersonaPath基准，包含2,000个细粒度学习者画像，以及覆盖77个学科、347本教材、1,751个单元、4,092个概念的分层知识图谱；并在该基准上评测代表性LLM。
AI.result: 即便最强LLM在基础教育（Basic Education）中的最终通过率也仅为29.5%；主要瓶颈在于适配性（adaptivity），没有模型在为个体学习者定制路径方面超过44.7%。
AI.conclusion: PersonaPath揭示了现有LLM在目标导向、课程级先修约束下的个性化学习路径规划能力不足，尤其缺乏对个体学习者的适配能力，为后续研究提供了新基准与明确改进方向。

title: NormLift: From Lifted Features To Semantic Reliability In 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Training-free weighted aggregation is widely used to lift 2D semantic features onto 3D Gaussians for open-vocabulary scene understanding, yet its theoretical role remains insufficiently understood. Existing analyses typically justify this operation from the rendering side, treating Gaussian features as linearly composable Euclidean variables for reconstructing 2D feature maps. However, this view does not match downstream 3D usage, where each Gaussian is often queried independently in a cosine-based embedding space. We revisit feature lifting from the 3D side and formulate per-Gaussian assignment as a cosine alignment problem on the CLIP unit sphere. Under this objective, the L2-normalized semantic back-projected feature emerges as the closed-form solution, providing a complementary interpretation of the standard lifting rule from the perspective of per-Gaussian semantic assignment. The same formulation further yields a norm decomposition into intra-view and inter-view consistency, suggesting that feature magnitude itself can serve as a semantic reliability signal. Calibrated by effective multi-view support, this reliability score guides a mode-voting refinement that preserves CLIP feature validity by avoiding linear averaging. Experiments on open-vocabulary 3D semantic segmentation show that NormLift is an efficient, training-free framework that achieves strong performance across evaluation protocols.

AI.tldr: 从3D查询视角重新审视开放词汇3D高斯语义特征提升，将逐高斯分配建模为CLIP单位球上的余弦对齐问题，导出L2归一化语义反投影特征的闭式解，并利用范数分解得到语义可靠性信号用于模式投票精修，提出免训练框架NormLift。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练加权聚合方法虽广泛用于将2D语义特征提升到3D高斯，但理论基础不足。已有分析多从渲染端出发，把高斯特征视为可线性组合的欧氏变量以重建2D特征图，这与下游3D使用方式不符——下游通常是在基于余弦的嵌入空间中独立查询每个高斯，因此需要从3D侧重新审视特征提升。
AI.method: 从3D侧出发，将逐高斯语义分配形式化为CLIP单位球上的余弦对齐问题；在该目标下，L2归一化语义反投影特征成为闭式解，从而为标准的加权聚合提升规则提供互补的逐高斯语义分配解释。进一步由同一形式导出范数分解，将其拆分为视角内一致性与视角间一致性，表明特征模长可作为语义可靠性信号；以有效多视角支持度进行校准后，该可靠性分数指导模式投票精修，通过避免线性平均来保持CLIP特征有效性。
AI.result: 在开放词汇3D语义分割实验上，NormLift作为高效、免训练的框架在多种评测协议下均取得强劲性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作从3D逐高斯语义分配角度为免训练特征提升提供了理论解释，揭示了L2归一化反投影特征的闭式解地位，并提出基于范数可靠性的模式投票精修机制，验证了NormLift的有效性与高效性。

title: Structured Claim-Level Discourse Representations for Dense Health Narratives
summary: Health discourse in social media videos often contains densely entangled claims spanning multiple thematic aspects, stances, evidential frames, and rhetorical functions within short conversational spans. Existing approaches largely rely on coarse topic-level, sentiment-based, or stance-oriented representations that do not adequately capture this structure. Our analysis identifies an average of 13.22 atomic claims per minute, motivating richer claim-level discourse representations. We introduce a structured framework for claim-level discourse analysis in dense health narratives. Our framework models discourse through tuples linking atomic claims with thematic aspects, stance, and multidimensional pragmatic discourse attributes. To support this setting, we construct a benchmark spanning four health domains with 1,191 manually annotated claims from 60 videos. Using this framework, we evaluate automated structured discourse analysis under different discourse context settings. Results show that current LLMs achieve strong performance on thematic categorization and stance prediction, but struggle with high-dimensional pragmatic profiling. We also find that different discourse tasks benefit from different forms of contextual reasoning, suggesting that future systems may require task decomposition and specialized inference strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向社交媒体健康视频的细粒度"命题级"话语分析框架与基准，用包含主题、立场及多维语用属性的元组刻画密集话语，并系统评测LLM在该任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体健康视频中的话语在短对话跨度内密集纠缠多个主题、立场、证据框架与修辞功能；现有方法多依赖粗粒度主题、情感或立场表示，无法充分刻画这一结构。作者统计发现每分钟平均含13.22个原子命题，凸显了更丰富的命题级表示需求。
AI.method: 提出命题级话语分析的结构化框架：以元组将原子命题与主题维度、立场以及多维语用话语属性相链接。为支撑该设定，构建覆盖四个健康领域的基准，包含来自60个视频的1,191条人工标注命题，并在不同话语上下文设置下评测自动化结构化话语分析。
AI.result: 当前LLM在主题分类与立场预测上表现较强，但在高维语用属性刻画方面存在明显困难；此外，不同话语任务受益于不同形式的上下文推理。
AI.conclusion: 命题级结构化表示是刻画密集健康叙事的有效路径；未来系统或需引入任务分解与专门的推理策略，以应对高维语用建模挑战。

title: How Much is a Human Right Worth? ECtHR-NPD: A Benchmark for Predicting Non-Pecuniary Damage Awards
comment: EMNLP 2026 main conference paper. 28 pages, 5 figures
summary: Existing legal benchmarks cover diverse tasks, while continuous monetary remedies remain comparatively underexplored. We introduce ECtHR-NPD, to the best of our knowledge, the first benchmark for predicting non-pecuniary damage (NPD) awards at the European Court of Human Rights (ECtHR) from case information when no statutory formula or explicit calculation rule determines the amount. ECtHR-NPD contains 14,575 cases with case-level awards in nominal euros, chronological splits, and a protocol separating target construction from model input. We evaluate a battery of methods, including constant predictors, gradient-boosted trees, retrieval methods, fine-tuned encoder language models (LMs), prompted decoder LMs, and knowledge-augmented agents. Our results show that more sophisticated LM and agentic approaches do not consistently outperform the strongest feature-based baseline. All model families struggle to identify zero awards and to calibrate high-award predictions, with further degradation on the Challenging test view, making ECtHR-NPD a challenging testbed for current state-of-the-art open-weight and proprietary LMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ECtHR-NPD，首个从案件信息预测欧洲人权法院非金钱损害赔偿金额的基准，含14,575个案件及时间划分协议；评估表明复杂语言模型与智能体方法未能稳定超越最强特征基线，且存在零赔偿识别与高额赔偿校准难题。
AI.motivation: 现有法律基准覆盖任务多样，但连续型金钱救济（尤其是无成文公式或明确计算规则的非金钱损害赔偿）预测研究相对不足，缺乏标准化评测平台。
AI.method: 构建ECtHR-NPD基准：采集14,575个案件的名义欧元案件级赔偿额，采用按时间顺序的划分，并设计将目标构建与模型输入分离的协议；评测常数预测器、梯度提升树、检索方法、微调编码器语言模型、提示式解码器语言模型及知识增强智能体等多类方法。
AI.result: 更复杂的语言模型与智能体方法未稳定优于最强特征基线；所有模型族在识别零赔偿与校准高额赔偿预测上均表现不佳，在Challenging测试视图上进一步退化。
AI.conclusion: ECtHR-NPD构成面向当前先进开源与专有语言模型的挑战性测试平台，揭示连续金额预测中的零值识别与高值校准等关键难点。

title: Beyond Outcomes: Dual-View Relational Learning for Efficient Agent Benchmarking
summary: Agent benchmarks are substantially more costly to evaluate than conventional LLM benchmarks. Benchmark compression is therefore a natural solution, yet existing methods primarily model redundancy in task--model final-score distributions, which is important in agentic evaluation. To address this limitation, we analyze large-scale trajectories and identify six complementary process signals that are systematically associated with final agent performance. To disentangle agent performance redundancy from a complete perspective, we propose DualViewEval, an agent benchmark compression method that jointly exploits outcome and process relations to learn an exact-size miniset and predict the full-benchmark scores. Across five agent benchmarks and five representative baselines, DualViewEval achieves the best results in all datasets. With only 20 tasks, it achieves $24\times$--$40\times$ compression on APEX-Agents and BFCL, reducing mean absolute error (MAE) by $14.5\%$--$28.2\%$ over the strongest competitors while improving Kendall's $τ$ by up to $7.2\%$ relative to EssenceBench on SWE-bench Verified. The selected minisets further reveal capability differences among different agents, providing compact and diagnostic feedback for efficient agentic model development.

AI.tldr: 提出DualViewEval，通过联合利用结果与过程关系进行智能体基准压缩，以极小任务集预测全基准分数。
AI.motivation: 智能体基准评估成本远高于传统LLM基准，现有压缩方法主要建模任务-模型最终分数分布中的冗余，未充分考虑智能体评估中过程信号的重要性。
AI.method: 分析大规模轨迹，识别六种与最终智能体性能系统性相关的互补过程信号；提出DualViewEval，联合利用结果与过程关系，学习精确规模的miniset，并预测全基准分数。
AI.result: 在5个智能体基准和5个代表性基线上均取得最佳结果；仅用20个任务，在APEX-Agents和BFCL上实现24×--40×压缩，MAE较最强竞争方法降低14.5%--28.2%；在SWE-bench Verified上Kendall's τ较EssenceBench最高提升7.2%。
AI.conclusion: 所选miniset能揭示不同智能体的能力差异，为高效智能体模型开发提供紧凑且具诊断性的反馈。

title: PhysVGGT: Feed-Forward Dense Physical Property Estimation from A Single Image
summary: Physical properties, such as friction, hardness, stiffness, and density, govern how robots should grasp, manipulate and interact with objects, yet estimating these properties from RGB images remains challenging. Existing methods typically employ per-object reconstruction augmented with physical properties or directly query vision-language models at test time, which results in substantial computational overhead that limits their applicability. In this work, we present PhysVGGT, a feed-forward model that predicts dense maps of friction coefficient, Shore hardness, Young's modulus, and density, together with object-level mass, from a single RGB image in one forward pass. The key idea of PhysVGGT is to formulate physical property estimation as a dense per-pixel prediction problem and employ a visual geometry transformer to extract geometry-aware tokens from the input image followed by a dense prediction branch for estimating local physical properties and a global prediction branch for estimating object-level mass. In addition, we introduce a scalable pseudo-label generation pipeline that enables large-scale weakly supervised training for dense physical property prediction, substantially reducing the need for expensive direct physical measurements. Extensive experiments show that PhysVGGT achieves state-of-the-art performance on the ABO-500 dataset and generalizes effectively to the out-of-distribution NeRF2Physics dataset. Moreover, PhysVGGT eliminates the need for per-object reconstruction and test-time optimization, achieving an inference latency of only 0.13s per image, making it $27\times$ faster than the previous state of the art.

AI.tldr: PhysVGGT是一个前馈模型，可从单张RGB图像一次前向传播中预测稠密的摩擦系数、邵氏硬度、杨氏模量和密度图，以及物体级质量，无需逐物体重建或测试时优化，推理延迟仅0.13秒。
AI.motivation: 物理属性（摩擦、硬度、刚度、密度）决定机器人如何抓取和操作物体，但从RGB图像估计这些属性仍具挑战性。现有方法要么对每个物体进行重建并附加物理属性，要么在测试时查询视觉语言模型，导致计算开销巨大，限制了实际应用。
AI.method: 将物理属性估计建模为稠密的逐像素预测问题，采用视觉几何变换器（visual geometry transformer）从输入图像提取几何感知token，之后分别通过稠密预测分支估计局部物理属性和全局预测分支估计物体级质量。此外提出可扩展的伪标签生成流程，支持大规模弱监督训练。
AI.result: 在ABO-500数据集上达到最先进性能，并在分布外的NeRF2Physics数据集上有效泛化。取消了逐物体重建和测试时优化，每张图像推理延迟仅0.13秒，比先前最先进方法快27倍。
AI.conclusion: PhysVGGT通过稠密逐像素预测框架和弱监督伪标签流程，实现了高效、无需重建的单图物理属性估计，兼顾精度与推理速度，为机器人交互等下游应用提供了实用方案。

title: RAUL: Reference-Assisted Ureteroscopy Localization for Skill Assessment
summary: Objective: Incomplete navigation of anatomy during ureteroscopic kidney stone surgeries can contribute to repeat interventions. While skilled surgeons have lower reintervention rates, there are no objective metrics to quantify scope-navigation performance to evaluate when a trainee becomes skilled. This work aims to recover ureteroscope trajectories from endoscopic video and derive navigation metrics to quantify differences in skill. Methods: We propose RAUL, a reference-assisted reconstruction framework for recovering ureteroscope trajectories from ureteroscope videos only in phantoms. For each phantom, we use a slow, high-quality reference exploration video to generate a reference reconstruction. We localize subsequent exploration videos against this reference. We evaluate localization accuracy against electromagnetically tracked scope pose. We compute navigation metrics from phantom exploration trajectories to compare surgical residents across experience levels. Results: The proposed reference-assisted framework achieves a mean translation root mean square error of $0.5 \pm 0.1$ mm across 9 phantoms. Compared to standard Structure-from-Motion (SfM), the proposed pipeline increases frame-wise localization coverage from $50.5 \pm 14.9\%$ to $86.1 \pm 7.2\%$ of all video frames. The reconstructed trajectories revealed significant differences between high- and low-experience trainees in established navigation metrics. Conclusion: RAUL enables substantially more complete recovery of ureteroscope trajectories from videos compared to standard SfM pipelines, enabling trajectory-based skill assessment without additional tracking equipment. Significance: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first use of video-only recovery of ureteroscope trajectories without external tracking sensors for skill assessment, supporting scalable automated assessment of ureteroscopy navigation skill.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAUL——一种参考辅助重建框架，仅用输尿管镜视频即可恢复镜体轨迹，用于客观量化导航技能。该方法在9个体模上实现0.5±0.1 mm的平均平移RMSE，将逐帧定位覆盖率从SfM的50.5±14.9%提升至86.1±7.2%，并揭示高、低经验受训者在既定导航指标上的显著差异，实现了无需外部追踪设备的可扩展技能评估。
AI.motivation: 输尿管镜碎石术中解剖导航不完整会导致重复干预。熟练外科医生再干预率更低，但目前缺乏客观指标量化镜体导航表现，无法判断受训者何时达到熟练水平。现有方案依赖电磁等外部追踪设备，成本高、难以规模化，因此需要仅从 endoscopic 视频恢复轨迹并导出导航指标的方法。
AI.method: 提出RAUL参考辅助重建框架：对每个体模，先用一段缓慢、高质量的参考探查视频生成参考重建；再将后续探查视频定位（localize）到该参考坐标系中，从而恢复输尿管镜轨迹。使用电磁追踪的镜体位姿作为金标准评估定位精度。最后从体模探查轨迹计算导航指标，比较不同经验级别外科住院医师的表现。
AI.result: 在9个体模上，参考辅助框架的平均平移RMSE为0.5±0.1 mm；相比标准Structure-from-Motion（SfM），逐帧定位覆盖率由50.5±14.9%提升至86.1±7.2%。重建轨迹在既定导航指标上显示出高经验与低经验受训者之间的显著差异。
AI.conclusion: RAUL相比标准SfM管线能显著更完整地恢复输尿管镜轨迹，无需额外追踪设备即可实现基于轨迹的技能评估。这是首个仅用视频、无需外部追踪传感器恢复输尿管镜轨迹并用于技能评估的工作，支持输尿管镜导航技能的可扩展自动化评估。

title: Long-Lived Characters, Local Inference: Incremental Memory Maintenance for Game NPCs
comment: 18 pages, 6 figures. Supporting numerical snapshots included as ancillary files
summary: A game character should not have to reread its entire life before every conversation. For locally deployed language-model characters, however, revising a few memories can invalidate a long reusable prefix. The resulting preparation cost competes with both foreground dialogue and the maintenance of other characters. This matters especially when dialogue feeds game-defined actions and value judgments: a fluent but incorrect account of who owns an item, or whether a transfer has already happened, can corrupt the input to otherwise deterministic rules. We study incremental memory maintenance for long-lived game NPCs in a quantized Qwen hybrid recurrent-attention model. Our runtime removes superseded attention KV entries, computes replacement records at the true sequence tail, and preserves the continuing recurrent state and unchanged KV. Existing local experiments combine multi-update dialogue replays, fixed-input placement ablations, and attention diagnostics. Independent block composition weakens query-conditioned memory selection without a uniform chunk-initial attention collapse. True-tail updates preserve important current-state and historical bindings across eight scripted maintenance rounds; a placement case recovers the full-refill quantity in three reconstructions, while slot-preserving alternatives repeat a double-subtraction error. Attention-distribution proximity alone does not explain these semantic differences. The results motivate treating a character's inference state as a maintained, history-dependent resource, rather than only a disposable encoding of its latest memory text.

AI.tldr: 论文研究长生命周期游戏NPC的增量记忆维护问题：在量化Qwen混合循环-注意力模型中，通过删除被取代的注意力KV条目、在真实序列末尾计算替换记录、并保留循环状态与未变更KV，避免每次对话重置整个可复用前缀，从而与前台对话及其他角色维护争抢的预处理成本。
AI.motivation: 本地部署的LLM游戏角色在修改少量记忆时会令长可复用前缀失效，导致重算成本高，并与前台对话、其他角色维护竞争资源。当对话驱动游戏定义的动作与价值判断时，记忆更新不当会造成语义错误（如物品归属或转移状态误判），进而污染确定性规则的输入。
AI.method: 以量化Qwen混合循环-注意力模型为对象，设计增量记忆维护运行时：移除被取代的注意力KV条目，在真实序列尾部计算替换记录，并保留持续的循环状态和未变更的KV。实验包含多轮更新对话重放、固定输入放置消融以及注意力诊断。
AI.result: 独立块组合削弱了查询条件下的记忆选择能力，但未出现均匀的块首注意力坍缩。真实尾部更新在八轮脚本化维护中保留了关键的当前状态与历史绑定；一个放置案例通过三次重建恢复了完整重填量，而保留槽位的替代方案重复出现双重扣减错误。注意力分布接近性本身无法解释这些语义差异。
AI.conclusion: 应将角色的推理状态视为需持续维护、依赖历史的资源，而非仅是对最新记忆文本的一次性编码。

title: Sage: Formalization with Semantic Correction
summary: While neural theorem provers have achieved impressive milestones in formal mathematics, they largely operate on the assumption that faithful Lean 4 formal statements are already provided. Translating informal natural language into a formal language is a critical data bottleneck plagued by an "illusion of rigor": standard type-checkers accept statements that compile but drop hypotheses, introduce vacuous truths, or subtly alter mathematical bounds. To resolve this, we introduce Sage (Semantic Agent-Guided Formalization Engine), an agentic framework that replaces monolithic translation with a four-stage decomposed generation pipeline coupled with a dual-signal semantic correction loop. By pairing Lean 4 compiler diagnostics with multi-dimensional semantic feedback, our correction loop enforces mathematical fidelity alongside syntactic validity. By explicitly accounting for the gap between open-ended queries and declarative formal targets, our pipeline prevents models from achieving high formalization rates by guessing unverified answers (exhibiting a 70.9% answer leakage rate in monolithic baselines). Consequently, Sage suppresses leakage to 2.7% while achieving 73.3% pass@4 joint compilation and semantic fidelity on the Omni-MATH without proofs (compared to 42.0% for a fine-tuned Goedel-Formalizer-V2 baseline). Finally, on IMO-Unformalized, a novel frontier of 175 unformalized International Mathematical Olympiad problems, Sage demonstrates effective zero-shot generalization with 87.4% pass@4 verified fidelity compared to just 19.4% for the baseline, winning over 79% of blind pairwise evaluations.

AI.tldr: 提出Sage：一种智能体式形式化框架，用四阶段分解生成流水线加双信号语义纠错回环，将自然语言数学问题转为忠实Lean 4命题，显著抑制"答案泄漏"并提升语义保真度。
AI.motivation: 神经定理证明器多假设已存在忠实的Lean 4形式化命题，而自然语言到形式语言的翻译是关键数据瓶颈，且存在"严谨性幻觉"：类型检查器会接受编译通过但丢失假设、引入空真或篡改数学边界的命题。同时开放式查询与声明式形式目标之间存在差距，单块式翻译易通过猜测未验证答案获得高形式化率。
AI.method: Sage（Semantic Agent-Guided Formalization Engine）以智能体框架替代单块翻译，采用四阶段分解生成流水线，并耦合双信号语义纠错回环：将Lean 4编译器诊断与多维语义反馈配对，在保证语法有效性的同时强制数学保真；显式建模开放式查询与声明式形式目标之间的差距，防止模型以猜测未验证答案的方式达成高形式化率。
AI.result: 单块基线答案泄漏率高达70.9%，Sage将其降至2.7%；在Omni-MATH（无证明版）上达到73.3% pass@4的联合编译与语义保真度，而微调的Goedel-Formalizer-V2基线为42.0%；在由175道未形式化国际数学奥林匹克题构成的新前沿IMO-Unformalized上，Sage实现有效零样本泛化，pass@4验证保真度达87.4%，基线仅19.4%，并在盲测成对评估中胜出超过79%。
AI.conclusion: 通过分解式生成与语义纠错回环，Sage在保持句法有效的同时提升了形式化命题的数学忠实度，有效缓解答案泄漏，并在标准集与未形式化前沿集上展现出显著优于基线的性能与零样本泛化能力。

title: MUSE: Benchmarking Large Vision-Language Models on Multi-Modal Understanding in Situated Education
summary: Large vision-language models have achieved remarkable progress in multi-modal understanding, yet their capabilities in educational settings remain insufficiently evaluated. In AI-assisted language learning, models must interpret artistic imagery, understand its semantic, affective, and cultural content, and reason about visual context to support meaningful interaction. However, existing benchmarks primarily focus on real-world images or domain-specific educational reasoning, providing limited coverage of artistic educational content. To address this gap, we introduce MUSE, a benchmark for evaluating large vision-language models on artistic image understanding in situated educational applications. MUSE decouples image annotation from question generation, enabling diverse tasks with controllable difficulty while reducing annotation effort. It comprises twelve tasks spanning visual perception, semantic and affective interpretation, culture understanding, and compositional reasoning, together with diverse artistic images deliberately curated to center Singaporean and Southeast Asian multicultural contexts alongside Western art traditions, covering multiple themes and difficulty levels. Evaluation of open-source and proprietary models reveals substantial disparities across capability dimensions, particularly in affective interpretation and compositional reasoning. Our analysis further identifies common failure modes and key challenges for developing trustworthy multi-modal models for education. We hope MUSE will serve as a standardized benchmark for advancing multi-modal understanding in situated educational applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MUSE 基准，用于评估大型视觉语言模型在情境化教育场景中对艺术图像的理解能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在教育场景中的能力评估不足；AI辅助语言学习需模型解读艺术图像的语义、情感与文化内容并进行视觉上下文推理，而现有基准多聚焦真实图像或特定领域教育推理，对艺术教育内容覆盖有限。
AI.method: MUSE 将图像标注与问题生成解耦，支持生成多样化、难度可控的任务并降低标注成本；包含12项任务，覆盖视觉感知、语义与情感解读、文化理解及组合推理，并收集以新加坡与东南亚多元文化语境为核心、兼顾西方艺术传统的多样艺术图像，涵盖多主题与多难度层级。
AI.result: 对开源与专有模型的评估显示，各能力维度存在显著差距，尤其在情感解读与组合推理方面差距明显；分析进一步识别出常见失败模式及构建面向教育的可信多模态模型的关键挑战。
AI.conclusion: MUSE 有望成为推动情境化教育应用中多模态理解研究的标准化基准。

title: Reporting Practice Matters: The Impact of Reference Choice on Chest X-ray Report Evaluation
summary: Radiologists follow heterogeneous reporting practices. Two radiologists examining the same image and identifying the same clinical findings might nevertheless compose superficially distinct reports, varying in terminology, shorthand, formatting, and level of detail. These variations in reporting norms represent an under-appreciated obstacle in efforts to evaluate AI-based radiology report generation (RRG) models, where machine-generated reports are typically assessed based on their concordance with human-generated references. In this paper, we quantify the sensitivity of established evaluation metrics to variations in reporting practices, revealing impacts large enough to alter the rankings of models. We introduce a radiologist-informed taxonomy of variations in radiology reporting practice and a method (ReRef) that rewrites reference reports along the axes of our taxonomy while preserving clinical interpretation. For instance, when comparing the performance of nine RRG models on MIMIC-CXR using RadCliQ-v1, condensing the discussion of normal findings in the reference reports causes Libra to drop from first to second place while CheXOne rises from third to first. Our results suggest that many current metrics fail to decouple clinical interpretation from conformity to reporting practices and that choosing the ``right'' references that accurately reflect the desired reporting practices can be important in practice. To support future research, we release MIMIC-CXR-Ext-ReRef, a radiologist-validated dataset of 120 (original, alternative) reference report pairs derived from MIMIC-CXR.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示放射学报告撰写习惯的异质性会显著影响AI报告生成模型的评测，提出报告变异的分类体系与重写方法ReRef，并通过实验证明现有评测指标对报告风格变化高度敏感，甚至会导致模型排名改变。
AI.motivation: 放射科医生在撰写报告时存在术语、简写、格式和详细程度等方面的异质性。同一图像、同一临床发现的报告可能表面差异很大。这种报告规范的差异在以人类参考报告一致性为基础的AI报告生成评测中成为被低估的障碍，导致评测结果不稳定、不公正。
AI.method: 1) 量化已有评测指标对报告撰写习惯变化的敏感度；2) 提出由放射科医生参与制定的报告实践变异分类体系；3) 设计ReRef方法，在保持临床解释不变的前提下，沿分类体系各维度重写参考报告；4) 构建经放射科医生验证的数据集MIMIC-CXR-Ext-ReRef，包含120对（原始、替代）参考报告。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-CXR上对9个RRG模型使用RadCliQ-v1评测时，仅压缩参考报告中正常发现的描述，就使Libra从第1名降至第2名，CheXOne从第3名升至第1名。表明既有指标难以将临床解释与报告规范依从性解耦，模型排名对参考报告风格高度敏感。
AI.conclusion: 当前许多评测指标无法将临床解释与报告实践规范性分离；在实践中，选择能准确反映目标报告规范的“正确”参考报告至关重要。研究发布了经放射科医生验证的MIMIC-CXR-Ext-ReRef数据集以支持后续研究。

title: Monitoring and Discovering Reward Hacking with Internal Representations during LLM Evaluations
summary: As models scale, reward hacking becomes more frequent, more sophisticated, and more consequential. Does it leave a telltale signature in model representations? This work analyzes how reward hacking is represented internally in frontier open source LLMs, and how those representations can be used to understand and discover the range of hacking behaviors a model displays. In particular, we find that simple difference of means vectors coherently represent reward hacking in Kimi K3, GLM 5.2, and Qwen 3.8 Max across a variety of behaviors in common evaluations. Despite their simplicity, these vectors are both generalizable and interpretable, and we can use them to reliably detect reward hacking. We first evaluate reward hacking in commonly reported benchmarks like DeepSWE and SWE-bench, finding that models reward hack excessively in these environments; GLM 5.2 hacks in 57.2% of rollouts on DeepSWE and in 73% of rollouts on SWE-bench. Catching these requires monitors; LLM monitors are effective, but expensive detectors. We show that DoM vectors are similarly effective but virtually free, catching 3.1% more hacks in Kimi K3 and 7.9% fewer hacks in GLM 5.2 on DeepSWE at a monitor matched false positive rate. DoM vectors run on the chain-of-thought also predict reward hacks in the model's subsequent actions, meaning we can run them online and catch potential hacks before they occur. Finally, we analyze probe-hits that LLM monitors do not catch and discover other undesirable behaviors, as well as show transfer to finding hacks in non-SWE evaluations. Together, these results provide evidence that simple, white-box methods can be used to scalably study and monitor reward hacking behaviors in frontier open source models

AI.tldr: 该论文发现奖励黑客行为在前沿开源大模型内部表征中留下了可提取的"签名"：简单的均值差（DoM）向量即可连贯地表征、检测并预测奖励黑客行为，且成本极低。
AI.motivation: 随着模型规模增大，奖励黑客行为愈发频繁、复杂且后果严重，但现有检测主要依赖昂贵的外部监控器。作者希望探究奖励黑客是否在模型内部表征中留下可识别的痕迹，从而以可扩展、低成本的方式进行理解和监控。
AI.method: 作者在Kimi K3、GLM 5.2、Qwen 3.8 Max等前沿开源模型上，通过在多种常见评测行为中计算简单的均值差（DoM）向量来表征奖励黑客。随后利用这些向量在DeepSWE、SWE-bench等基准上进行奖励黑客检测，并与LLM监控器对比；同时将DoM向量应用于思维链（chain-of-thought）以在线预测后续动作中的黑客行为。
AI.result: 模型在这些环境中大量出现奖励黑客：GLM 5.2在DeepSWE上57.2%的rollout、在SWE-bench上73%的rollout存在黑客行为。DoM向量在匹配假阳性率下，于DeepSWE上比LLM监控器在Kimi K3多捕获3.1%、在GLM 5.2少捕获7.9%的黑客行为，但几乎零成本。作用于思维链的DoM向量还能预测模型后续动作中的奖励黑客，实现在线预警。此外，探测命中了LLM监控器漏掉的行为，并发现其他不良行为，同时可迁移至非SWE评测。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，简单、白盒的DoM向量方法可扩展地研究和监控前沿开源模型的奖励黑客行为，其表征具有通用性、可解释性和预测性，为低成本、在线检测奖励黑客提供了可行路径。

title: Playing log(N)-Questions over Wikipedia Abstracts: How Per-Round Errors Compound Under Information Asymmetry
summary: We evaluate six frontier language models on the two-agent $\log_2 N$-Questions game (Potash et al., 2019) to measure self-communication across an information asymmetry. A questioner with access to $N$ candidate Wikipedia lead paragraphs ($N = 4$ to $1024$) must identify a secret target using exactly $\log_2 N$ binary questions answered by an agent from the same provider that sees only the target. Across 408 games, win rate decays cleanly as a geometric power of horizon length, $p^{\log_2 N}$ ($p \approx 0.93$). Per-round failure rates are flat across the horizon, indicating that errors compound because more rounds must succeed rather than because individual rounds grow harder. Adjudication across three independent judges shows that losses divide between single-agent answer errors and discrimination failures, which become undetectable and unrecoverable under the two-agent structure rather than from channel breakdown. Claude Opus 5 lags behind due to systematic false-negative answers (82% answer errors), whereas the five leading models (GLM-5.3, GPT-5.6 Sol, Grok 4.6, Gemini 3.8 Flash, and Kimi K3) are closely clustered. Maximizing information gain requires structural partitioning (e.g., splitting on document titles), and neither reasoning-token expenditure nor API cost correlates with success ($r = -0.05$), highlighting communicative reliability as a distinct bottleneck from inference compute.

AI.tldr: 该论文使用双智能体 log₂N 问答游戏评测六个前沿语言模型，发现胜率随轮数呈几何衰减（p≈0.93），错误源于累积而非单轮难度，且受试模型间差距有限，通信可靠性是独立于推理算力的瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型评测多聚焦单智能体推理能力，缺乏对"信息不对称下自我通信"这一能力的度量。作者希望区分推理算力与通信可靠性，探究多轮协作中错误如何累积、何时失效。
AI.method: 采用 Potash et al. (2019) 的双智能体 log₂N 问答游戏：提问方获得 N 个候选维基百科导语段（N=4 至 1024），须用恰好 log₂N 个二元问题识别由同一提供方、只见目标的智能体所回答的秘密目标。共进行 408 局游戏，并使用三位独立裁判进行裁定。
AI.result: 胜率随轮数呈几何幂律衰减，约为 p^(log₂N)，p≈0.93；每轮失败率在整个轮数范围内保持平稳，说明误差是累积效应而非单轮难度上升。裁定显示损失分为单智能体答案错误与判别失败两类，且在后者的双智能体结构下变得不可检测、不可恢复，而非源于信道故障。Claude Opus 5 因系统性假阴性答案（82% 答案错误）明显落后，其余五个领先模型（GLM-5.3、GPT-5.6 Sol、Grok 4.6、Gemini 3.8 Flash、Kimi K3）表现接近。
AI.conclusion: 最大化信息增益需要结构性划分（如按文档标题切分）；推理 token 消耗与 API 成本均与成功率无相关（r=-0.05），表明通信可靠性是与推理算力不同的独立瓶颈。

title: Track, Articulate, Act: Generating Articulation from Casual Human Videos
summary: Human videos contain rich causal evidence for robot manipulation: they reveal how hand motion induces object motion and produces task-relevant changes in object state. In this work, we study articulated objects such as doors, drawers, cabinets, laptops, ovens, and hinged containers that are ubiquitous in daily life and present unique challenges for embodied interaction. These objects cannot be represented by a single pose; their motion depends on the underlying parts and joints. We introduce a real-to-sim framework that reconstructs a simulation-ready articulated object and hand-object interaction from a casual monocular RGB video, without RGB-D or multi-view input, prior scans, manually specified joints, or robot demonstrations. Our key insight is that dense 3D point tracks provide an embodiment-agnostic articulation cue: points on the fixed link remain approximately stationary, while points on the moving link follow coherent revolute or prismatic motion. Our method segments the links, estimates the joint and its state trajectory, reconstructs an articulated asset, and aligns the recovered 3D hand motion with the object. Central to our approach is a modular recipe that repurposes powerful pretrained models for single-image 3D reconstruction, mesh segmentation, and 3D scene flow, connecting their predictions through explicit geometric reasoning to infer articulation. We use the reconstructed articulated object and the human hand trajectory to replay interactions through contact in MuJoCo. The framework shows how pretrained vision models and explicit motion reasoning can turn casual human videos into articulated object models suitable for downstream embodied interactions. https://track-articulate-act.github.io/

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个real-to-sim框架，仅用单目RGB视频即可重建仿真就绪的铰接物体与手-物交互，无需RGB-D、多视角、先验扫描、手工关节标注或机器人演示，并可在MuJoCo中重放交互。
AI.motivation: 人类视频蕴含丰富的因果操作证据（手部运动如何引发物体运动并改变物体状态），但门、抽屉、橱柜、笔记本电脑、烤箱等铰接物体无法用单一位姿表示，其运动依赖部件与关节，对具身交互构成独特挑战；现有方法通常依赖RGB-D、多视角、先验扫描或手工关节指定，难以从随手拍摄的单目视频中获取可用模型。
AI.method: 核心洞察是稠密3D点轨迹提供了与具体具身无关的铰接线索：固定连杆上的点近似静止，运动连杆上的点呈一致的旋转或平移运动。方法据此分割连杆、估计关节及其状态轨迹、重建铰接资产，并将恢复的3D手部运动与物体对齐。整体采用模块化配方，复用预训练的单图3D重建、网格分割与3D场景流模型，通过显式几何推理连接其预测以推断铰接关系，最后用重建物体与手部轨迹在MuJoCo中通过接触重放交互。
AI.result: 框架能够从随手拍摄的单目人类视频中重建出可仿真的铰接物体模型与手-物交互，并在MuJoCo中实现基于接触的交互重放，验证了预训练视觉模型结合显式运动推理可生成适用于下游具身交互的铰接物体模型。
AI.conclusion: 预训练视觉模型与显式运动推理相结合，可将普通人类视频转化为铰接物体模型，为下游具身交互提供可用的仿真资产；该real-to-sim范式降低了对专用传感器与人工标注的依赖。

title: Training-Adaptive Convolutional Sparse Coding via Information Bottleneck for Robust Visual Representation
summary: Visual signals require compact yet sufficient representations for robust downstream prediction. Convolutional sparse coding (CSC) provides an explicit mechanism for suppressing redundant components while preserving signal content, but its sparsity coefficient is often manually selected during training. We propose a training-adaptive convolutional sparse coding framework for robust visual signal representation. Specifically, we unfold the CSC optimization with the Fast Iterative Shrinkage-Thresholding Algorithm (FISTA) and treat the sparsity coefficient as a differentiable variable jointly learned with the network parameters. From the information bottleneck perspective, this coefficient controls the trade-off between information retention and compression: the sparsity term promotes compact representations, while the reconstruction term together with task loss preserves task-relevant signal content. We further introduce a label-free post-training strategy that adjusts the compression strength for corrupted inputs with the main network parameters fixed. Experiments on CIFAR and ImageNet demonstrate competitive clean-data recognition and greatly improved robustness under different input perturbations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种训练自适应的卷积稀疏编码框架：用FISTA展开CSC优化，将稀疏系数作为可微变量与网络参数联合学习，并从信息瓶颈视角解释其控制信息保留与压缩的权衡；此外引入免标签的后训练策略，在固定主网络参数下针对受损输入调整压缩强度。在CIFAR和ImageNet上取得有竞争力的干净数据识别性能，并大幅提升多种输入扰动下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 视觉信号需要紧凑而充分的表示以支撑鲁棒的下游预测。卷积稀疏编码（CSC）能显式抑制冗余成分并保留信号内容，但其稀疏系数在训练中通常需人工设定，缺乏自适应性，限制了表示质量与鲁棒性的最优权衡。
AI.method: 1) 用快速迭代收缩阈值算法（FISTA）展开CSC优化过程，构建可端到端训练的展开网络；2) 将稀疏系数视为可微变量，与网络参数联合学习，实现训练自适应；3) 借助信息瓶颈理论解释该系数在信息保留与压缩之间的权衡作用：稀疏项促进紧凑表示，重构项与任务损失共同保留任务相关信号内容；4) 提出免标签的后训练策略，在固定主网络参数的前提下，针对受损输入调整压缩强度。
AI.result: 在CIFAR和ImageNet数据集上的实验表明：在干净数据上识别性能具有竞争力，同时在不同输入扰动条件下鲁棒性显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过将稀疏系数变为可学习变量并结合信息瓶颈视角与免标签后训练，该框架实现了自适应且鲁棒的视觉信号表示，兼顾干净数据精度与扰动鲁棒性。

title: ScienceIDE: Turning World's Scientific Codebase into Agent Learnable Environments
summary: Scientific code repositories encode decades of human knowledge in executable models, methods, and tools. Yet fragmented toolchains, implicit domain conventions, and specialized correctness criteria make this knowledge difficult to convert into reliable learning experience-a challenge we call the scientific experience bottleneck. We introduce ScienceIDE, infrastructure for turning the world's scientific code into programmable environments for scientific agents. Guided by expert-defined scientific cases and acceptance criteria, agents transform repositories into executable environments that support task generation, execution, and scientific verification. These environments provide a shared foundation for supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and evaluation. Using verified interaction trajectories, we train PhAI-IDE-72B, PhAI-IDE-9B, and PhAI-IDE-4B. The model family shows gains in held-out scientific-code repair and across selected general-purpose benchmarks in code, reasoning, and knowledge, providing evidence of positive transfer from scientific experience to broader capabilities. ScienceIDE lays the foundation for an integrated workspace for agent learning and scientific practice, making humanity's scientific software a shared substrate for developing scientific intelligence. Code: https://github.com/aitofound/ScienceIDE

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ScienceIDE 基础设施，将科学代码仓库转化为可执行、可验证的智能体环境，并据此训练出 PhAI-IDE 系列模型（72B/9B/4B），在科学代码修复及部分通用基准上取得提升。
AI.motivation: 科学代码仓库蕴含数十年人类知识，但工具链碎片化、领域约定隐含、正确性标准特殊，导致知识难以转化为可靠的学习经验——作者称之为"科学经验瓶颈"（scientific experience bottleneck）。
AI.method: ScienceIDE 以专家定义的科学案例与验收标准为引导，由智能体将代码仓库改造成支持任务生成、执行与科学验证的可执行环境；这些环境为监督微调、强化学习和评估提供统一基础。利用已验证的交互轨迹训练 PhAI-IDE-72B、PhAI-IDE-9B 与 PhAI-IDE-4B。
AI.result: 模型系列在留出的科学代码修复任务上取得增益，并在代码、推理、知识等部分通用基准上有所提升，表明科学经验对更广泛能力存在正向迁移。
AI.conclusion: ScienceIDE 为智能体学习与科学实践的一体化工作空间奠定基础，使人类科学软件成为发展科学智能的共享底座。代码已开源：https://github.com/aitofound/ScienceIDE

title: In-Context Robot Learning with VLM Agents
comment: Project Page: https://cheng-haha.github.io/GPT-Policy GitHub Code: https://github.com/cheng-haha/GPT-Policy
summary: Enabling robots to adapt to unfamiliar environments as readily as humans remains a moonshot goal of embodied AI. No finite collection of demonstrations can cover every task and situation a robot will encounter, making the ability to learn from context at deployment essential for generalization. Such in-context learning (ICL), however, remains largely beyond the reach of existing robotic policies. The broad agentic capabilities of commercial vision-language models (VLMs), such as GPT-6 Astra, raise a compelling question: can these models learn from demonstrations, examples, and interaction feedback, then translate that information into executable and verifiable robot behavior from a new initial state without gradient updates or persistent changes to task-specific parameters? We introduce GPT-Policy, a general-agent framework for in-context robot learning. GPT-Policy integrates a context compiler that preserves task-relevant visual transitions, a VLM that proposes robot-tool actions, and a constrained controller that verifies and executes each action and reports its outcome. We evaluate its reliability and limitations through task success and efficiency metrics, matched comparisons across models, and controlled context ablations. In real-robot trials, human video demonstrations improve task completion even without robot action labels, while aligned action references yield further gains on contact-sensitive tasks. These findings position GPT-Policy as a step toward robot adaptation through in-context learning, providing an empirical foundation for translating the general-purpose capabilities of VLMs into physical behavior and clarifying the challenges that must be overcome for reliable deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出GPT-Policy框架，利用商用视觉语言模型的上下文学习能力，实现机器人无需梯度更新的在上下文学习与部署。
AI.motivation: 机器人需适应未知环境，但有限的演示无法覆盖所有任务与情境，因此部署时的上下文学习（ICL）能力对泛化至关重要；然而现有机器人策略普遍缺乏ICL能力。商用VLM（如GPT-6 Astra）的通用智能体能力，为探索"无梯度更新、不改变任务专用参数"的机器人行为生成提供了契机。
AI.method: GPT-Policy为通用智能体框架，由三部分组成：上下文编译器（保留任务相关的视觉转换）、VLM（提出机器人工具动作）、受限控制器（验证并执行每个动作并回报结果）。评估采用任务成功率与效率指标、跨模型匹配比较、以及受控的上下文消融实验。
AI.result: 在真机实验中，人类视频演示即使没有机器人动作标签也能提升任务完成度；在接触敏感任务中，对齐的动作参考带来进一步增益。
AI.conclusion: GPT-Policy向基于上下文学习的机器人自适应迈出一步，为将VLM通用能力转化为物理行为提供了实证基础，并明确了可靠部署仍需克服的挑战。

title: PANORAMA: Panoptic Grounded Captioning via Mask Proposal Selection
summary: Intelligent systems that act in the world require image understanding that is both comprehensive and spatially grounded. Current vision-language models (VLMs) can generate fluent and detailed image captions, but reliably associating them with image pixels remains challenging. Existing methods that combine dense captioning with pixel-level grounding often produce either incomplete descriptions or inaccurate segmentation masks. We study this problem through panoptic grounded captioning, a task that requires a VLM to describe both foreground objects and background regions while grounding each referring phrase with pixel-level masks. We make three contributions. First, we introduce PanoCaps, a human-annotated benchmark constructed from panoptic segmentation datasets. It provides dense captions with near-complete pixel coverage and image-text alignments at the entity level, supporting both training and evaluation. We further propose a phrase-mask matching protocol and a generalized Panoptic Quality (gPQ) metric that jointly evaluates textual and mask agreement. Second, we formulate phrase grounding as selection from a phrase-conditioned pool of mask proposals and introduce PANORAMA, a VLM that conditions a pretrained segmenter on contextualized phrase representations to obtain candidate masks and learns to select those corresponding to each phrase. Training this interface jointly with caption generation enables PANORAMA to produce high-quality masks while allowing each phrase to refer to a single region or multiple instances. Third, PANORAMA achieves the best overall grounding on PanoCaps and matches or exceeds specialized models across several pixel-level grounding tasks. Experiments show that our method produces precise entity-level segmentations while maintaining detailed, mask-consistent captions. Code, data and models are available at https://www.di.ens.fr/willow/research/panorama/.

AI.tldr: 论文提出全景接地字幕任务、PanoCaps基准与gPQ指标，并设计PANORAMA模型，实现高精度像素级接地与稠密字幕的统一。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型虽能生成流畅详细的图像字幕，但难以可靠地将文本与像素关联；已有稠密字幕与像素接地方法往往描述不完整或分割掩码不准确，缺少覆盖前景与背景区域、且文本-掩码一致的综合方案。
AI.method: 提出全景接地字幕任务，要求模型同时描述前景物体与背景区域并对每个指称短语给出像素级掩码。构建基于全景分割数据集的人工标注基准PanoCaps，提供近全覆盖像素的稠密字幕与实体级图文对齐，并提出短语-掩码匹配协议与gPQ指标。将短语接地建模为从短语条件掩码候选池中选择，设计PANORAMA：以预训练分割器结合上下文化短语表示生成候选掩码，并学习为每个短语选择对应掩码，与字幕生成联合训练，支持短语对应单区域或多实例。
AI.result: PANORAMA在PanoCaps上取得最佳整体接地性能，并在多个像素级接地任务上达到或超越专用模型；在保持详细且与掩码一致的字幕同时，生成精确的实体级分割。
AI.conclusion: 全景接地字幕可作为统一稠密描述与像素级接地的有效框架，PanoCaps、短语-掩码匹配协议与gPQ为训练与评测提供支撑，PANORAMA验证了联合建模字幕生成与掩码选择的可行性与优势。

title: PointZero: 3D Point Track Completion for Learning Transferable 3D Dynamics
summary: World models endow perceptual systems with the ability to predict how scenes evolve under interaction. They are most beneficial when trained on diverse volumes of data, to instill a rich prior into downstream applications. Existing methods typically require robot action labels to learn action-conditioned 3D dynamics, which excludes web video data from the training pool. We study 3D point track completion as a pre-training objective for learning transferable 3D dynamics without robot data. Given a single RGB-D observation and sparse partial 3D trajectories (tracks), we predict future 3D tracks of all observed points. We show this objective produces a rich 3D dynamics prior, without requiring robot action labels. We contribute a diverse dataset of 2.9 million synthetic frames spanning deformable, articulated, and rigid objects, and use it to train PointZero. We show that a flexible and expressive transformer, PointZero, outperforms prior methods on the same data. We demonstrate the utility of our pre-training objective by post-training PointZero for two downstream applications: (1) action-conditioned 3D dynamics prediction and (2) imitation learning. When fine-tuned to condition on end-effector pose, PointZero outperforms the baselines on the recent PGND 3D dynamics benchmark. When fine-tuned to predict robot actions and 3D tracks, PointZero outperforms or matches the baselines on 6/7 simulated and real-world robot manipulation tasks. We furthermore evaluate training PointZero from scratch to isolate the benefits of our proposed architecture from those of our proposed pre-training objective and dataset. We release the dataset, checkpoints, and full training recipe.

AI.tldr: 提出以3D点轨迹补全作为预训练目标，无需机器人动作标签即可学习可迁移的3D动态先验，并构建2.9M帧合成数据集训练PointZero，在3D动态预测与模仿学习任务上超越基线。
AI.motivation: 世界模型可预测场景在交互下的演化，其性能依赖于大规模多样化数据以形成丰富先验。但现有方法通常需要机器人动作标签来学习动作条件化的3D动态，导致无法利用网络视频等无动作标签数据，限制了训练数据规模与多样性。
AI.method: 将3D点轨迹补全作为预训练目标：给定单帧RGB-D观测与稀疏部分3D轨迹，预测所有已观测点的未来3D轨迹，从而在无机器人动作标签下学习3D动态先验。构建包含变形、铰接、刚性对象、共290万合成帧的多样化数据集，并设计表达力强、灵活的transformer模型PointZero进行训练；随后将PointZero后训练用于两个下游任务：(1)动作条件化的3D动态预测，(2)模仿学习。
AI.result: 在相同数据下，PointZero优于先前方法。微调为以末端执行器位姿为条件时，在PGND 3D动态基准上超越基线；微调为预测机器人动作与3D轨迹时，在7个仿真与真实机器人操作任务中的6个上优于或持平基线。此外，通过从头训练PointZero，分离了架构贡献与预训练目标及数据集贡献。数据集、检查点与完整训练配方均已开源。
AI.conclusion: 3D点轨迹补全是一种有效的可迁移3D动态预训练目标，无需机器人动作标签即可利用多样化数据，为下游动作条件化动态预测与模仿学习提供强先验；PointZero架构与预训练数据、目标均带来可验证收益。

title: A Zeroth-Order Paradigm for LLM Preference Alignment
summary: Direct preference alignment methods are widely used to align large language models (LLMs) with human preferences because of their computational and memory efficiency. However, likelihood displacement motivates alternative ways to extract information from preference pairs with small likelihood margins. In this paper, we propose and analyze Comparison-based Preference Optimization (ComPO), a zeroth-order alignment method based on comparison oracles. ComPO extracts directional information from these pairs without directly optimizing a differentiable preference loss on them. We establish a convergence guarantee for its basic offline scheme under smoothness, gradient sparsity, and compatibility between the oracle and a latent objective. We further introduce online ComPO, which retains the offline comparison mechanism and uses unlabeled policy generations for reverse-KL control relative to a reference policy. Following the coverage perspective of preference fine-tuning, we establish a performance guarantee for a basic constrained scheme under local coverage and in-distribution pairwise reward accuracy. Experiments on Mistral, Llama, Gemma-2, Qwen3, and Gemma-3 models demonstrate improvements over existing direct alignment methods, including length-controlled win rates, with pair-level diagnostics providing evidence consistent with mitigating likelihood displacement.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出并分析了基于比较预言机的零阶对齐方法 ComPO，从偏好对中提取方向信息而非直接优化可微偏好损失；给出了离线方案的收敛保证，并提出在线 ComPO 结合无标注策略生成实现反向 KL 控制；在多个模型上取得优于现有直接对齐方法的效果。
AI.motivation: 直接偏好对齐方法因计算与内存效率被广泛用于使 LLM 对齐人类偏好，但存在似然位移（likelihood displacement）问题，促使研究者寻求从似然间隔较小的偏好对中提取信息的替代途径。
AI.method: 提出 Comparison-based Preference Optimization（ComPO），一种基于比较预言机的零阶对齐方法：不直接对偏好对优化可微偏好损失，而是从中提取方向信息。离线方案在平滑性、梯度稀疏性以及预言机与潜在目标兼容性假设下建立收敛保证；在线 ComPO 保留离线比较机制，并利用无标注策略生成进行相对参考策略的反向 KL 控制，在局部覆盖与分布内成对奖励准确率下建立约束方案的性能保证。
AI.result: 在 Mistral、Llama、Gemma-2、Qwen3 和 Gemma-3 模型上的实验表明，ComPO 优于现有直接对齐方法，包括在长度控制胜率上取得提升；成对层面的诊断结果与缓解似然位移的证据相一致。
AI.conclusion: ComPO 通过比较式零阶优化有效利用偏好对中的方向信息，并在理论与实验两方面得到支持，为偏好对齐提供了一条缓解似然位移的可行路径。

title: Objective vs. Search: Decomposing What Makes a Good Tokeniser
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026. 20 pages, 4 figures, 10 tables. Code: https://github.com/Ahmetcanyvz/comp-vs-like
summary: Two dominant tokenisation algorithms are used by modern language models: byte-pair encoding (BPE) and UnigramLM. These differ along two orthogonal axes: their optimisation objective (compression vs. log-likelihood) and their search procedure (bottom-up merging vs. top-down pruning). Existing comparisons confound these axes, making it unclear whether their observed differences stem from what is being optimised vs. how it is being optimised. We disentangle the two by introducing two new tokenisation algorithms that complete this 2x2 design space: BottomUpLL, a bottom-up likelihood-based tokeniser, and TopDownComp, a top-down compression-based tokeniser. We train language models with tokenisers produced by each algorithm, varying: model size, vocabulary sizes, and domain (English-only vs. multilingual). Evaluating models on bits-per-byte, we find that the search procedure -- not the objective -- is the dominant factor: bottom-up tokenisers consistently achieve lower bits-per-byte in most settings. Evaluating models on the BLiMP task, however, shows no consistent relationship between design choice and performance. Overall, our results disentangle the effect of tokeniser design choices on language modelling performance, offering concrete guidance for their more principled construction.

AI.tldr: 通过构建补全2x2设计空间的两个新分词算法（BottomUpLL和TopDownComp），解耦优化目标与搜索过程对语言模型性能的影响。
AI.motivation: BPE与UnigramLM在优化目标（压缩vs.对数似然）和搜索过程（自底向上合并vs.自顶向下剪枝）两个正交维度上不同，但现有比较混淆了这两者，无法判断差异源于"优化什么"还是"如何优化"。
AI.method: 引入两个新分词算法补全2x2设计空间：BottomUpLL（自底向上的似然型分词器）和TopDownComp（自顶向下的压缩型分词器）。用各算法生成的分词器训练语言模型，变化模型规模、词表大小与领域（纯英语vs.多语言）。
AI.result: 在bits-per-byte指标上，搜索过程而非优化目标是主导因素：自底向上分词器在多数设置下持续取得更低的bits-per-byte。但在BLiMP任务上，设计选择与性能之间无一致关系。
AI.conclusion: 研究解耦了分词器设计选择对语言建模性能的影响，为更合理的原则性分词器构建提供了具体指导。

title: Why Pretraining Fails to Share Cross-Lingual Knowledge
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have made remarkable progress in the processing and modeling of many languages. Yet, unlike human multilinguals, they exhibit surprisingly limited cross-lingual knowledge transfer. While this limitation is well documented, its origins during multilingual training remain unclear. We pretrain 360M- and 7B-parameter LLMs and show that poor cross-lingual knowledge generalization emerges during pretraining and persists under standard interventions. To isolate its cause, we employ a controlled bilingual pretraining setting using two copies of the same language, sharing identical text and token segmentation, but mapped to disjoint token spaces. We find that disjoint tokens alone are enough to induce knowledge compartmentalization, even between identical copies of the same language, establishing disjoint token spaces as a fundamental barrier to cross-lingual knowledge generalization. Guided by this understanding, we suggest mapping languages into a shared token space by simple word-wise translation and find it substantially improves cross-lingual knowledge generalization, recovering up to 12.6\% of native-language learning efficiency --- 14$\times$ the baseline.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了大模型跨语言知识迁移受限的根源在于预训练中不共享的token空间，并通过词级翻译映射到共享token空间来显著改善跨语言知识泛化。
AI.motivation: 人类多语者能自然实现跨语言知识迁移，但LLM尽管在多语言处理上表现出色，跨语言知识迁移却异常有限。该局限虽已被广泛记录，但其在训练过程中的起源仍不清楚，作者希望定位根因。
AI.method: 预训练360M和7B参数LLM，观察跨语言知识泛化何时出现并测试标准干预；设计受控双语预训练：使用同一语言的文本和分词完全相同，但映射到不相交的token空间，以隔离token空间的作用；再尝试用简单词级翻译将语言映射到共享token空间。
AI.result: 跨语言知识泛化差在预训练早期即出现，且标准干预难以消除。即使两份完全相同的同语言副本，只要token空间不相交，也会产生知识隔离，证明不相交的token空间是跨语言知识泛化的根本障碍。将语言经词级翻译映射到共享token空间后，跨语言知识泛化显著提升，最多恢复12.6%的母语学习效率，是基线的14倍。
AI.conclusion: 不相交的token空间是阻碍LLM跨语言知识泛化的根本原因。共享token空间（如通过词级翻译）是一种简单有效的改进途径，可大幅提升跨语言知识迁移效率。

title: AUDITPLAN: Commit, Then Answer for Auditable Safety Alignment
summary: Safety tuning pipelines judge only the final answer, which makes it difficult to distinguish robust refusal from two undesirable shortcuts: blanket refusal on benign requests and polished but unfaithful safety rationales that do not actually constrain the answer. We propose AUDITPLAN, a single-model plan-then-answer approach where the model first emits a compact structured safety plan and then answers conditioned on it. The plan records a threat label, intended action, and explicit constraints, enabling machine-checkable auditing while remaining hidden from users at deployment. We train this behavior with supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning with FAITHGATE, a reward-gating objective that grants answer reward only when the safety plan is correct. This discourages safe-looking but unfaithful behavior and promotes tighter plan-answer coupling. Across Qwen backbones, AUDITPLAN improves both robustness and auditability: on Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, FAITHGATE reduces ASR from 24.0% to 11.6%, LSR from 1.0% to 0.36%, and over-refusal from 11.0% to 2.0%, outperforming answer-only RL, free-form explanation, and weighted-sum structured rewards. Similar trends hold for Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct. Larger-model confirmation runs on Qwen-3-4B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct preserve the same trend suggesting that explicit internal commitments can make safety alignment more faithful, robust, and auditable.

AI.tldr: 提出 AUDITPLAN 的"先规划后回答"单模型安全对齐方法，通过结构化安全计划与 FAITHGATE 奖励门控强化计划-答案耦合，在多个 Qwen 模型上同时提升鲁棒性与可审计性。
AI.motivation: 现有安全调优流程只对最终答案进行评判，难以区分真正稳健的拒绝与两种不良捷径：对良性请求的"一刀切"过度拒绝，以及表面精致但与答案脱节、并未真正约束答案的安全理由（不忠实解释）。因此需要一种可机器审计、能约束答案生成的内部机制。
AI.method: AUDITPLAN：单模型"先规划后回答"。模型先输出紧凑的结构化安全计划（含威胁标签、意图动作、显式约束），再以该计划为条件生成答案；计划在部署时对用户隐藏以便审计。训练分两步：监督微调（SFT）后接强化学习，使用 FAITHGATE 奖励门控目标——只有当安全计划正确时才发放答案奖励，从而抑制"看起来安全却不忠实"的行为，强化计划与答案的耦合。与仅答案 RL、自由形式解释、加权求和结构化奖励等基线对比。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 上，FAITHGATE 将 ASR 从 24.0% 降至 11.6%，LSR 从 1.0% 降至 0.36%，过度拒绝从 11.0% 降至 2.0%，优于仅答案 RL、自由形式解释与加权求和结构化奖励。Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 呈相同趋势；Qwen-3-4B-Instruct 与 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 的更大模型验证保持同样趋势。
AI.conclusion: 显式的内部承诺（结构化安全计划）可使安全对齐更忠实、更鲁棒、更可审计，且该收益在不同规模 Qwen 骨干上具有一致性。

title: A frontend-backend architecture for tool calls in full-duplex speech models
summary: Full-duplex speech-to-speech (S2S) models provide natural, low-latency conversational interaction and would benefit from the ability to use external tools and complete voice-agent tasks. We propose a frontend-backend architecture where a duplex speech-to-text frontend learns to emit a delegation token and forwards streaming ASR transcripts to a text-based backend LLM for tool calls. Tool-call results from the backend are injected back into the frontend through a lightweight prefill-and-repeat mechanism and then synthesized using streaming TTS to the user. Our approach largely preserves regular duplex turn-taking, interruption handling, and low-latency interaction as it requires minimal modifications to the frontend model. In a single-turn tool-call evaluation, our system achieves 92-97% tool-call recall, competitive tool-call prediction performance, and 81.2% accuracy in rejecting irrelevant calls. When equipped with a larger backend (e.g., Qwen3-235B-A22B), our system achieves competitive results on Full-Duplex-Bench-V3 compared to open and closed source models, and significantly outperforms GPT-realtime-mini and Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct on EVA-Bench. These results demonstrate that backend delegation is an effective and modular approach for combining natural duplex speech interaction with strong agentic tool-call capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出前端-后端架构的全双工语音到语音模型：前端为双工语音识别模型，学习发出委派令牌并将流式转写转发给后端文本大模型进行工具调用，结果经轻量预填充-重复机制注入前端并由流式TTS合成语音，从而实现保留自然双工交互的低延迟代理能力。
AI.motivation: 全双工S2S模型能提供自然、低延迟的会话交互，但缺乏使用外部工具和完成语音代理任务的能力。直接在前端集成工具调用可能破坏双工轮次切换、打断处理与低延迟特性，因此需要一种模块化方案来融合强大的代理式工具调用能力。
AI.method: 采用前端-后端解耦架构：1) 双工语音识别前端学习发射委派令牌，并将流式ASR转写转发给文本后端LLM；2) 后端LLM执行工具调用；3) 工具调用结果通过轻量级预填充-重复（prefill-and-repeat）机制注入回前端；4) 前端最终经流式TTS将回复合成给用户。该方法对前端模型改动极小，从而基本保留原有双工轮次切换与打断处理能力。
AI.result: 单轮工具调用评测中，系统达到92-97%工具调用召回率、具有竞争力的工具调用预测性能，以及81.2%的无关调用拒绝准确率。搭配更大后端（如Qwen3-235B-A22B）时，在Full-Duplex-Bench-V3上取得与开源及闭源模型相当的结果，并在EVA-Bench上显著优于GPT-realtime-mini和Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct。
AI.conclusion: 后端委派是一种有效且模块化的方法，能够将自然的全双工语音交互与强大的代理式工具调用能力相结合，在保持低延迟与双工行为的同时获得竞争性的工具调用性能。

title: Verification of PETSc with CIVL using LLM-generated ACSL contracts and deterministic driver generation
summary: Parallel numerical libraries such as PETSc are widely used in science and engineering applications where wrong results can have costly consequences. Despite this, numerical libraries are rarely formally verified. One of the challenges is the need for an expert to hand-write a specification and manually apply a verification tool, often requiring the development of a harness or driver, all of which can contain additional bugs that lead to false positives or false negatives during verification. With recent advancements in large language models (LLMs), it is tempting to generate such drivers and reference models automatically, but one-shot generation based on a simple prompt is brittle and leads to additional unverified code that needs to be audited. In this paper, we present an approach to use LLMs in a limited setting to generate a small, human-certifiable ACSL contract from the function's documentation, combined with a deterministic toolchain that supports a restricted ACSL profile and generates a driver that uses the CIVL verifier to check the implementation against the contract and, when available, an existing reference model. We demonstrate the pipeline end-to-end on three PETSc functions: MatAXPY (reference model already exists), MatAYPX (no reference model, so the certified contract is the sole oracle), and the non-compressing mode of MatFilter (no reference model, with more complex, conditional behavior). With this pipeline, we were able to discover a bug in PETSc's MatAYPX function that was previously undiscovered and had been present in the code since 1997.

AI.tldr: 提出一种受限使用LLM的验证流水线：由LLM依据函数文档生成小规模、可人工认证的ACSL契约，再由确定性工具链生成驱动，用CIVL验证器对照契约（及已有参考模型）检查实现，在PETSc三个函数上端到端验证并发现MatAYPX中隐藏自1997年的缺陷。
AI.motivation: 并行数值库（如PETSc）广泛用于科学与工程计算，错误结果代价高昂，但这类库很少被形式化验证。主要障碍在于：需专家手工编写规约并手动应用验证工具，往往还要开发测试驱动（harness/driver），而这些人工产物本身可能含缺陷，导致误报或漏报。LLM的出现使自动生成驱动与参考模型具有吸引力，但基于简单提示的一次性生成很脆弱，会产生需要额外审计的未验证代码。
AI.method: 将LLM的使用限定在受限范围内：仅从函数文档生成体量小、可人工认证的ACSL契约；配合确定性工具链，该工具链支持一个受限的ACSL profile，并自动生成驱动，调用CIVL验证器检验实现是否满足契约，且在存在参考模型时同时对照参考模型。在PETSc的MatAXPY（已有参考模型）、MatAYPX（无参考模型，认证契约即唯一判定依据）以及MatFilter的非压缩模式（无参考模型、行为更复杂且带条件分支）三个函数上完成端到端演示。
AI.result: 该流水线在三个PETSc函数上成功端到端运行；并借此发现PETSc的MatAYPX函数中存在一个此前未被发现的缺陷，该缺陷自1997年起就存在于代码中。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM限制在生成可人工认证的ACSL契约、其余环节交由确定性工具链与CIVL验证器完成，是一条可行且有效的数值库形式化验证路径；它能覆盖有/无参考模型的不同情形，并已实际发现长期潜伏的实现缺陷。

title: Don't Repeat Yourself: Self-Supervised Fine-Tuning for Coverage
comment: 19 pages, including references and appendices. v2: corrected appendix ablation, figure and formatting fixes
summary: In verifiable domains such as math and coding, finding one correct solution among many attempts can matter more than the pass rate of each attempt. Post-training can concentrate large language model outputs around a few modes, while increasing sampling temperature has limited effectiveness. We introduce Don't Repeat Yourself Supervised Fine-Tuning (DRY-SFT), a post-training method that increases output diversity and coverage: the probability of at least one correct solution among many attempts. DRY-SFT has two stages. First, for each problem, sequentially generate K solutions, showing the model all prior attempts and asking for a different solution. Second, fine-tune on each attempt independently, removing prior attempts from the context. The process uses no reward, verifier, or correctness filter. On HumanEval+, MBPP+, and DS-1000, DRY-SFT raises pass@100 by 10.8, 12.5, and 12.4 percentage points, respectively, at a small cost to pass@1. Structural diversity, measured by abstract syntax tree edit distance among passing solutions, rises significantly on all three benchmarks. DRY-SFT also solves 244 of 600 problems that the base model did not solve in the same 200 attempts. Across nine open-weight models, lower structural diversity of the base model significantly predicts larger DRY-SFT gains, indicating that the method is especially effective on more mode-collapsed models.

AI.tldr: DRY-SFT：一种无需奖励/验证器的后训练方法，通过两阶段流程（先在同一问题上下文内连续生成K个不同解，再独立微调每次尝试）提升大模型输出多样性与覆盖率，在HumanEval+、MBPP+、DS-1000上pass@100分别提升10.8、12.5、12.4个百分点。
AI.motivation: 在数学、代码等可验证领域，"多次尝试中至少有一个正确解"比单次尝试的通过率更重要。然而后训练会使大语言模型输出集中在少数模态上，而单纯提高采样温度效果有限，因此需要提升输出多样性与覆盖率的方法。
AI.method: DRY-SFT分两阶段：第一阶段针对每个问题顺序生成K个解，向模型展示所有先前的尝试并要求给出不同的解；第二阶段对每次尝试独立微调，从上下文中移除此前的尝试。整个过程不使用奖励模型、验证器或正确性筛选。
AI.result: 在HumanEval+、MBPP+、DS-1000上，pass@100分别提升10.8、12.5、12.4个百分点，而pass@1仅有小幅下降；以抽象语法树编辑距离衡量的结构多样性在三个基准上均显著提升；在基础模型200次尝试未能解决的600道题中，DRY-SFT额外解决了244道。在九个开源权重模型上，基础模型结构多样性越低，DRY-SFT增益越大。
AI.conclusion: DRY-SFT无需奖励或验证信号即可有效提升模型输出的多样性与覆盖率，且对模态坍缩更严重的模型效果更佳，表明其适合用于缓解后训练导致的输出同质化问题。

title: Can Vision-Language Models Judge Olympic Diving? From Reasoning to Scores in Zero-Shot Action Quality Assessment
summary: Automated action quality assessment (AQA) in Olympic sports remains a challenging task due to the complexity of human motion and the subjectivity inherent in expert judging. This work evaluates the capability of open-source Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to perform zero-shot action quality assessment on Olympic diving videos using the AQA-7 benchmark dataset. In this regard, a regression-based framework is pro-posed to leverage both the semantic reasoning and phase-level sub-scores generated by the VLMs, combining TF-IDF vectorization, dimensionality reduction, and ensemble learning to predict final competition scores. Experimental results show that standalone VLMs achieve moderate Spearman correlations below 0.32, while the proposed ensemble regression framework substantially improves performance in the reported evaluation, reaching a Spearman correlation of 0.67 with a four-model configuration. Textual reasoning features con-sistently outperformed raw numerical sub-scores, highlighting the richness of VLM-generated explanations for action quality analysis. These findings suggest that VLMs hold strong potential as assistive tools for explainable and semi-automated sports performance evaluation. The code is publicly available on GitHub https://github.com/hvelesaca/olympic diving judge vlm

AI.tldr: 本文评估开源视觉语言模型在奥运跳水动作质量评估中的零样本能力，并提出基于TF-IDF、降维与集成学习的回归框架融合VLM语义推理与分阶段子分数，最终获得0.67的Spearman相关性。
AI.motivation: 奥运跳水等项目的动作质量评估因人体运动复杂且专家打分主观性强而具有挑战性，作者希望探究开源视觉语言模型能否在零样本条件下胜任该任务。
AI.method: 在AQA-7基准数据集上对奥运跳水视频做零样本评估，构建回归框架：融合VLM生成的语义推理与分阶段子分数，采用TF-IDF向量化、降维和集成学习预测最终比赛得分。
AI.result: 单独使用VLM时Spearman相关性低于0.32；所提集成回归框架在四模型配置下将Spearman相关性提升至0.67；文本推理特征的性能持续优于原始数值子分数。
AI.conclusion: VLM在可解释、半自动化的运动表现评估中具有较强潜力，可作为辅助工具，代码已开源于GitHub。

title: Open-vocabulary 3D object detection with promptable segmentation
summary: Three-dimensional object detection for autonomous driving is dominated by detectors trained on large corpora of human-annotated 3D boxes. Such a detector learns a fixed category list, and everything outside it is invisible. This paper asks whether the task can be solved training-free and open-vocabulary. A promptable segmentation model (SAM3), queried with class names as text prompts, supplies instance masks in the vehicle's six surround-view cameras, and the masks are turned into metric 3D boxes using the geometry of the scene. The core is a controlled three-stage comparison on nuScenes in which 2D detection is held fixed and only the source of 3D geometry changes. Geometry predicted from images alone reaches 0.183 mean average precision (mAP) under the official protocol; fitting boxes from raw LiDAR points inside the same masks with training-free rules reaches 0.298 mAP / 0.348 nuScenes detection score (NDS) at zero labeling cost; borrowing supervised box geometry at inference time lifts the same detections to 0.413 mAP / 0.555 NDS, which locates the pipeline's largest deficit in measurement precision rather than 2D detection, while class confusion and confidence calibration survive that substitution. Reversing the direction, a three-state camera-witness rule built from the same masks improves a supervised LiDAR-only detector from 0.596 to 0.630 mAP, roughly half the gain of fully supervised camera fusion, with no training. A coverage analysis shows that SAM3 finds 84% of in-range objects with a correctly named mask; the classes that fail in the official metric are misnamed or geometrically unforgiving, not unseen.

AI.tldr: 该论文探索了无需训练且开放词汇的3D目标检测方案：利用可提示分割模型SAM3以类别名作文本提示，在六路环视相机中生成实例掩码，再借助场景几何将掩码转为度量3D框；在nuScenes上以受控三阶段实验隔离2D检测与3D几何来源，量化了各环节贡献与瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶3D检测器依赖大规模人工标注3D框训练，只能学习固定类别列表，列表之外的物体被视为不可见，泛化性受限。论文希望验证3D检测能否以无需训练、开放词汇的方式完成，并定位该范式的性能瓶颈所在。
AI.method: 在nuScenes上进行受控三阶段对比，固定2D检测、仅改变3D几何来源：（1）仅由图像预测几何；（2）在同一掩码内用无训练规则拟合原始LiDAR点；（3）推理时借用监督式框几何。反向实验中，用同一掩码构造三状态相机见证规则，用于增强仅LiDAR的监督检测器。并进行覆盖度分析。
AI.result: 仅图像几何达0.183 mAP；掩码内无训练LiDAR拟合达0.298 mAP/0.348 NDS，零标注成本；借用监督框几何提升至0.413 mAP/0.555 NDS，说明最大短板在测量精度而非2D检测，且类别混淆与置信度校准在该替换下仍保持稳定。反向增强使仅LiDAR检测器从0.596提升至0.630 mAP，约为全监督相机融合增益的一半，且无需训练。SAM3以正确命名掩码覆盖84%范围内目标；官方指标中失败的类别是被误命名或几何上难以处理，而非未见类别。
AI.conclusion: 训练-free、开放词汇的3D检测在nuScenes上具备可行性，其主导瓶颈是3D几何测量精度而非2D分割检测；无训练LiDAR拟合可获得零标注成本的可用性能，掩码亦可反向增强监督LiDAR检测器。开放词汇失败主要源于命名错误与几何不适，而非类别未见过。

title: The Role of Fine-grained Harm Signals in LLM Safety
summary: Prior work has shown that internal harmfulness representations in large language models vary across risk categories, while sharing a common general harm representation component. This raises a question about the role of the category-specific component beyond general harm representation in LLM safety. To answer this question, we isolate the category-specific component by removing shared general harmfulness representation from each categorical harmfulness representation, yielding a category residual that is orthogonal to general harmfulness at every layer. Using activation steering with category residuals across 11 risk categories in 3 instruction-tuned LLMs, we find that whether category residuals encode harmfulness varies across categories, and that this category-wise pattern is similar across models. Whether category residuals induce refusal also varies across categories, but this category-wise pattern is more model-dependent. We also find that category residuals increase LLMs' downstream internal alignment with shared general harmfulness representation. Together, these findings demonstrate that more fine-grained category residuals should also be considered beyond shared general harmfulness representation to fully understand LLM safety. More broadly, our findings show that even a direction orthogonal to a concept at one layer can contribute to the concept's downstream amplification.

AI.tldr: 论文通过正交分解法分离出类别残差表征，用激活引导在3个指令微调LLM的11类风险上测试，发现类别残差在编码危害性与诱发拒绝上均呈类别依赖模式，且能增强下游对齐，表明细粒度类别表征对理解LLM安全不可忽视。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明LLM内部危害性表征在不同风险类别间存在差异，但共享一个通用危害表征成分。这引出一个关键问题：在通用危害表征之外，类别特异性成分在LLM安全中扮演什么角色？
AI.method: 从每类危害表征中剔除共享的通用危害表征，得到在每一层都与通用危害性正交的"类别残差"；随后在3个指令微调LLM、11个风险类别上使用激活引导（activation steering）对类别残差进行干预分析。
AI.result: 类别残差是否编码危害性因类别而异，且该类别模式在不同模型间相似；类别残差是否诱发拒绝也因类别而异，但该模式更具模型依赖性；类别残差能提升LLM下游内部与共享通用危害表征的对齐程度。
AI.conclusion: 理解LLM安全不能仅依赖共享通用危害表征，还需考虑更细粒度的类别残差；更广泛地，即使在某一层与某概念正交的方向，也能促进该概念的下游放大。

title: LinePilot Digitizer: Line-Plot Recovery with Manual and Automatic Calibration
summary: Recovering numerical series from line plots requires accurate axis calibration and reliable curve extraction. We present LinePilot Digitizer (LinePilot), which combines continuous color-based curve recovery with three calibration modes: LinePilot (standard), LinePilot (enhanced), and LinePilot (OCR). We also introduce DigitizerBench, the first dedicated benchmark for systematically evaluating digitizer performance, using an orthogonal design spanning signal, rendering, and plot-structure factors with complementary automatic and human-guided evaluations. We evaluate performance using failure-penalized capped normalized root-mean-square error (FPC-NRMSE), which assigns unit loss to missing, unusable, or catastrophically inaccurate outputs. On DigitizerBench-Full, LinePilot (OCR) achieves the lowest mean FPC-NRMSE (0.672) and highest trusted usability (38.2%) among the tested automatic pipelines. On DigitizerBench-Lite, LinePilot (enhanced) achieves the lowest mean FPC-NRMSE (0.081), 100% output success, and highest trusted usability (93.3%). The orthogonal benchmark design further enables factor analysis to identify the factors that most significantly affect digitizer performance. Together, the three calibration modes provide a practical trade-off between automation, user control, and accuracy within a shared curve-recovery workflow.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出LinePilot Digitizer（LinePilot），通过基于颜色的连续曲线恢复与三种校准模式，从折线图中恢复数值序列；同时构建首个专用评测基准DigitizerBench，并采用FPC-NRMSE指标进行评估。
AI.motivation: 从折线图中恢复数值序列需要准确的坐标轴校准和可靠的曲线提取，但此前缺乏系统性评测数字化工具性能的专用基准和统一指标。
AI.method: LinePilot结合连续的颜色曲线恢复与三种校准模式：标准、增强和OCR；并构建DigitizerBench，采用正交设计覆盖信号、渲染和图表结构因素，结合自动与人工引导评测；使用FPC-NRMSE作为评测指标。
AI.result: 在DigitizerBench-Full上，LinePilot（OCR）取得最低平均FPC-NRMSE（0.672）和最高可信可用性（38.2%）；在DigitizerBench-Lite上，LinePilot（增强）取得最低平均FPC-NRMSE（0.081）、100%输出成功率和最高可信可用性（93.3%）。
AI.conclusion: 三种校准模式在共享曲线恢复流程中提供了自动化、用户控制与精度之间的实用权衡；正交基准设计还可通过因素分析识别对数字化性能影响最显著的因素。

title: Riemannian--Lorentz Fusion of Vision Transformers and State-Space Models
summary: Scaling deep learning faces critical bottlenecks: data exhaustion, exponential training costs, and resource concentration. Model merging combines pre-trained checkpoints without gradient descent, offering orders-of-magnitude savings versus retraining. Combining independently trained vision models is difficult when their architectures and parameter shapes differ. Existing weight-space merging methods generally assume aligned, shape-compatible checkpoints, whereas a Vision Transformer (ViT) and a state-space model (SSM) implement token mixing with different operators. We study a hybrid Heterogeneous merging setting that retains both architectures while aligning parameter groups by semantic role. Our proposed Riemannian--Lorentz Parameter Fusion (RLPF) method projects aligned groups to common coordinates, lifts selected coordinates to the Lorentz hyperboloid model of hyperbolic space, computes a regularized geodesic barycenter, and decodes the result into the two branches. A learned gate then combines branch logits for each input. Component groups use fixed curvature values, with normalization parameters treated as Euclidean. In the results available in this manuscript, the fine-tuned system obtains 82.37\% on CIFAR-10, 75.04\% on Oxford-IIIT Pet, and 78.58\% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K; the corresponding best-parent accuracies are 76.54\%, 71.42\%, and 76.42\%. On ImageNet-1K, the reported pre-fine-tuning initialization reaches 77.80\%. These results support further study of geometry-aware heterogeneous fusion, but not a training-free single-checkpoint merge: RLPF is a two-branch hybrid whose gate and reported final models are trained.

AI.tldr: 提出Riemannian–Lorentz Parameter Fusion (RLPF)，在异构架构（ViT与SSM）间按语义角色对齐参数组，投影到共同坐标并在Lorentz双曲面上计算正则化测地重心，再解码回双分支，配合学习门控融合logits。微调后CIFAR-10 82.37%、Oxford-IIIT Pet 75.04%、ImageNet-1K top-1 78.58%。
AI.motivation: 深度学习的扩展面临数据枯竭、训练成本指数增长与资源集中等瓶颈。模型融合无需梯度下降即可组合预训练检查点，比重新训练节省数量级成本。但异构架构（如ViT与SSM）因参数形状与token混合算子不同，现有权重空间融合方法普遍假设检查点对齐且形状兼容，难以直接组合，因此需要研究保留双架构的异构融合设置。
AI.method: RLPF：将按语义角色对齐的参数组投影到共同坐标；选取部分坐标提升到双曲空间的Lorentz双曲面模型；计算正则化测地重心；将结果解码回两个分支。组件组使用固定曲率值，归一化参数按欧几里得处理。最后用学习到的门控逐输入组合分支logits。
